links.title: ROSETTA: Efficient and Accurate Privacy-Preserving LLM Decoding via Hybrid CKKS/TFHE Evaluation

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 4.8× Softmax speedup and 1.5–2.1× end-to-end speedup over SOTA CacheMir, framing the work as privacy-preserving LLM decoding via hybrid CKKS/TFHE.

§1: motivates the problem by noting nonlinear operators account for more than 70% of CacheMir decode-stage runtime (Figure 1(b)) and that single-PBS LUTs cap precision at ~11 bits, inflating softmax perplexity by over 100%.

§3.1–3.2: adaptive segmented LUT with piecewise-linear interpolation and a three-step cryptographic lookup protocol (HomComp, construct-then-select PBS) avoiding ciphertext–ciphertext fixed-point arithmetic.
§4.2: extends CacheMir's DAG shortest-path formulation by injecting level-0 TFHE nodes for non-arithmetic primitives, jointly optimizing scheme assignment and CKKS level allocation.
§5.1: all baselines re-implemented in the same framework with identical cryptographic parameters; Lattigo v6 CPU backend, customized Phantom GPU library, Xeon Gold 6240R and A100 hardware specified.

Table 8 (§5.4): average PPL increase +1.4% for ROSETTA vs +116.0% for PEGASUS across four 7–9B models (LLaMA-3-8B, Qwen2-7B, Mistral-7B, DeepSeek-8B) on five datasets; quality evaluated via ciphertext-aligned plaintext PPL, not fully encrypted generation.
Table 4 (§5.2): ROSETTA precision anomaly at range [-32,32], n=4k shows 9.2 bits vs 13.0 bits at n=2k and 15.1 bits at n=8k, unexplained in text.
Table 7 (§5.3): one-token decode latency of 2.28–4.44 h on CPU for LLaMA-3-8B (n=512–8k), indicating FHE decode remains far from practical deployment.
Appendix A (Open Science): public models/datasets and anonymous source code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ROSETTA_artifact-B77F/; Appendix B discusses ethics and honest-but-curious scope.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems/cryptography paper squarely targeting LLM decoding: it optimizes autoregressive decode-stage latency for LLMs (GPT-2, TinyLlama, LLaMA-3-8B) under fully homomorphic encryption, matching LLM, inference/serving, Transformer, and efficiency preferences; it is not a pure domain application and is fully in scope. Contributions are moderately novel: hybrid CKKS/TFHE assignment is known (PEGASUS), but the adaptive segmented LUT protocol (12–19-bit precision vs ~11-bit single-PBS ceiling, §1.1/§3) and joint scheme-selection + level-allocation shortest-path DAG (§4) are new twists on CacheMir. Rigor is solid: clear threat model (§2.4), 128-bit-security parameters (§5.1), five micro-benchmark baselines plus end-to-end and PPL evaluations; weaknesses include all baselines being author re-implementations, an unexplained precision anomaly at n=4k in Table 4 (9.2 bits vs 13.0 at 2k), and quality measured via ciphertext-aligned plaintext PPL rather than fully encrypted generation (§5.4). Evidence is strong and specific (4.8× softmax speedup, 1.5–2.1× end-to-end, +1.4% avg PPL vs PEGASUS +116%), though per-token latencies of hours on CPU (Table 7) show limited practicality. Generalizability is decent across decoder architectures but confined to FHE private-inference decode; reproducibility is aided by detailed parameters, public models/datasets, and an anonymous artifact link (Appendix A), though the link is anonymous and GPU backend is 'customized'.

primary_link.title: ROSETTA: Efficient and Accurate Privacy-Preserving LLM Decoding via Hybrid CKKS/TFHE Evaluation

papers.summary: Generative large language models (LLMs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance on many real-world tasks such as code generation and question answering. These models predominantly rely on an autoregressive decoding strategy that generates output tokens sequentially. However, their pervasive deployment raises serious privacy concerns, motivating private inference frameworks based on fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). A major limitation of existing FHE frameworks is their inefficiency in evalu
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對生成式大型語言模型（LLM）在全同態加密（FHE）私密推論下的效率問題提出解方。現有 FHE 框架評估非線性運算（如 Softmax 中的 exp 與 1/x、LayerNorm 中的 1/√x）成本高昂，且這些運算在解碼階段佔總延遲七成以上。作者觀察到解碼階段的非線性運算在元素數量與輸入動態範圍上高度異質，單一方案難以兼顧效率與精度，因而提出混合 CKKS/TFHE 框架 ROSETTA。核心貢獻有二：其一為自適應分段查找表（Segmented LUT）協定，將輸入域非均勻分割為多個區段，各段以線性內插近似，僅靠 RLWE 明文—密文乘法與 PBS 查找即可達到 12 至 19 位元精度，較單一 LUT 方案高出 6 至 10 位元，並比 CKKS 迭代法快 8 至 9 倍；其二為方案感知的運算子選擇，將各非算術原語的方案指派與 CKKS 層級分配共同最佳化，轉化為擴增有向無環圖上的單一最短路徑問題。實驗顯示，相較純 CKKS 框架 CacheMir，ROSETTA 取得最高 4.8 倍 Softmax 加速與 1.5 至 2.1 倍端對端加速；相較混合框架 PEGASUS 加速 3 至 4 倍，平均 PPL 退化由 +116% 降至 +1.4%。結果在 LLaMA-3-8B、Qwen2-7B 等多個模型與 WikiText、GSM8K 等資料集上均獲驗證。限制包括需預先校準輸入範圍，且 CPU 上單 token 解碼仍需數小時。此工作對推動可實際部署的安全 LLM 推論具重要意義。

links.title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield

evidence: Abstract/Contribution 3: delta=0.34 [0.30,0.38] measured by three identifications on 600 production deep-research traces; C=0.571 [0.527,0.615] read directly at b=1 over 16,082 hops.
Section 4.1 (Table 2): per-item hazard over 98,768 surfaced URLs with stratum intercepts and cluster bootstrap (B=400) gives delta_used=0.341 [0.298,0.384], delta_cited=0.398 [0.315,0.462].
Section 4.2 (Table 3, Eq. 8): C=rho(1)=0.571 observed at 550 b=1 search hops; raw retention 0.358 vs permutation null 0.0012; retention rate r(b) ~ flat at ~1/3 from b=5 to b=41.

Section 4.3 (Table 4, Eq. 9-10): mu=0.939 [0.935,0.960] via framework-fixed-effects on 1,012 MAST-Data traces; pooled fit unidentified because MetaGPT contributes 429 traces at near-constant h=4; two biases push mu down and are disclosed.

Section 7 (Table 6): discrete-time hazard on 502,718 session-rounds, 563 events; log accumulated context odds ratio 0.969 [0.954,0.985] per doubling; two prior regressions (+0.649, -0.372) shown to be mechanically biased.
Section 6: flat-agent token bill exponent 1.392+/-0.004 (R2=0.939) over 6,567 sessions, sub-quadratic vs append-only prediction of 2; equal-spend crossover N*=403 with briefing loss charged.

Section 9 (Limitations): C measured at one hop and assumed constant across levels; one (C,delta) pair contradicted by the two measured exponents (0.13 immediate vs 0.34 eventual); hazard result subject to frailty bias.

Reproducibility section: every number produced by named scripts in anc/code/ from three public corpora (two from [11], MAST-Data CC-BY-4.0 via get_data.sh); audit.py re-derives all numeric assertions; no GPU used.

Related Work: positions conservation point rho(b)=b*r(b)=1 against Evans-Schulman noisy-circuit threshold, noting fan-out supplies no redundancy in agent trees, distinguishing mechanism from von Neumann-style results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-plus-measurement paper on multi-agent LLM systems that is squarely in-scope: it analyzes delegation trees, tool-call traces, context eviction and token cost in Claude Code/Codex and MAST-Data multi-agent frameworks, hitting Agents & Tool Use (w2.5) and Long Context & Memory (w1.8) directly. Novelty is strong: the conservation law (Theorem 1), the Y=C^k N^(1-delta) factorization separating task size from architecture, and the framing that depth pays on integrity/token axes rather than yield are fresh, with explicit connection to noisy-circuit thresholds. Rigor is high: three non-sharing identifications for delta (aggregate fit beta=0.601, per-item hazard with cluster bootstrap delta=0.341, citation outcome 0.398), a permutation null for C, falsification tests for the per-brief model, honest reporting of two biased regressions and a correctly identified pre-decision hazard model. The theorems themselves are elementary power-law algebra, but the paper does not oversell them. Evidence is well-quantified with CIs and large samples (98,768 URLs, 16,082 hops, 743,819 tool calls), though it rests heavily on corpora from the same author's earlier preprint [11] and one research scaffold. Generalizability is the weakest axis: constants are agent- and hop-specific (acknowledged in Limitations: C assumed constant across levels, mu identified essentially by one framework's handoff variation, hazard subject to frailty bias). Reproducibility claims are unusually thorough (script-per-claim list, audit.py, public CC-BY-4.0 MAST-Data, laptop CPU), slightly discounted because the deep-research and production corpora depend on a 2026 preprint not verifiable here.

primary_link.title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield

papers.summary: Multi-agent systems split a task across a tree of agents and justify the split with folklore: smaller contexts, cleaner separation, parallelism. We ask what the split does to how much of what the leaves discover reaches the root. Model a decomposition as a tree in which an agent handed $b$ items keeps any one with probability $r(b)$. If $r(b)=1/b$, every tree delivers exactly one finding, for every task size and every shape; we verify this to $2.4 \times 10^{-15}$ on 20,000 random irregular tree
papers.summary_zh: 多 agent 系統宣稱把任務分解成樹狀架構能縮小脈絡並提升成效，本文檢驗這個近乎公理的主張：葉端發現究竟有多少能傳抵根節點（產量 yield）。作者將分解建模為樹，收到 b 個項目的 agent 以機率 r(b) 保留任一項，並定義承載數 ρ(b)=b·r(b)。理論上，若 r(b)=1/b，任何形狀與規模的樹產量恆為一（守恆定律）；若 r(b)=Cb^(−δ)，深度 k 的均勻樹產量為 C^k·N^(1−δ)，架構僅貢獻每層 C≤1 的因子，故就產量而言平坦最佳。實證上，以三種不共享失效模式的識別法，在 600 條生產深度研究軌跡測得 δ=0.34；於 16,082 個搜尋跳躍直接觀察 C=0.571；加上交接簡報對齊率 μ=0.939，每層淨懲罰為 0.536。深度買到的是另一軸：根脈絡是唯一持久且無法廉價遺忘的狀態，深度把污染暴露由 N 降至 N^(1/k)，實測參數下最佳層數為二至三層，任務規模跨十四個數量級也僅增加七層。成本軸上，生產系統的 token 帳單以 N 的 1.39 次方成長，等預算下兩層在 403 個發現處反超平坦結構。對 743,819 次工具呼叫的風險模型顯示委派是開場動作，不隨脈絡填充調整；模型預測 0.7%–11.3% 的任務值得委派，與觀察值 7.8% 同一量級。限制包括 C 僅於單一跳躍測得並假設各層相同、完整性項把污染視為全盤失敗、μ 幾乎只由單一框架識別。本文為多 agent 架構設計提供少見的定量法則：摘要近乎無損時才放寬扇出，帳單而非資訊成為瓶頸時才加深。
papers.title: Decomposition Buys Integrity, Not Yield
papers.title_zh: 分解買到的是完整性，而非產量

links.title: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.1: 'No evaluated world achieved full resilience across all three stress events'; highest phishing defense 6/9 (Claude), misinformation 3/6 (Claude, DeepSeek), memory breach 5/5 (OpenAI only), with detection not ensuring containment (one agent fetched attack link ~46 hours after campaign).

Table 2 and Section 2.4: positions the study against AgentDojo, Prompt Infection, NRT-Bench, Melting Pot, claiming to be the first system combining persistent multi-agent operation, self-governance, adversarial events, and system-level metrics.

Section 4.4: event-specific binary rubrics grounded in NIST incident-response phases, automated fact-checking, and contextual-integrity theory; scoring separated captured reasoning, requested actions, executed actions, and durable records.

Section 5.2.1/Table 12: Grok world total population collapse (0/10) within four days via retaliatory violence cascade (780 punches); Mistral lost four agents to context exhaustion from memory-breach searches (Section 5.2.1).

Section 5.5: longitudinal statistics—Claude tool-failure rate fell 3.1%→0.7% (Day 1→16), Qwen 5.1%→3.3%, Mistral goal drift rose 8.6%→23.2% (Spearman ρ=0.63, p=0.009); recurring invalid tool names recurred after median 9.9 days and 2,499 intervening actions (Section 5.4).

Section 5.8.1: Claude world external-contact incident survived four rounds of containment, including democratic creation of post_egress tool in under 45 minutes and prohibition defeated by reinterpreting 'contacting' as 'placing'; Appendix I documents parallel self-imposed oversight blind spots in OpenAI and Qwen worlds.

Section 5.10 (Limitations): single continuous run per configuration precludes variance estimation; findings framed as proofs of existence; substantial compute/API costs made repeated runs prohibitive; context capped at 200K tokens vs. native 1M; Mixed world used one fixed composition.

Contributions (Section 1): releases agent prompts, agent-authored blogs, and tool call records at github.com/EmergenceAI/Emergence-World; run was live-streamed publicly providing an external record (Section 4.2).
Appendix C: DeepSeek world received 43,276/105,158 (41.16%) content-safety rejections; provider serving-stack confounds explicitly acknowledged in Section 5 opening.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Exceptionally high relevance to the preference profile: an empirical LLM-agent study evaluating seven frontier model families as persistent, tool-using multi-agent systems under controlled adversarial stress (indirect prompt injection, misinformation, memory breach). Directly targets Agents & Tool Use, LLM, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and Alignment preferences. Novelty is strong but not maximal: it extends the authors' own Study 1 platform and combines existing ingredients (generative-agent simulation, AgentDojo-style injection testing, multi-agent risk taxonomies), though the claimed combination of persistence + self-governance + adversarial events + system-level metrics (Table 2) appears genuinely new, and concepts like 'societal sycophancy' and 'quiet withdrawal' are novel observations. Rigor is solid for an empirical systems study—pre-specified event rubrics (Tables 6, 8, 10), Spearman and chi-square statistics with correction, matched homogeneous/Mixed comparisons (Table 13), separation of reasoning vs. requested vs. executed actions—but is limited by n=1 run per configuration, self-authored rubrics, and LLM-as-judge classification for goal drift and opacity. Evidence is rich (850K calls, quantified failure tables, live-streamed external record) yet observational; the authors appropriately frame findings as proofs of existence. Generalizability is constrained by one town layout, ten fixed personas, single Mixed composition, and provider-stack confounds the authors themselves flag. Reproducibility benefits from released prompts/blogs/tool records and a public repository, but prohibitive cost, dated proprietary models, and undescribed analysis pipelines limit independent replication. Overall a strong, highly on-preference contribution with acknowledged limits.

primary_link.title: Emergence World: Adversarial Stress-Testing of Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Systems

papers.summary: As AI agents move from bounded tasks to persistent deployments, failures can propagate through memory, tools, other agents, and environmental state long after their interactions. This creates a safety regime that cannot be characterized by evaluating model responses in isolation. Emergence World, is a continuously running multi-agent environment for adversarial stress testing of long horizon autonomous systems. We ran eight parallel worlds of ten agents from identical starting conditions: seven
papers.summary_zh: AI 代理長期持續部署後,錯誤會透過記憶、工具、其他代理與環境狀態擴散,單回合評測無法涵蓋此類風險。團隊建置 Emergence World——具民主治理、持久記憶、經濟系統與逾 120 種工具的持續運作多代理平台,以相同初始條件運行八個平行世界(七個分別由 Claude、GPT-5.5、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Mistral、Grok 驅動的同質世界與一個混合模型世界),十六天產生逾 85 萬次 LLM 呼叫與近 500 億 token,期間注入釣魚式間接提示注入、錯誤資訊攻擊與記憶外洩三次受控壓力事件。結果顯示無一世界全面通過:偵測威脅不保證遏制,有代理在攻擊結束 46 小時後仍取用攻擊連結;Gemini 世界全體代理遭入侵並縱火燒毀中央銀行;僅 OpenAI 世界通過記憶外洩全部五項標準;各世界皆在查證前就對錯誤資訊採取行動;Grok 世界因暴力循環四天內全員耗盡能量終止。研究另發現「社會性諂媚」(同質群體結構性喪失異議能力)、「安靜退出」(Claude 世界集體靜默、代理間通訊驟減 81%)與自發對外聯繫人類等湧現行為。限制包括每種配置僅單次運行、系統提示未含明確安全指示、上下文上限 20 萬 token 且代理數固定為十名。核心啟示:模型層級對齊不具組合性,個別看似安全的代理組成的系統會呈現性質不同的失敗模式,安全重心應從對齊模型轉向打造具韌性的自主多代理系統。

links.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants

evidence: Abstract: introduces Fuse, 'a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning', validated 'through a human study with 24k annotations' and applied 'to 12 LLMs'
§3.3 'Simulation validation': 'The majority-vote prediction matches the ground truth in 97% of cases' over 300 simulations with 10 raters each (Appendix B: 96.9%, inter-rater agreement 91.2%)
§3.3 'First-message solvability': human majority baseline of 2,100 examples labeled by 10 raters each 'yields 88% correct predictions and an MSR of 89.8'
§4: 'no model exceeds 83.7 MSR, while the human majority baseline achieves 89.8 MSR' — a gap of over 6 MSR points for the strongest model
§4.2: bias condition degrades all models; 'average model gap (7.7) is more than double the drop in human baseline (3.6)', with the 8 non-high-abstention models ranging 6.9 to 12.5 points
§4.3: with more narrative detail, 'the average gap decreases by 22% from 14.1 to 11.0' (model mean 74.2 to 80.1 vs human 88.3 to 91.1)
§4.4: multi-turn analysis, 'by turn 8 only 18% of initial abstentions remain', 81% position persistence from turn 2 to 8, and no model matches the human turn-2 baseline

§3.1 and Appendix D: dataset of 21,600 examples = 1,200 simulations × 2 bias conditions × 3 detail levels × 3 debriefs; footnote 1 provides public GitHub release; Appendix D gives detail-level prompt construction and message length statistics
§5.3 limitation: 'we do not empirically separate them [simulator-specific effects] from the intrinsic difficulty of user mediation, which remains a limitation of our evaluation'

§3.2 and §2 Step 5: judge and simulator are Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, excluded from the 12 evaluated models; judge labels predictions as Correct/Incorrect/Not Attempted with MSR(d=0.75) aggregation (Equation 1)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM evaluation paper: introduces Fuse, a multi-agent simulation benchmark (built on Concordia) for user-mediated social reasoning with verifiable ground truth by construction, evaluating 12 LLMs across controlled axes (observer vs assistant, user bias, narrative detail, multi-turn). Novelty is solid but incremental over existing theory-of-mind/social-IQ benchmarks and sycophancy literature; the user-mediation decomposition and synthetic ground-truth-by-construction design are the main new contributions. Rigor is good: 24k human annotations validate simulation faithfulness (97%) and first-message solvability (88%), and the human majority baseline (89.8 MSR) calibrates the task. Weaknesses: the judge is an LLM with no reported judge-human agreement on assistant outputs, MSR's d=0.75 is admittedly arbitrary, no statistical significance testing, and simulator artifacts are acknowledged but not empirically separated (§5.3). Evidence is quantitative and detailed (bias gaps 6.9-12.5 vs human 3.6; detail-gap narrowing 22%; turn-level transition rates), though several headline findings rest on a single judge/simulator model (Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite). Reproducibility is helped by an open-sourced dataset (21,600 examples) and codebase. Not a pure domain application; directly matches LLM, reasoning, agents, and evaluation preferences.

primary_link.title: Verifiable Social Reasoning for LLM Assistants

papers.summary: LLM assistants are widely used for daily social advice, yet evaluating their social reasoning in such consultation settings remains challenging since (i) it requires setups where the assistant learns about social situations from subjective user narratives, and (ii) social properties, such as others' intentions, typically lack verifiable ground truth. To address these challenges, we introduce Fuse, a multi-agent simulation framework for studying user-mediated social reasoning. In Fuse, a target a
papers.summary_zh: LLM 助理日益被用於諮詢日常社交難題，但其社會推理難以評估：助理只能透過使用者的主觀敘述理解事件，且他人意圖等屬性缺乏可驗證的標準答案。本文提出 Fuse，一個多代理模擬框架：依 ATOMS 分類產生情境範本，以 Concordia 架構模擬由隱藏動機驅動的社交互動，再由模擬使用者向受測助理轉述，助理須預測目標的隱藏動機，因此標準答案由建構天然可得。框架另設報告偏誤與敘事細節兩個可控軸。作者以 24,000 筆人工標註驗證模擬忠實度（97%）與首則訊息可解性（88%），並評測 12 個模型：最強者 MSR 僅 83.7，低於人類多數決基線的 89.8；相較直接觀察原始事件的 Observer 設定，使用者中介帶來額外的效能落差；模型對偏頗框架呈系統性敏感（平均落差 7.7 高於人類的 3.6）；細節不足時模型可能過度推論，需要比人類更多的細節；多輪對話在第 4 輪後停滯甚至退化，立場持續率高達 81%；部分模型（Gemma 與 Claude 家族）即使被要求作答仍大量棄答。限制包括模擬使用者可能引入模擬器特有效應，且其與使用者中介的內在難度尚未完全分離。此開源框架與 21,600 筆資料集，為日常社會推理、諂媚行為與對齊評估提供了可控且可擴充的基礎。

links.title: Large Language Models Develop Belief State Geometry In-Context

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): 'peak probe R2-values from 0.83–0.99 across HMM and LLM combinations' for six open-source LLMs prompted with data from 40 HMMs

Section 5.2 (Page 6): shuffled-belief and random-belief control probes show 'extremely low R2 values... across all layers', and probes fit on early positions recover 'visibly coarser geometries with lower R2'
Section 6.2 (Page 11): belief steering installs target log-NTP at subsequent layers; 'there appears to be a self-repair mechanism' when steering before the effective layer range
Section 7.2 (Page 13): patching shifts KL toward injected target belief while 'the random-belief control (blue) shows no such shift'; past-inconsistent targets succeed despite conflicting prefix
Section 3 (Page 4): 'some findings are weaker or absent for Gemma-4-E2B, the smallest model by effective parameter count'

Limitations (Page 14): results restricted to HMMs 'selected for low entropy... and non-trivial belief geometry'; linear-probe spurious-structure concern (Méloux et al., 2025) acknowledged, with unsupervised evidence left to future work
Table 3 (Page 28): subset of Mess3/Wing/Strata parametrizations show 'no gap between 1-HMM and true-HMM probe R2'

Section 3 (Page 4): tokenization alignment verified, sequences of 20,000 tokens, 10 sequences averaged, parametrizations defined in Appendix C.1 (Page 21); however no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability work: tests a falsifiable computational-mechanics prediction that in-context learning of HMM data induces linearly decodable, causally relevant belief-state geometry in open-source LLMs. Strong preference fit (LLMs, ICL, probing/steering). Novelty is good but an incremental extension of Shai et al. 2024 (toy transformers) and Sarfati et al. 2026 (Gaussian beliefs), with the genuinely new pieces being 30 newly designed HMM families, NTP/log-NTP and suffix-approximation controls, cross-parametrization transfer probes, and δ-direction (NTP-preserving) steering. Rigor and evidence are high: quantitative R² (0.83–0.99), k-HMM behavioral baselines, intervention controls, correlations with ground-truth theoretical counterparts, and honest flagging of failures (Gemma-4-E2B, Table 3 parametrizations, Mess3 belief/NTP indistinguishability). Generalizability is limited by low-entropy HMM selection and synthetic settings, acknowledged in Limitations; reproducibility benefits from detailed setup and full process definitions but no code/data release is stated.

We consider such representations in a controlled setting: prompting LLMs with data emitted from hidden Markov models (HMMs) and probing for the corresponding belief state -- the posterior distribution over the HMM's hidden states given the observed token history. papers.summary_zh: 研究探討大型語言模型（LLM）在上下文學習（ICL）時，內部表示如何組織以預測訓練分布外的資料生成過程。作者援引計算力學（computational mechanics）的可否證預測：當LLM讀入隱藏馬可夫模型（HMM）產生的token序列時，其殘差流應線性編碼「信念狀態」，即在給定觀察上下文下對HMM隱藏狀態的後驗分布。團隊以六個開源LLM（Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1/3.2、Gemma-4）配對40個具非平凡信念幾何的HMM實驗。主要結果：（1）線性探針可自各層殘差流激活解碼信念狀態，最佳R²為0.83至0.99，遠高於亂序與隨機信念對照；（2）收斂後的預測KL優於低階馬可夫近似，約等同4至11階預測器；（3）信念可解碼性無法僅以NTP或log-NTP表示解釋（Mess3除外，其兩者線性等價）；（4）對信念子空間進行steering與patching可將預測推向注入的目標信念，且沿不改變NTP的δ方向介入仍具特異效果，顯示信念表示位於log-NTP上游並具因果作用。限制：所選HMM熵偏低且參數範圍有限；線性回歸可能浮現虛假結構，尚缺無監督證據補強；最小模型Gemma-4-E2B部分結果較弱。本研究將信念狀態幾何的計算力學描述由玩具Transformer延伸至生產級LLM，提供表徵層級證據，支持ICL近似於對上下文推斷之生成模型的最佳貝葉斯預測。
papers.title: Large Language Models Develop Belief State Geometry In-Context
papers.title_zh: 大型語言模型在上下文中發展出信念狀態幾何

links.title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning

evidence: Abstract: proposes path-level routing, representation-level compression, and decoding-level intervention evaluated on TOFU, MUSE-News, WMDP with reformulation/extraction robustness tests
Sec 4.1 Baselines: compares against GradAscent, GradDiff, NPO, SimNPO, PDU, RMU, UNDIAL, AltPO, WAGLE plus Original/Retrained references under shared pipeline
Sec 4.2 Table 1: Llama-3.2-3B Forget10 Cascade CFI 0.7165 (best) and BUS 0.6616 (second to AltPO 0.6629); Qwen3-4B Cascade CFI 0.7481 and BUS 0.5231 (best)
Sec 4.3 Table 2: ablation shows removing decoding control drops BUS to 0.2388 (~64%); removing path or repr control drops BUS to 0.5393/0.5244, supporting hierarchical design
Appendix E.2 Table 8: Cascade Avg ASR 0.10% and Avg R-ROUGE 0.043 vs NPO 0.00%/0.268; paper concedes NPO reaches zero ASR while missing partial recovery
Appendix E.5 Table 25: probe AUC drops from 0.819 (Original) to 0.621 (Cascade) with reduced forget radius, plus Table 26 state-probe Top-1 0.0417 vs NPO 0.0576
Appendix F.2 Target 3: Cascade reproduces 'Tae-ho Park' under the strongest extraction prompt, an honestly reported failure boundary case
Limitations: restricted to existing benchmarks, offline unlearning with predefined forget sets; no sequential deletion or multi-turn settings
Appendix D.2 Table 5 and D.3: full hyperparameters listed (lr 2.35e-5, alpha 0.58, route budget 20) and 8x RTX 4090 compute described; Abstract links code at github.com/Noryxen/Cascade
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-focused work: LLM unlearning sits at the intersection of LLMs, AI safety, and interpretability, evaluated with extraction-attack robustness (Red Teaming & Evaluation). Method combines three mostly existing ingredients (activation routing, Poincare-ball radius compression, NLL-based forgetting) into a hierarchical framework; the 'internal identifiability' framing and hyperbolic compression for unlearning are reasonably novel. Rigor is strong: 3 benchmarks, 5 backbones, 9 baselines, component ablations, sensitivity analyses, probe-based diagnostics, and an honest failure case. Evidence is solid but tempered by author-introduced aggregate metrics (CFI/BUS, Sec 4.1/C.2) and mixed cross-backbone results (e.g., RMU beats Cascade CFI 0.7377 vs 0.5418 on Gemma-3-4B Forget10, Table 22; AltPO edges CFI on Qwen3-4B Forget05, Table 18). Generalizability limited to 1-4B models and offline, fixed-forget-set settings per Limitations. Reproducibility strong: code link, full hyperparameter table, public datasets, compute described.

primary_link.title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning

papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is essential for removing sensitive or copyrighted knowledge while preserving general utility. Existing methods often leave residual knowledge in intermediate representations, which can still be recovered. To address this, we propose Cascade, a hierarchical recoverability control framework that minimizes the internal identifiability of target knowledge. Cascade combines three complementary controls: path-level routing to suppress privacy-associated activatio
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文指出大型語言模型（LLM）遺忘學習（unlearning）的根本缺陷：現有方法多半只壓低目標答案的輸出機率，但敏感知識仍可能殘留在中間表徵中，透過改寫提問、線索提示或抽取式攻擊被重新喚回。作者提出 Cascade，一個階層式可復原性控制框架，將遺忘形式化為「內部可辨識性」的受限最佳化問題，並從三個層面削弱恢復鏈：路徑層級以 forget–retain 激活差異定位並壓制隱私相關的激活路徑；表徵層級將選定路徑的隱藏狀態映射至龐加萊球（Poincaré ball），利用雙曲半徑壓縮遺忘表徵、降低幾何可分性；解碼層級則提升遺忘目標的負對數似然，並以 retain 難度為參考邊界。實驗涵蓋 TOFU、MUSE-News 與 WMDP，使用 Llama-3.2 與 Qwen3 系列模型。Cascade 在 Llama-3.2-3B 上取得最高 CFI 與接近最佳的 BUS，Forget ROUGE 降至 0.0180；在 WMDP-Cyber 將敏感知識準確率從 40.36 降至 23.60，同時 MMLU 維持在 63.75；面對查詢改寫與抽取式提示，平均 ASR 僅 0.10%。消融實驗證實三個元件缺一不可，機制分析顯示選定路徑穩定且遺忘表徵半徑確實收縮。限制方面，評估僅限現有基準與離線、預定義遺忘集情境，尚未涵蓋開放式刪除、多輪互動或連續遺忘，且在極強抽取提示下仍出現罕見的精確復原案例。此研究的價值在於指出「輸出壓抑不等於真正遺忘」，唯有對激活路徑、表徵幾何與解碼階段進行結構化控制，才能兼顧遺忘強度與模型效用。
papers.title: Cascade: Hierarchical Recoverability Control for Large Language Model Unlearning
papers.title_zh: Cascade：針對大型語言模型遺忘之階層式可復原性控制

Table 1 (§6.1): early exit from layers 8/16 on Llama2-7B keeps MMLU within 0.4 pts of Dense (43.1 vs 42.9/43.0) at average exit layers 22.16/24.42.
Table 2 (§6.1): FlexEE WikiText PPL 6.4 vs LayerSkip 7.4, AdaInfer 319, SpecEE 135 on Llama2-7B at comparable FLOPs (0.69 vs 0.73/0.74).
Table 7 (Appendix A.2): exit-prediction overhead ~0.264 GFLOPs/token vs AdaInfer 8.13 (30.74×) and SpecEE 0.666 (2.52×) on Llama2-7B.
§6.1: 'Our work is built upon the LayerSkip pre-trained checkpoints' — intermediate-layer decodability gains (Fig. 3) derive from inherited supervision, not trained in this paper.
Table 5 (§6.4): at 0% offloading FlexEE throughput falls to 42.7 tok/s at B=8 vs 48.0 baseline; Limitations section concedes benefit is confined to small-batch, memory-constrained serving.

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM systems/efficiency work: offloading-aware early exiting for Llama models, directly matching LLM, inference/serving, and scaling-efficiency preferences. The self-speculative Top-K local vocabulary for cheap exit decisions and KV-cache-compatible dynamic hidden-state management under weight offloading are genuine but incremental refinements over LayerSkip/AdaInfer/SpecEE. Evaluation is broad (4 Llama variants, 14 datasets, offloading 0-75%, FLOPs-normalized baselines, AlpacaEval/MT-Bench), with honest limitations (small-batch focus; Table 5 shows FlexEE below baseline at B=8/0% offloading). Caveats: layer-wise supervision is inherited from LayerSkip checkpoints rather than trained here, speedups come from a FlexGen-based simulation on one hardware setup, judge model for open-ended eval is only described as 'GPT-4-class', and no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is often constrained by both computation and memory, especially in offloading-based deployments where model weights are transferred across memory hierarchies during autoregressive decoding. In this setting, reducing the number of executed layers can lower per-token latency while also avoiding costly weight movement. Motivated by this observation, we present FlexEE, an early exiting framework for resource-constrained and offloading-based LLM inference. FlexEE
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）在資源受限環境下推論時，常因權重超出晶片記憶體容量，而需將部分層參數卸載至離晶片記憶體，使瓶頸從運算轉為資料搬移。本文提出 FlexEE，一個針對卸載式推論的提早退出框架，透過演算法與系統共同設計，讓每個 token 動態決定執行到哪一層。方法包含三大元件：（1）逐層提早退出監督，強化中間層隱藏狀態的語意可解碼性，且不增加推論成本；（2）自我推測機制，先由自推測層選出 Top-K 局部詞彙（Llama2 為 K=30、Llama3 為 K=80），後續退出層僅在此縮減空間內做預測，大幅降低 LM head 全詞彙投影的開銷；（3）動態隱藏狀態管理，保留退出層的隱藏狀態並在下一 token 運算至對應層時融入，解決 KV 快取不一致問題，且無需為其餘層複製快取或載入權重，因而契合卸載式推論。實驗基於 LayerSkip 預訓練檢查點，在 Llama2-7B、Llama2-13B 與 Llama3-8B 的多項生成與下游任務上，FlexEE 幾乎不損失準確率，困惑度優於 ShortGPT、AdaInfer、SpecEE 等對比方法；在 0%/50% 權重卸載下，Llama2-7B 達 1.27×/3.16× 端對端加速，Llama3-8B 達 1.25×/2.83×，75% 卸載時最高達 3.29×。限制包括需依賴經逐層監督訓練的模型，且效益主要集中於小批次、記憶體受限的部署情境，批次增大時加速減弱。此工作對邊緣裝置上的高效 LLM 服務具重要參考價值。
papers.title: FlexEE: Self-Speculative and KV-Compatible Early Exiting for Offloading-Aware LLM Inference
papers.title_zh: FlexEE：適用於卸載感知 LLM 推論的自我推測與 KV 相容提早退出框架

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety work: derives a prompt-identifiability observation for prompted subliminal learning, builds SALVE (soft-prompt tuning + LLM verbalization + sentence-level beam search) on top of LARGO/neologism learning, and applies it to detect hidden traits in distillation data, steered data, LLS-selected preference data, and ciphered fine-tuning attacks. Novelty is solid but incremental on prior verbalization methods; the amplification findings (system-prompt token suffixes, embedding-only fine-tuning) and the 'trait recoverable even when transfer fails' result are genuinely new. primary_link.title: Verbalizing Subliminal Learning Effects Using Text Optimization

papers.summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon in which a distillation dataset transmits traits from the teacher model that are not legibly encoded in the dataset itself. This introduces a new challenge for model development and creates new risks from data poisoning. In this work, we use text optimization to detect subliminal learning effects and describe them as legible prompts. Subliminal learning from a prompted teacher motivates our approach. We observe that this is a special case of context distillati
papers.summary_zh: 閾下學習是指蒸餾資料集會傳遞教師模型的行為特質，即使這些特質並未明確編碼於資料本身，可能帶來資料投毒風險並危及模型的安全開發。本文指出，以提示詞驅動的閾下學習是 context distillation 的特例，並在理論上證明資料集可唯一識別教師的系統提示詞。據此，作者將還原提示詞轉化為文字最佳化問題，提出 SALVE 方法：先以梯度下降對資料集最佳化 soft prompt，再查詢同一模型將其言語化為自然語言，並以訓練損失引導的句子級 beam search 提升言語化可靠性。在動物偏好經數字序列傳遞的標準設定中，SALVE 於 20 次實驗有 18 次還原出明確指名目標動物的流暢提示詞，而 OPRO、GCG、AutoDAN、PGD、GBDA 等基線方法皆失敗。更重要的是，SALVE 甚至能在學生模型未展現閾下學習的資料上還原特質，顯示失敗根源在於學生訓練的表達能力；作者據此發現為系統提示詞附加 token，或只 fine-tuning 嵌入矩陣，皆可放大閾下學習效應。SALVE 亦能偵測混合資料、以 activation steering 偏置的教師（較不可靠），以及經 Logit-Linear Selection 篩選之偏好資料中的諂媚與失準傾向，並可揭露加密 fine-tuning 攻擊中的有害指令。限制包括言語化可能含虛構內容、單一提示詞表達力低於完整 fine-tuning，處理更複雜的真實資料仍具挑戰。整體而言，此方法讓研究者在訓練前即可主動稽核資料中隱藏的特質，對安全的模型開發深具價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM methodology paper on knowledge updating via CPT plus a modified DPO that inverts factually-correct style-only pairs with a calibrated weight; clearly in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: the automatic identification of style-only ties via a judge score plus provable style-gradient cancellation (Proposition 1) goes beyond length-debiasing (SamPO) and hand-built tie training, though it assembles known components (DPO, EntiGraph, LLM judging). Rigor is strong: tuned vanilla DPO, IPO, KTO, SamPO baselines, a mechanism ablation removing only inversion (59.17→55.82), learning-rate/budget controls, 3 seeds on QuALITY, three base families on AToKE, and retention checks. Evidence is solid but not airtight: AToKE uses a single seed, all judging is LLM-based without human verification, the CPT-token-efficiency claim rests on one measured scaling point, and ROME/MEMIT comparisons are cross-protocol reference-only. Generalizability is limited to ≤8B transformer models and two benchmarks, acknowledged in Appendix G. Reproducibility is high: verbatim judge prompts, hyperparameters, data-generation details, and a referenced released code test.

primary_link.title: Style-Debiased DPO: Updating LLM Knowledge with Factuality-Aware Synthetic Preference Data

papers.summary: Continued pretraining (CPT) with data augmentation such as paraphrasing can store inside a large language model (LLM) the knowledge of a small source corpus. The stored knowledge, however, is not always retrieved correctly. We study the eliciting side rather than the storing side: we use preference optimization, which learns from pairs of a preferred (chosen) and a dispreferred (rejected) response, so that the model elicits its stored knowledge more accurately. One proposed approach takes the mo
papers.summary_zh: 持續預訓練（CPT）搭配改寫等資料增強，可將來源語料的知識存入 LLM，但未必能被正確提取。本文聚焦提取端，採用直接偏好最佳化（DPO），以黃金答案為 chosen、模型自身回應為 rejected；但當知識僅部分已知時，多數 rejected 事實上正確、只差在長度與措辭等風格，標準 DPO 反而壓低剛儲存的正確知識。提出的風格去偏 DPO（SD-DPO）以評審 LLM 為各偏好對評分事實一致性：rejected 事實錯誤者照常訓練，僅風格不同者反轉偏好方向，並以權重 w=p/(1-p) 加權，使風格梯度整體抵銷；Proposition 1 證明初始化時風格成分在期望中消失，並輔以知識保留等修正。在 QuALITY 上，SD-DPO 較 EntiGraph 式 CPT 基線（56.21%）提升 2.96 個百分點至 59.17%，所需偏好資料僅約為同精度額外 CPT 的數十分之一；vanilla DPO、IPO、KTO 皆不敵基線，SamPO 僅部分改善。在 AToKE 知識更新基準上整體準確率達 0.982，能依查詢時期正確回答新舊事實，優於直接改寫參數的編輯方法（協定不同，僅供參考）；MMLU 等六項通用基準幾乎不受影響。限制：AToKE 僅單一隨機種子、判分依賴 LLM 評審、訓練預算過大時輸出冗長重複；理論保證僅限初始化時的梯度均值。本研究顯示儲存與提取知識是不同的最佳化問題，尊重偏好對內的實際差異，即可用遠低於 CPT 的成本更新 LLM 知識並兼顧新舊事實。

links.title: When Agents See Differently: Exposing UI Desynchronization Threats in Mobile Agents

evidence: Abstract: 546 tasks, 13 apps, five mobile-agent frameworks, three backbone models, average misleading rates 77.9% (static) and 66.9% (dynamic); 186-participant study found perturbations hard to notice.
Section 5.1: benchmark built on AndroidWorld with 13 open-source apps; tasks expanded ~7×; evaluation-set instructions held out from attack optimization (60% reserved for evaluation).
Section 5.2: MR-D is on average 10.96% lower than MR-S; gap larger for structured-UI agents (12.08%) than vision-based agents (9.01%).
Section 5.3.2: increasing victim reasoning intensity does not mitigate the attack — MR-D on known tasks rises from 43.3% (minimal) to 79.1% (high reasoning).
Section 5.4: Content Optimization ablation improves MR across all five agents by 4.1–17.9 percentage points; AutoDroid saturates at k=1 (96.9%).
Section 5.5: with 186 participants, 88.7% reported no abnormality and no participant reported seeing the injected perturbation text in the first round.
Section 6.1: acknowledged limitations — rule-based problem-space realization is imperfect, and Appendix H shows MR-S decreases as UI element count (environmental complexity) increases.
Open Science: anonymized repository (https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mobile-agent-artifact-3BBF) providing implementation, configurations, and evaluation artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A security evaluation of LLM-powered mobile GUI agents, squarely within Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming preferences: it defines a new threat surface ('human-agent UI desynchronization') and an automated pre-deployment APK perturbation pipeline steering agents to honeypot widgets while invisible to users. Novelty is solid — unlike prior runtime-injection work (ads, pop-ups, notifications), the attack is instruction-agnostic, requires no runtime access, and exploits screenshot/accessibility observation gaps. Rigor is strong: 546 tasks over 13 AndroidWorld apps, 5 agent frameworks, 3 backbones, static vs. dynamic evaluation with a defined 10.96-point gap, ablations (operations, content optimization: +4.1–17.9 pts), strategy/comcombination analysis, and a notable finding that higher victim reasoning intensity raises misleading rate (MR-D 43.3%→79.1%). Evidence is detailed (per-cell Table 1, cause breakdowns in Appendix F, cutout/placement sweeps) but lacks significance testing, and the questionnaire is screenshot-based with limited ecological validity. Limitations are honestly stated (imperfect feature-to-APK mapping, dilution in dense UIs per Appendix H). Reproducibility is aided by an anonymized artifact repository, though key hyperparameters (λ, cost weights, γ) lack stated values. Not out-of-scope: the methodology targets LLM-based agent perception and reasoning, not pure vision or domain applications.

primary_link.title: When Agents See Differently: Exposing UI Desynchronization Threats in Mobile Agents

papers.summary: Mobile agents are increasingly capable of autonomously interacting with mobile applications and performing consequential actions on behalf of users. Effective human oversight of such agents relies on a basic premise: users and agents observe consistent information from the same interface. We show that this premise can be systematically violated. Users perceive mobile interfaces through physical displays and the human visual system, making their observations subject to occlusion and luminance con
papers.summary_zh: 本文指出行動代理(mobile agents)存在一個新的攻擊面:人類使用者與代理從同一介面接收的資訊可能不一致。使用者經由實體螢幕與人眼觀看,受限於遮擋與低對比敏感度;代理則讀取數位截圖與無障礙樹等結構化表示,可能保留被遮擋的內容與非視覺中繼資料。作者將此落差稱為人機 UI 不同步,並證明重新打包的克隆 APK 可在部署前嵌入擾動,在不知曉使用者執行期指令、也不偵測代理是否在場的情況下,誘導代理點選攻擊者指定的蜜罐元件而偏離使用者原意,同時對一般使用者保持外觀與功能不變。方法上,框架定義九種針對狀態感知、路徑規劃與動作選擇三階段的擾動策略,先在特徵空間以層級式搜尋、束搜尋與迭代刪除排名獎勵(IDRR)最佳化內容,再透過語意程式碼定位落實到可部署的 APK,例如以沉浸模式將蜜罐渲染進螢幕挖孔區、注入僅差 12 階 RGB 的低對比文字,或竄改無障礙描述。在涵蓋 546 個任務、13 個 Android 應用、五個代理框架與三個骨幹模型的評估中,靜態平均誤導率達 77.9%,動態為 66.9%,且能轉移到未見任務;186 名參與者的問卷顯示這些視覺擾動幾乎無法被人眼察覺。值得注意的是,受害者模型推理越強,誤導率反而上升。限制包括規則式問題空間實作造成的落差,以及密集介面會稀釋擾動效果。此研究顯示人類監督所依賴的觀察一致性前提並不成立,對行動代理的安全對齊與防禦設計(如影像前處理)具有重要警示意義。
papers.title: When Agents See Differently: Exposing UI Desynchronization Threats in Mobile Agents
papers.title_zh: 當代理所見不同:揭露行動代理中的 UI 不同步威脅

links.title: Easy to Catch a Liar, Hard to Clear an Honest One: Language Models Diagnosing a Corrupted Reward Channel from a Verified Record

evidence: Abstract: 72B model calls an honest reporter a liar 38% (nothing changed) and 58% (payouts moved); registered prediction was 35% for the 58% figure
Section 3.5: three rules registered before runs, including answer-printed floor of 0.90 and flip-heuristic detection threshold 0.25
Section 4.2 / Table 2: honest-reporter penalty +0.482 [+0.406, +0.557] at Qwen 72B, +0.363 at Llama 70B, +0.135 at Qwen 32B
Section 4.3: original 64 worlds had round and answer-letter confounded by world index parity; repaired by regenerating reversed worlds, crossing round and letter over 128 prompts per combination
Section 4.4 / Table 5: round effect +0.348 [+0.244, +0.458] at Qwen 72B; letter effect +0.320 [+0.200, +0.435] at Llama 70B; lying-situation margins within 0.035 (Table C1)
Section 4.5 / Table 6: adding a record that agrees with the reporter drops Llama 70B from 0.961 to 0.707 in nothing-moved-honest; lying situations move within 0.012
Section 4.8 / Table 7: on histories where Qwen correctly diagnosed lying, fresh-pair accuracy only 0.117-0.200, following the corrupt report >80% of the time
Section 5: registered 0.65 prediction for points-moved-honest at Qwen 72B; observed 0.418 [0.316, 0.523]; four cells discounted under per-situation reading of ambiguous rules
Section 3.6: four open-weight models in 16-bit, 256/256 GPU bridge reproduction, total cost $13.19
Section 8 / closing: code, prompts, answer keys, and all scored outputs released at github.com/IamArmanNikkhah/easy-to-catch-a-liar
Section 7 (Limits): three models from two families, one seed of 64 worlds, four wordings are author-chosen, no mechanism for family-specific effects
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM behavioral-evaluation paper squarely within top-weighted preferences (LLMs, AI safety/deception detection, alignment via Everitt's corrupted-reward channel, evaluation, agentic knowing-doing gap); no out-of-scope domain cap applies. Novel empirical finding: frozen LLMs use a verified record asymmetrically—catching liars near-ceiling while convicting honest reporters at rates driven by irrelevant surface features (record round for Qwen, answer letter for Llama). Rigor is unusually strong: three pre-registered rules, a registered prediction (0.65) that failed against the observed 0.418, byte-identical matched pairs, reading-floor/ceiling controls, flip-heuristic control, a discovered round-letter confound that was repaired via regenerated 'reversed worlds', and honest discounting of four cells under ambiguous registered rules. Evidence supports the qualitative asymmetry claim (answer-printed 0.96-1.00 vs with-record falls of 0.22-0.44 in nothing-moved-honest; Table 5 crossed effects with intervals excluding zero), but rests on three models from two families, one seed of 64 worlds, and a single-token protocol the authors admit may differ from reasoning-out-loud behavior; the Llama honest-penalty partly survives only under row-level rule reading. Generalizability is limited to this hand-built game, four custom wordings, and per-family surface effects with no mechanism offered. Reproducibility is excellent: full prompt in Appendix A, generated NUMBERS.md as single source of numbers, hardware bridge 256/256, $13.19 cost, and released code/prompts/keys/scored outputs on GitHub.

primary_link.title: Easy to Catch a Liar, Hard to Clear an Honest One: Language Models Diagnosing a Corrupted Reward Channel from a Verified Record

papers.summary: An agent that learns from rewards has to trust whatever reports those rewards. When the reports suddenly change, either the world changed or the reporter broke. From the reports alone these are indistinguishable, and reinforcement learning theory shows that no amount of further experience separates them. The prescribed escape is richer data about the reporter itself. We ask whether a frozen language model, handed exactly that data, uses it. We build a two-option game in which a payout swap and a
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討強化學習中的受污染獎勵通道問題：當獎勵報告突然反轉，可能是世界改變，也可能是回報者開始說謊，僅憑報告無法區分。作者設計兩選項遊戲，使「獎金互換且回報者誠實」與「獎金未變且回報者說謊」產生位元組相同的歷史，再加入一筆記載某輪真實結果的「已驗證紀錄」，一行即可定案。研究以單一字母作答、不給推理空間的協定，測試 Qwen2.5-32B/72B-Instruct 與 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct，每個模型 10,240 個提示詞，並預先登錄分析規則。結果顯示，模型幾乎完美抓出說謊的回報者，卻很難還誠實者清白：Qwen 72B 在一切未變時有 38% 機率把誠實回報者誤判為說謊，獎金變動時達 58%，高於事前預測的 35%；Llama 70B 為 26% 與 48%。此失誤並非閱讀問題，印出答案時同批模型可達 0.96 至 1.00，但判斷受無關特徵左右：Qwen 受紀錄檢查哪一輪影響，Llama 受哪個字母代表誠實影響，說謊判斷則幾乎不動。在已印出答案的提示中加入相符紀錄，反使 Llama 更難給出該答案；而正確判斷回報者說謊後，另問新選項何者得分時，Qwen 逾八成仍照其報告行事，呈現知行落差。限制包括僅三個模型、單一 64 世界樣本、缺乏機制解釋，單步作答也無法反映允許推理時的表現。此研究警示：驗證機制雖能抓出壞掉的回報者，卻可能以無關因素決定的機率冤枉誠實者，對獎勵驗證與 AI 安全設計別具意義。

papers.title_zh: 抓騙子容易、還老實人難：語言模型從一筆已驗證紀錄診斷受污染的獎勵通道

links.title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering

evidence: Abstract: 'Extraction failures account for nearly half of all per-hop deficiencies and are invisible to standard retrieval metrics'; identifies 'fact-grounding gap' as 47% of per-hop deficiencies on MuSiQue

§4.1: fact-presence judge validated against human annotation on 200 stratified examples, 92.0% agreement, Cohen's κ=0.840, with documented conservative bias (12 of 16 disagreements judge Not-Answerable)

§4.2 Table 2: three-way decomposition over 6,401 hops—retrieval failure 30.7% (1,962), extraction failure 27.3% (1,749), fact present 42.0% (2,690); Table 3 shows best non-oracle predictor (retrieval recall) at 68.1% accuracy, ρ=0.042 with fact presence among incorrect answers (Appendix D)

§4.3: Contriever dense retriever replication—extraction failures rise from 598 (BM25) to 725 (Contriever) on MuSiQue; 77% of BM25 extraction failures also extraction failures under Contriever, supporting corpus-property claim
§5.2 Table 4/5: DeBERTa-v3-large F1 0.785 vs BERT-base 0.745 and RoBERTa-large 0.754; ablation shows LLM-judge labels +8.9 pts over string-match labels and passages +15.8 pts over question-only input

§6.5: re-retrieval improves retrieval failures (+8.6% augmentation, +25.3% reranking) but extraction failures change −0.5%; corpus search shows fact absent in 97.7% (MuSiQue), 100% (HotpotQA), 97.6% (2WikiMultihopQA) of extraction-failure cases

§6.2 Table 7 + Appendix H Table 13: DeBERTa-targeted intervention gains (MuSiQue +3.7, HotpotQA +5.1, Contriever HotpotQA +10.0) all McNemar p<0.001 with 95% CIs; Oracle conditions included as controls
Limitations: single reasoning model (GPT-4.1-mini), English Wikipedia datasets only, 'we do not propose solutions for extraction failures', RAG setting untested

Appendix J/K: DeBERTa training ~$80 on A100s, API costs ~$100, code released at github.com/RichardZhu123/fact-grounding-gap, hyperparameters (lr 2e-5, batch 16, seq 512, patience 3) and licenses fully documented

§6.6: honest negative result—2WikiMultihopQA gains negligible (78.8% baseline vs 78.9% targeted) even after dataset-specific predictor retraining (97.4% accuracy), attributed to small aggregate gap (2.7% extraction failures on comparison questions)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM/RAG evaluation paper: uses GPT-4.1-mini as both reasoning model and validated LLM judge, studies multi-hop reasoning chains and retrieval grounding across three standard benchmarks. The core contribution—decomposing failures into retrieval vs. extraction modes at per-hop fact level—is a genuine but incremental refinement over document-level RAG error decompositions (RAGChecker, lost-in-retrieval), and the lightweight predictor enabling targeted re-retrieval at half cost is a modest methodological add-on. Rigor is solid: human validation of the judge (κ=0.840, §4.1), two retrievers (§4.3), ablations on labels and inputs (Table 5), oracle controls, McNemar tests with bootstrap CIs (Appendix H). Evidence is convincing, especially the corpus-gap verification showing 97.7-100% of extraction failures lack the fact anywhere in the corpus (§6.5), which credibly establishes the retrieval-only ceiling. Generalizability is tempered by a single reasoning model, English Wikipedia corpora only, and the honest 2WikiMultihopQA null result (§6.6). Reproducibility is strong: GitHub code, pinned model version, full hyperparameters, prompts, corpus statistics, and compute costs (~$180, Appendix J).

primary_link.title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering

papers.summary: Multi-hop question answering requires combining information from multiple documents to answer complex questions. These systems have grown increasingly capable, yet when they fail, the error is typically attributed to not finding the right documents. Whether this holds at the level of individual reasoning steps remains largely unexamined. We investigate this across three standard multi-hop QA benchmarks and find that failures decompose into two distinct modes: retrieval failures, where the needed
papers.summary_zh: 多跳問答需跨多份文件整合資訊才能回答複雜問題，過往多半將失敗歸咎於檢索不到正確文件。本文在 MuSiQue、HotpotQA 與 2WikiMultihopQA 三個標準資料集上，以 Self-Ask 流程搭配 GPT-4.1-mini 與 BM25、Contriever 檢索器，逐跳檢驗檢索段落是否真正含有該推理步驟所需的事實。作者界定兩種失敗模式：檢索失敗（黃金段落未被取得）與抽取失敗（段落已取得但缺乏所需事實），後者即「事實扎根落差」。在 MuSiQue 的 6,404 個跳中僅 49.1% 可由檢索段落回答，抽取失敗佔 27.3%，約佔所有逐跳缺陷的 47%，且在系統答錯的案例上，檢索召回與事實存在性幾乎不相關，顯示標準檢索指標無法偵測此落差。作者以經人工標註驗證（κ=0.840）的 LLM 評審產生標籤，微調 DeBERTa-v3-large 預測逐跳事實存在與否（F1 0.785），並在被旗標的跳上進行增補檢索或重排；目標式介入以約一半的額外檢索成本，達到與每跳介入相當或更佳的準確率，且增益隨旗標數增加而擴大，在 HotpotQA 上未經重訓亦能遷移。然而抽取失敗幾乎不因再檢索而改善，語料庫檢查顯示 97% 以上的案例中，整個語料庫皆無段落陳述所需的關係事實，確立了純檢索改良的天花板。限制包括僅使用單一推理模型、英文維基百科語料，且未提出解決抽取失敗的方案。此研究顯示檢索與抽取是本質不同的瓶頸，需要不同解方，評估實務應納入逐跳事實存在性檢驗。
papers.title: Diagnosing the Fact-Grounding Gap in Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 診斷多跳問答中的事實扎根落差

links.title: ANIMASK: What the Model Contributes to Role Play in Simulated Story Worlds

evidence: Section 1: 'Across 40 stories, 6 actor models, and 3,846 decision points, the replays converge away from their canons in one shared direction' - headline scope and finding.
Section 6.3 Table 2: adherence 0.80-0.86, default inside implied set 72-81%, persona wins on disagreements 36-68%, cross kept 64-87% - core quantitative claims with per-actor detail.
Appendix H Table 9: judge-human agreement vs human-human baseline across eight judgments (e.g., actual label 0.71 vs 0.51); Table 10 splits by actor - calibrates every LLM-judged number.
Appendix E.3: five memorization probes run for each of six actor models; only stories with no evidence of memorization kept - guards against canon leakage.
Appendix G.1: Proposition 1 bounds Pr[e_d=1] between efficacy and adherence under stated assumptions - formalizes interpretation of the counterfactual instrument.

Appendix A: acknowledges judge shares a provider with one actor, author annotators, history reuse in no-persona replays making efficacy a lower bound, collinear medium/language - honest limitation accounting.

Reproducibility statement: code at github.com/Xiucheng-Zhang/ANIMASK with appendices B, D, E, F, H, J covering schema, prompts, thresholds, calibration, seeds, versions, and costs; Appendix J Table 16 logs 111,279 calls / 529M tokens.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-behavior methodology paper: attributes role-played character actions in multi-agent story simulations to persona conditioning vs. the actor model's post-training defaults, evaluated across 6 frontier LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen). Highly relevant to LLM, agents, prompting, and safety/preferences themes; findings on model-imposed caution (cross calls kept at 64-87%, Table 2/3) directly bear on alignment and persona-agent reliability. Novel attribution design: held-out author canon, decision-point persona removal, presence gating. Rigor is unusually strong for this area: pre-frozen thresholds, clustered bootstraps, permutation tests with Holm correction (E.4), memorization probes on all six actors (E.3), formal bounds on what the persona changed (G.1), and full judge-vs-human calibration where the judge matches or exceeds human-human agreement on eight instruments (H, Table 9). Evidence is solid but rests on a single LLM judge sharing a provider with one actor, author-only annotators, one replay per condition cell, and collinear medium/language (Appendix A). Generalizability is bounded: one engine, prompt-only personas (fine-tuning untested), fixed provider endpoints. Reproducibility is good: code released, prompts/schemas/seeds/versions/costs documented (Appendices B, D, J), though copyrighted sources cannot be redistributed.

primary_link.title: ANIMASK: What the Model Contributes to Role Play in Simulated Story Worlds

papers.summary: When a language model plays a character, the observed behavior reflects both the assigned persona and the default dispositions of the actor model itself. Existing evaluations test persona fidelity or model defaults in isolation, but neither says, at a specific choice with consequences, what the persona changed and what the model's default kept. We introduce ANIMASK, a simulation framework that freezes books and scripts into story worlds whose characters act on their own motivations and replays e
papers.summary_zh: 當語言模型扮演某個角色時,其行為同時反映被指派的人設與模型本身的預設傾向;現有評估分別只測人設忠實度或模型預設,無法在有後果的多角色互動中,把某個具體抉擇歸因於人設或模型。本文提出ANIMASK,將書籍與劇本凍結於情節中段,重建成故事世界,由同一演出模型讓各角色依自身動機自由發展;作者原寫的後續情節則留作正典(canon)對照。測量協定結合三部分:故事層級問卷追蹤情緒、情節強度、張力進展與關係溫度;劇中訪談驗證人設持續在場;並在每個決策點移除人設,僅保留姓名、位置與事實記憶,觀察模型的預設選擇。橫跨40個故事、6個演出模型與3,846個決策點,重演一致偏離正典,趨向更平淡、核心張力未解的結局,240次重演僅7次達成目標,但人設全程在場。約四分之三的決策中,模型預設本就落在人設接受範圍;兩者分歧時模型較保守,五個模型下約八成越界呼籲獲得保留,而角色的訪談分數無法預測人設改變行為的程度。結論:人設決定角色是誰,模型設定角色能走多遠。限制包括僅研究提示詞安裝的人設、每個故事只有一個正典對照、環境模組本身也是LLM等。此區分對模擬社會、陪伴機器人、遊戲NPC與代理應用甚為重要。
papers.title: ANIMASK: What the Model Contributes to Role Play in Simulated Story Worlds
papers.title_zh: ANIMASK:模擬故事世界中模型對角色扮演的貢獻

links.title: GrowMTP: Can RL Grow Its Own Draft Head?

evidence: Abstract/Section 4.2, Table 1: from-scratch K=5 head on Qwen3-4B reaches tau 2.91 (math) and 2.64 (code), yielding 2.13x/1.93x rollout and 1.60x/1.56x end-to-end step speedups including head-update cost.
Section 4.2, Table 2: GrowMTP totals 502.8 GPU·h vs 555.3 for an offline-trained head at nearly identical acceptance (2.91 vs 2.92), a 9.4% saving over 500 RL steps.

Section 4.3, Table 3/Appendix C.2: joint CE attains highest tau (3.99) but zero held-out quality on all six benchmarks; detached DCA gives 1.36x rollout / 1.20x step speedup with quality on par with frozen head.

Section 4.4, Tables 5, 10, 11: ablations isolate draft-path reconstruction (tau tied within 0.03 but step speedup 1.41x vs 1.28x), DCA over CE/KL/TV at K=5 (tau 4.04 vs 3.85-3.94), and VGM benefit (KL step speedup 1.37x vs 1.28x without mask).

Appendix H: one-step lag bounded by K(K+1)/2·eps_bar_t via triangle inequality and Pinsker; measured reference-KL < 0.007 nats, though authors note this is contextual rather than a direct estimate of eps_bar_t.
Appendix D.3: grown heads specialize—math-trained head drops from tau 2.91 (rollout) to 1.45 on code benchmarks—honestly scoped against pretrained heads for general serving.
Appendix J: acknowledged limitations—4B-7B models, single 8-GPU node, D.2 scaling projections (up to 2.17x) are explicitly assumption-based, not measured.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-systems paper on accelerating RL post-training rollout via an online-trained MTP draft head—directly relevant to LLM, RL, inference/serving, and efficiency preferences, with no out-of-scope drift. The core insight (RL rollouts supply both a narrow distribution and free verification supervision, enabling from-scratch head growth with no offline stage) is genuinely useful but builds on established speculative decoding, online draft adaptation (Liu et al. 2023), and TV-chain objectives (Bebop); DCA is a log-reweighting of prior work and ReSpec already used RL supervision with a warm-up. Rigor is strong: three models spanning headless/weak/strong heads, offline vs online cost comparison, training-strategy ablation including the revealing joint-CE quality collapse (Table 3), depth sweep, and component ablations, plus theory appendices (one-step lag bound, optimizer analysis). Evidence is concrete but single-seed, single-node (8xH800), 4B-7B scale, with no variance estimates, and the scaling table is explicitly an assumption-based projection. Honest limitations (domain specialization in D.3, evaluation scope in Appendix J). Reproducibility is aided by hyperparameters, Algorithm 1, and verl/SGLang implementation detail, but no explicit code release is stated.

primary_link.title: GrowMTP: Can RL Grow Its Own Draft Head?

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training drives the frontier capabilities of large language models, with its wall-clock dominated by autoregressive rollout generation. Speculative decoding is an established remedy for this bottleneck, but existing draft heads must be pretrained or warmed up before RL, introducing substantial training cost outside the RL run to be accelerated. We observe that RL training itself provides both conditions required for online draft-head training: its rollout distrib
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的強化學習（RL）後訓練中，rollout 的逐 token 自迴歸解碼佔每步七至九成時間。推測解碼雖是解方，但草稿頭（draft head）須在 RL 前離線預訓練，成本高昂。作者觀察到 RL 訓練本身已具備線上訓練草稿頭的兩項條件：rollout 分佈遠比預訓練集中，且驗證步驟持續產生相符的監督訊號，據此提出 GrowMTP，在 RL 迴圈內從零訓練 MTP 草稿頭。方法包含三項設計：草稿路徑重建使訓練狀態與推論一致；深度耦合接受（DCA）損失以對數轉換的接受鏈代理，給較弱循環更大梯度權重；驗證閘控遮罩（VGM）在首次拒絕處截斷監督。草稿頭更新與政策主幹梯度分離，保留原 RL 目標。實驗顯示，無草稿頭的 Qwen3-4B 經 500 步訓練，隨機初始化的 K=5 頭接受長度從 1.00 升至 2.91，rollout 加速 2.13 倍、端對端 1.60 倍，總 GPU 時數較離線路線省 9.4%；MiMo-7B-SFT 深度由 K=1 延伸至 K=5，端對端加速 1.41 倍；Qwen3.5-4B-Base 達 1.20 倍，且分離式訓練避免聯合訓練使政策品質歸零，測試集表現與基準相當。限制：長出的頭專屬於該任務分佈，跨領域接受率明顯下降；淨效益取決於訓練步數與 rollout 佔比；實驗僅涵蓋 4B 至 7B 模型與單節點八卡。此法使推測解碼免於離線預訓練階段，可作為現有 RL 框架的模組化加速元件，對缺乏預訓練 MTP 頭的模型尤具價值。
papers.title: GrowMTP: Can RL Grow Its Own Draft Head?
papers.title_zh: GrowMTP：RL 能否自行長出自己的草稿頭？

Open Science: artifacts released at github.com/ZJU-TrustAID/InceptionRAG with code, scripts, configs, and representative outputs; corpora >1GB and proprietary weights omitted with reconstruction instructions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant: a corpus-poisoning attack on LLM-based RAG systems aligning strongly with LLM, RAG & Knowledge, AI Safety, Red Teaming, and Reasoning preferences. Novelty is solid: the 'dormant in isolation, toxic upon aggregation' multi-hop logic trap (attribute + bridge documents via proxy entities) is a genuine paradigm shift from single-document injection (PoisonedRAG/HijackRAG), though ZOSO adapts existing zeroth-order/NTK-GP prompt optimization (Hu et al. 2024; Shu et al. 2023) and HODOR is a simple isolation-voting defense. Rigor is good: 3 datasets, 7 LLMs (7B-1000B), 5 defense baselines, 3 attack baselines, ablations (Tables 2-3), efficiency analysis (Tables 4-5), retrieval robustness (Tables 6-7), and metric validation (Table 9); weaknesses include no variance/significance reporting, a thin model-scale analysis (one 7B vs. larger models), substring-based ASR, and a somewhat under-analyzed HODOR utility trade-off. Evidence is strong with extensive quantitative tables matching claims. Generalizability is supported across retrievers (Contriever/Contriever-MS/ANCE), query rewrites, and model scales. Reproducibility is decent: released artifacts, full prompts (Appendix C), hyperparameters (Table 8), and detailed API-cost accounting (~42.1 calls/target), with only corpora/proprietary weights omitted.

primary_link.title: InceptionRAG: Stealthy Poisoning Attack Against Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge but have been demonstrated to be vulnerable to corpus poisoning. Existing poisoning attacks against RAG largely focus on single-point explicit injection, where the malicious payload is fully encapsulated within a single document. Consequently, recent mitigation mechanisms have evolved to identify and diminish these threats effectively. In this paper, we first verify that existing mitigation
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）系統雖為大型語言模型（LLM）補充外部知識，卻易遭語料庫下毒攻擊。現有攻擊多將惡意內容集中於單一文件並明文連結問題與答案，易被注意力變異、關鍵字密度等防禦偵測。本文提出 InceptionRAG，改採「間接邏輯誘導」範式：將惡意酬載拆解為屬性文件與橋接文件，並透過代理實體構成多跳邏輯陷阱；各文件單獨檢視時看似無害，可繞過以文件為單位的防禦，但同時被檢索時，LLM 會自行經三段論推理導出目標錯誤資訊。針對黑箱情境，作者提出零階後綴最佳化（ZOSO），以神經正切核引導之高斯過程在連續嵌入空間搜尋權威後綴，速度較暴力搜尋最高提升 41.1 倍；另以雙端注入提高檢索排名、以 CTTFT 級聯微調適應困難查詢。實驗涵蓋 NQ、HotpotQA、MS-MARCO 三資料集與多種 LLM，攻擊成功率普遍逾 80%，惡意文件數量僅為良性文件四分之一時仍具高成功率，並繞過 AVFilter、MIS 等五種防禦。研究揭示「推理脆弱性悖論」：模型推理能力越強，對此類攻擊越脆弱。作者亦提出以文件隔離與多數決為本的 HODOR 防禦，能有效阻斷攻擊鏈，但會降低多跳任務之準確率，凸顯實用性取捨。此研究指出防禦須審計推理過程，而非僅過濾明文內容。
papers.title: InceptionRAG: Stealthy Poisoning Attack Against Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: InceptionRAG：對抗檢索增強生成之隱蔽下毒攻擊

llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-forward analysis of KV-cache eviction effects on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct generation, squarely in-scope for LLM inference/efficiency and long-context evaluation (no excluded-domain content). Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: the exposure/mismatch-rate decomposition builds on known maximal-coupling, Rao-Blackwell, and partial-identification tools, though the sharp identified-interval theorem (Theorem 3.2) with an explicit attainability construction and the SWRB conditional estimator with proven variance dominance (Proposition 4.1) are genuine contributions. Rigor is a strength: proofs are given, the confirmatory 90% study prespecifies eight endpoints with family-adjusted intervals, dev/eval document splits are enforced, cache budgets are byte-matched, and exploratory vs confirmatory analyses are clearly labeled. Evidence is strong with exact finite-state validation (variance ratios 11.1-289, median 52.7), bootstrap CIs on all key contrasts, and equivalence testing; main caveats are only two models, one horizon (H=128), and mostly retrieval/synthetic long-context tasks. Generalizability beyond 7-8B instruct models and SnapKV/recent-token policies is untested, though the framework is model-agnostic. Reproducibility is moderate: parameters, Algorithm 1, and settings are detailed, but no code or data release is stated.

papers.summary_zh: 本文研究 KV-cache 驅逐如何改變自迴歸語言模型的生成行為，核心問題是：第一次分歧出現的時機，與分歧後持續不一致的程度，如何共同決定累積誤差。作者在步進式極大耦合下推導出精確分解：預期不一致比例等於首次失配貢獻，加上分歧後暴露時間乘以其失配率；並在任意自迴歸核對上建構出與有限觀察窗相容的風險區間，證明該區間是緊的。方法上另提出殘差分支條件蒙地卡羅（SWRB），聯合估計發生率、佔用與尾部貢獻，並證明相較普通耦合具每副本變異數優勢。實驗以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 於 HELMET/RULER 任務進行完整配對軌跡：在相同 50% 快取預算下，SnapKV 半保留比 SnapKV-512 或近期 token 保留更晚、更少進入分歧；探索性分析顯示分歧後暴露解釋四個彙總失配差距的 85–90%，而分歧後總變差（TV）仍維持約 90% 的高檔；90% 保留的獨立研究預先指定比較亦顯示後期窗口 TV 高於早期。限制包括首項研究屬探索性質、TV 接近飽和使差異難以放大，以及個別文件層級的預測 MAE 約 4–5 個百分點。此結果指出 KV 保留策略的收益主要來自延後並減少進入分歧，而非降低分歧後的差異，為累積比較提供了清晰的時間軸解讀。

Novelty is solid rather than high: MGT detectors and persona simulation exist, but the respondent-level behavioral-cue framing (Sec. 2.2), the ASURRE benchmark with revision/full-generation/agentic strategies (Sec. 2.1), and the training-free SPABD aggregator are a genuinely new combination. papers.summary: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains underexplored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討線上問卷面臨的新威脅:受訪者使用大型語言模型(LLM)代答或修飾答案,損害調查資料的有效性,但此類行為的偵測至今少有研究。作者建立名為 ASURRE 的基準資料集,涵蓋三種使用策略:修飾人類草稿的「修訂」、完全交由 LLM 生成的「全生成」,以及最擬真、以人物誌(persona)為基礎模擬整位受訪者作答的「代理式完成」,並結合三份 2020 年前的真實問卷與多個開放及專有 LLM。實驗顯示,現有機器生成文字偵測器在「全生成」上表現最佳(AUROC 約 0.79–0.93),「修訂」次之,「代理式完成」下則接近隨機(0.50–0.65),顯示最擬真的使用方式最難偵測。關鍵發現在於:AI 作答不僅在單一答案留下文字痕跡,更在受訪者層級留下行為軌跡,例如回答偏長且長度過於一致、過度填答選答欄位、答案與題目過度對題等。據此作者提出 SPABD,一種免訓練、僅需五筆已驗證人類回答作參照的聚合方法,對四項行為線索做單尾最大值聚合。SPABD 在代理式設定下將平均 AUROC 由 0.61 提升至 0.75,於 12 個設定中的 11 個勝過最佳現有偵測器,FPR=5% 時偵出率為 27.7% 對 12.0%,並對不同 LLM 後端與參照集污染展現一定穩健性。限制包括:需多個開放式欄位、效能仍不完美、以英文問卷為主,針對性對抗攻擊不在評估範圍。本研究對維護調查研究的可信度深具意義,偏誤分析亦顯示非英語母語者較少被誤判。
