However, each of these methods comes with different efficiency, cost, and performance trade-offs, with no single winner. We present a controlled comparison of representation-based (KV-cache based) and parametric (fine-tuning-based) adaptation metho
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）回答預訓練資料以外的問題時需要外部知識，這些知識可放入上下文視窗、編碼成 KV 快取等表徵，或寫入模型參數，各方法在效率、成本與效能上各有取捨。本文以受控方式比較表徵式（Cartridges、Compaction）與參數式（LoRA、MLP adapter、完整 fine-tuning）知識注入方法，在 LongHealth、QASPER、QuALITY、FinQA、TechQA 五個知識密集基準上，分別於單一文件（oracle）與多文件檢索情境評估，各方法皆以相同的 self-study 合成資料與蒸餾目標訓練，並以 GSM8K、HumanEval 等控制基準量化災難性遺忘，同時進行儲存量相符與推論成本分析。主要結果：oracle 情境下 Cartridges 幾乎在所有儲存預算皆最準確，領先參數式方法約 10 分；Compaction 僅在低壓縮率下相當，超過 50 倍壓縮即落後。多文件檢索情境中只有 Cartridges 追平 ICL，領先參數式方法 29 分、Compaction 15 分；但 Cartridges 也出現輕度災難性遺忘（平均約 6%，編碼任務達 13%），Compaction 則完全無遺忘。參數式 adapter 的合併在混入干擾文件時效能崩潰，聯合訓練雖較佳仍不及組合式 Cartridges。限制包括僅實驗兩個中型模型、聚焦知識而非技能習得，且依賴單一檢索與合併管線及合成訓練資料品質。本文證實沒有單一最佳方法，為實務選擇提供明確的取捨依據，並指出逐文件產物的組合是關鍵的開放問題。
papers.title: Where Should a Document Live: Context, Representations, or Parameters?
papers.title_zh: 文件應置於何處：上下文、表徵，還是參數？

links.title: ReDraft, Don't Just Distill: Reference-Driven Revision for Continual VLLM Post-Training

evidence: Abstract: claims 56.9-point mean target gain vs SFT's 52.9 and 11.3x less forgetting (prior-task loss 1.5 vs 16.6) on Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B

Appendix B.3 Table 4: per-setting ReDraft gains (11.63, 76.25, 84.88, 10.00, 69.75, 83.50) average to 56.0 and losses (0.21, 1.89, 0.80, 4.79, 2.05, 4.77) average to 2.4, disagreeing with the abstract's 56.9/1.5 headline; Appendix D.1 Table 6 also reports +56.0 and -2.4
Appendix B.1 Table 3: cold-start repair rates r_theta = 92.25% (3B Jigsaw) and 56.84% (3B Clock Reading) vs sampling Z_theta of 0.21% and 0.03%, empirically supporting Assumption 1
Section 5.2 Table 2: extending OPSD from 449 to 762 mean steps yields only 19.3 -> 23.4 mean gain, controlling for the under-training objection

Section 6 Figure 7: self-revision median answer-PPL 1.62 vs expert 5.33 on 3B (1.47 vs 5.90 on 7B), supporting the policy-proximity claim; Appendix D.4 Table 9 shows SFT-ReDraft cosine +0.272 vs SFT-OPSD +0.135

Limitation section: correction competence is empirical, an automatic verifier is required, targets are built once and go stale, OPSD is compared without pointwise clipping, and SDFT is not evaluated separately
Section 4 Hyper-parameter setup: lr 1e-5, batch 32, TRL framework, avg@8 decoding at temperature 0.7, GPT-5.5 expert references; no code or data release is stated anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology paper (SFT vs RLVR vs on-policy self-distillation, catastrophic forgetting, verifier-gated targets) evaluated on Qwen2.5-VL, so it sits squarely within LLM/training/RL preferences rather than pure CV despite vision-language tasks. The self-revision idea is close to STaR/ReST and three acknowledged concurrent methods (ReGFT, SPoT, SD-Zero), but the KL-regularized derivation of the ideal target and continual-learning framing add value. Rigor is strong: four baselines, two model scales, mixed and sequential curricula, an extended-budget control against the under-training objection, plus data- and parameter-space mechanism analyses; weaknesses are no seed variance/significance tests and an acknowledged baseline gap (OPSD without clipping, SDFT not run). Headline numbers in the abstract (56.9 gain, 1.5 loss, 11.3x) do not match the per-setting means in Appendix Tables 4/6 (56.0 gain, 2.4 loss), a transparency flaw on the central claim. Generalizability is limited to three narrow tasks requiring a verifier and expert references, with open-ended generation untested. Reproducibility benefits from full prompt templates and hyperparameters but no code/data release is stated and references depend on a closed GPT-5.5.

primary_link.title: ReDraft, Don't Just Distill: Reference-Driven Revision for Continual VLLM Post-Training

papers.summary: Continual post-training of large multimodal models should add new capabilities while preserving those from pre-training, and the two goals pull in opposite directions. SFT gives explicit target supervision that learns a task from near-zero accuracy, but its off-policy targets move the model far enough to cause forgetting; on-policy methods such as RLVR and self-distillation preserve policy proximity yet supply little signal when the policy cannot yet solve the task. We introduce ReDraft (Referen
papers.summary_zh: 大型多模態模型的持續後訓練須在習得新能力的同時保留預訓練既有能力，但兩者常互相拉扯：SFT 提供明確的目標監督，能在近乎零準確率的冷啟動任務上快速學習，其 off-policy 目標卻易造成災難性遺忘；RLVR 與 on-policy 自我蒸餾（如 OPSD）雖貼近當前策略，卻在模型尚不會解題時缺乏有效訊號。本文提出 ReDraft：先由當前策略取樣回應，答對者直接保留，答錯者僅以專家回應為參考、由模型自行修訂，再經驗證器核可，只以獲接受的修訂結果進行 fine-tuning，使每個訓練目標既明確正確又貼近原策略分布。在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B 的 Counting、Clock Reading 與 Jigsaw 實驗中（後兩者為冷啟動任務），ReDraft 目標任務平均增益 56.9 分、超過 SFT 的 52.9 分，舊任務損失由 16.6 降至 1.5 分，遺忘幅度縮小 11.3 倍，並在兩軸上皆優於 OPSD；混合與序列式多任務訓練亦維持此優勢。資料與參數空間分析顯示，修訂目標在基礎模型下困惑度更低，其引起的更新更集中且更貼近 SFT 的更新方向，而 OPSD 的逐 token 訊號常落在與解題無關的修辭與格式 token 上。限制包括依賴「模型具備修訂能力」的經驗假設、需可靠的自動驗證器（開放式生成需另覓代理），且修訂語料於訓練過程中會逐漸過時。整體而言，此方法為冷啟動情境下的持續學習提供兼顧習得與保留的務實路線。
papers.title: ReDraft, Don't Just Distill: Reference-Driven Revision for Continual VLLM Post-Training
papers.title_zh: ReDraft：別只蒸餾——以參考驅動修訂實現 VLLM 持續後訓練

links.title: Do LLMs Have Values? A Quantitative Analysis and Alignment Framework for Values in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: projects responses from 106 LLMs (150,000 queries per model) and 95,000 human survey profiles into a shared sociological space and proposes the PEC framework plus adaptive 'Alignment Prescription'.
Sec. 4.2.1: each of 106 models (23 closed, 83 open) completed 242 WVS items under 625 contextual configurations, accumulating ~31.8M queries.
Sec. 2.2.2 / Table 1: closed-source models deviate on average +86.7% above the human-to-human distance baseline (0.527); Gemini 2.5-Pro most extreme at +185.8%; ~91.9% of W2 gap driven by mean shift.

Sec. 2.4 / Table 3: cross-dataset validation on PKU-SafeRLHF achieves 70.0% overall match rate; Level 2 (CoT) matched 0/2 and Level 3 (SFT/DPO) 1/5, with antagonistic E-C interaction offered as explanation.

Sec. 9: WVS item-to-Schwartz dimension annotation performed by ensemble of five LLMs (GPT-4o, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.6, DeepSeek-R1) via majority vote — a circularity risk for LLM value evaluation.

Sec. 2.3.2: CoT shifts values non-neutrally (Hedonism +0.056, Achievement +0.047), improves value predictability to mean R2 = 0.60, and reduces environmental susceptibility (Frobenius norm 1.58 to 1.39, discount α = 0.88).
Sec. 3.6 (Limitations): authors acknowledge reliance on human-centric scales and predominantly English-language prompts, limiting cross-lingual and cross-cultural generalizability.
Secs. 6-7 (Data/Code availability): processed WVS files, curated splits, and Python analysis code released at github.com/KQ-Zhang/Do-LLMs-Have-Values-Release.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-alignment paper squarely within preferred topics: it evaluates value expression across 106 LLMs (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek families), formalizes value dynamics via a Prior-Environment-Cognition framework where Environment is prompt engineering and Cognition is chain-of-thought, and derives a cost-tiered alignment prescription spanning prompting, CoT, SFT/DPO, and continued pre-training (Abstract; Secs. 2.3-2.4, 4.3-4.4). Novelty is solid but incremental: distributional (rather than single-vector) value assessment and 'value crystallization' are new framings, though prompt sensitivity and CoT value effects are individually known; the prescription ladder formalizes existing intuition. Rigor benefits from massive scale (~31.8M queries, Sec. 4.2.1), formal Wasserstein-based distributional comparison (Sec. 4.2.3), and honest cross-dataset validation showing only 70% match, with weak intermediate-level prediction (Level 2 CoT: 0/2 matched; Level 3: 1/5, Table 3). Key weaknesses: the WVS item-to-Schwartz mapping is itself performed by five LLMs via majority vote (Sec. 9), creating circularity in the value space used to evaluate LLMs; threshold τ calibration is loosely specified (Sec. 4.4); and the compression explanation of crystallization (Sec. 3.3) is speculative. Evidence is generally well-quantified (Table 1: closed-source deviation +86.7% above human baseline), with limitations (English-only, human-centric scales) candidly stated (Sec. 3.6). Code and data are released on GitHub (Secs. 6-7), supporting reproducibility, though closed-source API versioning is a caveat.

primary_link.title: Do LLMs Have Values? A Quantitative Analysis and Alignment Framework for Values in Large Language Models

papers.summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly handle complex subjective tasks, aligning their intentions and behaviors with human values has become a critical scientific challenge. However, current efforts are confounded by a striking behavioral paradox: they fluctuate unpredictably under minor wording changes ("swing"), yet stubbornly ignore explicit instructions to correct ingrained biases ("rigidity"). Resolving this duality is critical for reliable AI alignment. To systematically understand a
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型(LLM)是否具備內在價值體系,並提出量化與對齊方法。研究以 Schwartz 價值理論與世界價值觀調查(WVS-7)約 95,000 份人類樣本為基準,對 106 個模型各施測 150,000 次查詢,將模型與人類的價值表達映射至共享的十維度空間,在分配層級上進行比較。結果發現 LLM 在主觀任務上呈現「擺盪」與「固著」並存的行為悖論,且其價值並未反映人類多樣性,而是產生「價值結晶」:收斂成高度集中、理想化的價值核心,最接近實際人口中最罕見的 Arch 5「Dynamic Challenger」原型,閉源模型偏離人類基準平均達 86.7%。為解釋此現象,作者提出 Prior-Environment-Cognition(PEC)框架,將價值表達建模為參數權重(先驗)、情境提示(環境)與 Chain-of-Thought 推理(認知)的共同作用,並證實推理並非價值中立,會系統性偏向自利強化與保守面向。基於 PEC 診斷,研究進一步設計四層級「對齊處方」,依各維度可塑性選擇最低成本介入,從零成本提示工程、CoT、SFT/DPO 到再預訓練,在 PKU-SafeRLHF 驗證集獲得 70% 匹配率,且不損害模型通用能力。侷限包括仰賴以人類為中心的量表、評估以英文提示為主,跨語言與跨文化涵蓋有限。此研究將價值對齊從試誤法轉為機制化的定量科學,也提醒 LLM 不宜直接充當人類心理樣本替代品。
papers.title: Do LLMs Have Values? A Quantitative Analysis and Alignment Framework for Values in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型語言模型有價值觀嗎?LLM 價值觀的量化分析與對齊框架

links.title: TAME: Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent misalignment

evidence: Abstract: attribution concentrated (top 5% of tokens hold 32% of mass); masking high-attribution tokens cuts EM 23x in Llama and 36x in Qwen; equal random mask leaves EM unchanged

Section 2, Stage 3: three conditions with identical text and hyperparameters (LoRA r=32, two epochs); random mask equalizes number of masked positions, not masked loss mass - confound acknowledged and deferred to Limitations
Section 3.2, Table 1: Llama full FT EM 8.6% [3.0,14.9] vs random mask 8.0% vs top 40% mask 0.4% [0.0,1.1]; Qwen 4.5%/6.4%/0.1%; factors computed from raw counts (69/800 vs 3/800; 36/800 vs 1/800)

Section 3.1: rarity controls - attribution-surprisal Spearman rho=0.68; register enrichment survives residualization in Llama (median 1.88x) but not Qwen (median 1.10x; 0.77x centered), so the characterization is scoped to Llama
Section 3.3, Table 2: held-out perplexity cost of top mask vs random mask is 3.7x on register tokens but only 1.3x on domain (medical) tokens, Qwen gradient 4.0/3.0/1.6/1.6x
Limitations: preliminary study with one domain (bad medical advice), one seed per training condition, small 1-1.5B students, single GPT-4o judge; 23x and 36x figures are single-run point estimates

Section 2 Setting: uses released Turner et al. (2025) bad-medical-advice organisms with public LoRA adapter and 6,849-example split; hyperparameters and lexicon (Appendix A) given, but the paper states no explicit code release for TAME itself
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment/safety/interpretability work: token-level attribution and causal loss masking for emergent misalignment in Llama/Qwen fine-tuning, directly matching high-weight LLM, AI safety, alignment, and interpretability preferences. Novelty is solid: it moves EM localization from example/feature level to response-token level using released LoRA adapters (forward-pass-only scoring) and proposes an unwarranted-certainty register reading, though the technique itself is a simple interpolation derivative. Rigor is good with random-mask controls, surprisal quintile/residualization/centering controls, held-out perplexity decomposition, cross-family replication, and clustered bootstrap CIs, but undermined by single seeds, an untuned 40% mask, a count-not-loss-mass mask confound, and one GPT-4o judge - all honestly disclosed. Evidence strength benefits from large, CI-separated effects (8.6%->0.4% EM in Llama) and family replication; limited by single-run point estimates and judge-based scoring. Generalizability is moderate: one fine-tuning domain, small 1-1.5B students, and the register characterization fails the rarity control in Qwen (1.10x median), which the authors scope to Llama. Reproducibility is decent: public organisms/adapters, full lexicon in Appendix A, stated hyperparameters, but no explicit code release by the authors. Score: 0.4*0.9+0.15*0.75+0.15*0.7+0.15*0.7+0.1*0.6+0.05*0.6 = 0.77.

primary_link.title: TAME: Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent misalignment

papers.summary: Fine-tuning an aligned language model on narrow, flawed data can induce harmful behavior far outside the training domain, known as emergent misalignment (EM). Prior work has localized EM in model weights, activations, and training documents, but it remains unclear which training tokens carry the relevant fine-tuning signal. We introduce TAME (Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent Misalignment), a three-stage framework: token attribution scores how strongly the fine-tuning update raises each
papers.summary_zh: 當對齊後的語言模型在狹窄且有缺陷的資料上進行 fine-tuning，可能引發遠超出訓練領域的有害行為，即突現性失準。過往研究已將此現象定位於權重、激活與訓練文件層級，但究竟是哪些訓練詞元承載相關微調訊號仍不清楚。本文提出 TAME 三階段框架：第一階段沿著已釋出的 LoRA adapter 進行插值，僅用前向傳遞為每個回應詞元計算概似度提升的歸因分數；第二階段將高歸因詞元歸類為領域、語域、功能與其他，並以基底模型 surprisal 分位數控制詞元罕見度；第三階段在重新微調學生模型時對高歸因詞元施加損失遮罩，並以等量隨機遮罩作對照，完成因果驗證。在不良醫療建議的 model organisms 上，歸因高度集中（前 5% 詞元即佔 32% 質量）；Llama 的高歸因詞元在醫療詞彙上明顯匱乏，卻富含「完全」「安全」等表達不當確定性的語域，且在罕見度控制下依然成立。遮罩前 40% 高歸因詞元使 EM 率在 Llama 學生模型下降 23 倍、Qwen 下降 36 倍，等量隨機遮罩則幾無效果，困惑度代價集中於目標語域而非醫療內容。限制包括僅涵蓋單一領域、單一訓練種子、小型學生模型與單一 GPT-4o 評審，且語域富集現象在 Qwen 未能在罕見度控制下存續。本研究提示突現性失準或更取決於缺陷內容被表達的確定程度，而非內容本身，為不改動文字的資料稽核與防禦提供了廉價可行的切入點。
papers.title: TAME: Token Attribution and Masking for Emergent misalignment
papers.title_zh: TAME：以詞元歸因與遮罩探究突現性失準

links.title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation

evidence: Abstract: 'Across ten models, Entry Top-1 ranges from 35.2% to 95.2% and web decision accuracy from 26.3% to 62.8%' and 'Execution failures account for 31.9% of web runs, whereas post-decision type errors account for only 0.9%'

Sec. 3.1 (Human construction of website gold): 'First-pass decision and joint-label agreement are 82.50% and 80.17%, with nominal Krippendorff's alpha of 0.6553 and 0.7425' and 'Hidden repeats yield 97.9% decision agreement'
Sec. 4.1 (Metrics): 'Primary metrics use central 95% intervals from 2,000 website-level bootstrap resamples... because each model-website pair is run once, they do not estimate rerun variance'
Conclusion (Sec. 5): 'The results use one trajectory per model-website pair... Future work should measure rerun variance... and validate the evidence rubric through a frozen human trajectory audit'

Sec. 3.4 (Multidimensional multimodal evidence judge): judge 'does not receive website annotations, model identity, URLs or domain-reputation signals' and 'does not determine the website decision or violation type'; evidence scores are 'coverage-conditioned' diagnostics only
Sec. 1: 'We release the benchmark, evaluation protocol, and resettable local sandbox, which also supports subsequent agent-training research'

Sec. 4.1 (Data and systems): 'Gemini 3.6 Flash is unranked in Task 2 because it was absent from the frozen report and judge batches'; Tables 1-2 report Task 1, Task 2, and gated end-to-end accuracies (16.7%-60.8%) for ten systems
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM/VLM agent benchmark that directly matches core preferences: web-agent investigation (Agents & Tool Use, 2.5), evaluation of ten frontier LLMs (LLMs, 2.5), platform-abuse risk detection (AI Safety 2.0; Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8), and Chinese obfuscated-text restoration (NLP 1.5). Novelty is solid: the cross-stage 'entry-gated' composition linking message restoration to downstream web investigation is a formulation prior obfuscation and web-agent benchmarks lack (Sec. 1-2). Rigor is substantial but not exemplary: careful human gold construction with reported Krippendorff's alpha and hidden-repeat checks (Sec. 3.1), bootstrap CIs (Sec. 4.1), and clean protocol definitions (Sec. 3.4) are offset by a single trajectory per model-website pair, an unvalidated automated evidence judge, and key details (stratified results, judge rubric, construction audits) deferred to a supplement not present here; ablations are limited to failure-stage attribution. Evidence is strong for the headline claims (Entry Top-1 35.19-95.22%, web accuracy 26.3-62.8%, execution failures 31.9% vs 0.9% typing errors; Table 1, Fig. 5) but CIs and coverage details are in the supplement, and one model (Gemini 3.6 Flash) is inconsistently excluded from Task 2. Generalizability is moderate: fully synthetic Chinese-centric messages and offline-constructed sites limit transfer. Reproducibility is aided by an explicit release claim of benchmark, protocol, and resettable sandbox (Sec. 1, Conclusion), though verification depends on unseen supplementary material.

primary_link.title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation

papers.summary: Platform abuse campaigns conceal redirection instructions with emojis, homophones, character decomposition, and redundant symbols, then route users through disguised links to services associated with pornography, fraud, gambling, or illicit transactions. Existing benchmarks evaluate obfuscated text and risky webpages separately, obscuring how target recovery affects downstream evidence acquisition. We introduce RiskChainBench, pairing 3,600 synthetic token-text restoration inputs from 600 source
papers.summary_zh: RiskChainBench 針對跨頻道平台風險調查,提出首個串聯混淆訊息還原與網頁證據調查的基準。違規廣告常以表情符號、諧音、拆字與冗餘符號掩飾跳轉指引,將使用者導向色情、詐騙、賭博等服務;既有基準多將混淆文字與風險網頁分開評測,無法呈現還原錯誤對下游取證的連鎖影響。本基準由 600 個來源工作階段衍生 3,600 個合成混淆訊息,並配對 600 個人工標註、可重置的本地隔離網頁環境。模型須先還原訊息、操作意圖與入口連結(任務一),再以視覺語言模型驅動的網頁代理在不知道訊息語意與網域信譽的前提下調查對應網站,產出附證據引用的風險報告(任務二);評測離線以固定主入口預測作為閘門,組合兩階段成績。十個模型的實驗顯示:入口 Top-1 介於 35.2% 至 95.2%,網頁決策準確率介於 26.3% 至 62.8%,且入口還原、完整重建、網站判斷與細粒度類型分類由不同系統領先;執行失敗佔網頁運行的 31.9%,決策後類型錯誤僅 0.9%,顯示穩定探索與風險判斷才是主要瓶頸。限制包括每組模型與網站僅單次軌跡、部分違規類型樣本稀疏,證據診斷亦取決於評審覆蓋率。此工作量化了上游還原損失對端到端成效的侵蝕,並為平台治理與網頁代理研究提供安全、可重現的基礎。
papers.title: RiskChainBench: A Benchmark for Obfuscated Platform Message Restoration and Evidence-Grounded Web Investigation
papers.title_zh: RiskChainBench:混淆式平台訊息還原與證據導向網頁調查基準

links.title: ExecuCritic: Calibrated Critic Shaping for Code Generation with Verifiable Rewards

evidence: Abstract: claims gains over GRPO without critic, prompted reviewer systems, and scalar reward model baselines across eight benchmarks with fewer policy gradient steps and fewer sandbox executions.
§4.1 Baselines: eight baselines B1-B8; trained baselines (B2, B3, B6, B8) share backbone, prompts, and token budget; B3 uses K=16 rollouts to match or exceed the method's training-time sandbox calls.
§4.3 Table 3: mean ± std over three RLVR seeds with paired bootstrap 95% CIs; all gains exclude zero (HumanEval+ +3.7 [+2.4,+5.0]; SWE-bench ranking NDCG@5 +11.1 [+8.4,+13.8]).
§4.4 Table 4: ablations removing α-shaping (48.3→45.2), calibration gate (→46.0), β margin (→46.3), γ critique loss (→46.7), plus shared-backbone, staged-training, and K∈{4,8,16} variants.
§4.6 Table 5: ExecuCritic critic reaches ECE 0.061, AUC 72.8, Spearman 0.71, Type-F1 64.6 versus frozen prompt critic at ECE 0.213, AUC 60.4 on validation rollouts.

§4.9 Discussion and limitations: authors state the method requires an executable test oracle per training prompt and that adversarial initial critics 'deserve study'; no reward hacking was observed but not systematically measured.
Reproducibility gap: §4.1 gives detailed hyperparameters (K=8, α=0.5, LoRA rank-32, 400 RLVR steps, bf16) but the document contains no code, data, or model release statement anywhere.

Reference anomaly: References list numerous 2026 venue citations with a recurring overlapping author 'Z. Kang' ([18]-[22],[25],[29],[36],[39]) cited only tangentially in §2 and §5, indicating possible citation-network padding.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper (code agents, RLVR, reward shaping, LoRA joint training) with unusually thorough evaluation design: eight benchmark views, eight baselines with matched budgets (B3 given K=16 rollouts to equalize sandbox calls, §4.1), three-seed paired bootstrap CIs excluding zero (Table 3), component-wise ablations (Table 4), calibration/reliability metrics (Table 5), and inference-budget Pareto analysis (Table 6). Core contribution—a rank-correlation calibration gate on critic-shaped GRPO advantages—is a sensible but incremental advance over existing process/outcome reward shaping. Concerns: arithmetic in Tables 1-2 checks out internally, but the reference list shows a cluster of tangential 2026 citations sharing one overlapping author ([18]-[22],[25],[29],[36],[39]) invoked only in related work/future work, a citation-padding pattern that weakens trust; no code, data, or checkpoint release is stated anywhere; headline figures (Fig. 2 sample-efficiency, calibration curves) are not tabulated; and the 'no reward hacking' claim is asserted rather than measured. Generalizable across two-plus backbones including a 16B MoE and Python/Java repository repair, though restricted to settings with executable test oracles per the authors' own §4.9 limitations.

papers.summary: Execution feedback is a useful supervision signal for code models because unit tests are objective and directly measure program correctness. Its weakness is that an entire program is often reduced to one pass or fail bit, leaving RLVR to solve a difficult credit assignment problem. At the same time, coding systems often include separate reviewer or tester roles, but these critics are usually prompted rather than trained and are not calibrated against execution. We propose ExecuCritic, a joint tr
papers.summary_zh: 執行回饋對程式碼模型是客觀的監督訊號，但整個程式常被壓縮成單一通過或失敗位元，使RLVR面臨困難的信用分配（credit assignment）問題；提示式審查者雖提供語言回饋，卻未與執行結果校準。ExecuCritic據此提出讓程式碼撰寫者與評論者共用凍結骨幹、各掛LoRA adapter、於同一批執行rollout上共同訓練的框架：評論者預測通過機率、排序候選並輸出簡短診斷；撰寫者採用校準優勢，僅當評論者分數與執行器結果在該rollout群組內的秩相關為正時，才將其納入GRPO優勢，避免採信不可信的獎勵。評論者損失結合判決似然、通過與失敗程式的排序邊際，以及對應執行器錯誤類型的診斷一致性。在Qwen3-8B與DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite上，橫跨HumanEval+、LiveCodeBench、SWE-bench Lite等八項基準，平均超越單一撰寫者GRPO約3.4點、提示式審查系統約6至7點，以約40%更少的策略梯度步數達到基線最終準確率，每個解決任務的沙盒執行次數由18.6降至10.7，patch排序的NDCG@5提升11.1點。消融顯示增益主要來自校準閘門、排序邊際與診斷一致性，而非更大的取樣預算；限制在於每個訓練提示皆需可執行的測試oracle，較弱或分布外的骨幹可能需更長的SFT階段。其價值在於以可驗證訊號錨定學得的密集回饋，在不淪為不可信獎勵模型的前提下，同時改善稀疏獎勵下的信用分配與樣本效率。

links.title: Beyond "ChatGPT Can Make Mistakes": Designing Interventions to Support Metacognitive Monitoring in AI-Assisted Work

evidence: Abstract and Section 5.3.1: between-subjects experiment (N=917, 12 planning-and-organizing problems); reliability cards and contrasting replies reduced estimation error (g=-.46 and g=-.65, p<.001) and increased aggregate confidence discrimination (g=+.50 and g=+.28); no task-performance improvement was established.

Section 5.2.6: one-way ANOVA omnibus with Tukey HSD familywise control, JZS Bayesian ANOVAs, OLS score-adjusted monitoring models, and trial-level GEE logistic models; study not preregistered but directional predictions and contrasts fixed before data collection.

Section 5.3.5 and Appendix F (Table 18): allowing condition-specific item effects left no reliable average correctness x condition interaction (reliability cards 0.15 pp, p=.909; contrasting replies 1.65 pp, p=.202); only an exploratory easier-item split retained a contrasting replies gain (5.71 pp, p=.001).

Section 6.3 Limitations: one closed task domain, single session, one assistant, mandatory consultation, 12 trials limiting individual-level precision, reflection exceeded announced duration for 67% of participants, and condition/collection period partially confounded (checked in Appendix G).

Open Science and Pre-Registration Statement: study-platform source code, task materials, analysis code, and participant/trial-level datasets publicly available on GitHub; expert transcripts not shareable but coding template in Appendix B.

Section 5.2.3 and Appendix H: shared assistant GPT-5.4-mini (low reasoning effort); scripted-agent check solved 41.7% of items under the plain prompt, supporting the assumption that wrong advice was common enough for monitoring to matter.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An HCI human-subjects study of metacognitive interventions (reliability cards, contrasting replies, pause points, reflection) for LLM-assisted task solving. Topic relevance is moderate: LLMs and appropriate-reliance/overconfidence (AI safety/evaluation adjacent) are central, but the contribution is interaction design and psychology, not LLM or NLP methodology; the model is off-the-shelf. Novelty is solid: a curated 30-intervention catalogue, a time/level/source design space, and a comparative 5-arm test where prior work tested single mechanisms. Rigor and evidence are exceptional for the area: N=917 with power analysis, omnibus-plus-Tukey and Bayesian analyses, GEE reliance models, manipulation/exposure checks, collection-period confound checks, and candid null results (no task-performance gain; within-item discrimination gains not reliable after item controls). Generalizability is limited to one closed planning domain, 12 trials, one assistant, mandatory consultation, and crowdworkers. Reproducibility is strong via a public repository with code, data, and task materials, though the study was not preregistered.

A between-subjects experiment (N = 917;
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 AI 輔助工作中，使用者必須同時判斷自己與系統能力的後設認知（metacognition）需求，但設計者長期缺乏何種介入有效、應置於何處、如何評估成效的比較證據。研究團隊先訪談 11 位專家，彙整出 30 項介入構想，並結合既有文獻提出由「時間」（介入於任務前、中、後何時作用）、「層次」（判斷對象為使用者、AI 或人機整體）與「來源」（監控線索由誰提供）三軸構成的設計空間。接著以受試者間實驗（N=917，12 道規劃與組織題）比較四種介入——可靠度卡片、對比回覆、暫停點與事後反思——與基線 LLM 助理的差異。結果顯示：可靠度卡片與對比回覆降低了估計誤差與過度自信，並提升整體信心區辨力，且信心調整集中在較困難的題目，但未偵測到任務表現改善；暫停點雖降低估計誤差，卻同時降低答題正確率；反思則未帶來可靠的監控效益。四種介入皆降低易用性、提高工作負荷。研究限制包括僅測試單一封閉式任務、12 題限制個別層次測量精度、反思組時程超出預告，以及條件與資料蒐集期間部分混淆。本文貢獻在於提供共同詞彙與設計空間，並以實證證明「監測」與「任務表現」是可分離的設計目標，對人機互動與信心校準研究具重要參考價值。

evidence: Section 3.1: two-sample power calculation targets n=176/group; analyzed N=535 with 57 sessions excluded (30 technical, 27 proctoring).
Section 3.5: each assistant answered every item alone over 100 independent runs; maximum binomial SE ~.05; chat-parity harness replays participant messages with no system prompt.

Section 3.6: second-model extraction validated by 200 hand-coded transcripts, 89.5% agreement (kappa=.64), with letter-string agreement only .71; advice-correctness extraction separately flagged as unvalidated.
Section 3.7 / Appendix E.1: WAMBS audit (max R-hat 1.003, min bulk ESS 1,663, 0.49% divergences); prior-sensitivity refits moved quantities at most .015; 4,000-resample robustness checks.
Table 5 / Section 4.4: pass-through slopes span 1.39 (kimi-k3) to 2.81 (gemini-3.6-flash); pooled realized synergy S = -.062 [-.118, -.005], i.e., teams did not beat the better component.
Table 4 / Section 4.2: deference .859 overall, discrimination only .165; overreliance .743 of wrong-advice trials.
Section 5.6 Limitations: results bounded to four assistants, one interface, 40 items, mandatory consultation; groups recruited via separate postings.
Section 4 availability note: de-identified model inputs, analysis notebook, R script, and posterior summaries 'will be added' to HAI_Benchmark repository (future release, not yet available).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A large, well-executed human-subjects study directly about LLMs (four named assistants) as reasoning aids, squarely matching the LLM (2.5), reasoning (2.5), reliance/safety (2.0), and evaluation/benchmark (1.8) preference axes; it is empirical HCI rather than LLM methodology, which caps relevance below top marks. Novelty is solid but incremental: it extends ChatBench-style solo-vs-assisted comparison with new metrics (item-level 100-run competence, pass-through, synergy capture, policy ladder). Rigor is exceptional: power analysis, Bayesian models with WAMBS diagnostics (R-hat 1.003, ESS 1663), held-out selection, extractor audit (kappa .64), and extensive sensitivity checks. Evidence is strong but bounded by a between-subjects design with separate Prolific postings, self-selected pre-reply trials, and incomplete validation of advice-correctness extraction. Generalizability is explicitly narrow (one interface, 40 items, mandatory consultation, AI-experienced UK sample). Reproducibility is promised (repo with notebook, R script, posterior summaries) but not yet released.

papers.summary: People increasingly reason with large language models (LLMs), yet complementary capabilities do not guarantee outperforming both components. In a between-subjects study, participants (N=535) solved a 40-item battery of matrix reasoning, mental rotation, syllogisms, and letter-string analogies, unaided or with GPT-5.6-Luna, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.6 Flash, or Kimi K3. Each assisted trial required consultation with the model. Each model answered every item alone 100 times under matched elicitati
papers.summary_zh: 本研究探討人與大型語言模型(LLM)協作時,互補能力能否轉化為真正的綜效(synergy),即團隊同時勝過人與模型各自的表現。535名受試者解決涵蓋矩陣推理、心智旋轉、三段論與字串類比的40題測驗,分為無輔助組,或搭配GPT-5.6-Luna、Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.6 Flash與Kimi K3其中一種助理;輔助條件下每題都必須諮詢模型。四種模型另在匹配的提示與API設定下獨立作答每題100次,建立逐題能力基準。結果顯示:輔助組整體準確率高於無輔助組,但平均實現綜效為負(-.062),160個題目×助理組合中僅42個同時勝過兩個組成;綜效擷取率約.584。效益隨模型逐題能力上升,顯著正效應集中於兩個較高的能力帶,且模型能力的增益約僅一半傳遞到輔助準確率,各模型的傳遞斜率差異近兩倍。參與者的服從率依任務差異甚大並隨題目能力提高,但對正確與錯誤建議的辨別度僅.165;諮詢後信心區分對錯的能力也低於無輔助時。回溯性政策估計顯示,逐題選擇可再增益約.061,獨立誤差預言上限約.141,正是「可得卻未被取用」的潛力。限制包括僅四種助理、單一介面、強制諮詢設計,以及各組透過不同招募貼文收集可能帶來的未測量差異。本研究主張應在與人互動中評估LLM,並設計支援選擇性服從、同時保留獨立推理的介面。

links.title: ECHO: Early-layer Collaborative Hierarchical Orchestration with Bonus Logits in Speculative Decoding

evidence: Abstract: reports 'a 2.4x to 2.9x speedup... with negligible engineering overhead and no extra deployment parameters, albeit with a one-shot fine-tuning dependency for optimal acceleration'.

Section 6 Conclusion: calls ECHO 'a training-free speculative decoding framework', contradicting the stated fine-tuning dependency in the Abstract and Section 5.1's use of Meta's LayerSkip checkpoints.

Table 1 (Section 5.2): ECHO overall speedups 2.87x (Llama-3.2-1B), 2.71x (Llama-2-7B), 2.60x (CodeLlama-7B), 2.42x (Llama-3-8B), 2.90x (Llama-2-13B) vs PLD, LayerSkip, LogitSpec, TokenRecycling, Self-Speculative.
Table 2 (Section 5.4): ablating the logits draft tree reduces overall speedup from 2.70x to 2.16x; removing outer automaton update drops it to 2.29x.
Section 5.1 'Hyperparameter and Settings': L_e=10, inner-loop buffer 5, bonus-logit sampling depth 8, n-gram retrieval depth 6, single RTX 3090 (<=8B) or A40 (13B).
Appendix A.2-A.4: operator decomposition identity M(X) = V_s(V_e(X)), tree-attention invariance proof, and rejection-sampling derivation showing output distribution is preserved (losslessness).
Table 3 (Section 5.4): ECHO 3.79x/4.84 MAT vs EAGLE-2 2.84x/3.37 on Llama-3-8B-Instruct, claimed without extra deployment parameters.
Table 10 (Appendix B.8): vanilla un-tuned weights give 2.44x on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct vs 2.71x with LayerSkip-tuned weights, still above TokenRecycling's 2.00x.

Section 5.3 Case Study: for a 512-token Llama-2-7B task ECHO executes '307 agile passes through the first 12 layers and only 109 authoritative passes through the remaining 20 layers', inconsistent with the L_e=10 stated in Section 5.1.
Appendix B.10/Table 14: 3-level cascade (layers 6/12/32) reduces speedup from 3.47x to 2.94x and more than doubles synchronization overhead (70.5s to 150.6s).
Limitations section: admits the implementation 'is primarily optimized for local deployment' with distributed cloud exploration left to future work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference methodology paper (speculative decoding) squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, inference/serving, efficiency); not out of scope. Strengths: broad evaluation across 1B-70B models, three benchmarks, many strong draft-model-free baselines plus EAGLE-2, extensive ablations (components, buffer size, n-gram/top-k depth, exit layer, 3-level cascade, vanilla vs tuned weights), formal losslessness proofs (Appendix A.2-A.4), overhead profiling, hyperparameters, algorithm pseudocode, chat templates, and a code link. Weaknesses: the contribution is an incremental composition of known ideas (hierarchical verification per HiSpec, logits recycling per TokenRecycling/LogitSpec, early-exit drafting per LayerSkip); an internal contradiction where the Conclusion (Section 6) claims a 'training-free' framework while the Abstract and Section 5.1 admit a one-shot early-exit fine-tuning dependency via LayerSkip checkpoints; inconsistent exit-layer reporting (L_e=10 in Section 5.1 vs 12-layer/20-layer split in Section 5.3 and Appendix B.2/B.9); no variance/significance reporting for speedups; the EAGLE-2 baseline configuration (Table 3) is not shown to be well-tuned. Solid, well-evidenced systems contribution with moderate novelty and some internal inconsistencies.

papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的自迴歸解碼受記憶體頻寬限制，推論延遲高。現有免草稿模型的投機解碼方法雖輕量，卻面臨兩大瓶頸：草稿資訊源自最終層而迅速衰退（資訊衰減），且每個候選token都須經整個目標模型完整驗證，形成「驗證之牆」。ECHO提出階層式雙迴圈框架，善用Transformer各層的功能不對稱性：內迴圈以前L_e層作為輕量驗證器，透過樹狀注意力高頻探索草稿樹，並回收早期層Bonus Logits作為低成本語意引導；外迴圈於緩衝區達門檻後，藉狀態重用機制略過前段層、僅執行後段層的權威性因果驗證，並產出最終層Bonus Logits修正路徑。草稿樹混合n-gram檢索自動機與logits取樣候選，作者以算子分解恆等式與拒絕抽樣證明流程無損（lossless）。實驗涵蓋Spec-Bench、HumanEval與GSM8K，在Llama-2/3、CodeLlama等模型上取得2.4×至2.9×加速，Llama-2-13B最高達3.01×，平均接受token數超越PLD、TokenRecycling、LogitSpec與LayerSkip，且不新增部署參數；34B與70B模型亦有效，分散式與高併發下同步開銷僅約1.15%。限制在於最佳加速需一次LayerSkip式early-exit fine-tuning，vanilla權重效能較低；內部緩衝區過大會重現驗證之牆；目前主要針對本地部署，雲端分散式潛力仍待探索。整體而言，ECHO在不引入額外參數的前提下瓦解驗證瓶頸，為LLM推論加速提供兼顧速度、品質與無損性的務實路徑。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM multi-agent systems research: systematically studies candidate model selection for routing, majority-vote, and LLM-as-a-judge MAS across 23 LLMs and 3 science-reasoning benchmarks, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, and evaluation preferences. The oracle-vs-achieved gap framing and the finding that diversity/heterogeneity degrades heterogeneous MAS (family-restricted pools being the exception) is a useful, partially negative result that fills a genuine gap versus routing/ensembling prior work. Rigor is solid (judge verification with 93% agreement/kappa 0.63, threshold and embedding ablations, train/test correlation r>0.9, subset identities disclosed), but weakened by tiny family groups (Shared-Gemma has 2 models), a single judge, no tool use, simple MAS architectures, and one nondeterministic selection method (GPT-5 Deep Research). Quantitative evidence is mostly figure-based with limited exact numbers in text. Generalizability is constrained to science reasoning QA with a 2024-2026 model snapshot; closed-source calibration data (Turing, Scale, Stack-Overflow) hurts reproducibility despite a released code link.

However, despite rapid growth of available open-source models, there is limited research on how to select optimal model candidates out of this massive pool. We systematically evaluate 8 model selection strategies (including model size, accuracy and answer diversity) across before-generation (routing) and after-generation (majority-voting, LLM-as-a-judge) MAS architectures on challenging scientific benchmar
papers.summary_zh: 多代理系統(MAS)結合多個模型輸出以解決複雜推理任務,但開源模型數量龐大,如何從中挑選候選模型池仍缺乏系統性研究。本文來自 NVIDIA 團隊,在 Humanity's Last Exam、GPQA-Diamond 與 Frontier Science-Olympiad 三個科學推理基準上,利用 23 個涵蓋 6 個架構家族、2B 至 1.6T 參數的模型,系統性評估 8 種模型選取策略,包括依參數量、模型家族、LLM 挑選、準確率、正確答案多樣性(IoU)與錯誤多樣性等,並比較生成前的路由系統,以及生成後的多數決投票與 LLM 評審等三種 MAS 架構。主要發現:理論 oracle 潛力與實際表現存在顯著落差;擴大候選池反而常使效能低於池中最佳單一模型;唯一能穩定相對超越單一模型的策略,是選取同一模型家族的成員;經領域特化微調的物理、化學模型並未在其專業領域勝過通用模型。此外,路由系統確實受益於正確答案多樣性,但生成後架構的效能隨模型數增加而急劇下滑,單一模型家族組成的 MAS 卻隨架構複雜度提升而改善。研究限制包括僅測試簡單的 MAS 架構、未啟用工具使用、採用單一評審模型,且僅聚焦科學推理任務。此研究凸顯模型選取是 MAS 的關鍵設計決策:盲目加入異質模型會引入系統不穩定,MAS 工程師應評估並報告系統成功所需的模型行為模式,而非假設「模型越多越好」。
papers.title: Mo' Models, Mo' Problems: How to best select model pools when designing Multi-Agent Systems
papers.title_zh: 模型越多,問題越多:設計多代理系統時如何最佳選取模型池

links.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract & Section 1: proposes γOPD, a discounted temporal-credit surrogate for on-policy distillation, plus Reward-Compatible Bounded Mixing (RBM) for LLM post-training
Propositions 3.1–3.2 (Section 3.1) with proofs in Appendix A–B derive token-level OPD as a stop-gradient approximation of the sequence-level reverse-KL gradient
Theorem 3.3 (Section 3.2) with proof in Appendix C: horizon-dependent variance for sequence-level OPD vs horizon-independent bound σΔ²/(1−γ)² for γOPD
Section 4.1: seven baselines (OPD, ExOPD, REOPOLD, AOPD, TOPD, JustRL, STAPO); all methods implemented on veRL with vLLM; γ=0.99 default
Table 1: vanilla setting γOPD AvgAcc 69.49 vs teacher 68.10; size-mismatch setting 56.51 vs best baseline JustRL 54.51
Table 3: ablation isolates discounting (+2.04 over vanilla OPD on AIME), reward mixing without discounting (+2.00), full combination (+3.91)
Section 6 (Conclusion): limitation that experiments are limited to models with fewer than 10B parameters
Appendix F.1 Table 5: profiling shows 0.1064% compute and 0.00046% memory overhead vs vanilla OPD
Appendix E Table 4: full hyperparameters (lr 1e-5, batch 1024, 16384 max response, 32 NVIDIA H20 GPUs); no code-release statement, seeds, or variance/error bars reported anywhere in the document
Section 4.4 Figure 4: γ sensitivity (0, 0.9, 0.99, 1) showing sequence-level γ=1 suffers gradient-norm blowup and entropy collapse
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM post-training methodology paper: on-policy distillation with temporal credit assignment for math/code reasoning on Qwen3 teacher-student setups. Preference relevance is high (LLM training, reasoning, RL-style objectives). Novelty is moderate: the core idea is applying a discount factor to distillation log-ratio advantages—an RL-standard technique—and the theoretical results are simple policy-gradient derivations plus a triangle-inequality variance bound; reward-mixing with distillation is already explored in cited work (REOPOLD, AOPD, RWOPD, SCOPE). Rigor is solid: propositions with proofs (Appendix A–C), seven baselines, three distillation settings, component ablations, γ-sensitivity, and overhead profiling; however, no seeds, error bars, or significance tests are reported and a self-cited nonstandard optimizer (RADAR) is used. Evidence strength is good—consistent gains across Table 1/2 (e.g., surpassing the teacher, 69.49 vs 68.10 AvgAcc) and ablation attribution in Table 3—but rests on single runs. Generalizability is decent within LLM reasoning but untested beyond <10B Qwen3 models and math/code domains, as the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is fair: detailed hyperparameters (Table 4), datasets, verifiers, and pseudocode are given, but no code release or seed protocol is stated.

primary_link.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective approach for large language model post-training, yet existing objectives face a trade-off between objective fidelity and optimization stability. Token-level OPD provides stable but local supervision, whereas sequence-level OPD captures future credit at the cost of horizon-dependent variance. We establish a unified temporal-credit view of these formulations, showing that practical token-level OPD can be interpreted as a temporal approximati
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型後訓練中的 on-policy 蒸餾(OPD)提出統一分析與改良。現有方法面臨目標忠實度與最佳化穩定性的取捨:token 層級 OPD 提供穩定但局部的監督訊號,sequence 層級 OPD 雖能捕捉未來信用,變異數卻隨序列長度增長而暴增。作者從時間性信用分配的視角證明,實務上的 token 層級 OPD 其實是 sequence 層級 reverse-KL 梯度的時間截斷近似。據此提出 γOPD,引入折扣因子 γ 在兩端點之間內插,並證明其變異數具有與序列長度無關的上界。再設計獎勵相容有界混合機制(RBM),先對教師優勢做反應級標準化與 softsign 有界化,再與可驗證的結果獎勵相加,使獎勵正負號決定強化或抑制,教師訊號僅調節更新力度。實驗涵蓋數學與程式推理,在 vanilla、尺寸不匹配與多教師三種蒸餾設定中,γOPD 於 AIME24、AIME25、AMC23、MATH500、HumanEval+、MBPP+ 與 LiveCodeBench 上一致超越 OPD 系列基準與 RL 方法,vanilla 與多教師設定下平均更超越教師模型,額外計算開銷僅約 0.1%。限制為實驗僅涵蓋 10B 參數以下模型,γ 為固定超參數(預設 0.99)。此研究為 OPD 的偏差與變異數取捨提供理論基礎,並展示學生模型超越教師的可行路徑,對 LLM 後訓練具實務價值。
papers.title: Beyond Token-Local Imitation: Reward-Compatible Temporal Credit Assignment for On-Policy Distillation
papers.title_zh: 超越詞元局部模仿:以獎勵相容的時序信用分配改進 On-Policy 蒸餾

links.title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead

evidence: Abstract: top-ten systems share 285 successes and 51 failures on 500 Verified instances; frontier median nesting 0.935 vs score-implied baseline 0.774; 0 of 29 adjacent Verified pairs separable at α=0.05.
Section 3.2/Table 3: nesting exceeds its score-implied baseline in every ability band (frontier excess +0.161), arguing convergence is not an artifact of high scores.

Section 4.1: within-model scaffold range for claude-3-5-sonnet across nine scaffolds is 149 instances (29.8pp) versus the 8.8pp top-thirty spread; five repeat-cell replications give a median replication floor of 27 instances (5.4pp).

Section 5/Table 4: the same McNemar test separates 14 of 23 adjacent pairs on the 2,294-instance Test split, supporting irresolvability as a property of the converged comparison set rather than the test.

Section 3.3: alternative explanations quantitatively tested — 2PL IRT fit (in-sample accuracy 0.868), human-effort ordering inconsistent with defect account, PR-age correlation −0.069 with 95% bootstrap CI [−0.148, +0.012].
Section 7 Limitations: factorial design is observational, 54% of submissions unplaceable, one run per submission, results limited to one benchmark family and one harness.

Reproducibility section: GitHub repository (github.com/Adkid-Zephyr/resolution-audit), frozen analysis manifest, seeds and input hashes recorded; all inputs are publicly published per-instance verdicts requiring no model access.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical match: the paper audits LLM coding-agent evaluation (SWE-bench), directly engaging Agents & Tool Use (coding agents, scaffolds), Code & Programming, LLMs, and benchmark evaluation preferences, though it is a meta-evaluation rather than a new agent/LLM method. Rigor is high: paired exact McNemar tests with Holm correction, bootstrapped difference-in-differences interaction tests, a Test-split counter-test, IRT robustness checks, and explicit testing of alternative explanations (task defects via human-effort ordering, contamination via PR-age correlation). The paper is unusually careful about what its statistics do and do not license (non-rejection ≠ equivalence, observational ≠ causal). Novelty is moderate: the two claimed new constructs (comparison-set-relative n_eff, nesting coefficient vs score-implied baseline) are genuinely useful but the statistical machinery is established and honestly credited; the headline finding (0/29 adjacent pairs separable on a saturated leaderboard) is a novel extreme instance of known phenomena. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, but inherently observational, single-run, and restricted to one leaderboard snapshot. Generalizability is limited by the authors' own admission to the SWE-bench family. Reproducibility is strong: public per-instance verdicts as sole inputs, frozen manifest, released pipeline, seeds and hashes.

primary_link.title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead

papers.summary: Small differences on coding-agent leaderboards are often read as an ordering of systems. We audit whether the published verdicts support this reading, using 254 SWE-bench submissions across four splits without running models. On Verified, the leading two entries each resolve 396 of 500 instances. The top ten share 285 successes and 51 failures, leaving 164 instances that distinguish their outcomes. Frontier solution sets have median nesting 0.935 against a score-implied baseline of 0.774, indica
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文稽核 SWE-bench 排行榜是否真能為頂尖系統排出高下。作者不執行任何模型，而是分析四個公開分割共 254 個提交的逐實例判定結果，提出有效樣本數 n_eff(S)、巢狀係數、精確配對 McNemar 檢定與描述性層級等方法。主要發現：在 Verified 上，前兩名都解出 396 題，前十名共同解出 285 題、共同失敗 51 題，僅剩 164 題具區辨力；有效樣本比例從全體的 0.94 降至前十名的 0.33、前兩名的 0.07。前緣系統解題集合的巢狀係數中位數為 0.935，明顯高於分數隱含基線 0.774，顯示解法彼此巢狀而非互補。分數也不是模型的固有屬性：同一模型更換 scaffold 的差距可達 29.8 個百分點，超過前三十名的整體跨度 8.8 個百分點；九項模型×scaffold 交互作用檢定有六項在 Holm 校正後仍顯著，且 scaffold 優劣順序會隨模型反轉。配對檢定方面，Verified 前三十名的 29 對相鄰名次在 α=0.05 下全數無法區分，但實例更多、能力跨度更大的 Test 分割可分出 23 對中的 14 對，印證不可分源自比較集合收斂而非基準失效。限制：屬觀察性設計，無法推論 scaffold 的因果效果；每個提交僅單次執行；無法排除預訓練資料污染；結論僅限 SWE-bench 家族。本文貢獻在於提供可重用的五步稽核協定，建議社群報告 n_eff、以機器可讀格式記錄模型—scaffold 配對來源、發布層級而非嚴格排名，並以能打破巢狀的不一致實例作為新增題目的預算準則，避免把微小分數差距解讀為確立的排名差異。
papers.title: Coding Agents Have Converged: Why the SWE-bench Leaderboard Can No Longer Order Its Top Entries, and What to Measure Instead
papers.title_zh: Coding Agent 已趨同：SWE-bench 排行榜為何無法再為頂尖系統排序，以及應改測什麼

links.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run

evidence: Abstract: claims 'fully auditable' tier where 'every operation on every data sample during training is independently reproducible on heterogeneous commodity hardware with bitwise certainty'.
§1 Contributions: releases RepOps, topologically invariant data loader, full dataset, checkpoints at 100-step intervals, and an audit harness for NVIDIA GPUs, x86/ARM CPUs, Apple Silicon.
§6 and Algorithm 1-2: sequentialized audit replay with TreeFold binary-carry fold reproducing the cluster's recursive-doubling all-reduce order bit-for-bit.
Table 6 (§3.3.2): Open-1B at 400B tokens scores 25.4 OLMES avg vs OLMo 2 1B's 31.9 at 4T tokens; authors acknowledge the token-budget confound in §7.
§4.2: quantizer step-size drift in pretraining fixed by recomputing scales each step (2*mean(|w|)/sqrt(q_max)); cost ~2% of step time; cause isolated by substitution ablations.
§5 Table 10: repop bf16 reaches 3.3% MFU vs stock PyTorch 40.5% on one node (12.2x gap); int8 narrows it to 6.8x, ~5x at 6 nodes; MFU ~5% during the released run (§5).
§3.4.1 Table 8: held-out mixture CE falls monotonically 6.59 to 2.580; power-law fit R^2=0.93 vs 0.71 on training loss.
§3.4: run validated only via internal 'hash comparisons on the steps which were repeated' across seven restart segments; no third-party audit or cross-device hash-match results are reported.
§7 Conclusion: describes RepOps as a 'proprietary library', in tension with the open-release claims in §1; the backdoor-detection capability (§1, §6) is claimed but never demonstrated experimentally.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope: an end-to-end pretraining and release of a 1.61B decoder-only LLM (§3) whose core contribution is auditable, bitwise-reproducible training infrastructure (RepOps, topologically invariant data stream, deterministic collectives; §2, §6), plus native int8 QAT with useful stability findings (§4.1-4.2). Strongly matches LLM/Training/Transformer/Scaling preferences, moderately the AI Safety angle via backdoor/bias auditability. Novelty is solid: the 'fully auditable run' tier and step-replay audit harness are new, though components (counter-based RNG, fixed reduction order, FTZ matching, recursive-doubling all-reduce) are individually established techniques combined rather than invented. Rigor is mixed: detailed recipe, loss/gradient statistics, spike analysis, and scaling tables are commendable, but there is no controlled int8-vs-bf16 model-quality comparison (only loss-curve divergence of ~0.2 nats in Fig. 7, and the bf16 baseline differs in numerics), the benchmark gap to OLMo 2 1B is confounded by a 10x token-budget difference (Table 6), and the headline claim of detecting injected backdoors/biases (§1, §6) is asserted but never demonstrated with an injection experiment or third-party audit result. Evidence for overheads and convergence is strong (Tables 8-11, Appendix B); evidence for the central audit guarantee rests on internal restart hash comparisons (§3.4) with no published cross-device hash-match table. Generalizability is moderate: methods are architecture-agnostic but the ~5x overhead vs. stock PyTorch (3.3% vs 40.5% MFU at 1 node, Table 10) and socket-fabric-specific scaling leave applicability to larger runs unproven. Reproducibility is exceptional by design: full dataset, 100-step checkpoints, code, audit harness, and per-step hashes are claimed released (§1, §7), slightly marred by calling RepOps 'proprietary' in §7.

primary_link.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run

papers.summary: Open-source language models have a reproducibility problem. Despite releasing weights, training data, and recipes, none of them are provably reproducible due to the non-associativity of floating-point arithmetic. Deep learning frameworks often offer a deterministic execution mode, allowing reproducible operations on the same machines. Unfortunately, this determinism does not carry across hardware such that a user can verify that a released checkpoint was actually produced using the declared trai
papers.summary_zh: 開源語言模型長期存在可重現性問題:即使公開權重、訓練資料與配方,由於浮點運算不滿足結合律,跨硬體無法逐位元重現訓練結果,因此無法證明模型確實依宣告流程訓練,也難以排除未揭露資料、注入偏誤或後門。本文提出「完全可稽核」的新透明度層級,並發表首個符合此標準的模型 Open-1B(1.61B 參數,於 48 張 H100 上預訓練 400B tokens)。方法核心包括:RepOps 程式庫,透過固定縮減順序、停用融合乘加、將次正規數歸零及計數器式亂數生成,在 x86/ARM CPU 與 NVIDIA、Apple GPU 上實現逐位元一致的運算;拓撲不變的資料載入器,使批次順序與叢集規模無關;以及可在單一裝置循序重放的確定性集合通訊。訓練採用 int8 量化感知預訓練(LSQ),並解決了梯度爬升與量化器步長漂移兩種不穩定性,最終 held-out 交叉熵降至 2.580,全程僅兩個批次觸發梯度跳過協定。代價是效能:可重現執行的 MFU 僅約 5%,比最佳化的 PyTorch bf16 慢約 5 倍;且因僅訓練 400B tokens,基準測試落後於使用 4T tokens 的 OLMo 2 1B。作者同時釋出完整預訓練資料集、每 100 步的中間檢查點、程式碼與稽核工具,配合逐步狀態雜湊與集體稽核機制,第三方可在消費級硬體上逐位元驗證任一訓練步驟,首次使後門注入等攻擊可被確切偵測,對建立可驗證的開源 AI 具重要意義。
papers.title: OPEN-1B: A Fully Auditable Training Run
papers.title_zh: OPEN-1B:一次完全可稽核的模型訓練

links.title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement

evidence: Abstract: DRPG integrates memory-based retrieval with a dynamic policy generator, evaluated across six benchmarks (text-to-SQL, QA, medical diagnosis, Python programming) with seven LLMs from proprietary and open-weight families.
Section 5.1 / Table 1: DRPG beats Self-StreamICL in 29/42 model-dataset configurations (35/42 vs Self-Refine and Zero-shot), with the strongest gains on text-to-SQL (18/21).

Section 5.1 / Appendix G Table 9: one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test p=0.005 overall vs Self-StreamICL; per-dataset tests show significant gains on Spider (p=0.016) and CoSQL (p=0.031) but no significant difference on DDXPlus (p=0.938) and DS-1000 (p=0.734).

Section 5.3 / Table 2: cross-model ablation showing smaller models (scout, mistral-small) can serve as policy generators for stronger agents, and that same-model generation on maverick degrades HotpotQA (50.60) while cross-model avoids the drop (63.73, 63.07).
Appendix F / Table 8: no-feedback ablation on llama-3.3-70b shows DRPG beats the feedback-free variant on all six datasets, isolating the contribution of environment feedback.
Appendix C / Table 5: fully specified retrieval pipeline (BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5, FAISS cosine, question-only embedded key, k=16/4), shared unmodified across DRPG and baselines.
Appendix I (Figures 6-13): complete agent and policy-generator prompt templates for all four task types, supporting reproducibility.

Limitations: single fixed data ordering (seed=42) with no variance reported, clean per-step binary feedback acknowledged as idealization, no reasoning LLMs evaluated due to budget, and Dynamic Cheatsheet excluded as a baseline because it does not cover the chosen benchmarks.
Section 4.4: no OpenAI or Claude models tested; authors explicitly note the model spread 'does not by itself establish generality across all modern LLM ecosystems'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely within preferred topics: memory-based continual adaptation of LLMs, retrieval-augmented in-context learning, agent-style environment feedback loops, and prompting/policy generation. Novelty is honest but incremental: the authors themselves state the contribution lies in the combination (Section 2.2, 'the novelty of DRPG lies less in its individual components than in the capability their combination enables') of contrastive retrieval plus streaming feedback-conditioned policy synthesis, distinct from MemPrompt/Self-StreamICL (example-level), Dynamic Cheatsheet (no environment feedback), and LEAP/SALAM (offline, static guidance). Rigor is solid: six benchmarks, seven main + two additional model families, shared retrieval pipeline, fixed prompts, Wilcoxon significance tests (Appendix G, p=0.005 overall), and multiple ablations (retrieval strategy, previous-policy, no-feedback, cross-model generators). Evidence is concrete with full tables, cost/token analysis (Appendix B), and calibrated claims that openly report ties/failures on DDXPlus and DS-1000. Limitations: single seed/ordering with no variance reporting, only clean per-step binary feedback (an acknowledged idealization), limited baselines (no Dynamic Cheatsheet comparison), no reasoning LLMs, and the no-feedback ablation run on only one model. Reproducibility is high on setup detail (full prompts in Appendix I, exact retriever config in Appendix C) but no code release is stated. Generalizability is decent across model families and four task types, but conclusions are explicitly scoped to clean-feedback streaming settings.

primary_link.title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement

papers.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across diverse domains, but continual adaptation to evolving tasks and environments remains a key challenge. Existing memory-augmented approaches retrieve individual past examples as direct references, but do not explicitly synthesize actionable strategies from them, causing the same types of errors to recur. We propose Dynamic Retrieval-based Policy Generation (DRPG), a framework that integrates memory-based retrieval with a dynamic
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型(LLM)在線上串流環境中持續適應的挑戰。現有記憶增強方法僅將過往單一範例作為直接參考,未能從中歸納出可執行的策略,導致同類錯誤反覆出現。作者提出動態檢索式策略生成框架 DRPG:在每個時間步,代理先從記憶庫檢索答對的範例,並由獨立的策略產生器對比檢索正確與錯誤案例,濃縮成至多五點的行動指引(policy)供代理作答時參考;環境回傳的二元正確性回饋則存入記憶,持續支援後續檢索與策略生成。實驗涵蓋 text-to-SQL、問答、醫療診斷與 Python 程式設計六個基準,測試七個專有與開放權重模型。結果顯示 DRPG 在 42 個模型–資料集組合中,以 29 勝優於主要基準 Self-StreamICL,於 Spider、CoSQL、BIRD 等 SQL 任務增益最大,整體差異經單側 Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定顯著(p=0.005)。分析指出策略級指引最適合錯誤型態系統性且可泛化的任務;對需實例特定知識的任務(如 DDXPlus、DS-1000)則與基準相當。消融研究顯示策略生成對檢索組成穩健、不需前次策略延續性,且可由較小或跨家族模型擔任產生器以節省成本,移除環境回饋則效能全面下滑。限制包括仰賴每步乾淨的二元回饋、僅測試單一資料順序與非推理型模型,策略偶爾可能干預代理正確推理。本研究的價值在於為串流環境下何時採用策略級調適提供實務指引。
papers.title: Smarter by the Moment: Environment-Driven Dynamic Policies for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.title_zh: 時刻更聰明:環境驅動的動態策略讓 LLM 持續改進

links.title: RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views

evidence: Abstract: claims 2.4-point resolve-rate gain with 5.8% fewer input tokens and 7.8% fewer model calls vs strongest multimodal graph baseline across three models
Section 5.1: evaluation on all 500 SWE-bench Verified and all 560 LocBench instances; three VLM families (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MiMo-V2.5, Kimi-K2.5); three runs per configuration; budgets B_V=15, B_E=20
Section 5.3 Table 3: six ablations on SWE-bench Verified; per-call refresh drops resolve to 51.0% with highest tokens/calls, no refresh 58.4%, removing textual channel 59.2%
Section 5.3 Table 4: selection analysis on LocBench shows w/o PageRank lowers FA@3 from 0.336 to 0.290 and w/o representative exposure lowers FR from 0.252 to 0.102
Section 5.4: failure case sympy-17630 - runtime-registered dependency absent from static graph; RepoAtlas never opens gold file across eight runs, honestly reported limitation
Section 5.2: SeeRepo reproduction shows views obtained in only 40.5% of instances, used to justify guaranteed initial view; main text reports no confidence intervals or significance tests

Section 4.2/4.4 and Section 5.1: calibration, selection pipeline, and state-transition details deferred to appendix not included in provided text; no code or artifact availability statement anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM coding-agent paper (Agents/Code/LLM preferences) proposing RepoAtlas, a training-free select-project-refresh module that maintains budgeted multimodal (visual+textual) repository views over a static code graph. Relevance is high: repository-level issue resolution with LLM/VLM agents, in-context view management, and tool-based exploration. Novelty is moderate: personalized-PageRank relevance propagation, budgeted subgraph selection, and graph rendering are established; the state-aware auto-refresh and view-maintenance framing distinguish it from SeeRepo's on-demand views. Rigor is solid: full 500-instance SWE-bench Verified plus 560-instance LocBench, three model families, three runs, six-component ablation, selection-only analysis, and an honest failure case; however no significance testing and per-run variance are relegated to an appendix. Evidence is consistent across Tables 2-4 with matched baselines, but effect sizes are modest (1.1-3.0 points) and cost comparisons rely on provider list prices. Generalizability is limited to Python-centric static graphs and VLM-capable models; the paper itself flags runtime-dependency blind spots. Reproducibility is uncertain: training-free and well-specified, but calibration/implementation details live in an appendix not provided and no code release is claimed.

primary_link.title: RepoAtlas: Guiding Coding Agents via Evolving Multimodal Repository Views

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered coding agents have made rapid progress in automating software engineering tasks, yet repository-level issue resolution remains challenging. Beyond generating a plausible patch, an agent must localize relevant code across interdependent files and maintain repository context that is both sufficient and focused. Code graphs expose non-local relations, but linear text interfaces obscure their topology; rendering the full repository graph yields visual representatio
papers.summary_zh: RepoAtlas 針對大型語言模型程式代理在儲存庫層級議題解決上的難題：相關程式碼散布於相互依賴的檔案之間，而現有程式碼圖方法多以線性文字呈現，使拓撲結構隱而不顯；完整渲染的圖過於稠密難以可靠辨識，一次性的局部檢視又會隨探索過程失效。作者提出免訓練模組 RepoAtlas，在離線建構的儲存庫程式碼圖上，以「選取—投影—更新」迴圈維護演進式檢視：選取階段融合議題的詞彙、語意與軌跡證據，並以個人化 PageRank 傳播相關性，在固定節點與邊數預算下組出連通的任務相關子圖；投影階段依圖拓撲與探索狀態自適應選擇版面，產生對齊的視覺圖與記載精確符號及原始碼位置的文字索引；更新階段則依狀態判斷檢視是否過時，定位階段維持多模態檢視，開始編輯後切換為聚焦文字檢視。在 SWE-bench Verified 的 500 個實例上，RepoAtlas 相較最強的多模態圖基線平均提升解決率 2.4 個百分點，輸入 token 減少 5.8%、模型呼叫次數減少 7.8%，且在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、MiMo-V2.5 與 Kimi-K2.5 三種 VLM 上結果一致。消融實驗顯示視覺與文字通道互補，固定預算、自適應版面與狀態感知更新各有貢獻。主要限制是靜態圖無法涵蓋僅於執行期註冊的依賴，失敗案例 sympy-17630 即源於此；未來擬結合執行軌跡與測試回饋補足。本研究說明儲存庫圖作為演進式多模態脈絡，比靜態文字承載更能有效引導代理。

links.title: On the Importance of Gating: Memorization vs. In-Context Learning in State Space Models

evidence: Abstract: gating mechanism causes SSMs to first learn an in-weights memorization solution while delaying or preventing convergence to ICL, even without architectural memory limitations
Section 2.3, Proposition 1: initial growth-rate ratio δ̇r(0)/δ̇m(0) = Pα²/((1-2ϵ)(1+α)²) yields critical scale α*≈sqrt((1-2ϵ)/P) separating retrieval vs. memorization regimes
Proposition 4 / Appendix B.1: escape time from memorization plateau T = Θ(1/(α0 log(1/α0))), potentially exponential in query distance and double-exponential in λ initialization scale
Section 2.4, Proposition 9: decay induces locality; maximum retrievable distance Δmax = Θ(τ log(d/τ)), validated in Figure 1d
Section 5.2 / Figure 4: on BFCL, weaker Mamba gating scores moderately better and hallucinates less, but gating does not influence length generalization in the probed range (reported negative result)
Appendix D.2.2 and D.2.3: full optimization details (AdamW betas/weight decay/warmup/cosine, 8xH100, bfloat16) and five random seeds for Figure 2
Appendix D.5: ~200 experiments each under 10 hours on 8xH100 plus pretraining on 128xH100 for under two days, total under 28,288 H100 GPU hours
Section 6: authors state the work does not offer an immediate solution, and that scalar gating may be insufficient, requiring higher-dimensional or non-linear state transitions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core architecture-science paper directly on preference topics: SSMs/Mamba/linear attention (Transformer Architecture), in-context learning vs. memorization (ICL), length generalization (Long Context), and a full tool-calling section using BFCL with a BM25 tool retriever (Agents & Tool Use). Novelty is solid but incremental: gating-induced recency bias and mimetic/no-decay initialization for copying are already known (Trockman et al. 2024; Wang et al. 2024); the fresh part is the memorization-plateau escape-time analysis and the explicit dual-role tradeoff (gating hurts short-context ICL retrieval but enables length generalization). Rigor is high: formal propositions with proofs (Appendix B), stated simplifying assumptions (orthonormal tokens, identity K/Q/V, gradient flow), quantitative validation of predicted critical α*, escape-time scaling, and Bayes-error contours (Figure 1), gate-drift check for the static-gate assumption (Table 1, Appendix B.3). Evidence is strengthened by 5 seeds, Transformer baselines, a hyperparameter sweep, honest negative results (no gating effect on BFCL length generalization in the probed range), and explicit compute reporting (~28,288 H100-hours, ~200 runs, Appendix D.5). Generalizability is capped because theory covers a simplified single-head gated linear model and the authors concede (Section 6) that no fix is offered and scalar gating may be fundamentally insufficient for complex retrieval. Reproducibility is good on hyperparameters, architectures, datasets (Nemotron-CC-HQ, Nemotron Agentic, BFCL python simple), and seeds, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: On the Importance of Gating: Memorization vs. In-Context Learning in State Space Models

papers.summary: State Space Models (SSMs) have emerged as a compelling alternative to Transformers, enabling sequence modeling with constant memory and linear compute. Although SSMs exhibit reasonable performance and favorable computational characteristics, they continue to lag behind Transformers on tasks that require in-context learning and precise retrieval, slowing their adoption for large-scale language modeling. In this work, we demonstrate that both the success and failure of SSMs in these domains can be
papers.summary_zh: State Space Models(SSM)如 Mamba 具有線性計算與常數記憶體的優勢,但在需要 in-context learning(ICL)與精確檢索的任務上仍落後 Transformer。本文跳脫「表達能力不足」的傳統解釋,指出 gating 機制的初始化與訓練動態才是關鍵:強 gating 會讓模型先收斂到依賴權重的「記憶化」解,延遲甚至阻礙正確的 ICL 解。作者針對帶全域 gating 參數的簡化 Mamba 模型做理論分析,將 signed margin 分解為記憶化與檢索兩項,證明初始化強弱決定收斂路徑,並推導逃離記憶化高原的時間約為 1/(α log(1/α)),可能隨查詢距離呈指數成長;另一方面證明衰減可控制長上下文的雜訊累積,有效可檢索距離約為 τ log(d/τ),故強 gating 反而利於長度泛化。實驗以多 token 檢索、Horn 子句邏輯規則任務,以及預訓練 Mamba 於 BFCL 工具呼叫的微調加以驗證:較弱 gating 降低幻覺率、加快學會檢索,較強 gating 則改善超出訓練長度的泛化表現。限制在於本文重在科學理解,未提出直接解方,改變初始化可能犧牲長上下文表現,且純量 gating 或不足以支援複雜的記憶管理,未來可能需要更高維線性或非線性的狀態轉移。整體而言,此研究闡明 gating 在訓練動態與泛化之間的雙重角色,為理解與改進線性時間架構奠定基礎。

links.title: SKIP: a Self-knowledge-guided Step-wise Preference Learning Framework for Concise Reasoning

evidence: Section IV (Models and Datasets): experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen-3-14B over GSM8K, MATH, MedQA; OOD on StrategyQA and BBH Date Understanding; 'we ran the experiments five times and report the mean results'.
Table I: Llama-3.1-8B GSM8K SKIP-8 84.35 Acc / 119.00 Length vs Default 85.50 / 240.40; Qwen3-14B GSM8K SKIP-1 95.45 Acc / 152.47 Length vs Default 88.93 / 473.57.

Section III-B (Step-wise Preference): knowledge preference 'longer and right > shorter and wrong' and length preference 'shorter but right > longer and right'; long-but-wrong vs short-and-wrong pairs discarded as uninformative.
Table III: masked-DPO vs DPO on Llama-3.1-8B, SKIP-8 GSM8K 84.35 vs 83.96 Acc, MATH 46.68 vs 45.8 — improvement is small.
Table II (Section IV-A): OOD on Llama-3.1-8B, MATH-trained SKIP-8 BBH(DU) 70.8 Acc / 91.8 Len vs Default 76.8 / 257.5; text admits 'notable drop in accuracy compared to the Default model'.
Appendix -A (Table IV): EM vs LLM-as-a-Judge consistency 0.85-0.94 across models/datasets on 300 sampled examples each.
Appendix -B (Table V): SKIP1-V2 gives 82.1 Acc / 101.7 Len on GSM8K vs V1 82.9 / 115.2, supporting the choice of conditional length-preference data.
Section VI (Limitations): authors acknowledge the accuracy-per-token efficiency metric ignores diminishing returns and call for broader evaluation.
Section I (Contributions): 'Our data/code is available at https://github.com/linqinhong/SKIP'; however no LoRA rank, DPO beta, learning rate, or epoch counts are specified anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work: step-wise forced-answer probing constructs knowledge/length preference pairs for DPO to compress chain-of-thought without accuracy loss. Strongly matches top-weighted preferences (LLMs, Reasoning & CoT, DPO/alignment, efficiency) and is clearly in scope. Novelty is moderate: it combines known ingredients (internal-state probing, DPO, LoRA, SFT cold start; cf. cited TALE, FS-BoN, C3OT, probing refs [15,16]) into a new data-construction recipe plus masked-DPO, rather than a fundamentally new technique. Rigor is decent: 3 public models, 3 ID + 2 OOD datasets, matched-data BON controls, 5-run means, ablations over mix ratio, data size, masking, and V1/V2 preference variants; but baselines are thin (one inference-time method), no significance tests, MATH test is only 500 examples, and OOD evaluation covers only Llama-3.1-8B. Evidence is generally consistent and honestly reported (e.g., accuracy drop on OOD acknowledged), though the conclusion's 'even improving accuracy' is mildly overstated (Llama-3.1-8B GSM8K SKIP-8 84.35 vs Default 85.50) and the masked-DPO gains are marginal. Reproducibility is helped by a stated code/data release and detailed data-construction rules (Table VI), but training hyperparameters (LoRA rank, beta, LR, epochs) are absent.

primary_link.title: SKIP: a Self-knowledge-guided Step-wise Preference Learning Framework for Concise Reasoning

papers.summary: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has been proven to be effective, it often leads to overthinking, resulting in computational overhead, inference latency, and even degraded performance in large language models (LLMs). Existing concise reasoning frameworks significantly compromise accuracy while compressing the length of output. In this paper, we propose SKIP, a self-knowledge-guided step-wise preference learning framework. Starting with lightweight fine-tuning to adjust the model's output s
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）在 Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理中的「過度思考」問題：冗長的推理鏈帶來額外運算成本與推論延遲，而現有簡潔推理方法在壓縮輸出長度時往往明顯犧牲準確率。作者提出 SKIP 框架，分三階段：先以少量資料進行 SFT 冷啟動，使模型輸出較簡潔、以「The answer is」收尾的風格；接著設計自我知識探測機制，在每個推理步驟後插入探測訊號，強迫模型以貪婪解碼產生答案，藉中間步驟的正確與否判斷知識是否已充足；最後依此建構「知識偏好」與「長度偏好」兩類成對資料，採用 masked-DPO（僅微調 LoRA 參數）訓練，並遮蔽樣本間的共同前綴以穩定最佳化。實驗涵蓋 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B 與 Qwen3-14B，在 GSM8K、MATH、MedQA 上，SKIP-8 幾乎於所有設定取得最高 token 效率，且較 BON 基線同時提升準確率並縮短推理長度；在 StrategyQA 與 BBH 日期理解等 OOD 資料集上也展現泛化優勢。消融實驗顯示兩類偏好資料形成制衡：知識偏好資料拉長推理並提高準確率，長度偏好資料則抑制冗餘步驟；masked-DPO 亦優於傳統 DPO。限制包括效率指標（準確率除以長度）未考慮邊際遞減效應，且評估範疇仍待擴充。此研究的重要性在於不需依賴外部強大模型，僅憑模型自身知識即可高效建構訓練資料，實現簡潔推理而不損失、甚至提升效能。

links.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control

evidence: Abstract: 'Grounded-CoSQ at tau=0.90 reduces the mean unconditional wrong-commitment rate from 13.1% under chain-of-thought prompting to 8.9%, a 32.1% relative reduction, while increasing answered accuracy from 86.9% to 89.7% and answering 87.6% of questions.'
Section 4.3: 'Each model is evaluated under seventeen conditions... The final manifests share one question-ID hash, one balanced-option hash, and one prompt digest.'
Section 5.6 / Table 8: mean HR decrease 0.0422 [0.0272, 0.0595], one-sided Wilcoxon p=0.00049, direction '11/11' for all three variant comparisons.
Section 5.2 / Table 4: Grounded-CoSQ correct-abstention share 0.313 vs lost-value share 0.687 at tau=0.90.
Section 3.4 'Baselines': 'Direct prompting... CoT... These baselines measure the cost of adding a selective gate' - no external abstention/confidence-elicitation baselines are compared.

Section 7 Limitations: 'confidence is elicited from the same language model that produces the answer... The model panel uses endpoint-level identifiers and hosted model names. Some endpoints may change weights or serving behavior without exposing immutable revisions.'
Appendix A: full versioned prompt templates for all three CoSQ variants and baselines; Data Availability: GitHub (github.com/senolali/CoSQ) and PyPI (pypi.org/project/cosq).

Section 4.5: paired exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, 10,000-resample bootstrap CIs, Cohen's dz, with caveat that 'hosted model endpoints [are] not independent samples from a population of all LLMs.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper (prompt-only selective answering/abstention for hallucination risk control) with strong match to LLM, chain-of-thought, prompting, factuality, and evaluation preferences. Experimental design is careful: 11 model families, 817 TruthfulQA-MC items, prespecified full threshold sweep, balanced option order, paired Wilcoxon/bootstrap statistics with 11/11 directional consistency, transparent abstention-composition analysis (68.7% of Grounded-CoSQ abstentions withhold CoT-correct answers), and full prompt templates in Appendix A. Main weaknesses: novelty is incremental over cited selective-generation work (verbalized confidence, R-Tuning, multi-LLM abstention); the only baselines are forced-choice Direct and CoT (Section 3.4), so no simpler prompt-only confidence-threshold abstention or SelfCheckGPT-style comparator isolates the value of the multi-stage decomposition; hosted endpoints (GPT-5.5, Claude 5 Sonnet, DeepSeek Flash) lack immutable version pins; and evidence rests on one primary benchmark plus a small 5-model NQ-Short secondary test with no threshold transfer.

primary_link.title: When Should LLMs Abstain? Chain-of-Self-Questioning for Selective Risk Control

papers.summary: Large language models can produce fluent answers when their factual support is weak. This paper introduces Chain-of-Self-Questioning (CoSQ), a prompt-only framework that makes answer commitment conditional on an explicit assessment of the information required to answer a question. We evaluate three CoSQ variants under seventeen conditions on the 817-item TruthfulQA multiple-choice validation set using eleven open-weight and hosted model families. In the final balanced-option protocol, Grounded-C
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）在事實依據不足時仍可能流暢作答的幻覺問題，提出僅靠提示詞即可運作的選擇性作答框架 Chain-of-Self-Questioning（CoSQ）。方法分三階段：先辨識回答問題所需的資訊單元，再對每個單元評估信心分數，最後依門檻 τ 決定作答或棄權，且只有通過門檻的資訊單元才會進入最終答案生成。論文比較 Grounded、Critical 與 Adaptive 三種變體，在 817 題 TruthfulQA 選擇題、十一個模型家族與十七種條件下評估。主要結果顯示，Grounded-CoSQ 在 τ=0.90 時將無條件錯誤承諾率自 CoT 基線的 13.1% 降至 8.9%（相對降幅 32.1%），已答題正確率由 86.9% 升至 89.7%，涵蓋率維持 87.6%；十一個模型全數呈現同向改善，配對 Wilcoxon 檢定與 bootstrap 信賴區間支持兩項方向性假設，Natural Questions 短答題的次要實驗亦提供一致證據。限制包括：信心訊號來自同一模型而非校準機率、每題需 3 至 4 次推論呼叫而增加成本、Grounded-CoSQ 的棄權中僅約 31% 確實對應基線錯誤（其餘為放棄的潛在價值），以及單一主要基準與通用提示詞可能限制泛化。此研究重要性在於將「答對多少」與「是否該答」分離，提供可在風險與涵蓋之間調節的操作點，適合高風險場景中優先降低錯誤承諾的部署需求。

links.title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: evaluates ten instruction-tuned LLaMA-3/Qwen-2.5 models on counterfactual self-explanations, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and human alignment.

Section 2.3, Eq. 4: introduces ESMP (Evidence-Supported Modification Precision), computed as TP/(TP+FP) over edits falling inside ERASER human-annotated rationale spans; precision chosen deliberately over recall for minimality.

Section 3 and Appendix D, Table 6: Spearman ρ=0.866 (p<0.001) for size vs faithfulness, ρ=0.778 for ESMP, ρ=0.319 closeness, ρ=0.157 semantic similarity; regression β=0.119 [0.092,0.147] per log2(size) doubling with controls.
Appendix D: fractional-logit model gives odds ratio 2.00, 95% CI [1.68,2.40], p<0.001 for faithfulness per size doubling; analyses explicitly framed as descriptive over aggregate values.

Appendix C, Tables 2-5: full per-setting results for faithfulness, semantic similarity, closeness, ESMP across Movies and e-SNLI; Chat-History best faithfulness in 12/20 settings, Rationale-Guided best ESMP and closeness in 15/20 settings.
Appendix A, Table 1: exact HuggingFace model identifiers, single NVIDIA H200 GPU, temperature 0 / top-p 1 / max 4096 tokens decoding.
Appendix B: complete prompts for all three pipeline stages under Baseline and Rationale-Guided conditions.
Limitations: analysis restricted to binary classification tasks; metrics may not capture human understandability or usefulness.
Footnote 1: code available at https://github.com/gianniskalyvas/cf-self-explanations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference LLM interpretability work: studies faithfulness of LLM self-generated counterfactual explanations across 10 instruction-tuned LLaMA-3/Qwen-2.5 models, with prompting-strategy ablations. Novelty is moderate: the pipeline is adapted from Madsen et al. (2024) and the rationale-guided condition from Bhattacharjee et al. (2024); the main new contributions are the ESMP metric (Section 2.3, Eq. 4) and a controlled scale analysis (Appendix D, Table 6: Spearman ρ=0.866, p<0.001; regression β=0.119 [0.092,0.147] per size doubling; fractional-logit OR=2.00 [1.68,2.40]). Rigor is solid with 20 settings, full result tables (Appendix C, Tables 2-5), regression controls for dataset/family/prompting, and acknowledged limitations (binary classification only, metric scope); however, analyses are aggregate/descriptive over ~20 setting-level means, only two binary English tasks, and prediction-flip faithfulness conflates classification competence with explanation quality. Evidence claims are checkable against the tables and mostly consistent, though minor non-monotonicities (e.g., Qwen 72B below 32B under Chat-History in Table 2) are not deeply analyzed. Generalizability is constrained by binary-task scope, explicitly stated in Limitations. Reproducibility is excellent: public code (footnote 1), exact model identifiers, hardware, deterministic decoding parameters, and full prompts (Appendices A-B).

primary_link.title: An Empirical Study of Counterfactual Self-Explanations in LLMs

papers.summary: Large language models can easily generate explanations for their own outputs, but such self-explanations are not necessarily faithful to the model's behavior. We study this issue through counterfactual self-explanations, where a model minimally edits an input so that its own prediction changes. Across sentiment analysis and natural language inference, we evaluate ten instruction-tuned models from the LLaMA-3 and Qwen-2.5 families, measuring faithfulness, minimality, and alignment with human-anno
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型能輕易為自身輸出產生解釋，但這些自我解釋未必忠實反映模型的真實行為。本文以「反事實自我解釋」檢視此問題：要求模型對輸入進行最小幅度的編輯，使其自身的預測翻轉。研究涵蓋電影評論情緒分析與 e-SNLI 自然語言推論兩項任務，採用 ERASER 基準測試集，評估 LLaMA-3 與 Qwen-2.5 兩家族共十個 instruction-tuned 模型，比較基準、Chat-History 與 Rationale-Guided 三種提示策略，並以忠實性（翻轉率）、最小性（編輯距離與語意相似度）及自創的 ESMP 指標（衡量編輯是否落在人類標註的證據區間）評估品質。主要結果顯示，模型規模是解釋品質的最強決定因素：規模與翻轉率的 Spearman 相關達 0.87，與 ESMP 達 0.78；控制資料集、模型家族與提示策略後，模型規模每翻倍，忠實性約提升 12 個百分點。較大模型不僅更能產生可翻轉自身預測的反事實，其編輯也更集中於與人類推理一致的證據。相對地，Rationale-Guided 雖提升 ESMP 與最小性，卻未能一致提升忠實性，顯示提示設計可能讓解釋「看起來」更佳，卻偏離模型實際的決策依據；Chat-History 則在 20 個設定中的 12 個取得最高忠實性。研究限制在於僅涵蓋二元分類任務，且現有指標未必反映解釋對人類的可理解性與實用性。本研究的意義在於：反事實自我解釋可作為模型行為的有用行為證據，但其可靠性高度依賴模型容量，必須經實證驗證，不能直接視為存取模型內部推理的途徑。

papers.title_zh: LLM 反事實自我解釋之實證研究

links.title: Autoformalizing Argumentative Material Inferences

evidence: Abstract/Results: GUARD yields verified-faithful gains of +35.3 and +32.9 points and leakage reductions of -25.9/-21.9 over PEIRCE; Table 1 confirms average VFR 61.13 vs 25.81 (Debatepedia) and 65.00 vs 32.13 (ARCT).
Table 1: GPT-5.1 reaches SP 78.14 / VFR 76.52 on Debatepedia and SP 82.50 / VFR 81.00 on ARCT, vs PEIRCE 45.34/33.60 and 51.00/39.00.

Table 3 and Appendix E: removing the soft symbolic critique drops VFR by 40.5 (Debatepedia) and 39.5 (ARCT) points with GPT-5.1; removing assumptions drops 23.5/31.5 points, consistent across all four backbones in Table E.1.
Stage IV (Faithfulness Check): counter-premise and alternative-claim probes 'are proposed by our framework' - self-generated contrastive tests, a potential evaluation weakness.
Abstention analysis: 63.5-74.3% of unproven instances are abstain-missing-guards under +10 hard iterations; GPT-5.1 would reach 93.5%/95.5% solver-pass under doubled budget.

Appendix B.4 / Table B.1: autoformalization faithfulness via informalisation cosine similarity 0.798-0.917, plus human annotation of 300 sampled logical forms (annotator count/agreement not reported).

Appendix A.2/Table A.2: model identifiers (gpt-5.1, qwen3-max-preview, deepseek-chat, mistral-medium-3-5), temperature 0.6 or reasoning_effort medium, and explicit refinement budgets (10 soft, 10 hard, 5 faithfulness) support reproducibility; Appendix D states complete prompts 'are provided in the submitted code' but no public code/data link is given.
Experimental Setup: 247 topic-balanced Debatepedia pairs (13 per topic, 19 topics) and 200 randomly sampled ARCT instances, identical instances across all methods and backbones.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper squarely in scope: a neuro-symbolic framework (GUARD) coupling four backbone LLMs (GPT-5.1, Qwen3-Max, DeepSeek-V3.2, Mistral Medium 3.5) with Isabelle/HOL to autoformalize argumentative material inferences, with explicit chain-of-thought/reasoning baselines (CoT, Toulmin) and a formal-verification refinement loop. Novelty is solid but incremental: the soft/hard critique loop extends the authors' own PEIRCE line; the genuinely new pieces are the guard-completion framing, PO1-PO4 obligations, and contrastive premise/claim faithfulness tests that block 'leakage' where added premises bypass the original premise. Rigor is good: two datasets (247 Debatepedia pairs, 200 ARCT samples, Section: Experimental Setup), a strong iterative SOTA baseline at matched 10-iteration budget, full ablations across all backbones (Table E.1), abstention analysis under extended budget, and autoformalization faithfulness checks (Appendix B.4). Weaknesses: no statistical significance testing or variance reporting, contrastive probes are generated by the system itself (Stage IV), and the human error annotation (300 logical forms) lacks annotator/agreement detail. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (e.g., average VFR 61.13 vs PEIRCE 25.81 on Debatepedia yields the claimed +35.3; leakage averages 4.06 vs 29.96 yield -25.9). Generalizability is limited to argumentative/NLI-style material inference with the authors noting broader domains as future work. Reproducibility is aided by model identifiers, decoding settings, iteration budgets, and full prompt templates, but code release is only implied ('provided in the submitted code') without a repository link.
