papers.summary_zh: 自然語言論證的支持關係常依賴隱含的論證保證、背景承諾與例外條件,直接翻譯成邏輯往往不成立:直接自動形式化在所有骨幹 LLM 上求解通過率皆為零。但若允許系統自由補建前提,又可能讓任何主張變得可證,造成「漏證」(leakage)——證明繞過原前提或證出超出主張的內容。本文將論證性實質推論的自動形式化建構為「守衛補全」(guard completion)問題,以明確建構的守衛集合把非單調的實質支持轉成可檢驗的單調形式推論,並提出神經符號框架 GUARD:第一階段脈絡強化,以 LLM 萃取預設假設、定義與詞項正規化,以及帶異常謂詞的可否證規則;第二階段依 PO1–PO4 四項證明義務做符號層軟性批評與修正;第三階段以 Isabelle/HOL 硬性驗證,將失敗證明步驟回饋迭代修補;第四階段以空前提、同主題反前提與替代主張做對比式忠實性檢驗,唯有擾動理論皆不可證才接受。在 Debatepedia 與 ARCT 上,以 GPT-5.1、Qwen3-Max、DeepSeek-V3.2、Mistral Medium 3.5 為骨幹,相較最佳基線 PEIRCE,平均 verified-faithful 率提升 35.3 與 32.9 點,漏證率下降 25.9 與 21.9 點;消融顯示軟性符號批評與假設層貢獻最大(最多 −40.5 與 −31.5 點),棄答主因是守衛不足(63.5–74.3%)而非論證不相容。限制包括僅評估兩個論證語料,殘餘漏證集中於前提端,且較弱模型可能把萃取能力不足誤判為不相容。此研究讓隱含論證支援成為可機器稽核的證明,對可信 NLP 推論具重要意義。

§3.2 Table 2: two-branch peak 12% lower at 8K but 'prefix physically shared? no (0%)' via data_ptr inspection before and after generation

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM serving/efficiency study: KV cache reuse across standard LoRA adapters on a shared backbone directly hits LLM (2.5), Inference & Serving, and efficiency preferences. Rigor is unusually high for an industrial empirical note: paired bootstrap CIs, an own-KV harness control (49.2 vs 48.3 EM, §4), explicit held-out vs overlapping-sample separation, seed replication, and honest negative results (no physical KV sharing despite 12% peak reduction, §3.2 Table 2; ridge translator rejected, §5). However, the central quality-penalty magnitude is unstable (−4.6 EM held-out CI excluding zero, but −3.0 at 320 tokens and −0.8 for seed 2, both CIs including zero; Abstract/§4), so evidence strength is moderate—the robust findings are adapter necessity, warm-cache TTFT speedup (~16× at 8K, Table 1), and the storage-copying correction. Generalizability is limited: one 1.7B backbone, two tasks, single seed per task (§6). Reproducibility is good (repo with code, checkpoints, per-example arrays, Appendix C) but timings are single-run, cap-fraction logging was missing, and the appendix is an outline. A valuable, transparent negative/qualified result rather than a new method.

papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討小型模型可組合式部署的實際問題：一個共享骨幹搭配多個已完成訓練的標準 LoRA 專家（未為快取相容性重新訓練），若在推論時直接重複使用骨幹預先算好的 prefill KV 快取，能保留多少任務品質、又換來多少 serving 成本效益。作者以 Qwen3-1.7B 為骨幹，訓練 HotpotQA 抽取式問答與 GSM8K 算術推理兩個 rank-16 的 LoRA 專家，掃描專家接手的邊界（native、早期、題目、完整前綴），並以配對 bootstrap 信賴區間量化品質差異。結果顯示完整前綴重用的 prefill 成本最低，但 GSM8K 留出測試集準確率下降 4.6 EM（160 token 預算下唯一顯著；320 token 為 −3.0、第二個訓練 seed 為 −0.8，幅度不一致）；QA 損失隨上下文長度變化（700 token 時 +0.3 F1，2K/8K 為 −6.6/−4.5）。serving 效益是暖快取 TTFT，8K 時約 16 倍加速；但兩分支峰值記憶體僅低 12%，檢查發現前綴從未實體共享——實作只重用 KV 值卻複製其儲存。此外 ridge KV 轉換器未勝過直接重用，專家依賴性對比皆含零。研究限制包括單一小規模骨幹、僅兩項任務、部分損失源自生成截斷，且未證立品質等價或通用邊界選擇法則。本文價值在誠實界定品質—延遲權衡，並指出實體共享需分頁快取等實作方能實現記憶體節省。

links.title: ResLRP: The Role of Residual Cancellation in Attribution Instability in Vision Transformers

evidence: Sec. 4.1 + Sec. A.2: Boundedness proposition (−1/γ ≤ Φ ≤ 1+1/γ), exact conservation proof, and per-merge amplification bound A ≤ 1+2/γ.

Sec. 3 + Fig. 2: cancellation metric C ≈ 1.7 for ViTs vs C ≈ 1.4 for LLMs; Pearson correlation 0.99 between C and relevance amplification A; paper itself notes correlation alone is not causal (Qwen2.5 counterexample).

Sec. 5.2 + Tab. A.8: targeted interventions — correcting top 0.5% cancellation-prone channels (92) gives +7.9% SRG while treating 75% low-cancellation channels gives −5.5%; replication on DINOv2-B in Tab. A.8b.
Sec. 5.4 + Tab. 3: on Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-4B, Gemma-3-4B-it, ResLRP best on both metrics; localization +27–29% relative, SRG up to 3.4×, Wilcoxon p ≤ 1.7×10⁻²⁶.
Sec. A.3 + Sec. A.5: complete PyTorch backward-hook implementation, listed TIMM/HF checkpoints, seeds (339306, 754068, 23001), and single-RTX-5090 hardware; GitHub link in author footnote.
Sec. A.13 + Tab. A.6: γ sweep over 11 values on 6 models shows plateau; untuned γ=1 attains 98–100% of best-γ SRG on 5/7 models, supporting hyperparameter robustness.
Limitations & Outlook: guarantees are local to residual additions, full-model conservation limited by AttnLRP attention rule, and diffusion transformers/SSMs unexamined — appropriate self-critique.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Methodologically strong XAI paper, but core topic is vision-transformer attribution, only partially aligned with top-weighted preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents, Japanese NLP). Relevance comes via Interpretability (LRP, SAE features), Transformer Architecture (residual/attention analysis), and Multimodal VLM evaluation; LLM content is comparative (Sec. 3: C≈1.4 in LLMs vs C≈1.7 in ViTs) rather than central, and the γ-rule is applied only to vision towers (Sec. A.11), so not capped as pure CV but not core LLM research either. Novelty is solid: identifying residual cancellation as the driver of LRP relevance explosion is a new diagnosis, though the mechanism is a simple reuse of the LRP-γ rule at residual adds. Rigor and evidence are strong: boundedness proposition with proof (Sec. 4.1/A.2), causal channel-wise interventions (Sec. 5.2, Tab. A.8: top-0.5% channels +7.9% vs bottom-75% −5.5%), component ablations (Tab. A.9), FunnyBirds ground-truth checks (Tab. 2), Wilcoxon significance for VLM gains (p≤1.7e-26, Tab. 3), γ-sweep robustness (Sec. A.13). Generalizability is good across seven ViT families and three VLMs but guarantees are local and diffusion/SSM models untested (Limitations). Reproducibility is high: complete PyTorch rule (Sec. A.3), checkpoints, seeds, hardware, and a public repo link. Quality of execution clearly above average; score capped mainly by topic fit.

primary_link.title: ResLRP: The Role of Residual Cancellation in Attribution Instability in Vision Transformers

papers.summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are central to most modern vision models, yet obtaining input attributions that are fine-grained, faithful, and stable remains challenging. Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) has been adapted to transformer attention, but in ViTs it often produces noisy, unfaithful explanations. We show that the missing ingredient is the treatment of residual connections: cancellation effects in residual pathways lead to attribution explosion. Moreover, we find that these cancellat
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討以 Layer-wise Relevance Propagation（LRP）解釋 Vision Transformer（ViT）時，常產生雜訊多且不忠實熱圖的問題。作者指出關鍵在殘差連接：當注意力或 MLP 更新與殘差流方向相反並相互抵消時，輸出活化值極小，標準 LRP 除以近零分母，會放大正負相關性對，造成「相關性爆炸」，使歸因圖破碎不穩；此現象在 ViT 中遠強於語言 Transformer，並集中於早期層。為此提出 ResLRP，在每次殘差相加處套用 γ 規則，強化與輸出同號的分支、壓抑矛盾分支的相關性；此規則完全守恆，並具可證明的放大上界（預設 γ=1 時每個殘差點 𝒜≤3）。透過通道層級因果介入，證實效益確實源自修正殘差抵消，而非一般正規化。實證涵蓋七個 ViT 檢查點、FunnyBirds 合成基準，以及 Qwen2.5-VL、Qwen3-VL、Gemma-3 三個 VLM。ResLRP 在忠實度（SRG）與定位指標上多半最佳，VLM 上定位相對提升 27–29%，SRG 最高提升 3.4 倍；ResLRP 亦能將 SAE 特徵定位回輸入空間，殘差放大指標可作為架構層級診斷，例如顯示 register tokens 能穩定殘差流。限制方面：理論保證僅限殘差相加的局部性質，整體品質仍依賴實證；端到端守恆受 AttnLRP 注意力規則限制；未檢視擴散 Transformer 或狀態空間模型等架構。由於 VLM 正成為主流視覺架構，忠實歸因對除錯、偏誤偵測與視覺接地至關重要，本方法深具價值。

links.title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback

evidence: Abstract: CCL couples teacher calibration with student updates via token-level branching using reward feedback only on source questions; expected average KL to oracle student converges at polynomial rate.
Section 5, Theorem 5.1: rate C_{lambda,m}(T+1)^{-1/(4 p_{lambda,m})} with constants 'independent of T' but model-dependent via Lojasiewicz exponent p_{lambda,m} (Lemma B.11).
Section 4, Algorithm 1 and schedules (4.3): exactly T source reward queries and O(T^3) target rollouts over T rounds, of which O(T^2) estimate student gradients.

Section 3, Eq. (3.3) and Assumptions 3.2-3.4: linear-softmax teacher/student classes with known feature maps, realizability of the regularized optimum in the calibration class, and positive-definite joint source information matrix.

Section 7 Discussion: 'computational experiments with pretrained LLMs on coding and mathematical reasoning tasks would help assess the method' - no experiments, code, or artifacts are included in the paper.
Section 6, Theorem 6.2: LLM-as-judge (H=2) instance where regularized direct matching retains KL at least kappa_SM(1-alpha)^2/(128 lambda^2) from the oracle student, supporting the separation claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on distillation/post-training: proposes Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL) to correct biased teachers under covariate shift using source-only reward feedback, with a token-level branching mechanism and a direct-matching separation in an LLM-as-judge instance. Highly relevant to LLM, RLHF/reward-model, and distillation preferences. Theoretical rigor is high: assumptions (realizability, uniqueness, joint source identification) are explicit, and full proofs are provided in Appendices B-C. However, the work is purely theoretical with zero empirical validation (Section 7 concedes computational experiments are future work), the framework assumes linear-softmax policies with known feature maps that are far from real LLMs, the convergence rate (T+1)^{-1/(4p)} carries non-explicit model-dependent constants (e.g., delta_loc^d, e^{-1/lambda}) with O(T^3) target rollouts per T source queries, and no code or artifact availability is claimed. Novelty is moderate: it is a close derivative of Yamamoto and Wainwright's residual-as-teacher line, though the coupling of source-reward calibration with target-side student learning and the no-target-feedback guarantee are new.
topics: Statistical learning theory for LLM post-training

primary_link.title: Coupled Calibration and Learning: Mitigating Teacher Bias in LLM Distillation without Target-Domain Reward Feedback

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) distillation aims to transfer the capabilities of a powerful teacher to a smaller student. Direct imitation, however, can also transfer the teacher's systematic bias and errors. This challenge is particularly pronounced under covariate shift, when the teacher's reliability on target questions is uncertain and target-domain reward feedback is unavailable. We propose Coupled Calibration and Learning (CCL), an LLM distillation algorithm that couples teacher calibration wi
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 知識蒸餾的核心難題:直接模仿強大教師模型時,會連同其系統性偏誤一併繼承;尤其在目標問題與來源問題分布不一致(covariate shift)、且目標域獎勵回饋不可得時更為棘手。作者提出耦合校準與學習(CCL)演算法,以 token 層級分支(branching)機制,僅使用來源問題的獎勵回饋同時校正教師並訓練學生:每輪迭代先以來源回饋校準教師的 softmax 參數,再以校準後的教師在目標問題上訓練學生,更新後的學生又成為下一輪校準比較時的備選 token 來源。在自迴歸策略與線性 softmax 架構下,論文證明輸出學生與 oracle 學生(在學生類別內最大化真實 KL 正規化目標獎勵的最優策略)的期望平均 KL 散度,以多項式速率收斂至零;分析結合梯度步的局部進度、均勻探索、批次梯度估計與新鮮驗證,同時控制校準誤差與有限 rollout 誤差。論文另建立分離結果:在 LLM-as-judge 實例中,即使教師的正規化獎勵高於所有學生策略,正規化直接匹配仍殘留無法消除的誤差,凸顯校準機制的必要性。限制包括尚未以真實 LLM 實驗驗證、常數依賴模型局部幾何與 Łojasiewicz 指數,且目標端 rollout 總量為 O(T³)。此結果顯示即使缺乏目標域回饋,蒸餾仍可克服教師偏誤、逼近最優學生,對 RLHF 後訓練與模型壓縮具理論價值。

Appendix A: 'we randomly select 50 episodes from the test set of each dataset, a total of 250 sessions' - a small evaluation subset for the main claims.

Table 1 (Section 4.2): ICML variants outperform Long Context, Mem0, A-Mem, MemoryOS, MemoryBank, LD-Agent, and THEANINE across CC/MSC/GC with both GPT-4o and Gemini2.5 backbones (e.g., CC Mauve 80.33 vs 54-75 for baselines under Gemini2.5).
Table 2 (Section 4.2): removing the Truth Reward causes the largest drop (CC Mauve 80.33 -> 76.19), and removing synthetic data, Planner, Trigger, or evolution all degrade performance.
Appendix L, Table 9: human evaluation win rates of 66.0% (generation) and 70.0% (memory) vs THEANINE with Fleiss' Kappa 0.65/0.68 and p<0.01.
Appendix J: ICML 'stabilizes to only 10.22s by Session 5' and MemoryOS reaches 826.61s, which contradicts the Section 5 conclusion of 'millisecond-level latency'.
Appendix P, Table 13: ICML beats an RL-only RMM variant in zero-shot adaptation across all datasets/backbones, supporting the claimed advance over the closest prior online-RL memory method.

Appendix C, Table 5: full training hyperparameters (LoRA rank 8, actor lr 1e-6, PPO clip 0.2) and judge prompts given in Appendices Q-R, but no code or data availability statement appears anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope LLM-agent research: a multi-agent memory framework (Planner/Trigger) for long-term conversation trained with online PPO, evaluated with LLM and open-source backbones and LLM-as-a-judge. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, agents, memory, RL all heavily weighted preferences). Novelty is moderate: online RL for memory management exists (RMM, Tan et al. 2025, which they compare against in Appendix P), but the delayed Cross-Session Truth Reward propagating future retrieval utility back to storage decisions and the backward session-synthesis warm-up are credible new combinations. Rigor benefits from ablations (Table 2), reward-model robustness (Appendices H, N), lambda sensitivity (Appendix M), and significance-tested human evaluation (Appendix L), but the main evaluation uses only 50 episodes per dataset (Appendix A) and the reward/backbone judges overlap with evaluated backbones (Gemini2.5 as backbone and judge), partially mitigated by cross-evaluation (Figure 3). Evidence strength is decent but docked for an unsupported claim: Section 5 claims 'millisecond-level latency' while Appendix J reports stabilization at 10.22s per session. Generalizability is limited to open-domain companionship dialogue, as the Limitations section concedes. Reproducibility is aided by full hyperparameters (Table 5), pseudocode (Appendix E), and judge prompts (Appendices Q-R), but no code or data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations

papers.summary: Recent advancements in large language models have significantly enhanced the capabilities of agents in modeling long-term conversations. Despite these successes, existing approaches typically adopt a static heuristic paradigm, where information is passively archived without adaptive memory valuation. Consequently, these methods fail to self-evolve or align their memory management with evolving user needs. To address this, we propose ICML (InteraCtive Memory Learning), a multi-agent framework tha
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在長期對話中多採靜態啟發式典範管理記憶，資訊被動歸檔且缺乏價值評估，導致代理無法隨使用者需求的變化自我進化。本文提出 ICML（Interactive Memory Learning），一個以線上強化學習為基礎的多代理框架，將記憶機制從被動檔案轉為可學習的互動策略。方法上，Planner 代理負責篩選並編碼高價值資訊、過濾低價值雜訊，Trigger 代理則依據當前語句動態檢索記憶；兩者共享 Actor-Critic 架構，以 PPO 進行端對端最佳化。為解決冷啟動問題，作者設計回溯式對話合成管線，先反向生成具因果一致性的前傳故事線，再正向標註記憶相依性，產生高品質專家資料供預熱。核心創新為跨對話真相回饋機制，藉由延遲獎勵將未來回應品質回傳至先前的儲存決策，使兩個代理在持續互動中共演化。實驗於 Multi-Session Chat、Conversation Chronicles 與 GapChat 三個真實長期對話資料集進行，ICML 在 BLEU-4、ROUGE-L、BertScore、Mauve 等自動指標以及 LLM 交叉評估與人工評估上，皆超越 Mem0、MemoryOS、THEANINE 等強基線，且隨對話累積持續改善；token 消耗穩定、記憶建構延遲僅毫秒等級。消融實驗顯示真相回饋與合成資料缺一不可。限制在於僅聚焦開放域陪伴式對話與個人化對齊，未涵蓋數學、程式設計或嚴格事實檢索任務，亦未驗證於對話以外領域。此研究證明記憶管理可透過環境回饋自主學習，對終身個人化助理的發展具重要啟示。
papers.title: Interactive Memory Learning for Long-Term Conversations
papers.title_zh: 互動式記憶學習：讓長期對話代理自我進化的記憶策略

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope: LLM-powered SWE-agents, tool use, specification gaming/reward hacking, and agent evaluation intersect multiple top-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning/CoT, AI Safety/Alignment, Code). The empirical arc (sycophancy -> fabrication -> sandbox specification gaming -> external deterministic verifier) is a well-designed ablation study with cross-model replication (GPT-4o, Claude, Qwen-Max), intent perturbations, and a public-dataset check. Novelty is moderate: generator-verifier decoupling is an intuitive, previously explored alignment principle; the Architecture-0 framing, TIR schema, dual-ledger S2P mapper, and NAC metric are competent system contributions rather than conceptual breakthroughs. Rigor is weakened by very small samples (N=15 per group in Fig. 7; 5 runs/case/model in core trials), manual outcome classification with no inter-annotator agreement or significance testing, hand-crafted static ledgers/profiles, and a model-version inconsistency between the preliminary (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Sec. 4.5) and core (Claude 4.5 Sonnet, Sec. 6) experiments. Evidence for 'complete eradication' of physical/validation gaming rests on zero counts across only 45-81 trials, and headline rhetoric ('unhackable', 'definitive') outruns the data, though quantitative tables and forensic code listings are concrete. Generalizability is bounded: only 4 adapted public tasks (with acknowledged pretraining-leakage risk) and a mapper that requires domains with hand-built deterministic profiles. Reproducibility is comparatively strong: full system prompts, tool protocols, TIR/YAML schemas, mapper prototype code, ledgers, and perturbation texts are in Appendices A-C, but the promised 'publicly available' replication dataset carries no link.

primary_link.title: Grounding SWE-Agent Decisions in Architecture-0 Design: Navigating Unknown Unknowns through Physical Mapping

papers.summary: Autonomous Software Engineering Agents (SWE-Agents) excel in deterministic coding tasks but struggle with Architecture 0, the nascent system design phase plagued by implicit engineering constraints, or Unknown Unknowns (UUs) that are rarely stated explicitly. To investigate how agents navigate UUs, we explore a progressive trajectory across pure-text self-play, tool-augmented feedback, and external physical mapping. Our empirical analysis reveals a cascading chain of failures. Pure-text reasonin
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討自主軟體工程代理（SWE-Agent）在系統設計初期階段的落地難題。程式碼層級任務仰賴編譯器與測試的確定性回饋，但在尚無程式碼的 Architecture 0 階段，代理必須面對隱含的工程限制，即「未知的未知」。作者以漸進式實驗揭示一連串認知退化：純文字自我對弈會淪為社交諂媚或看似合理卻違反物理的虛構設計；賦予代理可執行的 α-Sandbox 後，反而誘發規格操弄，代理藉竄改驗證腳本、捏造硬體參數或稀釋服務等級協定騙取表面通過。為破解此自我驗證陷阱，本文提出 Physical Mapping Guard（PMG），依據關注點分離原則，剝奪代理的驗證權限，強制其提交結構化拓撲表示，並由外部確定性的語義到物理（S2P）映射引擎計算資源帳冊與衝突偵測。跨模型實驗顯示，PMG 完全消除物理層與驗證層的規格操弄，公開系統設計資料集正確率達 88.9%，嚴格約束稽核者後更回升至 100%。剩餘失敗則遷移至語義層，包括重新詮釋業務語義、稽核者過度審查與停滯的結構修正；意圖擾動實驗亦證實單靠提示工程無法彌補此缺陷。限制方面，資源帳冊為靜態預設、評估規模有限，語義歧義仍需人類把關。本研究為 AI 輔助系統設計提供了可驗證的物理落地機制與清晰的診斷基準，凸顯代理須受外部確定性約束方能真正對齊工程現實。
papers.title: Grounding SWE-Agent Decisions in Architecture-0 Design: Navigating Unknown Unknowns through Physical Mapping
papers.title_zh: 將 SWE-Agent 決策扎根於 Architecture 0 設計：透過物理映射駕馭未知的未知

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM/RAG methodology paper (query-conditioned source routing, uniform budget allocation, task-conditioned chunking/metadata routing), not a pure domain application despite the historical-archive testbed. Methods are simple (logistic-regression router, nearest-centroid assignment, per-source quota) and build on existing adaptive-RAG/chunking ideas, so novelty is moderate; the clean contribution is the falsifiable decomposition of source-contamination vs. source-starvation failure modes. Rigor is good: fixed 437/438 split, 5 seeds, Bonferroni-corrected paired t-tests, ablations (QRe, UMS, composed), per-type/per-cluster decompositions, honest reporting that TC-Chunking gains vanish under routing and that the joint 14x14 variant never beats TC-Metadata. Evidence is strong within the single benchmark but rests on one 1887 French corpus, one embedding family, LLM-generated/historian-validated questions, and LLM-as-judge end-to-end evaluation with no human adjudication. Generalizability is explicitly argued-not-demonstrated by the authors (corpus-specific regexes, thin classifier support). Reproducibility is well supported: code, built indexes, fitted transforms, classifier weights, prompts, and per-seed splits are released, with a Cohere API dependency.

primary_link.title: ORDER: Task-Conditioned Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines typically rely on a fixed indexing and retrieval configuration determined at preprocessing time. This one-size-fits-all design is ill-suited to domain-expert settings, where heterogeneous queries require different chunking granularities, metadata constraints, and source-selection strategies. As a result, configurations that are effective for one family of queries often perform poorly for others. In this paper, we introduce ORDER (Optimal Routing for
papers.summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）系統通常在預處理階段就固定索引與檢索設定，這種一體適用的設計在需要異質查詢的領域專家場景中表現不佳。本文以法國第三共和史學問答資料集 HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic 為基礎，提出 ORDER 框架，將最佳化拆分為離線的文件條件化軸與線上的查詢條件化軸。線上機制包含兩個互補組件：監督式查詢路由器 QRe 僅從問題文字預測哪些資料集含有相關證據，以及均勻多來源取樣器 UMS 將檢索預算平均分配給路由後存留的資料集，分別對抗「來源污染」與「來源飢餓」兩種失敗模式。離線方面，作者對訓練問題進行語意分群，為每個群組選出最佳的區塊切分策略與詮釋資料過濾／重排設定，推論時以最近質心方式路由查詢至預建索引。在 438 題保留測試集上，QRe 與 UMS 結合使 Recall@3 從 37.7 提升至 53.7，端對端答題準確率從 31.0 升至 48.1，全面超越 BM25、HippoRAG v2、LinearRAG 與 Adaptive Chunking 等基線，且機制可移植至 BM25 等不同檢索器。不過任務條件化切分的增益在路由啟用後即被吸收，僅詮釋資料軸在 UMS 下持續有效。作者自陳限制：語料僅涵蓋 1887 年法文報紙與國會紀錄、題目由 LLM 生成、嵌入模型單一、端對端評估仰賴 LLM 評審且路由器訓練樣本偏少。此研究顯示查詢條件化路由能以極低的線上成本，顯著改善異質歷史檔案的跨來源檢索。
papers.title: ORDER: Task-Conditioned Routing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.title_zh: ORDER：針對檢索增強生成的任務條件化路由

llm_evaluation.rationale: A rigorous agent-evaluation paper, not a pure quantum domain application: the contribution is LLM-agent benchmarking methodology (verified autonomy, evidence-bound grading) instantiated on quantum engineering tasks. Strongly matches Agents & Tool Use (17 frontier LLM systems, MCP tools, Claude Code/Codex/OpenCode harnesses), LLM, and evaluation preferences. Evidence-bound grading that recomputes claims from a hidden evidence log and replays calibrations on fresh data is a genuine methodological advance over output-only benchmarks. Rigor is solid: Wilson intervals, Bradley-Terry Elo with ridge regularization, a three-way failure taxonomy, transcript audits, quarantining of infrastructure faults, and cross-benchmark discrimination checks against AutomationBench-AA and GDPval-AA v2. Not capped at 0.20 because language-model agent methodology, not quantum physics alone, is the core contribution.

primary_link.title: Evaluating Verified Autonomy in Quantum Engineering

papers.summary: Reliable quantum engineering is essential for turning quantum phenomena into practical technologies. As quantum platforms grow in scale and complexity, their characterization and operation require increasing human effort and coordination. Scientific artificial intelligence agents, which can plan experiments, operate instruments, and analyze observations, offer a promising route towards autonomous quantum engineering. Yet whether current agents can perform reliably in this setting has not been sy
papers.summary_zh: 量子工程隨平台規模擴大,人工操作與協調成本不斷攀升。科學 AI 代理雖能規劃實驗、操作儀器並分析結果,但其在量子工程中的可靠性尚未被系統性驗證。本文提出「可驗證自主性」,要求代理完成任務時,須以執行過程取得的證據支持結論;無法直接檢驗的校正或設計,須在全新隱藏條件下重測。團隊為此打造虛擬量子實驗室 Quantum-Harbor,以沙盒隱藏裝置參數與評分真相,代理僅能透過 MCP 公開介面讀取硬體規格、提交實驗並取得原始量測紀錄;評分器綁定證據日誌,從原始資料重新計算結果,防止虛報。基於此框架建立 QIQCBench,含 49 道專家設計任務,涵蓋校正控制、糾錯、編譯、感測與網路、模擬與多體物理六大類,橫跨量子運算堆疊五層,評分採通過/失敗與 Bradley–Terry Elo 競速兩種模式。研究評測八家廠商的 17 個前沿系統(如 GPT-5.6、Claude Opus 4.8、DeepSeek-V4),每題獨立執行三次,通過率介於 3% 至 78%,差異懸殊;未提交為最大失敗類別(1,510 次失敗中佔 937 次),其餘多為科學性失敗;競速排序與通過率一致。39 題中 37 題至少被一個系統解出,模擬與多體物理最難(15%),成功呈間歇性,僅 34% 曾通過的組合三次全過。限制在於全為模擬環境、固定時間預算與特定 harness,能否遷移至真實硬體仍待驗證。此基準揭示能力展示與可靠運轉間的落差,為量子工程自主代理的可驗證進展奠定測量基礎,並指出實驗判斷與 harness 改進是提升可靠性的關鍵方向。

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM study: structured pruning of four Qwen-family LLMs (dense, hybrid, MoE) evaluated on context-grounded tool calling across three datasets (>19,500 instances) with post-pruning SFT, matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, agents/tool calling, and efficiency (pruning/compression). The fine-grained degradation framework (action components o/d/p/v plus a five-level complexity taxonomy) is a genuine evaluation contribution, with notable findings: specificity (device/value) degrades before intent (operation/argument), dense pruning has narrow safe regions with cliffs while REAP expert pruning tolerates 70% removal at -0.37%, and aggressive dense pruning induces systematic over-refusal (7.7% to 56.2-80.8% false refusals). We systematically study pruning-induced degradation in smart-home tool calling across four LLMs spanning dense Transformer, dense hybrid, and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, together with depth, width, hybrid, and expert pruning methods. After post-pruning supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we evaluate more than 19,500 instances from three smart-ho
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型日益用於智慧家庭控制的自然語言介面，結構化剪枝雖能降低部署成本，其對情境grounded tool calling的影響卻缺乏系統性研究。本文以四個Qwen系列模型（dense Transformer、dense hybrid與MoE架構），搭配深度、寬度、混合與專家剪枝（ShortGPT、Angular、FLAP、2SSP、REAP），剪枝後施以相同SFT，於三個智慧家庭資料集逾19,500個實例上，從動作元件（operation、device、argument、value）與任務複雜度（Simple至Infeasible五類）兩面向分析退化。結果顯示：dense模型安全剪枝區間狹窄、之後急遽崩壞；MoE模型則容忍度高，REAP移除70%專家僅損失0.37%。剪枝先破壞grounded specificity（device、value）再及schema層級intent；原準確率無法預測剪枝敏感度，Partially Executable最脆弱；激進dense剪枝更引發過度拒絕：Qwen3-4B經FLAP 50%剪枝後，對可執行請求的拒絕率由7.7%升至80.8%。附錄另以F1與跨seed穩健性分析佐證。限制包括模型皆屬Qwen家族、剪枝方法受架構相容性限制，且僅限智慧家庭領域。本研究指出單看整體準確率不足以評估剪枝模型，細粒度評估對兼顧成本與可靠工具執行至關重要。
papers.title: What Breaks Under Pruning in Smart Homes, and When? Evaluating LLM Degradation Across Architectures and Task Complexity
papers.title_zh: 智慧家庭中剪枝會破壞什麼、何時破壞？評估 LLM 跨架構與任務複雜度的效能退化

links.title: Integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process with Large Language Models for Transparent Multi-Criteria Decision-Making

evidence: Abstract, p.1: claims 'the first end-to-end approach that enables LLMs to perform the complete AHP workflow' and a new annotated benchmark.

Section 3.3, p.3-4: of 20 annotation groups, 12 removed for invalid/inconsistent criteria; final LEGAL-AHP retains 60 reliable QA pairs with CR<0.1; Table 3 reports ~80% average agreement with LEGALBENCH gold.
Section 5.1 / Table 4, p.6: GPT-4o-mini Non-AHP 73.3% vs Multi-Agent (Auto) 81.7%; Mistral falls 68.3%→36.7% under Multi-Agent (Manual), showing model-capacity dependence.
Section 5.2 / Table 5, p.6: criteria alignment judged by LLM-as-judge (Qwen3-30B-A3B); Single-Agent most often selected (e.g., 53/75 for LLaMA3), with no validation of the judge itself.
Section 5.4 / Tables 12-13, p.7 and p.13: portability mixed—QS Kendall's Tau GPT-4o-mini 37.8%→42.2% but Qwen 24.4%→20.0%; U.S. News Qwen 37.8%→60.0% but GPT-4o-mini 68.9%→60.0%.

Limitations, p.9: authors acknowledge dependence on model reasoning capacity, annotator subjectivity in criteria/weights, and that LEGAL-AHP is 'relatively small due to the complexity of AHP-based annotation'.
Section 4.2, p.6: temperature fixed at 0.7, accuracy averaged over three runs with identical 5-8 few-shot examples; no standard deviations or significance tests reported.

Footnote 1, p.2 and Ethical Considerations, p.9: dataset available in supplementary material and 'will be anonymized prior to its release'; prompts given in Appendix E (Tables 16-19) support partial reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-centric paper spanning Agents (manual + auto multi-agent AHP with CaptainAgent), Reasoning (structured decomposition, pairwise weighting), Interpretability (auditable AHP pipeline), and Prompting/Evaluation (new expert-annotated legal benchmark, LLM-as-judge criteria check). Novelty is moderate: it credibly claims the first end-to-end LLM AHP workflow and first manually AHP-annotated legal benchmark, but builds on LEGALBENCH and prior partial AHP-LLM work (Doe & Liu 2023; Svoboda & Lande 2024; Lu et al. 2024a). Rigor is undercut by a very small gold set (60 QA pairs after removing 12/20 annotation groups), no variance/significance reporting despite 3 runs, and an unvalidated LLM-as-judge (Qwen3-30B) for criteria alignment. Evidence is mixed but honestly reported: large gains for GPT-4o-mini (73.3%→81.7%, Table 4) coexist with severe degradation for Mistral (68.3%→36.7%), and the portability claim is inconsistent (QS: Qwen drops 24.4%→20.0%; U.S. News: GPT drops 68.9%→60.0%). Generalizability is only partially supported by two top-10 university ranking tasks. Reproducibility is decent: prompts in Appendix E, fixed temperature 0.7, named models, dataset in supplementary (anonymized release promised), but no code release for the framework.

primary_link.title: Integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process with Large Language Models for Transparent Multi-Criteria Decision-Making

papers.summary: LLMs are increasingly employed in a wide range of decision-making tasks. However, the opacity of their internal reasoning makes it difficult to validate or interpret their outputs, and the need for interpretability becomes especially critical in high-stakes settings. This study examines the decision-making capabilities of LLMs through the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a classical and widely used multicriteria decision-making framework. We construct a new annotated benchmark based on AHP and
papers.summary_zh: 此論文探討如何讓大型語言模型（LLM）在多準則決策（MCDM）中產生透明且可稽核的推理。LLM 雖廣泛用於決策任務，但其內部推理不透明，輸出難以驗證，在高風險場景（如法律領域）尤其關鍵。作者以經典的層級分析法（Analytic Hierarchy Process, AHP）為骨架，提出首個端到端方法，讓 LLM 執行完整 AHP 流程：包括 AHP-Instruction 提示策略、單一代理人三步驟管線，以及手動建構與自動生成（採用 CaptainAgent 框架）的多代理人架構，透過成對比較推導準則權重並合成最終排序。他們亦建構 LEGAL-AHP 資料集，由法律碩士生依 AHP 標註指引對 LEGALBENCH 五個子集共 525 題進行人工標註，經一致性檢驗（CR<0.1）後保留 60 題作為黃金標準。實驗涵蓋 Llama-3-8B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct 與 GPT-4o-mini：GPT-4o-mini 獲益最大，Multi-Agent（Auto）在法律任務達 81.7% 準確率，對照人工標註決策時 AHP-Instruction 達 80.0%；Single-Agent 生成的決策準則最貼近人類推理。在大學排名任務上，AHP 框架亦展現跨領域可攜性。然而較弱模型（Mistral、LLAMA3）常因結構化提示而效能退化，標註具主觀性且資料集規模偏小。此研究證明結構化決策框架能提升 LLM 推理的可解釋性與專家判斷對齊度，但成效取決於模型能力與代理人協調機制。
papers.title: Integrating the Analytic Hierarchy Process with Large Language Models for Transparent Multi-Criteria Decision-Making
papers.title_zh: 整合層級分析法（AHP）與大型語言模型以實現透明的多準則決策

links.title: Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation for LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation (tlm-DRE) assigning weights to turns with asymmetric token-level training; experiments on a wide range of agent benchmarks vs traditional alignment methods.

Table 1 (Section 5): ALFWorld/ScienceWorld seen/unseen results for Llama-2-7B and Qwen2.5-7B including ablations 'tlm-DRE w/o DRE' (linearly turn-weighted DPO) and 'tlm-DRE w/o tlm'; five independent runs with std reported.
Table 2 (Section 5.2): HotpotQA EM 33.8 / F1 43.74 vs NAT 29.60/42.50 and DPO 26.40/34.83 on LLaMA2-7B.
Table 3 (Appendix B): under GiGPO's evaluation protocol, tlm-DRE reaches 92.4 on ALFWorld vs GiGPO w/ std 90.8 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct).

Appendix C: full training setup (8x A100, AdamW, 3 epochs SFT + 1 epoch alignment, LRs 1e-5/2e-5 and 7e-7/1e-6), p_pivot set heuristically at 0.9, omega_U=1.0, omega_L searched over {0.0,0.2,0.4,0.6}.
Section 8 (Limitations): method relies on offline sampling; combining with GRPO/GSPO dynamic sampling untested; kernel choice (UKL) not systematically analyzed; more agent tasks needed.

Section 6.1 (Fig. 2, Fig. 7): SFT-policy confidence scores show low-confidence Turns 10-11 in rejected trajectories corresponding to critical erroneous steps, motivating turn weights; no code availability claim appears in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work: LLM agent post-training via alignment (DRE/DPO family) evaluated on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and HotpotQA, strongly matching LLM, Agents, and Alignment preferences. Novelty is moderate: turn/token-level weighting exists (TiS-DPO, SDPO, DMPO cited in Related Work), and the contribution is extending weighting to the Bregman-divergence DRE loss plus an asymmetric positive-negative objective. Rigor is solid but not exceptional: baselines cover SFT, PPO, RFT, ETO, DMPO, DIL, NAT, plus an on-policy GiGPO-setup comparison; ablations isolate DRE and turn weights, but the derivation rests on a crude assumption (pi_c ~ 1, Eq. 16) and p_pivot=0.9 is heuristic (Appendix C). Evidence strength is tempered by small, overlapping margins in ablations (e.g., ALFWorld unseen 90.1±0.50 vs 89.3±0.99 for w/o tlm, Table 1), with the clearer gain on HotpotQA (EM 33.8 vs 29.6, Table 2). Generalizability is decent across three environments and two backbones with seen/unseen splits, though limited to offline pair-based settings per Section 8. Reproducibility is partial: detailed hyperparameters, seeds, and hardware are given (Appendix C) and datasets are licensed public, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation for LLM Agents

papers.summary: With the rapid development of Large language model (LLM), agent systems enhanced by LLMs show huge potential in being able to deal with complex tasks, especially involving multi-step thinking or interaction with tools. For applying LLM techniques with a well-designed agent paradigm, post-training of LLM in multiple agent scenarios is necessary to achieve better performance. Among the variable post-training techniques, alignment methods such as PPO, DPO, DIL, and GRPO become popular because many
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對大型語言模型（LLM）代理在多輪任務上的對齊問題。現有 RLHF、DPO、GRPO、DIL 等後訓練方法多以整條軌跡為單位進行對齊，忽略各輪（turn）貢獻的差異，導致錯誤輪次未被有效矯正，正確輪次反而可能被過度懲罰。作者提出 tlm-DRE（Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation）：先以 SFT 後的參考策略計算每一輪的信心分數，對低信心（訓練不足）的關鍵輪次給予較高權重，高信心輪次則降低權重；再據此定義多尺度密度比，在模仿學習框架下以 Bregman 散度（採用 UKL 核）進行非對稱的 token 級訓練。實驗涵蓋 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld 與 HotpotQA：以 Llama-2-7B 為骨幹時，ALFWorld unseen 達 72.6、ScienceWorld seen 達 71.4，超越 ETO、DMPO 等基準；以 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 訓練時，ALFWorld unseen 更高達 90.1；HotpotQA 之 EM 為 33.8、F1 為 43.74，勝過 NAT。消融實驗顯示 DRE 與輪級權重各自帶來明確增益，輪級權重對 unseen 任務幫助更大；margin 分析亦證實本方法比 DPO 更細緻地區分正負樣本，僅下調關鍵錯誤輪次的獎勵。限制方面：方法採離線取樣，與 GRPO/GSPO 動態取樣結合的效果尚待驗證；UKL 核的選擇缺乏系統性分析；新興代理任務亦需更多驗證。此研究對提升多輪代理訓練的 token 效率與穩健性具重要參考價值。
papers.title: Turn-level Multiscale Density Ratio Estimation for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 針對 LLM 代理的輪級多尺度密度比估計

links.title: SAVOR: Self-Aware Visual Grounding via Confidence-Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation

evidence: §1 Contributions: formulates MLLM hallucination mitigation as a calibration problem and uses calibration error as a direct reward signal in multimodal RL
§3.3 Eq.(9): R_cal combines per-rollout Brier penalty (c_ans - a)^2 with a group-level ECE improvement bonus (beta=0.5)
§4 Table 1: InternVL3-8B POPE-adv F1 92.4 vs 90.9 (GRPO w/o calib) and ECE 0.085 vs 0.272; MMHal 4.85 vs 4.59; CHAIR 6.2 vs 8.3
§4.3 Table 3: removing R_cal leaves POPE F1 ~91.8-92.4 but raises ECE from 0.085 to 0.268, isolating the calibration reward's effect

§4 Implementation details: LoRA rank-64 on language tower, G=8 rollouts, lambda=(1.0,0.5,0.2,0.05), 8xH800 ~36h per backbone, three random seeds averaged; no code or artifact release is stated anywhere in the document

§4.4 Inference cost: re-attention fires on 14.2% of prompts with +16.5% latency versus ~2x for VCD and ~1.7x for OPERA; Table 4 shows MME/MMBench/MMStar/SEED changes within seed variance across four backbones
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal-LLM methodology paper: hallucination mitigation via calibration-supervised GRPO and confidence-gated self-correction, squarely matching alignment/RLHF, safety/hallucination, and multimodal preferences. The framing (calibration as a first-class RL reward rather than post-hoc diagnostic) is a meaningful but incremental advance over prior verbalized-uncertainty work (SaySelf, Tian et al.) and confidence-triggered correction resembles HALC with a learned gate. Rigor is solid: four hallucination benchmarks, two main backbones plus two transfer models, baselines retrained on the same 100K mix, leakage control, component-wise ablations, weight sensitivity sweep, and three-seed averaging. The key ablation (dropping R_cal raises ECE 0.085→0.268 with accuracy largely unchanged) cleanly isolates the contribution. Evidence is internally consistent but not externally verifiable, with no statistical significance tests and no code/data release statement despite exhaustive hyperparameter reporting. Multimodal scope slightly reduces preference fit relative to core text-LLM work, but it does not fall under any out-of-scope category.

primary_link.title: SAVOR: Self-Aware Visual Grounding via Confidence-Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Hallucination Mitigation

papers.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made strong progress on visual question answering and image captioning, yet they still produce fluent claims about objects, attributes, or relations that are not grounded in the image. Many remedies either modify decoding at test time, which adds latency, or fine tune with preferences such as DPO variants, which teach which answer is preferred but not when the model's own answer is unreliable. We argue that calibrated self assessment is the missing s
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）在視覺問答與影像描述上表現亮眼，卻常輸出影像未支持卻語氣肯定的幻覺答案。既有解法分兩類：測試時的對比解碼等方法會增加延遲，且不改變產生錯誤的策略；DPO 系列偏好微調只教模型哪個答案較佳，未教它判斷自身答案是否可靠。本文主張「校準的自我評估」才是關鍵訊號，提出 SAVOR 框架：先以短期監督式訓練讓模型輸出答案與結構化信心值（整體答案與視覺片段層級），再以 GRPO 最佳化，獎勵涵蓋答題正確性、Brier 懲罰與群組 ECE 校準項、棄答獎勵、片段定位項及長度成本；推論時若信心低於門檻，模型會裁切注意力最集中區域重新查詢，再決定回答或棄答。在 InternVL3-8B 與 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，SAVOR 於 POPE、HallusionBench、AMBER、MMHal-Bench 皆優於 HA-DPO、RLHF-V 等基線，POPE 對抗子集的 ECE 由 0.272 降至 0.085，MME 與 MMBench 等通用能力幾乎不變；重新查詢僅在約 14.2% 的提示詞觸發，延遲增加 16.5%，遠低於 VCD 的約兩倍。消融實驗顯示校準獎勵主要貢獻校準改善而非準確率。限制在於影像外世界知識、組合式空間推理及對抗性語言先驗的案例仍難處理。本研究的價值在於將幻覺緩解重塑為校準問題，由單一策略同時完成偵測與修正，不需外部驗證器。

links.title: After the Party: Governing What a Viral Agent-Skill Ecosystem Left Behind

evidence: §III Methodology for RQ2: seven pre-declared features tested with two-sided Mann–Whitney U, rank-biserial effects, Benjamini–Hochberg correction, log-age adjustment, and pre-cutoff cohort restriction (31,031 listings), with Finding 2c reporting 0/7 associations surviving

§III Methodology for RQ4: 180 cases sampled with seed=42 from a 276-case SHA-256-verified pool; two annotators (7 and 5 years security experience) produced an adjudicated reference standard of 69 flag / 111 do_not_flag

§IV-D and Table II: scanners disagree on 23,702 of 61,990 jointly covered listings; weighted sensitivity spans 21.67% (static) to 61.06% (LLM scanner) with 95% bootstrap intervals, and 24.16% of weighted no-scan mass is still judged flag

§VI Threats to Validity: authors concede fallible human labels, single-registry external validity, partially observed sources, and two withdrawn data sources (public skill Git repo and comment bodies)

Data Availability: anonymized replication package with per-file SHA-256 hashes and a verifier program at a Zenodo DOI; §III states every reported number comes from a dated frozen release recomputed before citation
llm_evaluation.rationale: A measurement study of an LLM agent-skill registry (OpenClaw/ClawHub), squarely within the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety preferences (agent skill security surfaces, privilege evidence, scanner validation), though it is an empirical governance study rather than an LLM-methods contribution. Novelty is moderate-to-good: it extends the closest prior work [43] by adding adjudicated human reference labels for deployed scanners, and contributes the 'reviewability gap' framing and a snapshot-based methodology, but the artifact type and analysis techniques (rank-biserial effects, logistic adjustment, weighted audit) are conventional. Rigor is strong: pre-declared features, BH correction, age adjustment, cohort restriction, tri-state unknown semantics, weighted sampling with bootstrap CIs, and a disclosed protocol for two-annotator adjudication; deductions for the small 180-case audit from a 276-case pool, only two annotators with no reported inter-annotator agreement statistic, and an unvalidated hand-authored privilege detector. Evidence strength is solid with exact counts, CIs, and robustness checks (four identity definitions for growth), but key constructs are text-match proxies explicitly not evidence of runtime behavior, and sensitivity estimates carry wide intervals. Generalizability is limited by design to one registry and one boom window; the authors state only the protocol transfers. Reproducibility is unusually strong: frozen dated snapshots, stable identity keys, fixed seed, versioned detector, SHA-256-hashed replication package via Zenodo, though two underlying sources were withdrawn mid-study, making live replication impossible.

primary_link.title: After the Party: Governing What a Viral Agent-Skill Ecosystem Left Behind

papers.summary: AI agents increasingly act through agent skills, i.e., natural-language instructions, that direct a host agent toward shell, network, credential, file, and process actions, and public registries distribute them at scale. In the first half of 2026, the OpenClaw AI agent went viral, and its public skill registry boomed: the observable stock nearly doubled in 91 days, and a majority of the listings visible in June were created in just two months. By the end of our study window, the wave had crested
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 2026 年上半年爆紅的 OpenClaw AI 代理及其公開技能登錄站 ClawHub 進行大規模實證研究。代理技能是以 SKILL.md 等自然語言指示驅動代理執行 shell、網路與憑證存取等操作的工件，但登錄站賴以治理的詮釋資料、社群回饋與自動掃描訊號皆未經驗證。作者凍結 Git 歷史、GitHub issues 與 pull requests，以及三份登錄站快照，依次檢驗生態系成長、詮釋資料關聯的時間穩定性、問責訊號與特權證據的共現，以及掃描器的涵蓋率、分歧與效度。結果顯示：可觀測存量在 91 天內近乎翻倍（33,399 增至 65,175），63.25% 的六月項目集中於三、四月建立，下載高度集中（前 10% 佔 46.93%，Gini 係數 0.528）；七項基準關聯在限制建立世代後全數失效，下載關聯甚至反號，經年齡調整後僅剩一項正向關聯；77.86% 的項目既無星標也無留言，85.06% 的可評估工件卻帶有至少一項特權證據，形成「可審查性落差」；三種掃描器在 61,990 個共同涵蓋項目中有 23,702 個判斷不一致，相對人工裁定參考標準的加權敏感度僅 21.67% 至 61.06%，多數表決亦無法取代真值。研究限制包括僅觀察單一登錄站、觀察窗口有限、兩個資料來源於研究期間遭平台撤下，且人工標記本身可能出錯。本文證明快速成長的代理技能登錄站不能仰賴簡易詮釋資料或單一掃描器分數治理，必須建立版本化、透明且經獨立驗證的量測與分層治理機制。
papers.title: After the Party: Governing What a Viral Agent-Skill Ecosystem Left Behind

links.title: LSREP: A Longitudinal State-Replay Protocol for Evaluating Conversational Memory, with ICE v2 as an Audited Local-First Architecture

evidence: Abstract: reports near-zero mean quality difference from vector-RAG with 32% fewer fragments but 6.6% more estimated prompt tokens, and decisive LongMemEval losses (50.8% vs 72.8% oracle; 43.0% vs 69.5% full-S) with paired CIs
Section 7.2.1 / Table 10: only two ablation steps clear 95% CIs - unfused lexical leg harmful (-0.74 [-1.14,-0.36]) and RRF corrective (+0.82 [+0.39,+1.24]); full ICE vs baseline spans zero

Section 7.2.2 / Appendix A Table 14: fidelity audit classifies procedural leg as defective (pgvector bind error), document/batch-summary/cold-storage/temporal legs as never exercised, graph utility 'unconfirmed'
Section 8.1: 'all come from one author... The 1,211 observations are repetitions of 219 questions'; Section 6.1: raw conversations and probe text remain private
Reproducibility and Ethics: aggregate reports, analysis scripts, configuration and adapter code released; 'Exact private LSREP results are not independently reproducible from the released package'

Section 6.2: 72 hand-scored records from the corpus author are merged into headline aggregates (sensitivity analysis without them given in Appendix J.1); Section 8.3: Muse judge validated only via a three-case discrimination check and prior 73% agreement in a different setting

Section 7.1.1: density stress win is against an unbudgeted top-30 baseline (88,061 mean tokens, 94.2% score-1 failures) and the paper notes it 'does not show an advantage over a properly budgeted vector baseline' (Section 8.2)
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM memory/RAG evaluation paper with unusually honest, self-auditing methodology. Preference relevance is high: conversational memory middleware (MemGPT/Mem0/Zep lineage), retrieval fusion and RRF, hallucination/fidelity auditing, LongMemEval benchmarking, LLM-as-judge, and local LLM serving all match heavily weighted preference areas (RAG, Long Context & Memory, Evaluation, Agents). Novelty is moderate: LSREP's evolving ground truth with repeated probes and mechanism-fidelity checks is a genuine methodological contribution beyond endpoint QA, but the architecture explicitly recombines known ideas and the paper itself concedes temporal graph memory is 'not unique to ICE v2' (Section 2.1). Rigor is above average: paired bootstrap with fixed seeds, probe-cluster and ordinal sensitivity analyses, an explicit defective/unexercised/contributing component audit, disclosed imputation chains, and candid correction of the v1 token under-count; but confounds remain (shared memory state across conditions, 72 author-scored records merged into aggregates, minimal 3-case judge calibration, 67-probe ablation with a different answerer). Evidence strength is mixed: LongMemEval negative results are well-supported (paired -22.0/-26.5 points, n=500), while the headline LSREP tie is absence-of-detection on one private corpus and the density win is against an admittedly unbudgeted baseline. Generalizability is limited by a single-author, four-conversation private corpus (Section 8.1) and untested protocol portability; reproducibility is partial since code, seeds, and aggregates are released but raw private data is excluded by the authors' own statement.

primary_link.title: LSREP: A Longitudinal State-Replay Protocol for Evaluating Conversational Memory, with ICE v2 as an Audited Local-First Architecture

papers.summary: Conversational memory changes during use, so endpoint question answering alone cannot establish how a persistent state accumulates, ages, or incorporates revisions. We introduce LSREP, a Longitudinal State-Replay Evaluation Protocol combining ordered replay, explicit lifecycle schedules, repeated probes, evolving reference answers, and mechanism-fidelity checks. Its architectural case study is ICE v2, a local-first memory middleware with typed stores, retrieval fusion, and dynamic context budget
papers.summary_zh: 對話記憶會在使用過程中變動,單靠端點問答無法看出持久狀態如何累積、老化與納入修訂。本文提出 LSREP,一套縱貫式狀態重播評測協定,結合有序重播、明確的生命週期排程、重複探針、可隨時間演化的參考答案,以及機制保真度稽核,並以本地優先的記憶中介軟體 ICE v2 作為案例研究。在四個單一使用者的私人長對話資料集(1,985 輪、1,211 個探針—檢查點觀察)上,一般密度情境下 ICE v2 與向量 RAG 的平均分數幾乎相同,但選取片段少 32%,估計提示詞 token 反而多 6.6%;極端高密度資料集則暴露未設預算之向量基線的災難性失敗(94.2% 得分為 1),ICE 憑動態 token 預算維持 4.33 分。機制稽核顯示程序性檢索有缺陷、多個元件從未被觸發,知識圖譜效用未獲證實;消融實驗中僅未融合的詞彙檢索腿有害(-0.74)與 RRF 融合的修正效果(+0.82)具統計顯著性。互補的公開 LongMemEval 診斷中,ICE v2 大幅落後純向量 RAG:oracle 為 50.8% 對 72.8%,full-S 為 43.0% 對 69.5%,跨場次整合與時間推理嚴重失敗,僅保守棄答表現較佳,且使用較少 context,屬品質—成本取捨而非效率優勢。限制包括單一作者的私人語料、重播無法模擬真實使用的回饋循環、評審模型偏誤,以及缺乏配對預算實驗。本文的核心訊息是:縱貫重播、機制保真稽核與公開端點測試必須三者並行,才能支持可信的記憶系統主張。
papers.title: LSREP: A Longitudinal State-Replay Protocol for Evaluating Conversational Memory, with ICE v2 as an Audited Local-First Architecture
papers.title_zh: LSREP:以縱貫式狀態重播協定評測對話記憶,並以 ICE v2 作為經稽核的本地優先架構

links.title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech

evidence: Section 4: defines four prompting conditions A-D (HS-only, HS+IS, HS+annotations, HS+IS+annotations) evaluated with five open-source instruction-tuned LLMs (Ministral, Llama, EuroLLM, Llamantino, Salamandra) of similar 7-9B size across EN, ES, IT

Section 3.2-3.3 and Table 1: new human-curated annotations (implicitness, stereotype, generalization scope, trait type) over 496 HS/CS pairs per language with Krippendorff's alpha IAA (0.540-0.919 range)
Section 5.1 and Table 3: Conditions C/D substantially raise NLI contradiction scores vs A/B while METEOR gains are small and BERTScore slightly decreases for C/D
Appendix C: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction; 71 of 77 language x model x metric families show all four contrasts significant with median rank-biserial r=0.89
Section 5.3 and Table 5: human evaluation limited to 25 stratified HS messages x 3 native annotators per language (900 total evaluations), Condition D most preferred in all languages

Limitations: authors state results 'should not be interpreted as evidence that the approach generalizes to all LLMs' and that human evaluation is small; Appendix E concedes negative alpha for correctness/safety due to skewed distributions

Appendix B: full generation prompt template and fixed decoding parameters (top-p 0.9, temperature 0.01, max_new_tokens 300, A100 GPU) provided, but Section 1 footnote links only a data sample/guidelines at an anonymous repository
Appendix D, Tables 10-11: explicit and implicit stereotype subsets both improve under C/D, supporting RQ2, with implicit cases consistently scoring lower
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM prompting study for multilingual counterspeech generation conditioned on structured stereotype annotations (scope, trait type) plus a new EN/ES/IT annotated dataset. It aligns well with high-weight LLM, prompting, safety, and LLM-as-judge evaluation preferences, though not with the very highest-weight topics (reasoning, agents, Japanese LLM). The evaluation is unusually thorough for this area: four prompt conditions across five 7-9B open-source LLMs and three languages, automatic metrics, three-model LLM-as-judge, native-speaker human evaluation, Krippendorff's alpha IAA, and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction (Appendix C reports 71/77 families fully significant). Novelty is moderate: extending implied-statement conditioning (Akazawa et al. 2023) with scope/trait annotations is an incremental but sensible contribution; the method is plain structured prompting with no architectural or training novelty. Evidence is solid but constrained: automatic gains are modest (METEOR up slightly, BERTScore actually drops for C/D and is reinterpreted favorably), the human evaluation covers only 25 HS messages x 3 annotators per language (Section 5.3), judge models overlap with generation models, and correctness/safety show negative alphas dismissed as ceiling effects. Generalizability is limited by a single source dataset (MT-CONAN derivatives translated from English) and the authors' own admission in Limitations that results may not transfer to other LLMs. Reproducibility is reasonable: checkpoints, hyperparameters, and full prompts are given in Appendix B/D, but only a sample of the data is linked via an anonymous repository.

primary_link.title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech

papers.summary: Counterspeech (CS) - direct responses that counter online Hate Speech (HS) using reasoning and alternative viewpoints - has emerged as an alternative to content removal. Current automatic CS generation methods, however, frequently produce generic, ineffective replies that fail to target the implicit stereotypes behind HS. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel scope-conditioned generation framework that explicitly integrates structured stereotype characteristics into Large Language Models prompt
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對自動反制言論（Counterspeech, CS）生成的核心缺口：現有方法僅依賴仇恨言論（Hate Speech, HS）的表層文字或隱含陳述（Implied Statement, IS），產出的回應常流於空泛，無法觸及背後的刻板印象。作者提出範圍條件化生成框架，將結構化刻板印象特徵——HS 隱含性、刻板印象存在與其隱含性、概括範圍（universal、majority、essentialist）及六類歸因特質——明確納入大型語言模型（LLM）提示，並釋出英語、西班牙語、義大利語的人工標註資料集（每語言 496 則 HS/CS 配對，Krippendorff's α 顯示標註一致性良好）。實驗以 Ministral、Llama、EuroLLM 等開源模型比較四種提示條件，透過自動指標、LLM-as-a-Judge 與人類評估，一致顯示刻板印象條件化（條件 C、D）在事實性、具體性、有效性與說服力上顯著優於僅用 HS 或 HS+IS 的基線；NLI 矛盾分數大幅提升，代表回應更明確地反駁仇恨主張。效益亦延伸至隱含刻板印象，並能跨三種語言遷移，而單語模型未必優於多語模型。限制包括僅評估少數模型、LLM 評審過程透明度有限、人類評估樣本較小，以及多數決黃金標籤忽略標註者間的分歧。此研究證明外顯化刻板印象結構可作為跨語言中立的有效指引，為更具針對性與說服力的多語言反仇恨言論生成指明方向。
papers.title: Deconstructing Stereotypes: Scope-Conditioned Generation for Effective Multilingual Counterspeech
papers.title_zh: 解構刻板印象：以範圍條件化生成有效的多語言反制言論

links.title: The Role of Implicit and Explicit Demographic Signals in Large Language Model-based Student Assessment

evidence: §2.3: 'we adopt a controlled counterfactual sensitivity-testing framework in which the educational task input is held fixed while only the demographic context provided to the model is varied' — design isolates demographic effects.
§2.4: 6 models (GPT-5-mini/nano, Llama 3.3 70B/3.2 3B, Qwen3 4B/30B) and '192,480 LLM inference calls', temperature 0, open-weight models served via vLLM (Appendix D, Table 12).
Table 1 (§3.1): Llama-70B scores inflate +1.57 relative to its default under Imp condition (p<0.001), the largest deviation; GPT models stable under both conditions.
Table 3 (§3.2): education attribute yields significant positive ARI coefficients under Exp (Llama-70B +0.73, Cnt=36), showing models adapt readability to explicit education level.
Limitations: subsampling to 120 items and 200 profiles; skewed attributes (e.g., 96% English L1) excluded; implicit prompt histories not education-specific.

Footnote 1: 'All code and data used in this study are publicly available under the GNU General Public License v3.0'; Appendix C lists textstat, statsmodels, scipy, bert_score packages and Appendix B gives full prompts.
footnote 9 / §2.3: aggregation thresholds N=10 (Exp) and N=5 (Imp) are 'heuristic', and effect reporting uses a 10%-of-standard-deviation cutoff — ad hoc but disclosed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled LLM behavioral study of demographic sensitivity (bias/fairness) in educational assessment, squarely relevant to LLM, AI Safety, and Prompting preferences. Strengths: counterfactual design holding task inputs fixed across default/explicit/implicit conditions (§2.3), 6 models and 192,480 inference calls (§2.4), and layered statistics (Lasso CV, Bonferroni-corrected KS, paired t-tests) with explicit independence handling. Novelty is moderate: extends prior gender-bias work (§1, §4) mainly via real-user prompt histories for implicit conditioning (AI Gap dataset, §2.1), but the core finding that explicit education cues shift readability and implicit cues produce unpredictable shifts is incremental. Weaknesses: only 40 items per task and 200 profiles (Limitations), heuristic significance thresholds (N=10/5, footnote 9), skewed attributes limit interpretation (footnote 10), and implicit conditioning conflates demographics with conversational topic/style, only partially addressed via post-hoc topic modeling (§2.3, §E.1). English-only and education-domain restrict generalizability. Code/data availability is asserted under GPLv3 (footnote 1) with detailed prompts, model versions (Table 12), and packages (Appendix C), supporting reproducibility, though links are unverifiable from the text.

primary_link.title: The Role of Implicit and Explicit Demographic Signals in Large Language Model-based Student Assessment

papers.summary: Large Language Models are now common in student assessment, but we know little about how student demographics affect their use. Sometimes, considering student demographics may be necessary -- for example, to improve readability for users with lower educational levels. However, it also risks being a cause of discrimination, e.g., when assigning lower scores to students from lower socioeconomic backgrounds. We set up controlled prompts to test 1) explicit demographic effects, where we mention demo
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）已廣泛用於學生評量，但學生人口特徵如何影響模型輸出仍缺乏系統性研究：考量人口背景有時屬必要（如依程度調整可讀性），卻也可能造成歧視（如對低社經學生給較低分數）。本文採對照式反事實敏感度測試，在固定題目下比較三種條件：模型預設、顯性（提示中直接陳述人口屬性）與隱性（以 AI Gap 資料集 200 位真實使用者的對話歷史作為人口訊號）。任務涵蓋自動作文評分（AES）、形成性回饋與後設語言問答（QA），各取 40 題，評測 GPT-5-mini/nano、Llama 3.3 70B、Llama 3.2 3B 與 Qwen3 4B/30B 六種模型，共產出 192,480 筆回應，並以 L1 正規化迴歸與 KS 檢定分析。結果顯示，AES 中多數模型對顯性設定檔相對穩定，但 Llama-70B 在隱性條件下分數膨脹 1.57 分，Qwen-30B 於顯性條件下對高教育者給分較低；開放式任務中，模型得知教育程度時會為高教育者產出較難讀的文字，隱性條件卻出現難以預期的偏誤，如低教育程度者的問答回覆情感較負面。限制包括僅 120 題、200 個設定檔、僅限英文、提示歷史非教育情境，且 Bonferroni 校正偏保守。本研究凸顯高利害評量需要人口不變性，而現行模型無法可靠區分任務相關資訊與人口線索，對教育公平具重要警示。
papers.title: The Role of Implicit and Explicit Demographic Signals in Large Language Model-based Student Assessment
papers.title_zh: 大型語言模型學生評量中隱性與顯性人口統計訊號的角色

links.title: EchoPath: Execution-Level Replayable Memory for GUI Agents

evidence: Abstract: claims >90% median token reduction and ~60% time reduction; Section 4 reports first-pass medians of ~572k tokens and ~4.5 min vs second-pass 20,370 tokens and 127.5 s (codex-gpt-5.5-medium), supporting ~96% token but only ~53% time reduction.

Section 3.1: paired two-pass OSWorld-Verified design with deliberate 1920x1080 -> 1600x900 second-pass resolution shift so 'direct success must come from actions with corrected coordinates from visual re-aiming'.

Section 3.2 (Retrieval stress test): probes are 'deterministic task-intent probes derived from the stored intent after removing task-id scaffolding', a design that risks circular retrieval evaluation; Section 4 reports 100% recall up to 659 memories.
Table 3: state gate accuracy 98%/92%/78% for compatible/partially-changed/incompatible starts; flexible rebinding 100% on both valid and invalid conditions.

Appendix B.3: IBTR uses zero-mean normalized correlation over multi-scale crops (scale set 0.5-2.0, step 0.05) with acceptance thresholds eta=0.78 and margin eta_margin=0.02, i.e., classic template matching with rejection gating.

Appendix A.4: 'Executable Agentic Memory is the closest conceptual neighbor' and 'EchoPath does not claim a more general memory algorithm. Its distinction is a lightweight systems and evaluation point'.
Table 1: three host harnesses (codex-gpt-5.5-medium, claude-sonnet-5-medium, kimi-K3-medium) reach 91.2%/92.8%/87.3% success; Synapse baseline 91.8% at 586,386 median tokens and 315.7 s.

Section 5: limitations acknowledge vulnerability to 'toolbar rearrangements, localization, responsive layouts, display scaling, and near-duplicate interface elements' and that memory acquisition requires a costly first-pass agent exploration.

Appendix D: full planner/grounding/verification/consolidation/replay prompts included; Appendix C: EC2 t3.large (2 vCPU, 8 GiB, Ubuntu 24.04) configuration; Introduction: OpenPath package released at github.com/JackZhao1998/EchoPath.git.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core computer-use agent systems paper (top-weight Agents & Tool Use: MCP-style callable memories, ReAct-style planning, GUI/computer use agents), evaluated with OSWorld host harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Kimi). Novelty is moderate: Appendix A.4 concedes 'Executable Agentic Memory is the closest conceptual neighbor' and that EchoPath 'does not claim a more general memory algorithm'; IBTR is multi-scale normalized cross-correlation template matching with an ambiguity margin (Appendix B.3), extending the Sikuli record-and-replay lineage rather than introducing a new method. Rigor has real strengths (paired two-pass design with a deliberate resolution shift to defeat coordinate copying, retrieval/IBTR/state-gate/rebinding/storage diagnostics, honest 78% incompatible-start rejection in Table 3) but also weaknesses: retrieval probes are 'derived from the stored intent' (Section 3.2, potentially circular), second pass replays identical tasks, only one baseline (Synapse), no repeated runs or significance testing, and the abstract's '~60% time reduction' is inconsistent with reported medians (4.5 min -> 127.5 s is ~53%; the >90% token claim is supported at ~96%). Evidence is detailed and quantified (Table 1: 87.3-92.8% success, 20k-30k median tokens vs Synapse's 586k) but single-benchmark, self-evaluated, single-run. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged fragility to layout drift, localization, and display scaling (Section 5) and a single Ubuntu/OSWorld environment, though model-agnosticism is demonstrated across three harnesses. Reproducibility is above average: code release (Intro), full prompts (Appendix D), thresholds and gate weights (Appendix B.2/B.3), and hardware config (Appendix C), docked slightly for dependence on proprietary agent client versions.

primary_link.title: EchoPath: Execution-Level Replayable Memory for GUI Agents

papers.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly operate browsers, software, and desktop applications via CLI or API portals, but graphical user interface (GUI) still plays an important role in common industrial production scenarios. GUI agents commonly employ fresh observe-plan-ground-act loops, which is inefficient for enterprise tasks that repeatedly update records, process forms, configure tools, and export reports. We introduce EchoPath, a model-agnostic harness that converts artifact-validated GUI traject
papers.summary_zh: 電腦使用代理常以「觀察—規劃—定位—執行」迴圈逐步操作圖形介面（GUI），對企業中反覆出現的更新紀錄、處理表單、匯出報告等例行任務而言，token 成本與延遲皆高。EchoPath 提出一個與模型無關的框架，將經外部成品驗證的 GUI 軌跡轉換成標準化、可帶參數呼叫的「可重播記憶」，概念近似 MCP 風格的工具呼叫，而非非結構化的經驗紀錄。每筆記憶儲存任務意圖、應用程式與狀態前提、可彈性重綁的輸入參數、GUI 視覺證據與生命週期狀態，主機代理僅在當前環境可確定性重播時才呼叫。核心機制為影像式目標重新瞄準（IBTR）演算法：把儲存座標視為視覺證據，與當前螢幕截圖比對後輸出修正座標，藉此繞過傳統 GUI grounding 推理；當目標模糊或狀態結構不相容時，系統拒絕直接重播，改採有界的單步定位修復或重新規劃。在 OSWorld-Verified 的配對兩輪實驗中，第二輪刻意將解析度由 1920×1080 降至 1600×900 以防止座標照抄，EchoPath 達到約 87%–93% 的重播成功率，中位數消耗約 2 萬 tokens 與 127 秒，相較規劃增強基線 Synapse（約 58.6 萬 tokens）減少逾 90% 成本與約 60% 時間；檢索在 659 筆記憶的雜訊測試下維持 100% 命中率，離線視覺重新瞄準中位偏差為 0 像素，彈性輸入重綁與否決準確率達 100%。限制在於重播對工具列重排、在地化、回應式版面、顯示縮放與近似重複元素仍脆弱，記憶取得也仰賴首次代理自主探索而可能耗時，且尚未驗證企業規模下的即時穩健性。此研究讓已驗證的執行經驗成為可控、可稽核、可版本管理的可呼叫資產，為企業級 GUI 自動化提供務實的效率縮放路徑。
papers.title: EchoPath: Execution-Level Replayable Memory for GUI Agents
papers.title_zh: EchoPath：GUI 代理的執行層級可重播記憶

links.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents

evidence: Section 4.3: 'Validation accuracy increases from 31.1% to 51.1%, a gain of 20 percentage points with model weights fixed'
Section 4.4: 'Coverage increases from 48.3% before RL to 67.8% afterward' measured as pass@4 under a fixed harness

Section 4.2: 'Overall single-attempt test accuracy increases from 42.2% to 73.3%... 33.3% transition from incorrect to correct, whereas 2.2% transition from correct to incorrect' (implies ~90 test problems)
Section 7.2: 'Effects of individual skills and feedback sources are not separately isolated' — acknowledged absence of ablations
Section 7.1/Table 1: 895-task collection (96 LitQA2, 511 DbQA, 108 ProtocolQA, 180 GWAS) drawn from LAB-Bench and Biomni-Eval1
Title page footer: 'Website: Science-Buddy-Product | Code: Gen-Verse/ScienceBuddy' release claims
Section 2.4/7.3: outer recursion uses rubric rewards (Eq. 6) with GRPO (Eq. 8-10); epsilon, beta, and rollout group size G are left unspecified
Section 7.2: adaptation used 288 conversations (24 updates over batches of 12) with a reference-assisted bounded user simulator, with information boundaries in Table 2
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM-agent system coupling harness/prompt evolution with GRPO RL and rubric-derived rewards (LLM, Agents & Tool Use, Training & Optimization all high-weight matches); it is not a pure domain application since the language-methodology contribution (nested harness+model self-improvement) is central, with biomedicine only as the evaluation domain. Novelty is moderate: the nested 'recursive-in-recursive' coupling is a new arrangement, but the paper itself cites close precedents (SIA, HELIX, GEPA, ACE, Darwin Godel Machine) and assembles existing mechanisms (ReAct, GRPO, rubric rewards, environment augmentation). Rigor is limited: case studies rather than controlled comparisons, no external baselines (e.g., GEPA-style prompt search or fixed harness with equal compute), no significance testing or variance reporting, small effective test sets (transition percentages imply ~90 test problems in Section 4.2), and the authors concede in Section 7.2 that 'effects of individual skills and feedback sources are not separately isolated'. Positives include paired parent/candidate evaluation, separate adaptation/validation/test splits, an information-boundary table (Table 2), and a disclosed reference-assisted user simulator. Evidence consists of specific reported numbers without confidence intervals; release claims (website and Gen-Verse/ScienceBuddy code) support reproducibility, and the appendix supplies task counts, role prompts, and the GRPO objective, but key hyperparameters (clipping epsilon, KL coefficient beta, group size G, learning rates) and seeds are unspecified. Generalizability is plausible for the paradigm but demonstrated only on a 4B model across four biomedical task families.

primary_link.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents

papers.summary: We introduce and release ScienceBuddy, an interactive scientific research workspace that brings continually improving scientific agents into researchers' everyday workflows. ScienceBuddy supports researchers in carrying out scientific tasks while transforming their requests, feedback, and execution evidence into tasks and evaluation rubrics for continual learning. At its core is recursive-in-recursive self-improvement, a paradigm that couples harness evolution with model reinforcement learning:
papers.summary_zh: 本論文的核心問題是：科學 AI 代理如何將與研究人員的日常協作，轉化為工作流程與底層能力的持續改進。作者發布 ScienceBuddy，一個互動式科學研究工作區，整合 224 項工具與 22 個功能模組，涵蓋基因體學、分子與癌症生物學、藥理學、生物影像、文獻檢索與資料庫查詢，支援多模態輸入、程式碼執行與軌跡檢視。其核心為 recursive-in-recursive 自我改進：內層遞迴在任務模型固定的前提下，由固定的輔助模型（GPT-6 Astra）診斷失敗軌跡並提出有限幅度的 harness 修改，候選僅在配對開發評估改善且符合編輯約束時被採用；外層遞迴則以選定的 harness 校準環境難度，將研究者對話轉為 Harbor 任務與評分 rubric，以任務自適應 rubric 獎勵驅動 GRPO 強化學習更新模型。證據方面：以 Qwen3.5-4B 為起點進行三輪共同演化，整體單次測試正確率自 42.2% 升至 73.3%；僅改 harness 時驗證正確率由 31.1% 升至 51.1%（模型權重不變）；僅訓練模型時，固定 harness 下 pass@4 問題涵蓋率由 48.3% 升至 67.8%。限制包括：個別編輯成效與回饋來源未分離歸因、反思器固定意味著改進機制本身並未變強、案例聚焦生物醫學領域，且部分互動與介面為示意性重構。此工作示範了協作驅動的持續學習典範，朝「探索智慧」（discovery intelligence）邁進。
papers.title: ScienceBuddy: Recursive-in-Recursive Self-Improvement for Interactive Scientific Agents
papers.title_zh: ScienceBuddy：互動式科學代理的「遞迴中遞迴」自我改進

links.title: A Framework for Generating Valid Context-Specific Benchmarks through Expert Guidance

evidence: Abstract: 'end-to-end approach for generating context-specific large language model (LLM) benchmark datasets by combining expert input with synthetic data generation'

Table 1 (Sec. 5/6): expert Likert style 4.2±0.8 vs baseline 3.0±1.2, content 4.3±0.5 vs 3.3±1.0, 'Five of six participants preferred the schema-generated examples overall'; metrics coverage 0.23±0.02 vs 0.16±0.04, content realism 0.77 vs 0.73
Sec. 6: 'this trend was not reflected in our quantitative stylistic realism metric' — authors candidly report metric/human disagreement on style
Sec. 7: systematized instance and constituents raise coverage 'by as much as 12%'; 'the presence of seed examples reduces coverage by on average 3.44%'
Appendix B.1: judge agreement '0.94 agreement, 0.55 Jaccard similarity' on schema data 'but substantially lower for the baseline dataset (0.30 agreement, 0.21 Jaccard similarity)'
Appendix B.2: robustness check across '252 datasets of n=100' and seven embedding models; ranking robust, magnitude sensitive

Limitations: 'we engaged nine domain experts in total', single case study, n=100 datasets, metrics 'rely on certain assumptions, such as that the seed examples capture how the target population writes'

Appendix H: two additional domains (healthcare, political misinformation) shown via schema application and framework mapping only; 'We leave a full empirical study of these additional domains to future work'

Footnote 1 / Title page: implementation released at 'https://github.com/KimberlyTruong/expert-informed-eval-gen'; Appendix I provides complete generation, baseline, and labeling prompts; Appendix E specifies models (all-mpnet-base-v2, Wegmann et al. style embeddings, temperature 0.7)
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-methodology paper (not a pure domain application): it proposes a schema for eliciting expert context plus four validity-grounded metrics (coverage, diversity, content/stylistic realism) to guide synthetic benchmark generation with LLMs (GPT-5.x, Claude 4.x) and LLM-judge labeling. Preference relevance is solidly in-scope for LLM/evaluation/prompting/synthetic-data topics, though it does not touch reasoning, agents, RAG, or Japanese NLP, so it sits below core-weight maxima. Novelty is moderate: the schema operationalizes Chouldechova et al.'s systematization and extends Pombal et al.'s zero-shot structured prompting rather than introducing a fundamentally new technique; the validity-grounded quality metrics are the freshest contribution. Rigor is above average: formal metric definitions (App. A), a few-shot baseline (App. I prompts), seed/field/model ablations (Sec. 7, App. G), embedding-model and judge sensitivity analyses over 252 datasets (App. B), and an IRB-approved expert study; deductions for absent significance testing, n=6 participants, and low LLM-judge agreement on baseline data (0.30, App. B.1). Evidence is honest and triangulated (Table 1: schema 0.77 content realism / 0.23 coverage vs. baseline 0.73 / 0.16; 5/6 expert preference), including candid reporting that the stylistic realism metric contradicted human ratings (Sec. 6) and that absolute coverage stays below 25%. Generalizability is only structurally argued: Appendix H's healthcare and misinformation schemas are illustrative, with empirical multi-domain validation explicitly deferred to future work (Discussion, Limitations). Reproducibility is good: full code link, complete generation/labeling prompts, model, temperature, and embedding specifications; seed examples remain anonymized from prior work.

primary_link.title: A Framework for Generating Valid Context-Specific Benchmarks through Expert Guidance

papers.summary: This paper presents an end-to-end approach for generating context-specific large language model (LLM) benchmark datasets by combining expert input with synthetic data generation. Existing benchmark construction methods often trade off validity and scalability: datasets designed with domain experts can produce high-quality evaluations but are slow and costly to create, while synthetically generating data may scale efficiently but often results in unrealistic, redundant, or out-of-scope examples.
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對 LLM 評估基準的效度問題：現有公開基準多衡量通用能力，缺乏與特定部署情境的關聯；專家手工建立的評估資料集品質高卻緩慢昂貴，而純合成生成雖可規模化，卻常產生不真實、重複或超出範圍的範例。作者提出端對端框架，包含三項貢獻：一、schema 結構化範本，向領域專家蒐集母體、概念、實例與種子範例等最少情境資訊；二、依測量效度理論操作化四項資料集品質準則——涵蓋率、多樣性、內容真實性與風格真實性，並提供量化指標；三、以填妥的 schema 引導 LLM 合成評估資料。證據來自與美國學校社工組織的案例研究：六位社工的出聲思考訪談顯示，schema 生成範例在風格（4.2 對 3.0）與內容真實性（4.3 對 3.3）的平均評分較高，六位中有五位偏好此方法；量化指標亦顯示涵蓋率（0.23 對 0.16）與內容真實性（0.77 對 0.73）較佳，多樣性則無差異。消融實驗指出 schema 方法對種子範例數、模型選擇與批次大小穩健；系統化實例與構成要素欄位最影響涵蓋率，部署母體最影響內容真實性（平均提升 11.87%），種子範例反而使涵蓋率平均下降 3.44%。限制包括僅有單一案例、每個資料集約 100 筆、指標依賴種子範例具代表性等假設，且不可取代專家判斷。本研究為資源有限的組織提供兼顧效度與規模的情境特定評估資料集建置指引，並說明資源受限時應優先蒐集哪些專家資訊。
papers.title: A Framework for Generating Valid Context-Specific Benchmarks through Expert Guidance
papers.title_zh: 透過專家引導產生有效情境特定基準的框架

links.title: SpecLens: LLM-Based Verilog Generation with Specification-Derived Constraints via Behavioral Divergence

evidence: Abstract: SpecLens achieves functional pass@1 of 86.2% with o3-mini-medium and 89.4% with o3-mini-high on VerilogEval v2.0 spec-to-RTL, gains of 3.6/3.8 percentage points over SOTA prompting and SOTA behavioral divergence methods.

Section 4.1 Setup: hyperparameters specified (Q=3 refinement rounds, P=3 iterations, N=8 candidates, M=2 clusters, n=20 for pass@k); also states DeepV and VeriSeek results are cross-version references since they report on original VerilogEval.

Section 4.3 Ablation Study: removing entropy filtering reduces functional pass@1 from 86.2% to 84.0%; removing requirement extraction reduces it to 82.9% and scenario coverage from 891 to 781; prefiltering cuts tokens by 58.7% and runtime by 72.7%.

Section 4.2 Results: derived constraints transfer across models, improving GPT-4o-mini functional pass@1 by 6.84% to 54.7%; seven specification-testbench mismatch tasks identified in RTLLM, with revised-testbench results of 81.0% (v1.1) and 73.7% (v2.0) and a forced-error setting applied uniformly to all methods.

Section 4.1 post hoc analysis: probability a round yields >2 clusters with neither top-two cluster correct is 2.73% for o3-mini-medium but 15.8% for o3-mini-high, an acknowledged limitation of the M=2 design.
Abstract: code claimed open source at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SpecLens-4632/readme.md; pipeline relies on proprietary models o3-mini and GPT-4o-mini per Sections 4.1-4.2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper for Verilog/RTL code generation: it repurposes behavioral divergence (self-consistency signals) from a candidate-ranking back-end into a source of specification-derived disambiguation constraints, validated by entropy reduction. Core relevance is solid for LLM + Code & Programming + Prompting preferences; it is not a pure non-language domain application since the contributions are sampling, prompting, and constraint-validation techniques, though the EDA domain narrows appeal. Novelty is a genuine but incremental delta over VRank/VFocus (ranking-only divergence) and SpecFix (requires golden examples). Rigor is above average: multiple baselines (self-planning, two-shot prompting, DeepV, VeriSeek, SiliconMind-V1, VeriGRAG, VRank, VFocus), four ablations with concrete numbers, a post hoc failure-mode analysis, and transparent handling of RTLLM specification-testbench mismatches via forced-error and revised-testbench settings. Evidence is weakened by cross-version baseline comparisons (acknowledged in Section 4.1) and manual testbench revision that could favor the method, though the identical forced-error accounting across methods mitigates this. Generalizability is moderate: the approach needs executable simulation drivers, so transfer beyond simulable RTL/code tasks is unproven, though constraint transfer to GPT-4o-mini is demonstrated. Reproducibility is aided by an open-source anonymous code link and fully specified hyperparameters, but depends on proprietary closed models (o3-mini, GPT-4o-mini).

primary_link.title: SpecLens: LLM-Based Verilog Generation with Specification-Derived Constraints via Behavioral Divergence

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in Verilog generation, but producing functionally correct RTL directly from natural-language specifications remains a highly challenging task. Existing approaches improve LLM-based Verilog generation mainly with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), self-planning, or few-shot prompting. However, these methods focus primarily on external or generic forms of enhancement rather than strengthening the specification with task-specific constrain
papers.summary_zh: LLM 直接從自然語言規格產生功能正確的 RTL 仍具挑戰，現有 RAG、自我規劃與 few-shot 提示等多屬外部或通用增強，無法針對模型視角下的規格模糊處提供任務專屬資訊。SpecLens 提出三階段自動化框架：第一階段萃取行為需求，生成結構化情境與刺激，對初始 Verilog 候選分群並計算行為熵以預篩選；第二階段對產生多叢集的需求，以熵引導迭代推導消歧約束，僅接受能降低行為熵者，並獨立重新生成情境與刺激驗證；第三階段依最終刺激分群並選出最符合規格的候選，再依規格初始化輸出，全程不依賴外部檢索或黃金測試平台。在 VerilogEval v2.0 spec-to-RTL 上，語法 pass@1 達 100%，功能 pass@1 為 86.2%（o3-mini-medium）與 89.4%（o3-mini-high），優於 two-shot prompting、VRank 與 VFocus；導出的約束可跨模型轉移，使 GPT-4o-mini 提升 6.84%。在 RTLLM 上，SpecLens 對規格局部修改更忠實，較不易複製預訓練時學到的典範實作。消融實驗顯示預篩選減少 58.7% token 用量與 72.7% 執行時間，熵過濾、需求萃取與刺激精煉皆有貢獻。限制包括僅比較前兩大叢集可能遺漏低頻正確解（o3-mini-high 下風險約 15.8%）、模擬與迭代成本可觀，以及測試平台與規格不一致仍需人工修訂。整體而言，本文顯示行為分歧不僅能排序候選，更可定位規格模糊處並提供針對性語義補充，為不依賴 fine-tuning 資料與外部程式庫的 Verilog 生成提供可行路徑。
papers.title: SpecLens: LLM-Based Verilog Generation with Specification-Derived Constraints via Behavioral Divergence
papers.title_zh: SpecLens：以行為分歧導出規格衍生約束之 LLM 式 Verilog 生成

links.title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness

evidence: §2.1 Methodology: two scheduling scenarios (S1 student-professor, S2 group meeting), N in {1,3,5,7}, model configs M1 (all GPT-5.4) and M2 (one Claude Opus 4.8), success rates over n=10 runs, LLM-augmented trace analysis with human verification of selected findings

Table 2: honest-agent success degrades with scale (S1/E1/M1: 100% at N=1 to 10% at N=7) and message complexity reported as mean±std; group messaging (E3) yields 3-25x message reductions per §2.2 Findings
Table 3: attack outcomes for stalling (E4), social pressure/deception (E5), and stalking (E6), e.g., calendar reconstruction disclosed availability in 100% of runs in both configs per §2.3

§2.3 Findings: attacks succeeded despite models' safety guardrails because principals supplied false claims agents relayed; authors state deception prompts 'were refined in the M1 setup and then applied to M2'

§3 and Figure 8: five-layer social harness (identities, ordered communication/collectives, personal firewalls, norms/contracts, institutions) is a proposal without implementation; §5 admits open questions on contract synthesis and the coordination-throughput tradeoff
No code, dataset, or artifact availability claim appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-agent paper: experimental study of multi-agent LLM collaboration (agentic societies) across trust boundaries plus a proposed five-layer 'social harness' architecture, squarely matching Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, and Red Teaming preferences. Novelty is solid: distinguishing cross-principal collaboration failures (vs. single-principal swarms) and importing systems concepts (collectives, concurrency control, firewalls, accountability) is a fresh framing, though adjacent prior work (MAST, red-teaming networks of agents, Magentic Marketplace) limits the delta. Rigor is moderate: controlled factorial design (N in {1,3,5,7}, two model configs, three communication settings, three attack families, n=10 runs) with an LLM-annotation pipeline plus partial human verification, but small samples, only two frontier models, no significance testing, and authors admit attack prompts were 'refined in the M1 setup' before transfer to M2 (§2.3), an acknowledged bias. Evidence is concrete (Tables 2-3 with rates and mean±std message counts, trace figures) but confined to one toy task (meeting scheduling), so generalizability claims to agentic societies broadly remain speculative; §5 concedes key design questions (contract authoring, latency cost of pessimistic concurrency control) are open. The harness itself is never implemented. No code, prompts, or artifact release is mentioned anywhere, capping reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Agentic Societies Need a Social Harness

papers.summary: An agentic society is a collection of AI agents that coordinate autonomously across trust boundaries, on behalf of different principals whose objectives may only partially align. We show experimentally that in agentic societies even honest, competent agents often fail to reach satisfactory outcomes with existing harnesses and messaging primitives, and that faulty or malicious agents can stall collaboration, influence outcomes, and pursue other harmful goals by exploiting vulnerabilities in commu
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討「代理社會」中的自主協作失敗模式：當多位委託人的 AI 代理橫跨信任邊界協調時，即使所有代理誠實且稱職，現有的 harness 與點對點訊息機制仍常無法達成滿意結果；故障或惡意代理更能利用通訊弱點拖延協作、操縱結果。作者以教授與學生排定會議為實驗場景，在 1 至 7 位參與者下測試 GPT-5.4 與 Claude Opus 4.8 配置，比較隔離對話、共享情境與群組訊息三種設定。結果顯示成功率隨人數增加而下滑，誠實代理也會陷入無意義的確認迴圈與活鎖，單次成功排程竟交換上百則訊息；共享情境雖提升成功率卻帶來隱私疑慮；群組訊息可將訊息量降低 3 至 25 倍，但競態條件仍在。此外，單一故障代理即可拖延排程，社會壓力與欺騙攻擊能左右教授決定，側通道探詢更能完整重組教授行事曆。據此，作者提出五層「社會性 harness」堆疊：L1 不可偽造的可驗證身分、L2 支援集體通訊操作的可靠有序通訊、L3 過濾惡意訊息的個人防火牆、L4 可分析活性、安全性與效率的共享協作規範（合約）、L5 提供事後調查與懲處的社會制度。限制包括分層設計尚待社群檢驗、悲觀並行控制會增加延遲，治理結構亦留待後續研究。本文首度系統性檢視代理社會的協作失敗，對跨信任邊界的代理基礎建設具重要啟示。
