links.title: Large Language Models in the Loop: A Stability- and Network-Aware Survey in Networked Control, Cyber-Physical, and Multi-Agent Systems

evidence: Section 2.3, Table 2: LLM-in-the-loop / NCS correspondence mapping inference latency to delay, API failure to packet dropout, hallucination to bounded disturbance δ_LLM
Section 2.2, Remark 1: stability template 'stated as a design template, not a theorem', requiring bounded LLM error per Eq. (6) for inherited practical stability
Section 1.5: methodology states 'structured review of literature published primarily (87%) between 2021 and 2026' with inclusion criteria but no databases, search strings, or screening protocol
Section 1.3, Table 1: positioning against eight related surveys along LLM-specificity, network dimension, and whether stability/safety is analyzed rather than discussed

Section 6.1: identifies hallucination as uncharacterized disturbance, stating 'δ_LLM is not yet a bounded disturbance' and calling bounded error characterization 'the single most important open theoretical problem'

Section 5.2, Table 8: evidence typing per approach, e.g., VLA in-loop policies rated 'demonstration-level, no formal guarantees' and LLM-as-direct-controller supported only by a greenhouse GPT-4o comparative benchmark [121]
Section 1.4, Contribution 4: compiles safety mechanisms (CBFs, conformal prediction, runtime filters) into a perturbation-centric view and names missing Lyapunov-based proofs as central open problem
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey squarely centered on LLMs as system components, with strong alignment to high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, AI safety, reasoning/planning); it is not a pure robotics/domain application because its contribution is an LLM-integration framework, though it is a survey rather than new methodology. Conceptual novelty is solid: Section 2.3/Table 2 maps LLM artifacts onto networked-control phenomena (latency→delay, API failure→dropout, tokenization→quantization, hallucination→bounded disturbance) and Remark 1 offers an ISS-based design template, explicitly hedged as 'not a theorem'. Rigor is moderate: the formal model (Eqs. 1-7) is carefully assembled and claims are hedged, but the review protocol (Section 1.5) lacks database/search-string detail and the central stability claim remains unproven. Evidence strength is limited by absence of new experiments or quantitative synthesis, though Tables 7-9 honestly label per-approach evidence types (e.g., 'demonstration-level, no formal guarantees'). Generalizability is high by design, unifying NCS/CPS/CNS under one model. Reproducibility is weak: brief inclusion criteria and no released protocol or artifacts. Identifying unbounded hallucination error as the field's central gap (Section 6.1) is a well-supported, calibrated conclusion.

primary_link.title: Large Language Models in the Loop: A Stability- and Network-Aware Survey in Networked Control, Cyber-Physical, and Multi-Agent Systems

papers.summary: Modern networked control systems (NCSs), cyber-physical systems (CPSs), and complex multi-agent network systems (CNSs) increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) for high-level decision-making. However, the slow, stochastic nature of LLMs directly conflicts with the strict stability and safety guarantees required by these physical systems. This survey presents a unified analysis of how LLMs can be admitted into the control loop of NCS, CPS, and CNS without compromising closed-loop guarant
papers.summary_zh: 這篇綜述探討大型語言模型（LLM）能否在不破壞封閉迴路穩定性與安全性保證的前提下，進入網路控制系統（NCS）、資訊物理系統（CPS）與多主體網路系統（CNS）的控制迴路。作者提出統一框架：LLM 作為緩慢的高層監督者，調整參考值、約束集合、觸發條件與網路拓撲，而快速且經過認證的內層控制器維持物理穩定性；所有 LLM 輸出須先經過執行期安全過濾器。在此框架下，LLM 的缺陷可直接對應到經典網路控制問題：推論延遲視為時間延遲、API 失敗視為封包遺失、token 輸出視為量化，而幻覺則建模為有界擾動。文章以智慧程度、保證強度、網路感知、迴路角色與時間尺度五個維度分類文獻，歸納出設計期、監督式與 LLM 主導三類方法，並指出 LLM 與快速迴路耦合越緊密，可提供的理論保證越弱。綜觀各領域發現：模型能力提升常伴隨形式化安全保證下降，多數文獻僅屬示範級驗證，幾乎完全缺乏 Lyapunov 或 ISS 型式的穩定性分析，這正是本領域最核心的未解問題。作者進一步彙整 CBF 安全過濾器、預測式安全過濾、保形預測與神經憑證等工具，並提出數位孿生驗證環境、約束保持監督、多主體工具使用，以及放寬監督假設等未來研究方向。本綜述不追求窮盡文獻，但為安全地將 LLM 嵌入控制迴路提供了清晰的分析座標與實務路線圖。

links.title: Extracting ontology-compliant knowledge from scientific text describing irradiated materials using large language models

evidence: Abstract: 'we introduce eolas, a modular pipeline that uses large language models to automatically transform scientific documents into knowledge graphs aligned with a specified ontology' and 'the first benchmark dataset designed to assess large language models' capabilities in constructing knowledge graphs within the domain of irradiated materials'

Section 2.2: 'we use 6 openly accessible LLMs... we will refer to these models as GPT_120, GPT_20, GRANITE, LLAMA_3, LLAMA_4, and MISTRAL... a fixed random seed and temperature=0.0 to reduce randomness'; Table 1 enumerates the 168 configurations

Section 2.4: 'In few-shot scenarios, the best result is a 45.9% percentage of success' (LLAMA_3, D, TTL at NGED*=0.1) and 'the GPT_120 model achieves notable results (67.6%)' few-shot at NGED*=0.2 (Tables 2-3)

Section 2.4: 'A Mann-Whitney U test revealed no statistically significant differences between the distributions of percentages of success for configuration families with prompts containing instances versus those without' — ablation-style analysis of prompt components

Section 2.1: benchmark construction — '126 text passages, each paired with a KG... an evaluation set comprising 111 passages' and 'This semi-automated approach, in which the ground truth is collaboratively generated by LLMs and SMEs' (potential ground-truth bias), curation by 'five domain experts and 3 researchers'

Discussion (limitations): 'we adopt a strict metric... compare values (nodes or edges labels) using equality... the graph edit distance metric penalizes the LLM, even when the added content is factually correct'; 'Future research could explore the applicability of eolas across different domains'

Section 2.1 / Introduction availability: 'We publicly release both the ontology, and the benchmark dataset at https://github.com/jmendi/eolas_irradiated_materials/' and 'A demo version of eolas user interface is available at https://demo-public.1fotembijozx.eu-es.codeengine.appdomain.cloud/'; pipeline code release not stated
Appendix B: Graph-RAG validation is 'a naive Graph-RAG approach' demonstrated on competency questions (Table 7) with example answers only; no quantitative QA metrics reported
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper despite the materials-science application: the core contributions are ontology-guided prompting, few-shot/zero-shot in-context learning for KG extraction, hallucination mitigation, and an LLM evaluation benchmark. Preference relevance is strong (LLMs, prompting/ICL, knowledge graphs/RAG, NLP) but tempered by a very narrow domain focus. Novelty is moderate: LLM-based schema-driven extraction exists (Text2KGBench, ChatExtract, KEP cited in Introduction); the domain benchmark and the BAML-vs-TTL-vs-VERB serialization comparison are the freshest elements, and the 'first benchmark' claim is domain-scoped. Rigor is good: 168 systematic configurations across 6 open LLMs (Section 2.2, temperature=0.0), a clearly defined normalized graph edit distance metric (Section 2.3, Eq. 1-3), and nonparametric statistical testing with multiple-comparison correction (Mann-Whitney U, Kruskal-Wallis, Dunn's with Holm, Section 2.4). Weaknesses: evaluation on only 111 passages from 5 articles, ground truth co-generated by LLMs plus expert curation (potential bias toward extractable text, Section 2.1), single fixed-seed runs without variance reporting, and a strict equality-matching metric the authors themselves flag as penalizing factually correct outputs (Discussion). Evidence strength is solid for the main extraction tables (Tables 2-6 report all configurations at multiple thresholds) but the Graph-RAG validation (Appendix B) is a 'naive' qualitative demo without quantitative metrics, and the 30-90 minute human-time claim is an unsupported estimate. Generalizability is limited: pipeline is claimed domain-agnostic but never evaluated outside irradiated-material defect energetics, and authors list cross-domain validation as future work. Reproducibility is decent: ontology and benchmark are open-sourced (GitHub link, Section 2.1), a public demo UI exists, models are openly available, and prompt templates are shown (Figure 6), but the eolas pipeline code itself is not explicitly released.

primary_link.title: Extracting ontology-compliant knowledge from scientific text describing irradiated materials using large language models

papers.summary: The quest for new materials increasingly relies on predictive models and comprehensive simulations that span scales from atomic to macroscopic levels. However, essential data necessary for these models and simulations are often embedded in scientific literature as unstructured text, limiting reusability and posing challenges for researchers seeking to leverage existing knowledge effectively. While extracting structured data from unstructured text using large language models is gaining popularity
papers.summary_zh: 核融合反應器材料的開發依賴原子尺度缺陷參數（如遷移能、結合能、鬆弛體積），但這些關鍵資訊多半埋藏在非結構化科學文獻中，專家人工擷取每篇文章約需三十至九十分鐘。由 IBM Research 與西班牙多個機構組成的團隊提出 eolas，一套模組化管線，利用大型語言模型（LLM）搭配以 RDF/OWL 建構的輻照材料缺陷能量學本體論（含 14 類別、13 物件屬性、25 資料屬性），自動將科學文件轉為符合本體規範的知識圖譜，並以表格介面供專家驗證。作者並釋出首個該領域的基準資料集：126 個專家核可的文本段落與對應圖譜（評測用 111 個），以正規化圖編輯距離（NGED）為指標，對六種開放模型與多種提示組態（簡易/詳細指令、TTL/BAML/VERB 序列化、本體實例、少樣本/零樣本、整併啟發式）共進行 168 組實驗。結果顯示少樣本顯著優於零樣本：NGED 門檻 0.2 時，GPT_120 結合 BAML 序列化、實例與整併策略可達 67.6% 成功率，零樣本最佳為 36.0%；門檻 0.1 時，LLAMA_3 搭配詳細指令與 TTL 序列化達 45.9%。研究歸納出實務指引：以零樣本產生初始範例並經專家審核、高品質範例勝過實例清單、零樣本宜用 BAML、少樣本宜用 TTL 加詳細指令。限制包括評測採嚴格字串比對、段落級圖譜合併為文件級仍具挑戰，模型亦偶有幻覺或違反本體約束。此成果萃取的圖譜可直接支援 Kinetic Monte Carlo 等模擬設定與 Graph-RAG 問答，為 AI 輔助的科學知識擷取提供可重用的管線、資料與基準。
papers.title: Extracting ontology-compliant knowledge from scientific text describing irradiated materials using large language models
papers.title_zh: 利用大型語言模型從描述輻照材料的科學文本中擷取符合本體論的知識

links.title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents

evidence: Section 4.1, Datasets and Benchmarks / Models: evaluation on CC, MSC, GC, and PersonaMem with Llama-3.2 3B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B backbones against Long Context, GraphRAG, MemTree, MemGPT, Mem0, A-Mem, MemoryOS, MemoChat, MemoryBank, Rsum, COMEDY, LD-Agent, THEANINE, LightMem, SoftCoT, Co-processor, and MemGen.
Table 1 (Section 4.2): ThinkFlow best on all datasets (e.g., Qwen3-8B GC B-4 1.10 vs next-best 0.63; Mauve 65.26 vs 43.18), unusually large margins with no statistical significance reported.

Appendix D, Table 8: w/o GLC, w/o Phase1, and w/o Phase2 rows list identical values across MSC and GC (e.g., w/o Phase1 = 1.07/13.98/44.71/64.22 on both), and w/o CAHA's MSC row duplicates ThinkFlow's GC row (1.10/14.21/44.82/65.26), indicating probable transcription errors.

Section 4.1, Evaluation Metrics: PersonaMem accuracy defined as proportion of responses that 'correctly match the user's current persona and the conversational context,' but the judging procedure (human vs automatic) is never specified.

Section 3.2 and Algorithm 1 (Appendix G): Phase 1 KL-distillation from a same-base teacher reading full plaintext history; Phase 2 next-user-utterance prediction with cross-entropy plus min-entropy and KL regularizers.
Section 4.5, Figure 5: ThinkFlow consumes 2,857 tokens and 12.1s versus explicit baselines (MemTree, A-Mem) taking nearly 8x longer.

Limitations section and full text: no code, data, or artifact release statement appears anywhere; hyperparameters (LoRA rank 8, K=10, lr 2e-5) are given in Table 7 but external reproducibility is unverified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM-based memory methodology for lifelong conversational agents touching agents, long-context memory, personalization, and test-time adaptation, evaluated on two LLM backbones (Qwen3-8B, Llama3.2-3B) and four benchmarks with 17 baselines. Novelty is moderate: variational latent bottlenecks (PLMS), GRU-gated consolidation (GLC), and hypernetwork soft-prompt alignment (CAHA) recombine known mechanisms; the teacher-distillation cold start is context distillation and the next-user-utterance self-supervision is the most original piece, though latent-memory prior work (MemGen, SoftCoT, Co-processor) makes 'first' claims overstated. Rigor is undercut by automatic-metrics-only generation evaluation (BLEU/ROUGE/BertScore/Mauve, no human or judge study), no significance testing, unexplained near-doubled scores on GC, and a suspicious Appendix D Table 8 with duplicated rows across datasets, suggesting copy errors. No code/data release is stated, and the PersonaMem correctness-judging procedure is unspecified, hurting reproducibility despite detailed hyperparameters (Table 7) and pseudocode (Algorithm 1). Generalizability is supported by two backbones and up to 1M-token contexts, but scope is English open-domain text only.

primary_link.title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents

papers.summary: Lifelong conversational agents rely on memory systems to maintain deep, context-aware interactions with users. However, existing explicit textual memory pipelines suffer from a severe information bottleneck, often losing subtle behavioral patterns and emotional shifts. Furthermore, being typically static post-deployment, they cannot autonomously adapt to personal habits and preferences without manual feedback. Cognitive science, however, suggests that humans maintain mental models purely in a la
papers.summary_zh: 此論文針對終身對話代理的記憶系統提出 ThinkFlow 框架。作者指出，現有以明確文字為基礎的記憶流程存在嚴重的資訊瓶頸：將連續互動壓縮成離散文字摘要時，會遺失使用者的細微行為模式與情緒變化，且部署後模型多為靜態，無法自動適應個人偏好。受認知科學中內隱心智理論與預測編碼啟發，ThinkFlow 完全在潛在空間運作，包含三個模組：PLMS 透過 cross-attention 將對話流壓縮為 K 個解耦的機率性記憶技能向量；GLC 以資訊增益閘門搭配 GRU 過濾雜訊並依時序更新記憶；CAHA 則以 hypernetwork 產生低秩轉換矩陣，將歷史記憶對齊當前語境。訓練採兩階段的測試時自我演化：第一階段以文字教師模型透過 KL 散度蒸餾解決冷啟動問題，第二階段改用「預測使用者下一句話」的自監督任務，以隱性回饋實現無標籤的終身個人化。實驗以 Llama3.2-3B 與 Qwen3-8B 為骨幹，在 MSC、CC、GC 與 PersonaMem 上全面超越明確記憶與潛在記憶基線；於長達 1M token 的情境下，平均準確率可匹敵或超越 GPT-4o-mini、Claude3.7-Sonnet 等閉源模型及 Llama3.1-405B，且僅需 2,857 個 token 與 12.1 秒，效率遠優於明確式方法。消融實驗證實各模組與兩階段訓練皆不可或缺；t-SNE 視覺化顯示潛在空間能分離靜態事實與動態使用者狀態。限制在於尚未測試極端規模下的崩潰上限，且預測編碼機制仍有待擴展至跨模態與多代理社會情境。此研究為無標籤、高效率的終身個人化對話提供了嶄新典範。
papers.title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents
papers.title_zh: ThinkFlow：邁向終身對話代理之自我演化機率性潛在記憶

links.title: MarkSec: Capability-Aware Evaluation of Adversarial Attacks Against LLM Watermarks

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: frames LLM watermarking for tracing LLM-generated content against stealing, scrubbing, and spoofing attacks
Section 5.1: 'The main matrix uses 26,096 recorded outputs from 261 runs' across six watermark schemes (KGW, Unigram, SIR, UW, DIP, SynthID), three LLM families, three prompt datasets
Section 5.2: 'Detector calibration targets an FPR of 1%; results use the decision and threshold recorded for each run. This is a calibration target, not a separately measured test-set FPR'
Section 6.1 Finding 1: SIRA achieves highest mean ASR while LLMP achieves highest mean QSR@3 on C4, supported by Table 3 per-cell values
Section 6.5 Finding 5: 'B4 leads stealing-based QSR@3 in all four KGW settings; DE-MARK-Sp attains 98-100% detector acceptance and 47-64% QSSR@3' per Tables 5 and 7
Section 6.6 / Appendix E.3: output screening inspected 251 source-output pairs, identified 254 invalid outputs, and LLMP retains highest dataset-level mean QSR@3 after screening
Appendix E.2: 'Quality evaluation uses automatic scores; supplementary content screening uses deterministic rules and Codex-assisted source-output inspection, with no independent human annotation'

Appendix A: 'Planned Benchmark Release - We intend to release the framework source, configuration files, experiment manifests, and figure-generation scripts' with third-party checkpoints/datasets excluded from redistribution
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM security/evaluation paper (Section 1: watermarking for tracing LLM-generated content) that strongly matches the LLM, AI Safety, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences, though it contributes no new model, reasoning, or language methodology beyond evaluation infrastructure. Novelty is moderate: the unified stealing/scrubbing/spoofing taxonomy, capability-stratified reporting, and the quality-gated QSR metric (Section 3.2, Section 5.2 Eq. 7) are useful but largely integrative over existing attacks and prior platforms (WaterPark, Mark My Words, MarkLLM, per Section 7). Rigor is solid: a 26,096-output/261-run matrix across six watermark families, three open models, and three datasets (Section 5.1), explicit metric formulas, quality-gate sensitivity (Table 14), and an output-screening robustness check (Section E.3). Weaknesses include no significance testing, 100-sample cells, calibration stated as a 1% FPR target rather than measured (Section 5.2), and heavy reliance on a single automatic judge (Prometheus) with no human annotation (Appendix E.2), which caps evidence strength despite well-supported headline findings (Findings 1-5, Tables 3, 5, 7). Generalizability is decent but bounded: inference-time watermarks only, stealing/spoofing analysis restricted to KGW (Section 6.5), English-only data, open models only. Reproducibility is good via configuration-driven pipeline, detailed attack defaults (Appendix D), and hash manifests, but release is only 'planned' and third-party assets are non-redistributable (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: MarkSec: Capability-Aware Evaluation of Adversarial Attacks Against LLM Watermarks

papers.summary: LLM watermarking helps trace the origin of generated text, but faces stealing attacks that recover watermark information, scrubbing attacks that remove watermark signals, and spoofing attacks that forge text accepted as watermarked. These attacks are often studied in isolation, leaving their connections unclear. Evaluations also often lack shared detector calibration, metric definitions, and reporting protocols. Moreover, measuring attack success and text quality separately makes it difficult to
papers.summary_zh: 此論文針對 LLM 浮水印的安全性評估提出統一架構 MarkSec。現有研究將對浮水印的攻擊分散處理:竊取(還原浮水印相關資訊)、洗除(移除已標記文字中的浮水印訊號)與偽造(產生可被偵測器誤判為浮水印的文字),且缺乏共通的偵測器校準、指標定義與回報協定,攻擊成功率與文字品質也常分開衡量。MarkSec 依攻擊目標、能力假設、可回收工件與下游用途建立統一分類,並引入品質約束的攻擊成功率指標 QSR,以自動品質門檻(Prometheus)同時評估移除效果與文字品質。實驗涵蓋六種浮水印家族(KGW、Unigram、SIR、UW、DIP、SynthID)、五種一般洗除攻擊、五種竊取式方法、三種開源 LLM 與三個資料集。主要發現:僅看移除率會高估攻擊強度;在 C4 上 SIRA 的原始移除率最高,但 LLMP 在所有 Prometheus 門檻下的品質感知成功率最佳,DIPPER 為最接近的替代;竊取式洗除中 B4 在四種 KGW 設定下 QSR@3 領先,而 DE-MARK-Sp 偽造可達 98–100% 偵測接受率與 47–64% 品質化偽造成功率。研究顯示攻擊優勝者取決於品質約束、攻擊通用性與能力假設,主張能力感知的浮水印評估,對防禦方衡量浮水印穩健性具實務參考價值。限制包括僅採用自動品質評分而無獨立人工標註,部分比較屬設定層級,且涵蓋的模型與浮水印範圍有限。

links.title: Explainable Post-Disaster Grid Observability Recovery Using Human-Oversight Agentic LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'proposes an agentic tool-calling framework orchestrated by a large language model (LLM) for post-disaster PMU restoration' with 'tool-grounded explanations, interactive operator support, and human-overseen execution'
Section IV: 'the proposed framework is tested using OpenAI's GPT-4o mini model'; failure rates 30%-90%, budget 1-4, zones 1-4, horizon H=3
Table VI: IEEE 57-bus vs standalone MILP shows 7.76% avg step gap and 21.875% incomplete runs at 90% failure vs 0% gap at 70%
Section IV-C1: attributes incomplete runs to insufficient budget, LLM stopping early, and 'LLM reaches its generation limit before completing the full restoration procedure'

Table VII (Ablation): one-shot prompt-only LLM 'reports full observability without sequential restoration'; iterative LLM without tools needs '61% more restoration steps on average'; proposed variant achieves '100% observability with traceable restoration steps'
Section IV-A3: expert consistency check is 'a faithfulness check rather than a statistical user study' with 8 evaluated iterations, all consistent (Table V)
Reference [14] / Section IV-B: project repository (github.com/siu-power-lab/llm_tool_example) provides complete tool-call traces and the user prompt
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is an agentic LLM tool-calling framework (GPT-4o mini orchestrator, executor-validated tools, context memory, human approval) for PMU restoration, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Explainability); not a pure domain application since the language-methodology layer is the contribution. Novelty is moderate: the orchestration pattern (LLM + deterministic tools + executor + human-in-the-loop) is standard, and prior agentic power-system work (GridMind, Grid-Agent) exists, so the advance is primarily the new domain instantiation. Rigor is mixed: IEEE 30/57-bus case studies sweep failure rates (30-90%), budgets (1-4), and zones (1-4), with a MILP baseline comparison, an LLM-variant ablation, and an 8/8 rationale consistency check, but only one LLM is tested, no seed/statistical analysis is reported, and the faithfulness check uses author-written references on 8 iterations. Evidence is credible but thin (small tables, aggregate step-gap percentages, 21.875% incomplete runs at 90% failure acknowledged in Section IV-C1). Generalizability is limited by two small test systems and a single model. Reproducibility is helped by a public repository with traces and prompts (Ref [14]).

primary_link.title: Explainable Post-Disaster Grid Observability Recovery Using Human-Oversight Agentic LLMs

papers.summary: Post-disaster phasor measurement unit (PMU) outages reduce power-system observability and degrade operator situational awareness, requiring sequential restoration under limited resources. Existing PMU restoration methods based on optimization or heuristics can generate restoration schedules, but they often provide limited support for explanation, traceability, and operator interaction. This paper proposes an agentic tool-calling framework orchestrated by a large language model (LLM) for post-dis
papers.summary_zh: 災後相量量測單元（PMU）大規模失效會降低電網可觀測性並削弱調度員的情境覺察，而維修人力與備品有限，使 PMU 復原本質上是序列決策問題。現有以混合整數線性規劃（MILP）或啟發式為基礎的方法雖能產生復原排程，但缺乏解釋、可追溯性與互動支援。本文提出由代理式（agentic）LLM 編排的工具呼叫框架：LLM 不直接求解最佳化，而是協調經驗證的後端工具，涵蓋網路分區、分區權重與預算配置、滾動時程 MILP 復原規劃、狀態更新及可觀測性檢核；執行器驗證每次工具呼叫並維護結構化脈絡記憶，操作員可在每步審核、修改或批准計畫，也能以自然語言即時追問優先分區與剩餘缺口。以 GPT-4o mini 在 IEEE 30 與 57 匯流排系統的模擬顯示，框架達成與獨立 MILP 相當的恢復品質：57 匯流排在 70% 故障率下步驟差距 0%，90% 下平均 7.76%，30 匯流排為 0% 差距且全數完成；專家一致性檢查 8/8 通過，每步決策僅需數秒；消融實驗證實純提示 LLM 不可靠。限制包括預算緊縮且分區多時仍有約 21.9% 未完成案例與最佳化差距，脈絡管理與完成處理待改進，驗證亦僅限靜態故障情境。此工作展示 LLM 作為可信編排與解釋介面的價值，為關鍵基礎設施提供可追溯、可互動的營運決策支援。
papers.title: Explainable Post-Disaster Grid Observability Recovery Using Human-Oversight Agentic LLMs
papers.title_zh: 使用人類監督之代理式 LLM 實現可解釋的災後電網可觀測性復原

links.title: RoleBreak: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Role-Playing Robustness in Spoken Dialogue

evidence: Abstract: benchmark with 310 roles, 6,688 human-verified turns, 11,743 criteria, 1,856 emotion-target turns; strongest system's first persona/safety failures at 10.4/11.6 turns vs 21.57-turn average (Sections 3.1, 4.3, Table 2).

Section 4.2: DeepSeek-V4-Pro judges rubric pass rates; validated on 312 randomly sampled rubric-response pairs by three annotators with 94.55% agreement; UTMOSv2 for naturalness, emotion2vec+ for vocal emotion.
Table 2 / Section 4.3: scaling Qwen3.5 from 2B to 27B raises Persona 58.6->80.3 and P-FFT 6.0->10.4 with ASR/TTS fixed, while Emotion stays ~13-14, supporting the semantic-vs-vocal gap claim.
Section 4.4 / Table 3: fixing linguistic content and varying user emotion changes Persona by 5.6, Interaction by 4.2, Safety by 4.5 points; no variance estimates reported.

Footnote 1: dataset at huggingface.co/datasets/Greenbean/RoleBreak and code at github.com/bugggggggg/RoleBreak; Section 3.2 reports five-reviewer quality gate averaging 4.42/5 with 90.36% of examples rated at least 4.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A spoken-dialogue benchmark for long-horizon role-playing robustness that is not pure audio: it evaluates LLM-centric cascaded ASR-LLM-TTS and omni-modal systems on persona adherence, safety, and interaction, and reports an LLM-scaling finding (Section 4.3). Relevant to agents/role-playing, AI safety evaluation, red-teaming/benchmarks, and LLM-as-judge methodology, though its center of gravity is speech rather than core language modeling, tempering preference fit. Novelty is solid: it positions against character-centric, short-horizon spoken benchmarks (Table 1) and adds user-centered roles, first-failure-turn metrics, and a user-emotion ablation (Section 4.4). Rigor is reasonable: human quality review (4.42/5, 90.36% >=4, Section 3.2), judge validation on 312 pairs at 94.55% agreement (Section 4.2), and a controlled scaling study with fixed ASR/TTS. Evidence is undermined by a single proprietary judge (DeepSeek-V4-Pro), no confidence intervals or significance tests for the modest 4-6 point emotion effects, and some evaluated systems (PersonaPlex, Covo-Audio-Chat) with limited specification. Generalizability is limited to English with synthetic CosyVoice-cloned user speech rather than real interlocutors. Reproducibility is helped by public dataset and code links (footnote 1) and open models, but the judge and some systems are closed.

primary_link.title: RoleBreak: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Role-Playing Robustness in Spoken Dialogue

papers.summary: Speech-to-speech dialogue models increasingly support persona control, yet existing spoken role-playing benchmarks remain largely character-centric and short-horizon. This leaves open whether spoken dialogue models can sustain diverse roles over extended interactions, especially beyond predefined fictional characters. We introduce RoleBreak, an open benchmark for long-horizon role-playing robustness in spoken dialogue. RoleBreak contains 310 character-based and user-centered roles, 6,688 human-v
papers.summary_zh: 語音對話模型日漸支援角色與聲音控制,但現有口語角色扮演評測多以預設虛構角色為中心且對話輪數偏短,難以檢驗模型在長時間互動下能否維持角色一致。本文提出開放基準RoleBreak,將口語角色扮演視為長期穩健性問題。資料集包含310個角色、6,688個經人工驗證的對話輪次與11,743條細緻評分準則,其中1,856輪附有情感目標以評估語音情緒。標註者設計多輪情境、情境探針與壓力介入,以LLM草擬後人工修訂,並透過CosyVoice語音克隆合成使用者語音,整體品質平均4.42分(滿分5分)。研究評測九種系統,涵蓋全雙工、全模態與ASR–LLM–TTS串接架構,以DeepSeek-V4-Pro擔任評審,與人工判斷一致率達94.55%。主要發現:一、各系統語意層面的角色遵循明顯優於語音情緒,情緒得分皆低於14.7;二、最強系統平均在第10.4輪即出現首次人設失誤、第11.6輪出現首次安全失誤,遠早於平均21.57輪的對話長度;三、將Qwen3.5由2B擴增至27B可提升語意穩健性並延後失誤,但對語音情緒幾無幫助,自然度亦因ASR與TTS固定而持平;四、即使語言內容固定,使用者語音情緒仍會改變模型的角色扮演行為。研究侷限於九種系統與逐輪二元的情緒判定,且語料以英文為主。此基準同時檢驗角色一致性與語音表達,可作為發展長對話中連貫、具表現力且安全之語音代理的測試平台。

evidence: Abstract: 'integrates perception, compliance reasoning, vehicle-state interpretation, and safety arbitration into a modular and auditable pipeline' with MCP servers (Rules, Weather, MCP-CAN)
Section VIII-E / Table IV: all baselines (VLM-Direct, VLM-Direct+RAG, VLM-Tools-NoArbiter) use the same DriveLM checkpoint and sensor snapshots, isolating retrieval, tools, and arbitration

Table V: DriveMCP achieves lowest infractions (0.2-0.3/10km) and overspeed, but hazard response 0.73s and TTC 2.0s are worse than VLM-Tools-NoArbiter (0.70s, 2.2s) in URB-RAIN, partially contradicting the abstract's hazard-response claim
Table VIII: ablations over 10 runs with 95% CI in CROSS-BORDER; removing Rules RAG raises infractions from 0.20±0.06 to 0.90±0.19, identifying retrieval as the dominant contributor
Table II: full arbiter constants disclosed (t_r=0.7s, d_0=2.0m, tau=2.5s, alpha/beta/gamma=0.6/0.3/0.1, Delta=0.2), fixed across scenarios after offline calibration
Section VIII-D: controlled world_state corruption protocol (missed signs, misread limits, actor dropouts) with Table VI reporting event F1 and correct-tool rate degradation

Section XI-F: 'We also plan to evaluate DriveMCP against closed-loop benchmarks and to release reproducible tool-call traces and scenario specifications' - full code not yet released; only MCP-CAN server is a public GitHub repo (ref [36])
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an agentic system built around MCP tool servers (Rules/Weather/CAN), RAG with versioned rulepacks, stateful orchestration, and an RSS/TTC safety arbiter, directly matching Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, and AI Safety preferences; DriveLM as VLM front end adds multimodal relevance. It is a domain deployment (ADAS in CARLA) but the methodology is agent orchestration rather than pure robotics/vision, so the 0.20 cap does not apply. Novelty is moderate: the contribution is system integration of existing pieces (MCP, LangGraph-style graphs, BM25+DPR retrieval, DriveLM, RSS) rather than new methods. Rigor is solid for a systems paper: three scenario families, ablations with 95% CIs over 10 runs, controlled world_state corruption, arbiter sensitivity, CAN fault injection, and fixed calibrated parameters across scenarios. However, baselines are only ablations of the authors' own stack, all results are simulation-only, and some abstract claims are in tension with Table V (DriveMCP has worse hazard response 0.73s and TTC-at-escalation 2.0s than VLM-Tools-NoArbiter's 0.70s/2.2s, contradicting 'improving hazard response time' relative to all baselines). Evidence is quantitative but self-defined metrics in a single simulator. Generalizability is plausible (architecture is domain-agnostic in principle) but only validated for driving with three rulepacks. Reproducibility is partial: arbiter constants, CARLA 0.9.8, DriveLM checkpoint, and a supplemental synthetic rulepack with unit tests are given, and MCP-CAN is on GitHub, but the full DriveMCP code is only promised for future release (Section XI-F).

papers.summary_zh: 此論文提出 DriveMCP，一個以代理式 AI 為基礎的駕駛輔助框架，針對單體式視覺語言模型（VLM）在法規可更新性、決策可追溯性與延遲穩健性上的三大痛點。系統以 DriveLM 作為視覺語言前端，透過圖結構視覺問答產生場景理解，並將標誌解讀等語言線索解析為帶信心值與來源標記的型別化 world_state 欄位，而非直接注入模擬器真值。核心架構以有狀態編排圖協調三個 MCP 伺服器：負責法規推理與可稽核引用的 Rules 伺服器（採 BM25 與稠密檢索的混合 RAG，附轄區 rulepack 版本管理）、估算抓地力風險的 Weather 伺服器，以及讀取 CAN/OBD 車輛健康狀態的 MCP-CAN 伺服器。融合後的建議再經 RSS/TTC 啟發的安全仲裁器決定「建議」或「介入」。在 CARLA 模擬的多語言雨天、跨境與動態速限情境中，DriveMCP 相較 VLM-Direct、VLM-Direct+RAG 與 VLM-Tools-NoArbiter 基準，降低違規率與超速比例，縮短危險反應時間，並維持次秒級建議延遲；world_state 汙染實驗與 CAN 故障注入亦驗證其穩健性。作者明言此為研究原型而非認證安全機制，模擬與實路部署仍有落差，且須處理法規知識庫時效、工具安全與駕駛過度信賴等議題。此框架展示了模組化、可稽核的 VLM 整合範式，對智慧車輛輔助系統設計具實質參考價值。

links.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management

evidence: Abstract: 'three independent runs complete 196,608 input and 16,384 output tokens, increasing completed single-request context from the mlx-vlm baseline's 30,720 positions to 212,992 (6.93x)'
Section 3.1: 'Our contribution is the page-addressed execution of this representation, not a new quantizer or distortion bound.'
Section 5.2 / Table 5: segmented KV reached 13.30 tok/s vs 11.54 for the final paged configuration; authors note 'the individual changes are not one-factor ablations.'

Section 7 (Limitations): 'The development study combines changes rather than isolating each mechanism, and no matched PhaseSwap-off/on test is reported'; also 'The smallest sampled guard margin is 23 MiB.'
Appendix C.1: Paged TQ4 answers 29/30 AIME 2026 vs 28/30 uniform INT8; authors state this 'makes the comparison an integrated capability check rather than an isolated KV-bit-width experiment.'
Appendix C.2: 'The upstream model revision and historical checkpoint byte identity remain unverified'; 'A public benchmark companion is still being prepared.'
Section 4: baseline is the 'evaluated mlx-vlm baseline, before the JustFit KV and serving changes... It completes 24K input plus 6K output, but reaches the memory guard at 32K+6K.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Systems paper squarely on LLM serving: long-context KV management (Long Context & Memory 1.8), inference/serving (1.5), and quantization/efficiency (1.3) on a local LLM (LLM keyword 2.5), so preference relevance is high. Novelty is integration-level: the quantizer is TurboQuant's, and the authors themselves state 'Our contribution is the page-addressed execution of this representation, not a new quantizer or distortion bound' (Section 3.1), with the closest Apple-silicon precedent (Open-TQ-Metal) already published. Rigor benefits from three repeated limit runs with medians/ranges (Table 1) and unusually candid confound disclosure ('the individual changes are not one-factor ablations', Section 5.2; 'no matched PhaseSwap-off/on test is reported', Section 7), but is weakened by a baseline that fails at 32K input, no external system comparisons, synthetic repetitive capacity workloads, and a TQ4-vs-INT8 AIME comparison the authors admit is confounded (Appendix C.1). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent but self-reported, with unverified checkpoint identity and missing historical environment metadata (Appendix C.2). Generalizability is limited to one platform and one hybrid-attention 27B model with kernels specialized to 256-dim heads/256-token pages (Section 3.1, Section 7). Partial reproducibility: pinned source snapshots, manifests, and plot data exist, but a public benchmark companion 'is still being prepared' (Appendix C.2).
topics: LLM inference serving on consumer hardware
KV cache quantization and page-native execution
long-context memory management (200K tokens on 24 GiB)
component residency and request lifecycle scheduling
multi-token prediction and continuous batching transitions
AIME reasoning evaluation under compressed state

primary_link.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management

papers.summary: Capable open-weight models make local coding and reasoning attractive, but their context and execution state strain laptop memory. We present JustFit, an MLX-based inference runtime that combines KVExec for compressed KV execution, PhaseSwap for component residency, and StateTrans for state-preserving serving transitions. These mechanisms fuse reconstruction and coordinate just-in-time materialization and release, independently of model-weight quantization. In full-execution capacity tests on a
papers.summary_zh: 開源 27B 模型雖能力強大,但其上下文與執行狀態會壓垮筆記型電腦的記憶體。本文提出以 MLX 為基礎的推論執行環境 JustFit,在 24 GiB Apple M4 Pro 上運行 Qwen3.8-27B(MXFP4 權重),擴展本地長上下文服務容量。系統包含三項機制:KVExec 採用 TurboQuant 四位元 KV 快取,結合頁面定址與融合反重建,並設評估邊界避免跨層暫存;PhaseSwap 依據擁有權規則管理元件常駐,於中間 prefill 期間卸載約 644 MiB 的 LM head,在需要 logits 前即時重建;StateTrans 在安全邊界處理請求準入、MTP 與連續批次的轉換及頁面回收,使壓縮容量可分配給多請求。主要證據:三次獨立單請求執行皆完成 196,608 輸入加 16,384 輸出 token(共 212,992 個位置),為 mlx-vlm 基線的 6.93 倍;雙請求聚合保留 229,376 個位置(7.47 倍);重複 32K+6K 負載的峰值中位數為 16,374 MiB;AIME 2026 答對 29/30,驗證壓縮狀態下的長篇推理。限制:極端長度下解碼僅約 5 tokens/s、完整執行約 103 分鐘,速度是主要瓶頸;研究僅限單一平台,開發設定合併多項變更、缺乏 PhaseSwap 開關對照,最小防護餘裕僅 23 MiB。此工作證明緊湊狀態與生命週期管理可大幅擴充用戶自有裝置的本地 LLM 服務能力。

evidence: Abstract: 31,852 training / 1,345 validation / 1,111 benchmark questions; highest EgoPath Score 28.3 across nine VLMs; 2.9% Embodied Path and 4.0% Intent Path success vs 35.9% Point Path
Experiments, Table 2: Gemini 3.1 Pro 28.3, GPT-5.5 27.3, Claude Opus 4.8 25.6; Qwen3.5-4B improves 3.9 to 38.9 after SFT on released split
Table 3: external transfer of SFT checkpoint: VSI-Bench Route Planning +4.13 (Full) / +4.38 (Debiased), SpatialEval-VTQA +9.6, 3DSRBench +1.4
Appendix A, Table S2 and metric definitions: released five-task prompt templates, JSON output contract, BA/F1/VPR/SR/SPL formulas, and EgoPath Score definition
Appendix A (Software, compute, and release): LoRA rank 8/alpha 16, two-stage schedule, A100 80GB pair, seed 42; release of questions, code, configs, and prediction records promised 'upon publication'
Appendix B, Table S5: text-only and mismatched-overlay controls reduce route SR to 0.0, supporting paired-image dependence of results
Appendix B (Scene-consequence audit): 4,934 of 5,563 audited illegal edges (88.7%) have registered obstruction evidence in depth/object-index renders
Appendix B (Same-question human reference): 50 questions answered by one volunteer, score 54.2 vs 28.6 for strongest VLM, explicitly labeled exploratory rather than a population ceiling
Related Work: differentiation from NaviTrace via scene-geometry outcome evaluation (feasibility, edge legality, goal arrival) rather than DTW agreement with expert traces
llm_evaluation.rationale: A scene-geometry-grounded VLM benchmark for egocentric waypoint decisions. It matches several weighted preferences: foundation/VLM evaluation (LLM 2.5), multi-step spatial reasoning with released Spatial CoT supervision (Reasoning 2.5), embodied agent decision-making (Agents 2.5), zero-shot prompting with JSON protocol (Prompting 1.5), benchmark/evaluation methodology (Red Teaming & Eval 1.8), and multimodal AI (1.8), plus LoRA fine-tuning and a released dataset. It is not out-of-scope: the central object is language-vision model capability with language methodology (prompts, CoT, SFT), not pure CV or pure robotics, though no Japanese NLP, RAG, code, or safety content caps upside. Novelty is moderate: spatial/embodied VLM benchmarks are crowded (VSI-Bench, 3DSRBench, NavBench, NaviTrace); the differentiation is geometric outcome-based route scoring rather than expert-trace agreement, a real but incremental advance. Rigor and evidence are strong: five paired tasks, 9 frontier VLMs under a fixed contract, text-only/mismatched-overlay controls, geometry-sensitivity checks (Spearman rho=1.0), a scene-consequence audit recovering obstructions for 88.7% of illegal edges, and a transfer study (+1.4 to +9.6 on three external benchmarks). Weaknesses: a single-model, single-run SFT study with GPT-generated CoT and no contamination discussion; a tiny one-volunteer human reference (acknowledged exploratory); indoor rendered scenes only; and data/code promised only 'upon publication,' limiting current reproducibility despite very detailed protocols, prompts, hyperparameters, and seeds.

papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 EgoPathBench,一個針對第一人稱(自我中心)視角路徑點決策的資料集與五項任務基準,用以評估視覺語言模型(VLM)整合目標辨識、動作後果評估、距離估計與路徑規劃的空間智慧。現有空間基準多測量孤立的關係或方向判斷,難以直接檢驗導航所需的整合決策。每題提供自我中心 RGB 影像、自然語言目標與編號可見路徑點,模型須回傳可行候選集合或有序路線,並依場景幾何評分候選可行性、相鄰邊合法性與目標抵達;五項任務涵蓋點代理與具身代理的可通行性判斷及路線規劃。資料集含 31,852 筆訓練、1,345 筆驗證與 1,111 筆基準問題,且每題路線皆保留幾何驗證的參考路線。結果顯示九個 VLM 中最高 EgoPath 分數僅 28.3,最佳模型在 Point Path 成功率為 35.9%,但在 Embodied Path 與 Intent Path 僅 2.9% 與 4.0%;診斷指出模型雖常能選出合法第一步,卻難以選出符合目標的終點,並在中段邊違反具身幾何限制,同題人類對照分數為 54.2。以釋出的訓練資料 fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B,可將分數由 3.9 提升至 38.9,並在三個外部空間基準獲得 1.4 至 9.6 點增益。限制包括以模擬室內場景為主、人類對照樣本規模較小;本基準凸顯跨多步驟維持幾何與目標一致性,是 VLM 空間智慧的核心缺口。

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric evaluation-methodology paper: Claude Sonnet 5 and Gemini refine Ghidra-decompiled C, and the contribution is a 'memorization floor' — a within-item identifier-ablation plus arm-matched permutation nulls that separates prior-driven from input-driven naming recovery. Relevant to LLM evaluation, code tasks, and contamination measurement (high-weight preference areas), though not to core LLM methodology like reasoning, agents, or Japanese NLP, and the application domain (binary reverse engineering) narrows audience. Novelty is genuine: no prior refinement evaluation separates memorization from repair by design, and the arm-matched null (0.074 lower than the naive one) is a real correction. Rigor is unusually strong — pre-registration with hash-manifested uncontaminated T3 items, a mandatory manipulation check (Table 2), stated power (Table 6), and full disclosure that no registered hypothesis was confirmed — but the design self-reports material weaknesses: the registered n=5 decision rule was mathematically unattainable (min p=0.0625), the primary tier hypothesis is undecided (p=0.079/0.081), and the ablation cannot distinguish memorization from naming-from-operations-alone. Evidence for the bounded nulls is solid: all six full-corpus contrasts null (Table 5), replicated across two vendors on byte-identical inputs (Table 7), with claimed bound 0.056 explicitly widened after a 44% precision inflation on re-execution. Generalizability is limited by one compiler/decompiler/architecture, one prompt per model, small corpora (n=25/20), and self-acknowledged demand characteristics in author-written T3 items; the methodological prescriptions generalize better than the empirical findings. Reproducibility is excellent (Zenodo artifact, dated log, provenance map, raw responses), minus the disclosed destruction of original T3-side files. Transparent, honest null-result methodology rather than a substantive advance in LLM capability or understanding.

Refine a function, then refine it again from an input whose identifiers have been destroyed, and measure what survives. Because the comparison is within-item, corpus difficulty cannot contribute; it costs twenty API calls. Applied to functions written after our analysis plan was committed, so no released model could have memori
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理逆向工程的具體風險：大型語言模型（LLM）潤飾 Ghidra 反編譯輸出的 C 程式碼時，產生極可讀的結果，但讀者無從分辨命名是來自輸入資料流的分析，還是訓練時記住的熟悉範例，而此類基準已證實受污染。作者提出「記憶下限」（memorization floor）：先正常潤飾函式，再於識別字遭破壞的輸入上重跑（alpha 改名保留資料流但摧毀型別前綴；打亂則切斷定義-使用鏈），看命名增益殘存多少；此同項內比較不受語料難度混淆，僅需約二十次 API 呼叫。在預註冊後撰寫的 20 個新穎函式（T3）與 25 個教科書函式（T1）上，兩家供應商的模型（Claude Sonnet 5 與 Gemini）結果一致：命名回復確實高於以模型自身詞彙建構的排列虛無基準（+0.072 至 +0.137），但對被消融的輸入沒有可測依賴——破壞資料流僅使增益改變 +0.001（95% CI [-0.026, +0.026]），十二組對照全數為虛無；可讀性始終接近飽和，讀者得不到訊號。作者標明限制：此為有界虛無，0.056 以下貢獻不可見，消融保留運算結構，「僅憑運算命名」仍是競爭解釋；正確性工具 codealign 無法在其輸入上判別、重組測試框架系統性不利實驗組、重跑一次使偵測界限膨脹 44%，六個預註冊假說無一獲證實。其價值在於以低成本的同項內控制分離「修復」與「記憶」，並主張生成式輸出評估須配對虛無基準、消融須附操弄檢查，且至少重跑一次。

links.title: TIAO: Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization for Text Summarization

evidence: Abstract: TIAO 'identifies core tokens based on token dependency and reweights a trajectory's advantage'; code link https://github.com/TechCloud-x/TIAO provided.
Table 1: Qwen2.5 7B TIAO overall 0.960 vs GRPO 0.922, HVO 0.943, DAPO 0.909, SAPO 0.910, GPT-4 0.921, GPT-5-nano 0.794 on CNN/DailyMail.
Sec 3.1: all RL methods use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; 'We use UniEval-sum to compute the four reward dimensions' and UniEval for evaluation, so the reward and evaluation metric coincide.
Sec 3.3: ablation limited to masking ratio (TIAO-mask 20% 0.959, mask 80% 0.957, default 0.960); no ablation isolating macro-level trajectory shaping vs micro-level top-κ token gating.
Sec 2.4-2.6: source-dependency d_i,t = clip(ℓ^M−ℓ^F, −τ, τ), I = exp(d)−d−1, top-κ token gate m_i,t, and PPO-clipped objective; τ, ε, δ constants not assigned values.
Sec 3.1 implementation details: group size 8, 4 epochs, AdamW LR 5×10^-7, 2048/512 token limits, 50% source masking, top 40% tokens, 32×4 NVIDIA A100 40GB.
Sec 4 Conclusion: claims validated only on CNN/DailyMail; no limitations section discussing UniEval circularity or single-task scope.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM RL methodology paper: GRPO-style policy optimization for summarization with counterfactual source-masking token-importance credit assignment, validated on Qwen2.5-7B against GPT-4/GRPO/DAPO/SAPO/HVO. The dual-scale (trajectory shaping + top-κ token gating) idea is a moderate incremental advance over cited token-level RL work (reward redistribution, entropy-token selection, DAPO/SAPO). Rigor and evidence are limited by a single dataset (CNN/DailyMail), a single base model, automatic UniEval scores that double as the training reward (unaddressed circularity), no significance testing or human/factuality evaluation despite factuality framing, and ablations confined to masking ratio (20/50/80%) with no ablation of token gating, trajectory shaping, or κ. Reproducibility is decent: detailed hyperparameters (group size 8, 4 epochs, LR 5e-7, 50% masking, top-40% tokens) and a code link, though clip/threshold constants and batch sizes are unspecified.

primary_link.title: TIAO: Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization for Text Summarization

papers.summary: Text summarization requires models to condense content while preserving key qualities such as consistency and coherence. Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on this task and can be further improved through reinforcement learning (RL). However, most existing methods apply reward signals directly to undifferentiated token sequences, overlooking the varying importance of individual tokens to word and sentence level quality in summarization. In this paper, we propose Token Imp
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討以強化學習(RL)微調大型語言模型進行文字摘要時的信用分配失配問題:GRPO 等方法將序列層級獎勵平均廣播至所有詞元,忽略各詞元對摘要品質的重要性差異。作者提出 TIAO(Token Importance-Aware Policy Optimization),以反事實來源遮罩估計詞元對來源文件的依賴程度:隨機遮蔽部分來源詞元後,比較原始與遮罩來源下相同輸出詞元的對數機率變化,取得詞元重要性訊號,再於兩個層級運用——將詞元依賴聚合為軌跡層級分數以重塑優勢,並只對最依賴來源的前 40% 詞元施加策略梯度更新,全程不需額外訓練 critic。在 CNN/DailyMail 資料集上以 UniEval 多維度評估,TIAO 使 Qwen2.5-7B 達到 0.960 的整體分數,優於 GRPO、HVO、DAPO、SAPO 等基準,並在一致性、流暢度、相關性與整體分數超越 GPT-4 zero-shot(僅連貫性略遜),相較 GPT-5-nano 亦具明顯優勢。消融實驗顯示 50% 遮罩比例最為平衡,20% 與 80% 亦具穩健性。限制包括:跨維度標準差(STD)略高於 HVO,評估僅限單一資料集與 7B 模型,遮罩與詞元選取比例屬超參數,尚待跨領域驗證。其意義在於證明感知來源證據的細粒度信用分配,可比單純擴大模型規模更有效地提升摘要的事實一致性與訓練穩定性。

links.title: AI for Games in the Foundation Model Era

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: organizes literature into six roles by immediate use of AI output (Play and Act through Test and Evaluate) with recurring Boundary/Transfer/Evidence questions.

Section 9.2.1: defines five cross-role evidence dimensions (standardization, execution grounding, scope and transfer, horizon and revision, external validation) used to compare evaluations without collapsing unlike outcomes.

Section 9.1.4, Table 9: GameDevBench Pass@1 for 17 model-harness configurations with 95% confidence intervals (best 67.3±5.0); Table 10 notes GameCraft-Bench overall is a weighted, validity-gated score, not a pass rate.
Section 6.3: distinguishes failure modes with primary numbers — Mage mechanic F1 near 0.12 for the best-runtime configuration; JAMER runtime pass dropping from 80.4% (small projects) to 5.7% (large).

Section 10.2, Table 13: catalogs implemented cross-role exchanges (e.g., Play→Model via GameNGen trajectories, Test→Build via Play2Code) and states that artifact reuse does not itself establish capability transfer.

Section 9.3.4: specifies reproducibility requirements (model/engine versions, prompts, interfaces, retry budgets, data provenance), though the survey itself offers no systematic search or coding protocol.
Front matter: provides project page and GitHub repository (awesome-ai-for-games) supporting traceability of the indexed systems.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A comprehensive, critically caveated survey of foundation-model (heavily LLM/agent) AI across the game lifecycle, organized into six roles by output use. Strong alignment with high-weight preferences: LLM agents and tool use (Sections 3, 6.2: Voyager, Play2Code, SWE-agent, coding agents), code generation and repair (Sections 6, 9.1.4), LLM-as-judge and evaluation methodology (Sections 8.3, 9.2), memory/retrieval (Sections 3.3, 4.2), and reasoning/planning (Section 3.2). However, it is a qualitative domain survey, not a methodological contribution: no new methods, no systematic review protocol (no search strategy, inclusion criteria, or corpus statistics), and its central claims about transfer and evidence asymmetry are synthesized judgments. The role taxonomy and evidence framework are useful but incremental over prior LLM-game surveys it cites (Section 1, Gallotta et al. 2024). Rigor and evidence strength are above average for a survey because it consistently distinguishes claim types, reports primary-source numbers with interpretation boundaries (Table 7 fidelity targets; Table 9 GameDevBench with 95% CIs; Section 9.1.2 Table 8 PlayWorld rubrics), and explicitly marks announcement-grade sources as non-peer-reviewed. Preference relevance is capped below core LLM-methodology papers because games remain the organizing domain and many covered systems are RL/world-model/video rather than language-centric.

primary_link.title: AI for Games in the Foundation Model Era

papers.summary: Foundation models, alongside advances in learned game-world models, are reshaping AI across the game lifecycle. Beyond playing games, recent systems model players and game dynamics, support design and development, adapt player-facing experiences at runtime, and evaluate resulting artifacts. Yet these directions have evolved largely separately, obscuring which capabilities transfer across settings and which remain tied to particular games, engines, interfaces, or player populations. We organize t
papers.summary_zh: 本文為一篇系統性綜述,探討基礎模型時代人工智慧在遊戲生命週期中的應用。針對遊玩、建模、設計、開發、執行期生成與測試等研究方向各自獨立發展、難以比較的問題,作者以 AI 輸出的直接用途為標準,將文獻組織為六大角色:遊玩與行動、建模玩家與遊戲、設計遊戲、建構與維護遊戲、執行期生成與調適,以及測試與評估,並對每個角色檢視三個問題:遊戲或工作流程提供了哪些結構、AI 學習或生成了什麼,以及哪些宣稱有充分證據支持。綜述亦梳理跨角色連結,如互動軌跡可訓練 world model、學習式環境可為 agent 提供訓練經驗、設計規格可驅動可執行程式、測試回饋可引導軟體修訂。主要發現指出:廣泛預訓練雖擴充了可用介面,但控制方案、規則、引擎介面、狀態表示與玩家脈絡仍高度依賴特定設定,成果重用不等於能力遷移,下游能力宣稱須在目標場景重新驗證。證據方面,受限的遊戲遊玩與部分學習式環境的評估最為標準化;而持久世界狀態、反覆軟體修訂、經驗證的玩家建模、持續的執行期調適與代表性自動化測試則仍不成熟。限制在於本文屬定性綜述,未提供統一的量化排名。其價值在於為研究者建立共同分析框架,指出成果跨角色重用與遷移驗證的核心挑戰與研究缺口。

links.title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of training examples.'

Section 4.2: classifiers are calme-2.4-rys-78b (4-bit quantized), Gemma-3 12B IT, Exaone-3.5 7.8B, Granite-3.3 2B, run at 'temperature of 0.75 and top-k of 5', chosen as open models executable under 100GB VRAM.

Section 5.1 RQ1: 'employing original human-authored descriptions (OrigDesc) leads to an average performance improvement of 1.5 pp' on Dipromats while generated descriptions cause 'a mean decrease of approximately 4 pp'; SemEval improvement is only 0.66 pp.

Section 5.1 RQ4: 'Majority voting proves beneficial in this task, boosting performance by 8.5 pp with four models and 4.8 pp with three' on SemEval, while inclusion ensembles degrade performance by up to 3.5 pp.
Section 5.2: bootstrap confidence intervals (2000 resamples of 800 instances) computed only for Dipromats because 'the gold-standard labels for SemEval are not publicly available'.

Section 6 Table 8: best zero-shot system reaches F1 nar 0.5090 / subnar 0.4000 vs supervised GATENLP 0.6270 / 0.4630 (Δ -0.118 / -0.063); Table 9 shows the zero-shot system marginally exceeding ManchaAzul's few-shot GPT-4 system (0.6453/0.6209 vs 0.6403/0.6117) on Dipromats.

Section 7.1: multilingual evaluation on the SemEval dev set (35 docs each BG/PT/HI, 32 RU) uses 'a single inference pass per document instead of the five-run setting', limiting reliability of the generalization claim.
Section 3.1 footnote 1: public repository at github.com/JesusFraile/Zero_shot_narrative_detection_in_social_messaging with 'All generation scripts, prompts, and configuration details'.
Appendix A: full prompt template with JSON structured output provided; Table 3 anomaly: Calme Hybrid OrigDesc base 0.4858/0.3018 but 'majority' row reports 0.1050/0.0360 without explanation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid, in-scope empirical study of zero-shot LLM prompting for narrative classification (LLM, prompting/ICL, and NLP preferences; agents appear only in related work). Methodology is systematic (4 classifiers, 8 prompt strategies, 5 runs, bootstrap CIs, error analysis, leaderboard comparison), but novelty is incremental: it is a careful evaluation rather than a new method, and headline effects are small (OrigDesc +1.5pp on Dipromats, +0.66pp on SemEval; zero-shot still trails the best SemEval system by 0.118 F1). Evidence is generally well supported though a few anomalies (e.g., Table 3 Calme OrigDesc majority dropping from 0.486 to 0.105, and an unexplained claim in Section 8 that token counts increase as model size decreases) are unaddressed. Multilingual generalization (Section 7) uses only single runs on small dev sets. Reproducibility is good: open models, public repository with scripts and prompts, hyperparameters (temp 0.75, top-k 5) and full prompt in Appendix A.

primary_link.title: Zero-shot narrative detection in social messaging

papers.summary: This study investigates the zero-shot ability of large language models (LLMs) to identify and classify hidden narratives in social messages. Our research hypothesis is that LLMs' extensive contextual knowledge allows them to interpret messages on a deeper, pragmatic level, going beyond basic sentiment or topic analysis. Experiments on the Dipromats and SemEval datasets show that providing models with human-written narrative descriptions significantly improves performance, without the need of tra
papers.summary_zh: 這篇研究探討大型語言模型（LLM）能否在零樣本（zero-shot）設定下，偵測社群訊息中隱含的策略性敘事，亦即不需任何標註訓練資料。作者假設 LLM 訓練時累積的豐富脈絡知識，使其能超越情感或主題分析，理解訊息背後的溝通意圖。研究使用 Dipromats 2024 Task 2 與 SemEval-2025 Task 10 兩個多語言資料集，選用 calme-2.4-rys-78b、Gemma-3 12B、Exaone-3.5 7.8B 與 Granite-3.3 2B 四種開源模型，系統性比較八種提示（prompt）策略，涵蓋人類撰寫的敘事描述、模型自動生成的描述與僅用標題等設定，並評估多數決與全包含兩種集成方法。主要結果顯示：人類撰寫的敘事描述持續優於自動生成版本，後者常因措辭框架的細微偏移而降低準確率；多數決集成能顯著提升穩健性，尤其對細粒度的子敘事偵測；較大模型不僅整體表現最佳，對提示變化的敏感度也較低。最佳零樣本系統在 Dipromats 達到 F1 約 0.645（西語）與 0.621（英語），在 SemEval 子敘事 F1 為 0.400，已可比擬部分監督式系統。限制包括：SemEval 黃金標籤未公開，信賴區間分析僅限 Dipromats；敘事標註主觀性高、標註者一致性偏低；自動生成描述可能產生語意漂移。整體而言，此研究對缺乏訓練資料的領域（如假訊息偵測、社群輿情監聽）提供了可規模化、免標註的敘事偵測方案，並驗證 LLM 具備解讀策略性溝通意圖的潛在語用能力。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A benchmark paper evaluating 17 LLMs on structured, multi-field reasoning over firm-profile pairs, which is squarely an LLM-evaluation/reasoning contribution rather than a pure domain application. The task formulation (jointly predicting opportunity existence, strength, type, and role direction, distinguishing complementarity from relatedness) is reasonably novel relative to firm-similarity and supply-chain link-prediction work (Section 2). Rigor is solid: source-blind dual annotation with tuple-level adjudication (field agreement 84.26%, tuple 69.45%, 30.55% third-annotator involvement, Table 1), stratified hard-negative mining, unified zero-shot protocol at temperature 0, bootstrap CIs, trivial/lexical/supervised baselines (Table 5), oracle vs end-to-end decomposition (Table 7), A/B permutation stress test (Table 9), and output-validity/confidence calibration analysis (Table 10). Evidence for headline claims is quantitative and internally consistent (best Macro-F1 74.51, CI 72.89-76.07; best four-field EM 61.57%). Weaknesses: subjectivity of 'collaboration potential' labels unvalidated against realized partnerships; single deterministic runs and zero-shot-only limits stated conclusions (Section 7); hosted-model pool skewed toward the Qwen family; data drawn from a proprietary platform with only the final gold set releasable (Appendix C); English set is translated rather than natively sourced, narrowing cross-lingual and business-domain generalizability (Appendix C known biases). Preference fit is good for LLM/evaluation/reasoning topics but the Chinese business context and translated parallel set reduce breadth.

primary_link.title: FirmCORe: A Benchmark for Structured Reasoning about Inter-Firm Collaboration Opportunities

radar.summary: Comprehensive structured data on inter-firm relationships is often scarce or inaccessible because many relationships are privately negotiated, selectively disclosed, and fragmented across proprietary databases. This scarcity hinders the discovery of collaboration opportunities, particularly for startups and small and medium-sized enterprises. Firm profiles are readily available, but collaboration potential cannot be inferred from business similarity alone, since similar firms may be competitors,
radar.summary_zh: 企業間合作關係的結構化資料常因私下協商、選擇性揭露與散落於專有資料庫而難以取得,新創與中小企業尤其缺乏資源尋找合適的供應商與客戶。本文提出FirmCORe,一個人工標註的基準,包含2,805組源自真實企業檔案、具黃金標籤的配對。模型須判斷證據是否支持合作機會,對正例並須同時預測機會強度、主要合作類型(供應、經銷、技術轉移、研發、資本)與角色方向。資料透過分層候選挖掘、來源盲測的人工標註與完整三元組仲裁建構,並提供平行中英文評估集以控制語言變因。實驗評估17個大型語言模型:最佳模型Qwen3.6-27B在機會偵測上達Macro-F1 74.51,但四欄位完全匹配僅61.57%;Kimi-K2.7的正例完全匹配最高(61.98%)。分析顯示模型常將企業相似性誤當互補性而過度預測機會,技術轉移類型最易與其他類別混淆,角色方向偏誤明顯,且高跨語言一致性可能只是兩種語言重複相同錯誤。研究僅限零樣本提示與單次確定性執行,未探討微調、提示敏感度與夥伴檢索排序。此基準凸顯現有LLM辨識廣泛合作潛力尚可,但重建完整關係結構仍不可靠,為企業關係推理提供了可控的診斷平台。

links.title: PunGraph: Retrieval-Enhanced Phonetic-Semantic Graph Reasoning for Pun Understanding

evidence: Section 5.3/Table 1: evaluation over SemEval-2017 and WebPun with precision/recall/F1/accuracy/PMA; PunGraph-Llama4-Maverick SemEval heterographic F1 83.41 vs GPT-4o 79.45.
Section 6.2/Table 4: ablations remove IPA, G2P, and Unisyn links; Unisyn removal causes largest F1 drop (59.18 to 46.76 for Qwen2.5-7B on SemEval).
Table 3 vs Table 1: reported relative improvements match table arithmetic, e.g., Qwen-2.5-7B SemEval heterographic 37.47 to 59.18 = +57.9%.
Section 5.2 vs Table 1: Qwen-2.5-70B is listed as a baseline but does not appear in the reported results table.
Section 4.2 vs Tables 2 and 6: WebPun homographic counts are inconsistent across the paper (679 in Section 4.2, 668 in Table 2, 669 in Table 6).
Section 5.1: cites Augenstein et al. (2017) SemEval-2017 Task 10 (scienceIE) as the source of the pun benchmark rather than Miller et al. (2017) Task 7.
Limitations: framework is English-only, dependent on Unisyn and WordNet coverage; rare words and unseen pun patterns may cause retrieval failures.
Abstract and Section 8: code and dataset release claimed at https://github.com/ysu132/PunGraph; Appendix A.2 reports Fleiss' Kappa of 0.54 on 150 sampled instances.
Section 6.3/Figure 6: error analysis attributes 91.5% of homographic failures to incorrect candidate selection and 19%/5.9% to KG retrieval misses.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM methodology paper: retrieval-augmented phonetic-semantic knowledge graph constrains small-LLM candidate reasoning for pun interpretation, hitting LLM, RAG/KG, and reasoning preferences, though on a niche humor task rather than a core frontier problem. The two-limitation diagnostic analysis, multi-baseline comparison, phonetic-component ablations, and error analysis are solid, but undermined by count inconsistencies (WebPun homographic totals 679 vs 668 vs 669), a wrong benchmark citation (Augenstein et al. 2017 Task 10 cited for SemEval Task 7), a listed baseline (Qwen-2.5-70B) missing from results, absolute F1 drops mislabeled as percentages, and no significance testing. Quantitative claims are internally consistent (Table 3 improvements match Table 1 arithmetic). Generalizability is limited by English-specific Unisyn/WordNet resources, acknowledged in Limitations. Code/dataset release, prompts, thresholds, and phonetic similarity tables support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: PunGraph: Retrieval-Enhanced Phonetic-Semantic Graph Reasoning for Pun Understanding

radar.summary: Puns are a challenging form of figurative language that exploit phonetic similarity and semantic ambiguity to convey multiple meanings. Although large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong language understanding capabilities, they still struggle with pun reasoning due to limited phonetic modeling and uncontrolled end-to-end generation. We propose \textbf{PunGraph}, a retrieval-enhanced knowledge graph framework for pun understanding. PunGraph constructs a phonetic-semantic lexical graph usin
radar.summary_zh: 雙關語（pun）利用語音相似與語意歧義傳達多重意涵，是大型語言模型（LLM）難以處理的修辭現象。本文指出小規模開源模型的兩大弱點：一是音韻推理能力不足，產生的替代詞常不符合語音相似性要求；二是語意生成不受約束，解釋容易偏離原句的語意空間。為此，作者提出 PunGraph，以 Unisyn 發音詞典、IPA 與 G2P 表示法建立詞彙層級的音韻相似關係，並結合 WordNet 詞義定義，構建音韻—語意知識圖譜（含 46,208 個詞實體與逾 76 萬條語音相似邊）。模型先進行初步推理，再針對失敗案例從圖譜檢索候選詞或候選詞義，將後續推理限制在結構化候選空間內。作者並發表 WebPun 資料集，含 5,730 筆標註的異形（heterographic）與同形（homographic）雙關語。實驗顯示，PunGraph 在 SemEval-2017 與 WebPun 上持續提升小型模型表現，例如以 Qwen-2.5-7B 為骨幹時，異形雙關語相對 F1 提升 57.95%；PunGraph-Llama4-Maverick 在 SemEval 異形雙關語達 F1 83.41，超越 GPT-4o 等專有模型。消融實驗證明 Unisyn 語音連結貢獻最大，G2P 則為輔助機制。限制包括：僅適用英文、效能仰賴圖譜覆蓋率、錯誤主因仍是候選選擇失誤（同形雙關占 91.5%）。此研究展示結構化知識與檢索增強如何彌補小模型在語音建模與可控生成上的缺陷，對計算幽默理解深具參考價值。
radar.title: PunGraph: Retrieval-Enhanced Phonetic-Semantic Graph Reasoning for Pun Understanding
radar.title_zh: PunGraph：檢索增強之音韻—語意圖譜推理的雙關語理解框架

links.title: Plug 'n' Pray: Agentic LLM-based Detection of Potential Log File Exposures in Third-Party Content Management System Plugins

evidence: Section 4.1.1 (Table 1): 287 of 300 plugins analyzed, 62 plugins with file logging, 81 potential exposures, 79 manually validated; reported precision 98% (79/81) and recall 98% (62/63) for successfully analyzed plugins
Section 4.1.2: AST baseline flagged 165/300 plugins; union of detectors lowers framework recall to 90% (62/69), with 6 misses caused by timeouts and 1 (ninja-forms) missed despite completing
Section 5.4: cost ~$258 in Claude API equivalents (mean $0.91, median $0.69/plugin), ~1800 minutes and ~300M tokens total, median 5 minutes and 18 agent steps per plugin

Section 5.5: acknowledged limitations include single-run non-determinism, no ablation study, Apache+WordPress-only evaluation, 13 plugin timeouts, and no SAST comparison due to missing log-exposure rules
Section 5.6: framework and prompts to be open-sourced 'upon acceptance'; plugin analysis data released only after re-review and coordinated vulnerability disclosure

Section 4.3 (Figures 3-4): taxonomy distributions, e.g., static paths 37%, creation-control via manual change 69% and PHP constant 23%, access-control via directory listing off 64%, index files 54%, .htaccess 41%

Section 3.2.2 and Appendix A.1: three-phase agentic analysis (static, protection, dynamic) using claude-code with a fully specified main prompt; manual validation chosen over LLM-judge due to hallucination risk (Section 3.3)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A competent empirical security-measurement study that applies an off-the-shelf agentic LLM (Claude Opus 4.6 via claude-code) to detect log-file exposures in the top 300 WordPress plugins. Topic relevance is solid: it sits squarely in agentic tool-use, code vulnerability analysis, and AI security, matching the Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and AI Safety preferences, though it advances no LLM/language methodology itself. Novelty is moderate: the application area (log exposures, taxonomy of path/protection patterns) is new academically, but the three-phase static/protection/dynamic agent pipeline is conventional. Rigor benefits from 100% manual validation (79/81 findings reproduced) and an AST baseline for false-negative estimation, but is weakened by a single model, single run per plugin, no ablation, and a recall denominator built from the union of two imperfect detectors. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (taxonomic distributions, cost/token figures), yet limited to local Apache instances with no live-web measurement. Generalizability is constrained to WordPress/Apache and the top-300 slice; the authors acknowledge the long tail, other CMS, and NGINX caveats. Reproducibility is decent on paper (prompts in Appendix A.1, environment and cost details, repository URL) but code availability is conditional 'upon acceptance' and data release is gated by coordinated disclosure.

primary_link.title: Plug 'n' Pray: Agentic LLM-based Detection of Potential Log File Exposures in Third-Party Content Management System Plugins

radar.summary: Content Management Systems (CMS), such as WordPress, power a large share of the web (~58%), and their extensibility through third-party plugins is a major source of their popularity as well as of their attack surface. One high-impact weakness that remains understudied is log file exposure by CMS plugins, which create log files for debugging or other purposes. If these files are insufficiently secured, they can disclose sensitive information (e.g. credentials, personal data) which has led to webs
radar.summary_zh: WordPress 等內容管理系統(CMS)驅動全球近六成網站,其第三方外掛常為除錯目的產生日誌檔,若防護不足,可能外洩帳號密碼或個人資料,過去已造成網站遭入侵。本文提出一套代理式(agentic)LLM 偵測框架,以 Claude Opus 4.6 搭配 claude-code 環境,針對安裝量最高的 300 個 WordPress 外掛(涵蓋官方生態約 75%、逾 2.5 億次活躍安裝)執行三階段分析:先進行靜態分析,追蹤檔案寫入與日誌相關程式碼路徑;接著檢視 .htaccess、index 檔、PHP stub 等防護機制;最後於 Docker 內的 WordPress 實例動態觸發日誌產生,並驗證其透過 HTTP 的可存取性。所有發現均經人工重現驗證:62 個外掛共寫出 81 個日誌檔,其中 79 個獲得確認(精確率 98%);與寬鬆的 AST 基線相比,整體回召率約 90%。研究建立日誌路徑(固定、日期、雜湊、祕密值)與防護(建立控制、存取控制)的分類法,發現最常見的防護是建立控制(69% 需手動啟用),雖無日誌預設外洩,但多數防護繫於伺服器設定假設,風險僅差一次設定錯誤。限制包括僅評估 Apache 加 WordPress 預設組態、13 個外掛逾時、單次執行具非確定性,且未分析日誌內容的敏感度。本研究展現代理式 LLM 作為安全分析工具的價值,並建議開發者避免將日誌寫入 DocumentRoot、採多層縱深防禦,以及由 CMS 提供統一的日誌 API。

links.title: FLAT: Resampling Image and Text into 1D Flexible-Length Aligned Transmodal Tokens for Retrieval and Generation

evidence: Abstract: reports pre-trained GenEval 71.1 and fine-tuned 83.1 GenEval, 40.5 BLEU-4 / 138.6 CIDEr on MS-COCO, Recall@5 86.8/75.8 (COCO) and 98.3/93.6 (Flickr30K).

Sec. 4.5 Table 3: full loss-combination ablation at K=256 shows full objective balances retrieval (52.2/56.3), captioning (40.2 B@4, 137.5 CIDEr), and GenEval 0.327, while dropping contrastive collapses retrieval to 13.6/6.7.
Appendix D Table 9: matched task-only controls show FLAT pre-training lifts T2I GenEval from ~0.60 to 0.83 at K=16/64 and CIDEr from ~105 to 138.6, isolating the pre-training contribution.

Appendix B Table 4: complete training configuration (Qwen3.5-2B backbone with r=16 LoRA, SANA-1.6B decoder, AdamW lr 1e-4, global batch 1024, 135k steps, 8 nodes x 8 H200, 67M pairs), enabling partial reproduction.
Appendix H: Shapley value decomposition over all eight loss coalitions quantifies per-objective attribution across prefix lengths, with noted minor negative attributions at K=16/256.

Appendix C Table 8: zero-shot retrieval degrades with larger K (COCO I2T R@1 44.90 at K=1 vs 35.48 at K=256), an honest limitation partially mitigated only after task fine-tuning (Sec. 4.3.1 Table 2).
Sec. 4.2.1: T2I SOTA claim compares only against MetaQuery-L (0.78) under a no-rewrite protocol; main-text GenEval baseline table references are broken, weakening cross-model evidence.
Appendix I Figs. 23-24: truncation vs null-padding comparison is explicitly framed as qualitative evidence because runs follow differing original recipes.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal vision-language representation learning paper (in scope: central language methodology via a Qwen3.5-2B LLM backbone, text representations, and captioning; not pure CV or language-free diffusion). Preference relevance is moderate: it aligns with Multimodal AI, Training & Optimization (LoRA/pre-training/fine-tuning), and Scaling & Efficiency (flexible-length compute analysis in Table F.2), but it does not advance core LLM, reasoning, agent, or alignment methodology. Novelty is incremental-but-real: it composes known techniques (nested dropout/Matryoshka prefixes, TiTok/FlexTok-style 1D tokenization, CoCa-style contrastive+generative joint training) into a new unified framework that resamples both image and text into one shared continuous 1D space, with the truncation-vs-null-padding finding (App. I) as a useful practical contribution. Rigor is strong: all seven loss-combination ablations (Sec. 4.5, Table 3), Shapley attribution (App. H), prefix-sampling strategy comparison (App. F.3), and matched task-only controls without FLAT pre-training (App. D, Table 9) isolating the pre-training benefit (e.g., GenEval 0.83 vs 0.60 task-only at K=16). Evidence is solid but with weaknesses: headline retrieval numbers (COCO R@1 ~63/48) trail modern baselines, the flexible-length invariance claim rests on a qualitative Fig. 2 comparison against MRL/SAE/CSR, several main-text table references are broken, and SOTA claims for T2I rely on a narrow baseline set. Generalizability is supported by zero-shot multilingual/emoji, multi-frame video, and CIRR composed-retrieval diagnostics (App. G), though evaluations remain confined to COCO/Flickr/ImageNet-style benchmarks. Reproducibility is fairly good on hyperparameters and hardware (App. B: AdamW, lr 1e-4, batch 1024, 8 nodes x 8 H200, 135k steps, 67M pairs) but no code or data release is stated.

primary_link.title: FLAT: Resampling Image and Text into 1D Flexible-Length Aligned Transmodal Tokens for Retrieval and Generation

radar.summary: Traditional multimodal representation learning and generation are two stages: a contrastive or self-supervised visual encoder is trained first, followed by a separate downstream generative model. This setup bottlenecks generative performance behind frozen embeddings. To bridge this gap, we revisit joint multimodal representation learning and generation to produce linearly interpolatable embeddings that are directly consumable by generative decoders. We present FLAT (Flexible-Length Aligned Trans
radar.summary_zh: 傳統多模態學習將表徵學習與生成任務拆成兩階段：先訓練對比式或自監督視覺編碼器，再接上凍結嵌入的下游生成模型，使生成效能受限於既有表徵。本文提出 FLAT，一個表徵預訓練框架，將共享的多模態編碼器與文字生圖（T2I）、圖生文（I2T）兩個解碼器共同訓練，結合對比對齊與雙向跨模態生成損失。方法上，FLAT 透過暫存器 token 把影像與文字輸入重採樣為統一的連續一維序列，並以 nested dropout 對前綴 K（取自 {1,4,16,64,256} 的幾何階梯）進行訓練，使單一模型可在推論時自由選擇輸出長度。主幹採 Qwen3.5-2B 搭配 LoRA，影像解碼器初始化自 SANA-1.6B。實驗顯示：僅一次預訓練即達 T2I GenEval 71.1；經任務微調後 GenEval 升至 83.1（無提示改寫），MS-COCO 圖像描述取得 40.5 BLEU-4、138.6 CIDEr，檢索 Recall@5 於 MS-COCO 為 86.8（I2T）/75.8（T2I），Flickr30K 達 98.3/93.6，ImageNet 線性探測 81.8，且單一 token 即可支撐檢索而不明顯掉點。此表徵原生支援線性內插、潛在空間算術與零樣本組合檢索。限制方面：零樣本組合檢索在保留參考類別的同時處理數量編輯仍有困難，達 SOTA 需逐任務微調，且檢索介面主要仰賴任務內對比適配，預訓練帶來的增益相對較小。消融與 Shapley 分析證實對比與生成損失互相強化而非衝突。此工作顯示統一表徵可同時作為判別描述子與生成條件，並以可變長度連續 token 兼顧運算效率與細緻度，對統一多模態架構深具啟示。
radar.title: FLAT: Resampling Image and Text into 1D Flexible-Length Aligned Transmodal Tokens for Retrieval and Generation
radar.title_zh: FLAT：將影像與文字重採樣為一維可變長度對齊的跨模態 Tokens，用於檢索與生成

links.title: From Transient Prompts to Persistent Control: Scientific Poster Generation via Recursive Semantic-Geometric Contracts

evidence: Abstract: 'PosterVisor-PPT improves observed mean poster-grounded QA accuracy over PosterGen (64.47% vs. 58.53%) and is preferred by human judges in 72.5% of non-tied pairwise comparisons (95% CI, 61.6-83.4%)'

Main Results (Table 1 narrative): 'PosterVisor-HTML raises VLM Overall from 3.707 to 3.822 and Raw PaperQuiz Overall from 66.14 to 66.82'; both realizations 'tie for the highest displayed automatic VLM Overall of 3.82'
Human Evaluation, Table 5(b): HTML vs P2P '54.7 (45.6-63.8)' win rate with CI including 50%, explicitly described as 'a statistical tie'

Ablation Study, Table 2: SGC-only configuration lowers Raw PaperQuiz from 66.14 (P2P base) to 59.10; text notes 'non-monotonic trade-offs among the HTML ablations, with only the full system exceeding P2P on both aggregate objectives'
Ablation Study, Table 3: 'w/o Repair Guard' yields higher QA (67.30) than the full system (64.47), which the authors call 'a content-presentation trade-off rather than uniform gains'

Analysis, RCE Repair Activity: 'all 159 recorded deterministic repair events are followed by rule-based rechecking'; '75 code-level assertion transitions, of which eight are pass-to-fail transitions across eight different posters'
Analysis, Generation Overhead: 'PosterVisor-PPT increases calls from 8.05 to 19.15 and mean latency from 160.32 to 505.49 seconds per poster' while reducing token cost estimate '$0.297 to $0.228'

Conclusion: results 'support persistent contracts, scoped repair, and rechecking as practical control mechanisms for the two pipelines studied here', scoping generalizability to the two instantiations

Experimental Setup, Baselines: eight reproduced systems including PosterAgent, P2P, PosterGen, PPTAgent, PosterForest, Any2Poster, EfficientPosterGen, PosterHarness, with superscripts distinguishing reported vs. reproduced values in Table 1
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM/VLM multi-agent orchestration framework (Orchestrator, Semantic-Geometric Contract, Recursive Contract Enforcement) for scientific poster generation. Preference relevance is solid: it centrally uses LLM backbones (GPT-4o/GPT-4.1/Qwen/Claude/Gemini), agent pipelines, structured contracts, rubric-grounded checking, and LLM-as-judge evaluation (Agents & Tool Use + LLM preferences), though the target task is a fairly niche application rather than a general language-methodology contribution. Novelty is moderate: persistent contracts and repair-aware dependency rechecking are a meaningful departure from stage-local checking, but the space is crowded (PosterHarness already offers contract-oriented control) and the mechanisms are largely engineering refinements. Rigor is strong: 100-paper benchmark with 8 reproduced baselines, format-specific cumulative and leave-one-out ablations, 4-backbone cross-model runs, a 30-paper transfer set, and a human study with cluster-robust CIs, Holm correction, and bootstrap sensitivity. Evidence is good but tempered: HTML gains are small (VLM 3.707→3.822; QA 66.14→66.82) and its pairwise win rate (54.7%, CI 45.6-63.8) is a statistical tie; PPT gains are larger (QA 58.53→64.47; 72.5% preference). Ablations are honestly non-monotonic (SGC-only lowers QA to 59.10; w/o-Repair-Guard raises QA to 67.30), revealing a content-presentation trade-off that partially undercuts the headline framing. Heavy reliance on VLM judging with a same-family model (GPT-4o judging GPT-4o outputs) introduces circularity risk. Generalizability is limited to poster/slide-like artifacts and two formats; the abstract-level control abstraction is not demonstrated on other multi-stage tasks. Reproducibility is weak: very detailed thresholds and budgets, but no code, contract artifacts, or prompt release is claimed, and the system depends on commercial APIs. Net: a careful, application-grounded agent-control paper with modest incremental gains.

primary_link.title: From Transient Prompts to Persistent Control: Scientific Poster Generation via Recursive Semantic-Geometric Contracts

radar.summary: Scientific poster generation distills a multimodal paper into a single-page visual artifact, forcing strict trade-offs between informational coverage and readability under a fixed spatial budget. Existing methods pass plans as transient prompts and validate individual stages in isolation. This strategy causes requirements to drift across content and layout modules, and previous checks to be silently invalidated. We introduce PosterVisor, a control framework that shifts poster generation from tra
radar.summary_zh: 科學海報生成需將多模態論文濃縮為單頁成品，在固定空間預算下兼顧資訊涵蓋與可讀性。現有方法以暫態提示傳遞規劃並孤立驗證各階段，使語意與空間需求在內容與版面間漂移，先前檢查也可能被後續修改悄悄作廢。本文提出PosterVisor，核心有二：其一為語意—幾何合約（SGC），由Orchestrator將品質準則錨定於原文與視覺素材，把主張、證據、內容預算與空間承諾綁定為凍結的共享規格，僅完整具現化者編譯為可執行斷言，其餘保留為軟性指引；其二為遞迴合約強制執行（RCE），於相關狀態可用時觸發檢查，修復後依依賴閉包重新檢核受影響斷言，攔截修復引發的回歸。框架實例化為HTML/CSS與可編輯PPTX兩種生成器。在100篇論文的Paper2Poster基準上，PosterVisor-PPT將原始PaperQuiz準確率自PosterGen的58.53%提升至64.47%，並在非平手人類配對比較中獲72.5%偏好（95% CI：61.6–83.4%）；HTML版將溢出訊號自31%降至8%、必要圖表缺失自27%降至5%，並在四個替代模型骨幹上同時改善兩項指標。限制方面，消融顯示品質與資訊保留有非單調取捨，平均延遲自每張160秒增至505秒，回歸偵測亦受限於已宣告依賴與檢查器，軟性指引與未建模屬性不在合規聲明範圍。此研究將階段性規劃與檢查延伸為持續且修復感知的控制機制，對可控多模態文件合成具實務價值。
radar.title: From Transient Prompts to Persistent Control: Scientific Poster Generation via Recursive Semantic-Geometric Contracts

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-methodology paper (resume screening as the testbed) that cleanly separates screening validity from presentation invariance using competence-preserving perturbations and a deterministic fact-preservation gate. Strong topical fit to LLMs, prompt-format sensitivity, robustness, and evaluation benchmarks (weight-2.5 LLM; weight-1.5 prompting; weight-2.0 safety; weight-1.8 evaluation), though the hiring domain and 2B-8B open models keep it applied rather than core methodology. The controlled design, chat-template ablation addressing the miscalibration confound, lexical stability references, and bootstrap CIs are rigorous; weaknesses are the synthetic 102-profile/17-occupation scale (authors concede pilot-scale cluster bootstrap), single-slice axis analysis, no real resumes or proprietary systems, and no stated code/data release or prompt templates, limiting reproducibility. Findings (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B chat validity 0.781 with 29.6% flip) are internally well-supported but generalization beyond this controlled setting is asserted only directionally.

primary_link.title: Competence-Preserving Resume Perturbations Expose Presentation Sensitivity in LLM Screening

radar.summary: Resume screeners must infer job-relevant competence from resumes whose presentation can vary substantially in wording, structure, stylistic polish, and document extraction quality. Ideally, such surface variation should not change decisions when the underlying qualification evidence is unchanged. We introduce a controlled audit of this property, constructing occupation-grounded candidate profiles at controlled competence levels and rendering each profile into multiple resume presentations. A det
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個核心問題:當求職者的實際能力證據不變時,履歷的表面呈現方式(措辭、結構、風格、文件擷取品質)是否會改變 LLM 篩選系統的決策。作者建立一套以 O*NET 職業資料為基礎的受控稽核基準:為 17 種職業各建構六個能力層級受控的合成求職者檔案(共 102 個),再將每個檔案渲染成五種履歷版本(原始條列式、冗長化、段落重組、AI 潤飾、版面雜訊),產生 510 個變體;並以確定性的驗證關卡剔除改變潛在事實證據的變體,保留 505 個。評估採用兩個互補指標:效度(能否正確還原已知的能力優劣排序)與呈現不變性(能力不變時決策是否穩定,以 flip rate 衡量)。結果顯示兩者明顯脫鉤:Llama-3.1-8B 使用原生 chat template 效度最高(0.781),卻有 29.6% 的配對決策在能力不變的改寫下反轉;Mistral-7B-v0.3 效度 0.644 但 flip rate 高達 41.4%。原生 chat 格式雖能提升多個 chat-tuned 模型的效度(如 Llama-3.1 從 0.622 升至 0.781),仍無法消除不穩定性。BM25 與 TF-IDF 詞彙基線 flip rate 極低但效度接近隨機,僅作為穩定度參照。限制方面,基準僅涵蓋 17 種職業與合成履歷,職業叢集數少使信賴區間僅屬試驗規模證據,且未評估專有商業系統。此研究提醒:履歷篩選評估不應只看能否選出較強的候選人,還須檢驗決策對無關表面變異的穩健性。

Novelty is moderate-to-good: adapter-only BCT without weight access is a meaningful new setting, but the loss components (cycle-consistency, RKD-style angle loss, distance distillation, focal re-weighting) are adaptations of existing techniques. S11). Baselines are fair adapter-only variants; excluding XBT from main tables is justified and backed by data. primary_link.title: Multi-modal Knowledge Preserving Adapter for Embedding Backward Compatibility

radar.summary: Upgrading embedding models typically requires expensive database re-indexing, as new query embeddings are incompatible with existing database embeddings. While Backward Compatible Training (BCT) mitigates this by enforcing compatibility during training, existing approaches often require updating the backbone model. This is impractical because of significant training cost, the risk of performance regression, and limited access to proprietary model weights. We introduce Multi-modal Knowledge Prese
radar.summary_zh: 升級 embedding 模型時，新舊模型的向量互不相容，迫使系統重建整個向量資料庫（backfilling），成本高昂。既有的 Backward Compatible Training（BCT）雖在訓練時加入相容性約束，但多需更新主幹模型（backbone），不僅訓練成本龐大、有效能退化風險，也無法套用於僅能透過 API 存取的閉源模型。本文提出 MKP-Adapter，首個僅訓練 Adapter、完全不更動主幹的多模態 BCT 框架。核心挑戰在於：將新向量投影至舊空間時，直接擬合較弱且雜訊較多的舊目標會犧牲新模型的表示能力。為此，作者在基礎投影損失之外，加入三個層次的知識保存正則化：point-wise 的 cycle-consistency 重建損失、distance-wise 的成對距離損失，以及 angle-wise 的三元組角度損失，並以受 focal loss 啟發的重新加權策略強調難樣本。實驗涵蓋 CLIP→GME/UniME 與 E5-V→UniME 等升級情境，在 MS-COCO、Flickr30K、Urban1K、MMEB、ViDoRe 與 MSR-VTT 等影像、文字、視覺文件及影片檢索基準上，一致超越 adapter-only 基線，相較舊模型平均提升 I2T +5.43%、T2I +7.63%、MMEB +10.53%。Adapter 僅以預先抽取的向量訓練，推論額外延遲約 0.01%，於 8 張 A100 上 1–2 小時即可訓練完成。限制包括：相容效能仍不及全新模型、每組新舊模型需各自訓練 Adapter，且文件與影片檢索須改用對比學習作為基礎損失。整體而言，此方法使模型升級免於重建索引，對大規模檢索系統與 API 型模型極具實用價值。
