links.title: Toward Secure AI-Powered Penetration Testing Agents: Security Threats, Guardrails, and Architectural Perspectives

evidence: Abstract: proposes a 'two-axis lifecycle-aligned taxonomy' covering LLM lifecycle attacks (Cat. A-C) and agent-architecture attacks (Cat. D-F) with a symmetric six-category guardrail taxonomy (G-A to G-F).

Section 6, Assessment Methodology: ratings are 'qualitative architectural exposure derived from the published framework designs and should not be interpreted as empirical attack success rates' and the evaluation 'should be viewed as a security analysis based on the architecture and not a live penetration testing benchmark.'
Section 4: threat model defines three adversary access tiers (Model-Level, Runtime Context, Agent Architecture) and three trust boundaries (Model, Context, Execution).
Table 1 (Section 3.3): architectural capability comparison of 20 frameworks across planner, memory, RAG, reflection, tool execution, multi-agent, and human oversight dimensions.

Section 1.1: acknowledges related surveys (Chu 2026 layered attack-surface survey; Ferrag et al. 2026 prompt-sanitization-to-red-teaming) and positions this work as differing via an 'architecture-centric, two-axis lifecycle taxonomy.'
Section 8: eight research gaps (RG1-RG8, e.g., integrated architecture-aware guardrails, standardized benchmarks RG7) with no accompanying artifacts, code, or empirical validation.

Tables 4-5 notes: 'G-A and G-B reflect protection inherited from the underlying foundation model rather than framework-level guardrails,' confirming the qualitative, citation-derived nature of the insufficiency analysis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A survey of security threats and guardrails for LLM-powered autonomous pentesting agents, squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (agents & tool use, LLMs, AI safety, red teaming/evaluation, RAG security). Its two-axis taxonomy (LLM lifecycle attacks A-C vs. emergent agent-architecture attacks D-F) mirrored by a guardrail taxonomy (G-A to G-F) is a reasonable organizational contribution, but adjacent surveys are acknowledged (Section 1.1) and the framework is primarily a reorganization of cited results rather than new methodology. Rigor is limited: the vulnerability and guardrail-insufficiency assessments (Tables 2-5) are explicitly qualitative and non-empirical, with no described literature-search protocol or rating validation. Evidence strength rests on an extensive, largely verifiable citation base (e.g., AgentDojo, Sleeper Agents, PoisonedRAG), but the paper's own claims about framework exposure are subjective ratings derived from prior publications. Generalizability is moderate since the trust-boundary/threat-model framing applies to agentic AI broadly. Reproducibility is low: no code, datasets, or fully specified rating rubric; authors caution ratings 'should not be interpreted as empirical attack success rates.'

primary_link.title: Toward Secure AI-Powered Penetration Testing Agents: Security Threats, Guardrails, and Architectural Perspectives

radar.summary: LLM-powered autonomous agents are transforming the penetration testing space with dynamic, multi-step offensive security workflows that require minimal supervision by humans. These agents leverage sophisticated reasoning abilities and external security tools to independently carry out reconnaissance, identify vulnerabilities, devise exploitation plans, and perform post-exploitation operations. But the ability to have persistent memory, to take actions in the real world, and to do long-horizon re
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的自動化代理正改變滲透測試領域，但持續性記憶、真實世界行動與長程推理能力帶來有別於對話式AI的全新安全風險。本調查針對自主AI滲透測試代理進行系統性安全分析，提出雙軸威脅分類法：第一軸為LLM生命週期攻擊（A–C類：預訓練語料下毒、微調與對齊攻擊、推論時期提示注入），第二軸為代理架構攻擊（D–F類：記憶與知識庫下毒、多代理協調攻擊、工具與執行層攻擊）。作者梳理約二十個代表性框架（如PentestGPT、HackSynth、VulnBot、CAI等）的規劃、記憶、RAG與工具執行等架構能力及信任邊界，以質性方式評估各框架對六類攻擊的暴露程度，並提出對稱的guardrail分類法（G-A至G-F），檢視現有防禦的結構性不足。主要發現為：現有guardrail多為對話式AI設計，且各自僅保護單一元件，對跨層混合攻擊（如AgentSmith、STAC）防護有限；滲透測試情境下的「政策鄰近性」問題更進一步削弱推論層防禦。研究限制在於評估屬架構推導的質性分析，而非實測攻擊成功率，且排除目標基礎設施本身的漏洞。作者據此歸納八項研究缺口，涵蓋整合式架構感知防護、執行感知安全推理、可信記憶管理、多代理信任驗證、標準化基準與治理稽核。本調查凸顯攻擊面正是AI系統本身，對建構可信的自主攻擊性安全系統具重要參考價值。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM-evaluation benchmark paper squarely in scope: it studies tool-augmented LLMs (Agents & Tool Use, weight 2.5) and evaluation/benchmark methodology, not a pure domain application, since the core contribution is how tool-output rendering affects model behavior. Twenty pickups in a quiet neighborhood can be more abnormal than 180 at an airport. We introduce URBANCONTRASTIVEQA, a benchmark that asks whether tool-augmented language models can make this baseline-relative comparison. Each item pairs two urban situations from public mobility data in NYC, Chicago, and Seattle, labeled by how far current activity deviates
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討工具增強式語言模型在城市決策支援中,能否以「相對在地基準」而非原始數量進行比較:機場 180 次接送可能低於該區常態,而安靜社區的 20 次卻屬異常偏高,直接比較數量會導致錯誤尺度比較。作者建立 UrbanContrastiveQA 基準,利用紐約、芝加哥、西雅圖的公共移動資料(計程車、共乘、自行車計數與 NOAA 氣象觀測),以 2019 與 2022 年資料建構每區每時段的歷史平均與標準差,計算 z 分數作為真值,產出 432 個配對情境(864 個方向),分為 aligned 與 conflict 題型,另附 200 對的診斷子集與交換控制。研究在五種工具輸出格式(Count-only、+Baseline、Ask-score、+Server-score、Full-view)下,以溫度 0 評估六個 instruction-tuned 模型。主要結果:僅給原始計數時,各模型準確率約 0.25 至 0.48,在空間衝突題趨近 0.000,明顯追隨較大數字;+Server-score 與 Full-view 使所有模型進步,前者對六分之四的模型最佳,診斷子集上 Mistral-Small 達 0.986;Ask-score 則使部分模型輸出難以解析。限制方面:異常度屬操作化建構,替代標註方式的一致性有限,空間衝突層僅 26 對,且任務不涵蓋一般城市預測。此研究顯示,面對異質城市資料流,工具介面應在回傳計數時同時暴露在地基線脈絡,評估設計也須明確指明判定答案所用的決策尺度。

links.title: FlashVector: Agent for Hierarchical Model Serving Stack Optimization

evidence: Abstract: 'FlashVector achieved up to 2x throughput increase and up to 1.98x latency speedup on model server, and up to 1.6x throughput increase on feature store' in Unity's Vector ad platform

Section 3 & Section 2: positions contribution as extending kernel design agents; 'FlashVector is a direct extension of the profiling guided paradigm' reusing the profile-diagnose-optimize-verify loop for non-kernel layers

Section 4.2 Verify: deterministic rewrites require exact equality; FP reordering bounded at 1e-3 with ≤0.1% outliers; noise floor ±6% end-to-end, 2-6% band re-measured at 8x sample size tightening floor as 1/sqrt(k) to 2.1%
Section 5.1: Triton gRPC-to-Python-backend serialization rewritten in C++, 30x step-level speedup, fix contributed upstream (Triton Inference Server issue #8348)
Section 5.2.2: fused attention cuts module latency 996.5us to 279.8us (3.56x) with bit-identical outputs; embedding decomposition cuts total GPU kernel time 33.4% and forward-pass latency 30.1%
Section 5.3 Table 3: preprocessor pod throughput 940 RPS baseline to ~1.5k after native Cython kernels, assembly rewrite, and zero-copy I/O (1.6x), gains compounded across iterations
Section 5.4 Table 4: agent-selected instance/batch configurations for four production models at fixed p99 SLOs, delivered as reviewed pull requests via shadow-traffic canary

llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope agentic LLM systems paper: an LLM agent (Profile-Diagnose-Optimize-Verify loop) extends kernel-design-agent methodology to the full model-serving stack, strongly matching Agents & Tool Use, Inference & Serving, and Code & Programming preferences. Strengths: concrete production results across four case studies (30x step-level speedup on Triton serialization contributed upstream; 3.56x fused-attention speedup with bit-identical outputs; 1.6x preprocessor throughput; config tuning for four models), plus unusually careful verification discipline (tiered correctness bars, ±6% noise floor tightened to 2.1% at 8x samples, full-stack load-test gate). Weaknesses: the paper self-describes as a 'direct extension' of the kernel-agent paradigm, so novelty is incremental; no ablations of the agent loop, knowledge base, or refine stage, no baselines against human experts or alternative agent harnesses; all evidence is from a single proprietary recommender stack with replayed production traffic, and no code, knowledge base, or benchmark is released, so reproducibility is very low and generalizability is asserted rather than tested.

primary_link.title: FlashVector: Agent for Hierarchical Model Serving Stack Optimization

radar.summary: Model serving is one of the largest cost drivers in production recommender systems. Maximizing its throughput requires navigating a deeply layered hierarchy: GPU kernels, the ML framework computation graph, the model server, and on-demand feature processing -- each demanding specialized domain expertise. Such cross-layer expertise is inherently difficult to acquire, and does not scale with a workload that continuously grows and evolves, leaving significant cost efficiency gains unrealized. While
radar.summary_zh: 模型服務是生產環境推薦系統最主要的成本來源之一,而最大化吞吐量需跨越GPU核心、ML框架計算圖、模型伺服器與即時特徵處理等多個層級,各層所需的領域專業知識零散且難以取得,導致大量成本效率收益無法實現。FlashVector是一套代理式系統,將原本用於單一GPU核心最佳化的profile–diagnose–optimize–verify封閉迴圈,泛化到整個異質服務堆疊。其三大機制為:(1)層級代理抽象,每層實作相同的剖析、診斷、最佳化、驗證介面,並於執行後以Refine階段將發現寫回知識庫;(2)局部最佳化、全域驗證,候選變更須以重放的生產流量在固定延遲SLO下通過端對端負載測試,且增益需超過測量雜訊門檻;(3)常駐自動觸發的持續最佳化迴圈,對抗模型再訓練、流量轉移與硬體更新造成的最佳化衰退。部署於Unity的Vector廣告平台後,模型伺服器吞吐量最高提升2倍、延遲加速達1.98倍,特徵商店吞吐量提升1.6倍;案例包括將Triton伺服器的Python序列化瓶頸改以C++重寫(30倍加速)、融合注意力核心(3.56倍)、嵌入層重構、以Cython核心與零複製I/O加速CPU特徵前處理,以及動態批次等執行時參數的線上搜尋。其限制在於結果來自單一公司平台與特定工作負載,驗證容差需依精度與業務指標客製,浮點重排類變更允許10⁻³的元素級偏差,不適用於要求位元級精確的場景。本文意義在於證明代理式最佳化典範可從單一核心延伸至多語言、多儲存庫的完整服務堆疊,實現持續自動的跨層效率改善。

Table 2 and Section 4.3: 'Across the 63 checkpoint-benchmark pairs, AREA improves over LoT by approximately 0.55 points on average'; ChartQA 'remains approximately comparable to LoT and occasionally performs slightly worse'; AMBER-D degradations vs Base for InternVL3.5-4B/8B and Qwen3-VL-8B.
Appendix Part I: per-sample runtime on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (A30 24GB), AREA faster than LoT by 7.0% (POPE) to 34.0% (ViQuAE).
Appendix Part II Table 2: one-factor ablations, Retrieval Avg. 28.4 full vs 27.9 (w/o Scaling), 28.0 (w/o Gating), 28.1 (w/o Refresh) - small per-component deltas.
Title-page footer: 'Code: https://github.com/wongzbb/AREA' (availability claimed, not independently verified).

Section 4.1: only LoT is used as the comparison highlighting method ('Each LoT-AREA pair uses the same checkpoint, retrieved entities, task instruction, decoding configuration, and evaluator'); no error bars or significance tests anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal LLM methodology (not pure CV): a training-free, inference-time evidence-allocation method for frozen MLLMs combining attention-based relevance readout, visual sink filtering, entropy-calibrated scaling, modality-specific gating, and causal text refresh. It matches LLM, Multimodal AI, RAG/Knowledge (retrieval evidence utilization, hallucination benchmarks), and Interpretability preferences, though it misses the highest-weight topics (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). Novelty is incremental: it extends SelfElicit/LoT fixed highlighting with adaptive 'whether/how much/when' decisions built from known ingredients (attention readout, attention sinks from Kang et al. 2025, entropy budgets, median gating). Rigor is solid—9 frozen checkpoints across Qwen/InternVL families and 2B-32B scales, 11 benchmarks, matched LoT protocol, one-factor-at-a-time ablations, runtime comparison, and honest reporting of negative cases (ChartQA slightly worse, AMBER-D degradation on some backbones, InfoSeek Unseen-E marginal, Section 4.3)—but only one highlighting baseline (LoT) is compared, no significance/variance is reported, and no hyperparameter sensitivity analysis is given despite six fixed constants (Section 4.1). Evidence strength is capped by small margins: ~0.6-point average gain over LoT, ablation deltas of 0.4-0.5 points (Appendix Part II) that could fall within noise. Generalizability is well supported across families, scales, and retrieval vs. vision-only settings; reproducibility is aided by a public code URL, specified retrieval pipeline (EVA-CLIP+FAISS), evaluation suites, and hardware, though code availability is claimed rather than verified.

primary_link.title: Layers, Sinks, and Scaling: Adaptive Evidence Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models

radar.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer knowledge-intensive visual questions by combining visual evidence from images with facts retrieved from external sources. However, MLLMs may overlook relevant evidence in both modalities, attending weakly to the textual sentences or visual regions needed for the correct answer. Recent efforts address this by highlighting retrieved text and marking visual regions before generation, but apply a fixed, one-shot policy that cannot adapt to three so
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）回答知識密集型視覺問題時，須將圖像中的視覺線索與外部檢索事實結合，但模型常忽略兩種模態中的關鍵證據。現有免訓練方法如 SelfElicit 與 LoT 以固定的一次性策略標記文字與視覺區域，無法因應不同範例與生成步驟的證據需求變化。本文提出 AREA（Adaptive Relevance-guided Evidence Allocation），一種免訓練的推論階段方法，將證據標記視為自適應分配：藉由單一 probe token 從固定骨幹層讀取視覺與文字相關性，並做出三項決策——是否介入（依注意力覆蓋率與視覺 sink 污染程度）、暴露多少證據（由相關性熵決定句子數與裁切範圍）、以及生成過程中何時更新文字證據（由因果上下文注意力峰值觸發）。實驗涵蓋四個 KB-VQA 基準與七個標準多模態基準、九個凍結的 MLLM 檢查點，AREA 全面超越 LoT：KB-VQA 四資料集平均提升約 0.6 分，標準基準平均提升約 0.55 分，其中 V-Star、RealWorldQA 與 AMBER-D 增益最明顯；附錄進一步顯示其每樣本推論時間較 LoT 縮短 14% 至 34%。限制方面，ChartQA 上與 LoT 相當或略差，因裁切可能破壞圖表整體結構資訊；部分強悍骨幹在 AMBER-D 仍較未介入的 Base 退化，InfoSeek 的 Unseen-E 情境亦僅有邊際改善，顯示證據呈現無法彌補實體辨識與檢索品質的不足。此研究證明，依輸入證據分布自適應地決定介入時機與規模，是提升凍結模型推論表現的關鍵方向。
radar.title: Layers, Sinks, and Scaling: Adaptive Evidence Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: 層、Sink 與尺度：多模態大型語言模型的自適應證據選擇

links.title: ToMAS: A Pilot Failure-Grounded Theory-of-Mind Benchmark from Multi-Agent LLM Failures

evidence: Abstract: conversion of 242 eligible non-AG2 traces yielded 39 Clean items; 18-trace pilot with 94.4% raw agreement and Cohen's κ=0.92
Section III-B: four explicit convertibility criteria (a)-(d); two-annotator coding with supervisor adjudication on trace #13
Table II: 242 coded non-AG2 traces, 39 CLEAN / 21 AMB / 146 NC / 36 SM; MetaGPT GPT-4o 28/53 Clean vs. CodeLlama 0/86
Section IV-C (RQ2 adapter checks): LoRA B L2≈0.005-0.006, effective max|ΔW|≈7e-6; held-out outputs identical to Base; ToMAS-RL matched Base on 37-38/39 training items
Table IX: all conditions and seeds pass the same 2 of 28 held-out items (IVH_04, IVH_12), i.e., no training effect
Section IV-C: 'Gold answers for all 28 held-out items were created by the first author... no second annotator re-checked held-out gold'; scoring is lexical ROUGE-L F1 only
Table IV: LR 1e-6, 200 steps, LoRA rank 8 on q_proj/v_proj; Hub revision not pinned (revision=null); runtime not archived
Section III-E: EnactToM functional-ToM baseline excluded before comparison, so no direct ToM baseline present
Data Availability: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22685705, CC-BY-4.0, includes items, annotation materials, scoring scripts, train_condition.py, and reward logs
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant to core preferences: multi-agent LLM systems, Theory-of-Mind reasoning, RL-based training (GRPO), and benchmark/evaluation methodology. The core idea—converting diagnosed MAST FC2 inter-agent misalignment failures into partner-state benchmark items and binary RL rewards—is a genuinely underexplored niche, with a disciplined conversion rubric (four criteria) and strong pilot inter-annotator agreement (κ=0.92 on 18 traces). However, the central training experiment is a failed run the authors themselves invalidate: LoRA updates are numerically negligible (max|ΔW|≈7e-6 at LR 1e-6), all conditions decode identically to the untrained base model, and the 28-item held-out diagnostic therefore carries no information about training efficacy. Additional weaknesses: held-out gold authored by a single annotator with no second check, purely lexical ROUGE-L scoring that passes items on phrasing overlap, a provenance gap between MetaGPT-derived training items and GAIA-derived held-out items, exclusion of any functional ToM baseline, and very small item pools (39 train, 28 held-out). The paper is unusually honest and well-instrumented (locked logs, adapter-norm checks, scoping tables), which supports rigor and reproducibility credit, but the empirical yield is a pilot plus a null diagnostic; the training-claim portion of RQ2 has essentially no evidential content. Convertibility findings (GPT-4o MetaGPT 28/53 Clean vs. CodeLlama 0/86) are descriptive and confounded by task/trace differences. Score reflects strong topic fit and transparency against weak, non-informative experimental results.

primary_link.title: ToMAS: A Pilot Failure-Grounded Theory-of-Mind Benchmark from Multi-Agent LLM Failures

radar.summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems can fail even when communication succeeds because agents do not correctly track their peers' roles, knowledge, or intentions. We investigate whether such inter-agent misalignment cases, labelled FC2 in MAST-Data, can be converted into functional partner-state reasoning items. ToMAS applies four explicit convertibility criteria to diagnosed execution traces. A full conversion pass over 242 eligible non-AG2 training traces produced 39 CLEAN items. In an 18-trace relia
radar.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系統即使訊息交換成功，仍可能因代理間失準（MAST 分類中的 FC2）而失敗：代理未能正確追蹤同伴的角色、知識或意圖。既有心智理論（ToM）基準與強化學習訓練多採人工設計的任務，而非取材自真實執行失敗。作者提出 ToMAS 流程，以四項可轉換準則篩選 MAST-Data 中已標註的 FC2 軌跡，將其轉為「功能性同伴狀態推理」題目，並作為二值 ROUGE-L 獎勵。在 18 條軌跡的可靠性試點中，兩位標註者原始一致率達 94.4%，Cohen's κ=0.92；對 242 條非 AG2 訓練軌跡的完整轉換產出 39 題 Clean 題目，且可轉換率因模型而異：MetaGPT/GPT-4o 約 53%，CodeLlama 與 ChatDev 為 0%，AG2 則屬結構性不符（Structural Mismatch）。作者再以 Qwen2.5-1.5B 搭配 LoRA 進行小規模 GRPO 可行性實驗，但在 28 題 Magentic/GAIA held-out 診斷題組上，所有條件的貪婪解碼輸出與未訓練基準完全相同，且僅同樣 2 題超過門檻；事後檢查顯示在學習率 1×10⁻⁶ 下 LoRA 更新量可忽略（max|ΔW|≈7×10⁻⁶），故本實驗無法支持任何訓練效果主張。論文並指出訓練題與測試題的來源落差、僅以詞彙重疊評分等限制。其貢獻在於示範將診斷出的協調失敗轉為可訓練 ToM 題目之初步準則與端對端流程，並明確界定定論性後續研究必須滿足的條件。
radar.title: ToMAS: A Pilot Failure-Grounded Theory-of-Mind Benchmark from Multi-Agent LLM Failures

links.title: End-to-End Latency-Minimizing and Load-Balanced Request Scheduling for Edge LLM Inference in Agentic AI Services

evidence: Abstract/Section IV: LYREO combines Lyapunov optimization for long-term load balancing with LSTM-based reward redistribution using sequence truncation and value bootstrapping

Section IV-B2: reward redistribution follows optimal second-order Markov redistribution of Arjona-Medina et al. (RUDDER) [30]; the infinite-horizon truncation+bootstrapping target y_H is the claimed new extension
Section III-D Eq. (15): workload defined as normalized KV cache memory-time consumption; Section V-D Table II: LYREO-Count underperforms LYREO (avg latency 2.79s vs 2.63s, P99 4.56s vs 3.74s)
Section V-C1: convergence results ~2.4s (LYREO) vs ~3.9s (Ly-PPO) vs ~5.2s (PPO); queue lengths ~0.02 vs 0.09 vs 0.22

Section V-A: simulations use Llama-3.2-1B profiled via vLLM on RTX 3080/3090/4090, LMSYS-Chat-1M token statistics, T=800 slots, 5 random seeds; PyTorch 1.8, 4-layer MLP actor/critic, 2-layer LSTM hidden dim 64 (Table I)

Section III-A: output token length l_i^out is treated as a known input (user-specified or estimated); Section III-C: prefill assumed independent of decoding; downlink feedback latency neglected (Section III-B)
Section IV-C Theorem 1: performance gap bounded by O((gamma^H*eps_v + eps_r)/(1-gamma) + gamma^H*r_max/(1-gamma)^2 + eps_PPO); Step I deviation bound of 2*gamma^H*r_max/(1-gamma) is crude
Section III-E: NP-hardness of the integer program asserted without proof; Section V-E text refers to three different results all as 'Fig. 8' despite separate Fig. 6/7/8 captions

Section V-D: LYREO-NoLB raises load deviation +125.0%, P99 latency to 6.73s (+79.9%), high-KV ratio to 14.35% (+123.5%); Section V-E: nu=0.5 is the latency/balance turning point; H=250 yields diminishing returns
No code or artifact availability is mentioned anywhere in the paper; evaluation is purely simulation-based with no real testbed
llm_evaluation.rationale: Genuinely matches high-weight preferences (LLM inference serving with KV cache/continuous batching, agentic AI edge deployment, PPO-based RL, Lyapunov optimization), not a keyword-stuffed pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: the core techniques (Lyapunov virtual queues, RUDDER-style reward redistribution from [30], PPO) are established; the claimed new element is the infinite-horizon truncation+bootstrapping extension and the KV-cache memory-time workload metric (Sections IV-B2, III-D). The system model is detailed and the Lyapunov drift bound and Theorem 1 gap bound are derived, but several steps are loose (e.g., the 2*gamma^H*r_max/(1-gamma) deviation bound in Step I) and NP-hardness is asserted without proof (Section III-E). Evidence is simulation-only: one model (Llama-3.2-1B), LMSYS-Chat-1M requests, 5 seeds, min-max ranges (Section V-A), with useful ablations (Table II: LYREO-NoLB +125.0% load deviation, P99 6.73s) and sensitivity analyses. Strong assumptions (output length known a priori, Section III-A; negligible downlink delay) limit realism and generalizability; text mislabels multiple distinct figures as 'Fig. 8' in Section V-E. Hyperparameters and architectures are reported but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: End-to-End Latency-Minimizing and Load-Balanced Request Scheduling for Edge LLM Inference in Agentic AI Services

radar.summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered agentic AI services increasingly demand low-latency inference, motivating the deployment of LLMs across distributed edge servers. However, heterogeneous communication and computing capabilities, together with dynamically evolving inference states, make the edge server selection for each incoming request time-varying and tightly coupled across slots. In this paper, we investigate an online request scheduling framework for edge LLM inference that jointly minimize
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討代理式AI（Agentic AI）服務中邊緣LLM推論的線上請求排程問題，目標是在異質邊緣伺服器之間同時最小化長期平均端到端延遲並維持負載平衡。作者指出兩大挑戰：其一，傳統延遲模型無法刻畫涵蓋無線傳輸、prefill、逐步解碼與KV cache演化之多階段細粒度動態；其二，排程決策的延遲後果須待請求完成後才可觀察，形成回饋延遲。方法上，論文建立跨時槽推論模型，以KV cache記憶體—時間消耗的正規化指標衡量伺服器負載，將問題形式化為具峰值記憶體可行性與長期負載平衡約束的線上最佳化問題；並提出LYREO，透過Lyapunov虛擬佇列將長期約束轉為逐槽修正項，再以LSTM為基礎的獎勵重分配機制（結合序列截斷與值函數bootstrap）將延遲結果轉換為即時學習訊號，搭配PPO最佳化排程策略，並推導效能差距的理論上界。模擬採用Llama-3.2-1B與RTX 3080/3090/4090平台及LMSYS-Chat-1M資料集：LYREO收斂至約2.4秒平均延遲，優於Ly-PPO的3.9秒與PPO的5.2秒，負載偏差亦最低；消融實驗顯示移除負載平衡雖可降低平均延遲，但P99延遲與高KV使用率分別上升79.9%與123.5%。限制包括僅以模擬驗證、假設輸出長度已知或可估計，且理論界限依賴截斷長度與估計誤差。對於在邊緣部署LLM以支撐低延遲代理式應用，此聯合排程框架深具參考價值。

links.title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics

evidence: Abstract: 'raises end-to-end task success from 43% to 86% ... and cuts token cost by 2.4x' — but the 43% baseline is SoTA#2 with GPT-OSS-120B while the 86% is NSA with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (cross-model comparison).
Section IV-A, Table I: NSA w/ Qwen achieves 12/14 'Both' successes; SoTA#1 (EXASAGE Query Tool) only 0-1/14 despite published 93.6% accuracy, motivating the retrieval-level study.
Section IV-B, Table III: retrieval accuracy 66/75 (88%) for EXASAGE Reflect Agent vs. 42/75 (56%) EXASAGE Query Tool and 36/75 (48%) Datalake Query Tool on 75 queries from HPC studies.

Section IV-A: 'we count as completed also the cases in which the provided answers were wrong' and note that the one EXASAGE Query Tool code-execution success 'was achieved illegitimately' via cross-container escape — honest, but underscores small-sample fragility.

Section II-C contributions: authors explicitly disclaim being first to mediate access through an ontology, claiming only the 'trustworthiness-framed, deep-agent, deterministically-validated instantiation' for operational telemetry.
References [62]: citation retains the note 'VERIFY exact variant (e.g. Qwen3 35B-A3B MoE)', an unresolved editorial artifact that weakens reproducibility of the claimed model configuration.
Section V: future work includes extending the approach 'to other IoT and Industry 4.0 use-cases', acknowledging current single-domain (M100 telemetry) scope.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-agent architecture paper (deep agents, MCP tool calling, knowledge-graph grounding, hallucination prevention) applied to HPC telemetry, so it is squarely within the agents/LLM/RAG preference cluster rather than an excluded pure domain application. The 'symbolic separation' idea (ontology-constrained VKG plus deterministic pre-execution validation inside a self-correcting deep agent) is a reasonable and clearly motivated integration, but the authors honestly disclaim being first at ontology-mediated access (Section II-C), so novelty is incremental architecture composition over their own EXASAGE line of work. Rigor is limited: only 14 end-to-end queries, no repeated runs, no significance testing, single dataset, and a suspiciously weak EXASAGE Query Tool baseline (7% vs. its published 93.6%) that they only partially diagnose via the 75-query retrieval study (Section IV-B, Table III: 42/75 vs. 66/75). Evidence strength benefits from per-query token accounting (Table II), honest caveats ('we count as completed also the cases in which the provided answers were wrong', Section IV-A), and the 2.4x median-token claim (300k vs. 713k), but headline '43% to 86%' compares across different LLMs (GPT-OSS-120B baseline vs. Qwen proposed), and 'zero hallucinated outputs' rests on 14 trials. Generalizability is constrained by heavy domain-specific ontology engineering; authors defer other IoT domains to future work (Section V). Reproducibility is moderate: hardware, vLLM, GraphDB-Free, thresholds, and GitLab query availability are stated, but prompt contents, retry budgets, and the exact model variant are not fully specified, and reference [62] retains an unresolved editorial note ('VERIFY exact variant'), and 'Qwen3.6-35B-A3B' is an unverifiable model name.

primary_link.title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics

radar.summary: Generative AI promises natural language access to the massive numerical telemetry of data centers and Industry 4.0 installations, yet text-to-query and tool-using agents stay unreliable: even frontier models answer little more than half of real-world database questions, and far fewer of the multi-step, operational ones, because the LLM must compose how heterogeneous sources relate and hallucinates the relations, not just the fields. We propose symbolic separation: a deep agent reasons freely but
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）在資料中心與 HPC 營運遙測分析上的不可靠問題：文字轉查詢或工具型代理會幻覺出不存在的綱要與資料關聯，GPT-4 在 BIRD 基準的正確率僅約 40%，時序資料代理面對有狀態與異常查詢更是大幅退化。作者提出「符號分離」設計：代理可在神經層自由推理，但所有資料存取必須透過受限於本體的虛擬知識圖（VKG），並在執行前由決定性驗證器檢查類別、屬性與 domain/range 是否符合本體，使複雜問題化為單一經驗證的圖遍歷，而非由 LLM 於查詢時自行推斷 join。實作名為 Neurosymbolic Deep Analyst，包含協調者、具反思迴圈與確定性驗證的 EXASAGE Reflect Agent、於沙盒中執行分析的 Deep Code Agent，並擴充涵蓋電力、冷卻與碳排等概念的 ODA 本體。在 49.9 TB 的 M100 超級電腦遙測資料上，端對端分析成功率從非符號基線的 43% 提升至 86%（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 勝過 GPT-OSS-120B），檢索層正確率達 88%，中位 token 消耗降低約 2.4 倍，且零幻覺輸出。限制包括端對端測試僅 14 題、部分失敗源於子代理查詢措辭與 SPARQL 語法、與 Ontop 等工具的比較尚未完成。此結果顯示預先串接並經本體驗證的關係，是打造可信賴資料分析代理的關鍵。
radar.title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics
radar.title_zh: 符號分離：將深度代理錨定於知識圖，實現可信賴的營運資料分析

links.title: Not Another Text Benchmark: Putting the "Visual" Back in Visual Question Answering for Large Video Models

evidence: Abstract: introduces three vision-centric benchmarks in temporal frame retrieval, video future prediction, and causal memory distortion, showing frontier models degrade when answer choices are visual rather than text
Section 4.1 (Models): evaluates Gemini 2.5 Pro, GLM-4.6V, LLaVA-OV-72B, Qwen2.5-32B/72B, Qwen3-32B, mPLUG-Owl3, InternVL3-72B, Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5V-Turbo with fixed prompts across models
Section 4.2, Table 1: Gemini-2.5-Pro scores 30.00% TFR, 69.62% VFP, 58.00% CMD against 25/25/50 random baselines; human baselines 44/80/80
Appendix C, Table 3: text-negative ablation shows 73.87 (original text) vs 71.48 (hard text) vs 30.00 (visual), arguing distractor difficulty does not explain the modality gap
Appendix F.2, Table 4: signal detection results with d'=0.51 for both Qwen and Gemini but specificity 63 vs 33, supporting the claim that Gemini hallucinates contact frames more often
Appendix H, Table 5: prompt-variation ablation keeps the vision-text gap stable (Gemini Δ -0.432 vs -0.438; Kimi -0.386 vs -0.458)
Section 'A note on benchmark size and scaling': 641 total videos, 95% CIs via bootstrap B=10000 and Wilson score; Section 6 Limitations admits black-box-only analysis and small causal dataset

Appendix A.2: 'We will release all the JSON files for the three tasks'; Appendix G: annotation tool 'released as part of our code release', though no concrete repository URL is provided in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: A vision-centric evaluation benchmark for large video-language models (temporal frame retrieval, video future prediction, causal memory distortion). Strong match to Multimodal AI, Video & Temporal, and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences, with indirect LLM relevance via frontier video LMMs (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Qwen, LLaVA-OV, InternVL) and reasoning-trace analysis; however, the highest-weight preferences (LLM methodology, Japanese LLM/NLP, agents, code) are not central, and the work is closer to video-model appraisal than language methodology, capping relevance below top-tier. Methodologically careful: human solvability baseline (TFR 44% vs 25% chance, acknowledged as difficult), random baselines, hard-text-negative ablation (73.87→71.48 text vs 30.00 visual, Appendix C), prompt-sensitivity ablation (Appendix H), signal-detection analysis (Appendix F.2), and calibration analysis (Appendix F.3). Novel causal-memory-distortion task adapted from Strickland & Keil (2011) is a genuinely new probe for LMM hallucination. Weaknesses: small causal task (20 videos/60 clips) with only mean-level claims (no significance, Appendix F.1), manual reasoning-trace annotation limited to two models, and dataset/code release promised but not verifiably linked in the text.

primary_link.title: Not Another Text Benchmark: Putting the "Visual" Back in Visual Question Answering for Large Video Models

radar.summary: Large video models have exhibited impressive performance on a wide range of visual question answering tasks, owing to the rise of powerful, pretrained text and vision encoders. The usefulness of such models have also been demonstrated on a wide range of benchmarks, with an important caveat - the dominant approach in these benchmarks evaluates multiple choice reasoning via text options. This is a natural way to test text-based reasoning in these models, and has led to significant insights regardi
radar.summary_zh: 現行影片理解基準幾乎全以文字選項進行多選題評測，模型可能藉語言線索作答，掩蓋真正的視覺推理能力。本文提出三個以視覺選項為核心的新基準：時序影格檢索（基於 Charades 資料集，選出錨定動作前後的正確影格序列）、影片未來預測（基於 Shapestacks 物理模擬，由前八幀推測後續畫面），以及因果記憶扭曲（受認知科學實驗啟發，檢驗模型在接觸幀被移除、但後續畫面隱含因果時，是否誤以為看過該幀）。測試對象涵蓋 Gemini-2.5-Pro、Qwen 系列、LLaVA-OV-72B、InternVL3-78B、GLM-4.6V 等前沿模型。主要發現：改用視覺選項後表現驟降，Gemini 在時序影格檢索由文字版的約 74% 跌至 30%，各模型多僅略高於隨機基準；人類受試者在未來預測與因果任務達 80%，證明題目可解。若將視覺選項轉為文字描述，準確率反而下降，顯示文字化會損失細粒度視覺資訊。推理軌跡分析指出 Gemini 常推理正確卻選錯選項（選項錨定失誤）且過度自信，Qwen 則完全忽略視覺選項；因果任務中 Gemini 特異度較 Qwen 低 30 個百分點，更易幻覺出接觸幀。限制在於資料集僅 641 部影片、因果任務需大量人工篩選難以擴充，且分析皆為黑箱。本研究的價值在於提供文字基準之外的互補視角，直接揭露前沿模型視覺理解的弱點，指引未來改進方向。
radar.title: Not Another Text Benchmark: Putting the "Visual" Back in Visual Question Answering for Large Video Models
radar.title_zh: 別再是文字基準：把「視覺」放回大型影片模型的視覺問答

links.title: Semantic-Spatial Agreement Verification for Mitigating Object Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'On LLaVA-1.5-7B, accuracy averaged across COCO, A-OKVQA, and GQA improves by 1.81 and 3.17 percentage points under POPE Popular and Adversarial... while CHAIRs decreases from 49.40% to 32.80%.'
Sec. IV-A1: 'The hyperparameter lambda_ssav is set to 3, 1, and 8 for LLaVA-1.5-7B, mPLUG-Owl2, and MiniGPT-4 Vicuna-13B' with no stated selection protocol.
Sec. IV-C1, Table IV: Matched Random control yields CHAIRs 43.40/CHAIRi 12.49 vs full SSAV 32.80/8.22, supporting claim-selection over mere shortening.
Sec. IV-C2: progressive QIRV shuffling lowers ROC-AUC from 63.32% to 50.43%±0.38% (five seeds), indicating sample-specific spatial information.
Sec. IV-D1, Table V: geometric mean ROC-AUC 84.61 vs arithmetic 81.23 with paired-bootstrap 95% CI [-4.59,-2.18].
Sec. IV-B, Table I: LLaVA-1.5-7B Random Acc drops from 90.33 (Vanilla) to 88.54 (SSAV), attributed to over-correction.
Sec. IV-E: full pipeline 22:45 vs 19:37 vanilla (1.159x, 15.9% overhead) on RTX 4090, with verifier memory 0.666 GB.
Title-page footnote: 'Source code is publicly available at https://github.com/zihengren/SSAV'.
Sec. V: limitations include detector perceptual ceiling and weakened spatial evidence for small, occluded, or repeated-category objects.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Training-free external verification (OWL-ViT) for object hallucination in MLLMs, combining multi-prompt semantic aggregation with a spatial-consistency branch (QIRV) fused by geometric mean. Relevant to listed preferences via multimodal LLMs, hallucination mitigation, safety framing, and benchmark evaluation, though it is not core language-only LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: external-detector verification exists (Woodpecker, etc.); the cross-query semantic-spatial agreement and graph-based instance consistency are an incremental but well-motivated combination. Rigor is strong: core-component ablations, a matched-random-deletion control (Table IV), matched-rejection-budget design-choice comparisons (Table V-VII), evidence-correlation shuffling with seeds and CIs (Sec. IV-C2), and calibration-strength sensitivity (Sec. IV-C3). Gaps: per-model lambda_ssav values (Sec. IV-A1) lack a stated tuning protocol; many baselines are numbers reported by other papers; single-detector dependence. Evidence is consistent across three backbones and three protocols but MiniGPT-4's MME jump (135 to 195, Table II) is large and MME-Existence is small; Random-sampling accuracy drops on LLaVA (90.33 to 88.54), honestly acknowledged. Generalizability is limited to object-existence claims, English, and detector quality (Sec. V limitations). Code link, fixed templates, thresholds, and runtime/memory measurements (Sec. IV-E) support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Semantic-Spatial Agreement Verification for Mitigating Object Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models

radar.summary: Multimodal large language models generate natural-language responses from visual inputs, yet may mention objects absent from an image. In medication assistance, accessible perception, and environmental decision-making, such hallucinations can create real-world safety risks. We propose Semantic-Spatial Agreement Verification (SSAV), a training-free method for verifying object claims. A visually grounded claim should remain stable across semantically equivalent queries and repeatedly localize to t
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）常在影像問答與描述中提及圖中不存在的物件，此種物件幻覺在用藥輔助、無障礙感知等高風險場景可能引發安全問題。本文提出免訓練的語意—空間一致性驗證（SSAV）：對每個物件宣告建構四個語意等價查詢，交由凍結的開放詞彙偵測器 OWL-ViT 驗證。語意分支聚合各查詢的最高匹配分數，降低單一措辭造成的波動；空間分支 QIRV 以偏好候選框為節點、依 IoU 建圖，透過候選持續性、空間重疊度與查詢內候選優勢，檢驗回應是否反覆指向同一影像實例；兩分支以幾何平均融合，任一證據不足都會壓低最終分數。封閉式任務以此證據校準 Yes–No 判斷差距，開放式描述則過濾缺乏視覺支持的宣告。在 LLaVA-1.5-7B、mPLUG-Owl2 與 MiniGPT-4 上，SSAV 於 POPE Popular 與 Adversarial 的平均準確率分別提升 1.81 與 3.17 個百分點，LLaVA-1.5 的 CHAIRs 由 49.40% 降至 32.80%、CHAIRi 由 13.82% 降至 8.22%。消融與證據打亂實驗證實判別力來自樣本級空間對應，完整流程僅增加約 15.9% 推論時間。限制在於效能受外部偵測器感知能力約束，微小、遮蔽或同類重複物件可能削弱空間證據。整體而言，SSAV 以可解釋的外部視覺證據緩解幻覺，無須更新模型參數，有助於高可靠場景部署。
radar.title: Semantic-Spatial Agreement Verification for Mitigating Object Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models

links.title: Hub-Spectral Activation of Latent Multimodal Knowledge

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 19 retrieval and 11 prototype-classification relations on ImageBind and LanguageBind, HSA raises mean bidirectional Recall@10 from 18.27% to 31.15% and mean macro Top-1 accuracy from 29.01% to 52.43%'

Sec. IV-A, Theorem 1 and Corollary 1: hub-readable relation defined as K_AB^H = Sigma_AH Sigma_HH^dagger Sigma_HB with exact-recovery condition and rank(K_AB^H) <= rank(Sigma_HH); App. B.2 gives an explicit non-identifiability construction
Sec. V-B: 'The overall HSA-minus-Full A-B difference is -0.34 points, with a descriptive cluster interval of [-5.43, 5.57]. This comparison has no predefined equivalence or non-inferiority margin.'

Sec. V-C / Table XIX: permuting A-H, H-B, or both hub edges drops mean Recall@10 from 31.15% to 4.64/4.58/6.56%, all 19/19 positive, Holm p = 0.00293; disjoint-source estimation retains 10.77 of 11.94 points gain (Table V)
Sec. IV-D Scope: 'These claims are limited to second-order relations that can be linearly resolved through the frozen hub'; Table XVII shows heterogeneous recovery (Th-IMU 393.4% vs Im-D 30.6%)

App. C.3 and H.1: registered hyperparameters (lambda=0.5, kappa=2, kmax=256, permutation seed 142, calibration seeds 42-46); abstract states 'Code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/Luo1Yan/HSA'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed multimodal representation-learning paper, not a core-LLM/reasoning/agent work. It formalizes the hub-readable component of source-induced cross-modal dependence (Theorem 1: K_AB^H = Sigma_AH Sigma_HH^dagger Sigma_HB; Corollary 1 rank bound) and gives a closed-form spectral readout for frozen ImageBind/LanguageBind encoders. Preference match is mainly Multimodal AI (1.8) with partial Interpretability/representation-analysis relevance (probing what a frozen hub exposes); no LLM, Japanese NLP, agent, or safety methodology. Novelty is moderate-good: CCA/ridge/Procrustes machinery is classical, but composing two hub-edge moments without target pairs, plus the identifiability boundary and non-identifiability construction (App. B.2), is a fresh framing. Rigor and evidence are strong: 19 retrieval + 11 classification relations, source-permutation and disjoint-source controls (Sec. V-C), carrier localization (Table VII), dataset-cluster bootstrap with Holm correction (App. K.1), honest reporting that HSA is -0.34 points vs supervised Full A-B with no equivalence margin (Sec. V-B), and small-cluster caveats (MAVD n=2). Generalizability is bounded by linear second-order assumptions and dependence on hub-covariance structure (Sec. IV-D Scope); gains vary by relation (e.g., LanguageBind Im-D recovery 30.6%, Table XVII). Reproducibility is high: public code/models link, fixed hyperparameters (lambda=0.5, kappa=2, kmax=256), seeds, cost profiles, and detailed appendix protocols.

primary_link.title: Hub-Spectral Activation of Latent Multimodal Knowledge

radar.summary: Multimodal representation learning seeks shared representations for cross-modal retrieval and knowledge transfer. Hub-based binding reduces pairwise supervision costs, but separate hub connections cannot guarantee reliable alignment between modalities without direct joint training. We introduce Hub-Spectral Activation (HSA), a closed-form method for recovering and activating the hub-readable component of latent multimodal knowledge in frozen representations. We formalize this knowledge as source
radar.summary_zh: ImageBind 與 LanguageBind 等樞紐式綁定模型將各模態對齊至共享樞紐（影像或語言），但僅經樞紐間接相連的兩個非樞紐模態，其原始相似度檢索表現極不穩定。本文探問：訓練完成後，僅憑兩條已訓練樞紐邊能辨識並活化什麼關係？作者將「潛在多模態知識」形式化為共同來源引發的跨模態依賴，證明其中由兩條樞紐邊二階統計量決定的「樞紐可讀成分」可被識別，其秩受限於樞紐協變異數之秩，並提出閉式方法 HSA：組合並標準化樞紐邊矩量系統，以奇異值分解抽取配對譜載波方向，再結合可靠度加權證據與來源門控候選解析，支援雙向檢索與原型分類，全程不需目標配對監督、梯度最佳化或骨幹更新。在 19 個檢索關係上，平均雙向 Recall@10 由 18.27% 提升至 31.15%；11 個分類關係的 macro Top-1 由 29.01% 提升至 52.43%；打亂任一樞紐邊的樣本對應會使增益近乎消失，改用互不重疊的來源實例估計仍保留約九成增益，顯示訊號確實來自邊內有效對應與領先譜載波。理論界線在於僅涵蓋可經凍結樞紐線性解析的二階關係，高斯證據模型亦僅適用於標準化座標。此工作顯示凍結表示中的潛藏跨模態結構能以低成本讀出並直接應用，兼具關係讀出與診斷價值。

evidence: Section 4.3: 'we use DeepSeek-Chat as the attacker, target, and judge for all groups' — same-model confound across attacker, target, and LLM judge.
Section 7 Limitations: 'small strict subset (CounterFact-Strict, N=50) with relation skew' and 'We evaluate one model family (DeepSeek-Chat)'; judge 'may inherit model-specific biases'.
Section 5.1 Table 1: G1 Baseline PSR 96% (48/50) vs G5 Hybrid 90% (45/50) after 8 turns; no statistical significance testing reported for between-group differences.
Section 5.2 Table 2 and judging rubric: LLM-judge labels hits as PERSUASION (84.7% for G1) vs COMPLIANCE (21.4% for G5), no human validation of labels reported.
Section 4.1 Turn protocol: 'PSR@t is the fraction of subjects that have at least one hit within turns {1,...,t}' — cumulative-with-budget metric enabling near-ceiling success under random search.
Section 3.1: SAST MDP formulation with stateless target r_t = M_T(p_t), an implementation-level design ('we call the target model with a fresh messages list').

Section 7 Responsible release / Abstract footnote 1: code and dataset at https://github.com/cza1006/llm-persuasion-defense; Section 4.3 notes decoding parameters 'fixed across all groups via environment-controlled configuration' without published values.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Clearly in-scope LLM safety/red-teaming work with a genuinely interesting asymmetric design (stateful attacker, stateless target) that isolates refusal inertia from genuine cold-start persuadability, plus a counterintuitive 'Complexity Paradox' finding. However, rigor is materially limited: attacker, target, and judge are all the same DeepSeek-Chat model (Section 4.3), creating self-judging and self-attacking confounds; N=50 with acknowledged relation skew (Section 4.1, Section 7); group differences (48/50 vs 45/50, Table 1) and the Persuasion/Compliance split (Table 2) carry no significance testing or variance estimates; and 8-turn cumulative PSR with random search (G1) likely produces ceiling effects that the '96% PSR' headline overstates. Only one model family is evaluated, sharply limiting generalizability despite plural 'SOTA models' claims. Reproducibility is moderate: GitHub release of code/dataset is claimed, turn protocol and success criterion are precisely specified, but decoding parameters are only 'environment-controlled' and judge prompts are not fully published.

primary_link.title: Benchmarking Factual Robustness of LLMs via Multi-conversation Persuasion

radar.summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly serve as primary knowledge retrieval interfaces, their robustness against \textit{persuasion attacks}---attempts to inject misinformation or enforce counterfactuals---has become a critical safety concern. Existing red-teaming frameworks typically evaluate models in multi-turn dialogues where the target model retains full conversation history. We identify a critical flaw in this setting termed \textbf{``Refusal Inertia''}: a model's initial refusal oft
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）作為知識檢索介面時，抵禦說服攻擊的事實穩健性。作者指出現有紅隊測試框架多在保留目標模型完整對話歷史的設定下評估，導致「拒絕慣性」：模型最初的拒絕會因語境一致性而延續，掩蓋其真實弱點。為此，研究提出 SAST-IR 框架，採「有狀態攻擊者、無狀態目標」的不對稱設計，每輪清除目標記憶，迫使攻擊者將說服邏輯濃縮為單輪高效力提示。其搭載 CP-Agent（認知說服代理），以「規劃—反思—最佳化」迴圈運用 20 種心理攻擊模式（PAP），並由 Reflector 模組診斷軟性或硬性拒絕，決定微調現有論證或重新規劃策略。實驗在自建 CounterFact-Strict 資料集（N=50）上進行，五個實驗組於第八輪的說服成功率（PSR）皆超過 90%，最簡單的隨機基線 G1 達 96%。作者更發現「複雜性悖論」：複雜且反覆精緻化的攻擊易觸發模型防禦性順從（Compliance），而簡單多元的攻擊達到 84.7% 的真實信念說服率，此現象被稱為「表演式對齊」。研究限制包括資料集規模小且關係類型偏斜、僅測試 DeepSeek-Chat 一個模型家族，並依賴 LLM 評審可能繼承其偏見。本文意義在於揭露現行以拒絕訓練為主的防禦在冷啟動情境下極為脆弱，模型缺乏穩固的內部事實查核機制，並挑戰紅隊代理日益複雜化的趨勢，指出簡單與多元策略更能有效暴露模型真實的幻覺弱點。

evidence: Abstract: system combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and LLM components without task-specific training; ranked 4th on official leaderboard; code at github.com/tus-ist-nlp/littraceqa

Table 3 (official test set): paper_f1_macro 0.992, evidence_f1_macro 0.737, multiple_choice_accuracy 1.000, table_cell_accuracy_macro 0.309

Appendix B Table 5: MinerU 3.4.3 pipeline with PDF-Extract-Kit-1.0 snapshot ed6b654 specified for corpus preparation; Appendix C provides full retriever and reader prompts
llm_evaluation.rationale: A shared-task system paper (LitTraceQA, 4th place) describing a training-free LLM-based RAG pipeline over scientific literature. Strongly aligned with the curator's RAG/LLM/QA preferences: it uses GPT-5.4 for query decomposition and evidence verification, Qwen3-Embedding/Reranker-8B, hybrid BM25+dense retrieval with RRF, and a two-stage reader producing evidence-grounded answers. Novelty is modest: the pipeline integrates well-known components; the main contribution is the 'Relate' paper-to-paper expansion step (SPECTER2, bibliographic coupling, BM25), which shows a clear controlled gain (recall@50 0.647→0.940 on multi-paper questions, Table 2). Rigor is limited: only 55 validation / 71 test questions, ablation restricted to the retriever's Ranking A vs. A+B, and the authors concede in Limitations that individual expansion signals and reader stages are not isolated. Evidence strength is moderate: concrete official test metrics (paper F1 0.992, evidence F1 0.737, table cell accuracy ~0.31-0.33, Table 3) but no significance testing and leaderboard rank without comparison to top systems. Generalizability is untested per the authors. Reproducibility is good: released code, full prompts (Appendix C), model versions, hyperparameters, and MinerU weights snapshot, though dependence on the proprietary Azure OpenAI GPT-5.4 API partially limits exact replication.

primary_link.title: Lit3R: Retrieve-Relate-Read for Evidence-Grounded Question Answering over Scientific Literature

radar.summary: We describe tus-nlp's Lit3R (Retrieve-Relate-Read) system for LitTraceQA, a shared task for literature-grounded question answering that requires systems to retrieve relevant papers, identify supporting evidence, and generate answers. Lit3R combines off-the-shelf retrieval, reranking, and large language model (LLM) components without task-specific training. The retriever iteratively combines BM25-based sparse and dense retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and LLM-based verification, and complement
radar.summary_zh: 本文提出 Lit3R,一套為 LitTraceQA 競賽設計的「檢索—關聯—閱讀」系統,用於以科學文獻為依據的問答。該任務要求系統檢索相關論文、標註支持證據並生成答案,但僅提供 55 題驗證資料,監督訊號極少,因此團隊完全採用現成元件,免任務訓練。檢索器以迭代方式運作:LLM 將問題拆解為子查詢,混合 BM25 稀疏檢索與 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 密集檢索,經 Qwen3-Reranker-8B 重排,再由 LLM(GPT-5.4)驗證證據是否充分,最多三輪,並加入偽相關回饋。關鍵的 Relate 步驟以種子論文為起點,結合 SPECTER2 語意嵌入、書目耦合與 BM25 進行論文對論文擴展,再與問題錨定排名以 RRF 融合。讀取器以 MinerU 解析 PDF,分兩階段:先逐篇判斷相關性與可用證據,再跨論文綜合,生成答案與證據軌跡。結果顯示驗證集 recall@50 達 0.968;加入論文擴展後,多論文題型的 recall@50 由 0.647 提升至 0.940,效益顯著。官方測試集上,論文檢索 macro F1 為 0.992,證據 macro F1 為 0.737,選擇題準確率為 1.000,表格作答仍具挑戰性,總排名第四。限制在於僅於單一任務評估、未消融各擴展訊號的個別貢獻、泛化能力未知。本文展示在標註稀缺時,免訓練的模組化管線加上論文關聯擴展,能有效支援證據扎根的文獻問答。

Footnote 6 (Section 3.3): consensus-voting overhead asserted 'negligible' without measured cost breakdown; no GPU hardware specified for throughput in Section 4.1
Appendix D Table 9 / Appendix E Table 10: VideoMM-Lite (Qwen3-VL-4B selector) throughput 3.69→4.19 with acc 67.54→66.34; three-stage variant 64.55 acc at 5.91 samples/min
Section 5 Conclusion: code availability claimed at https://github.com/adfh917k/VideoMM; footnote 3 notes three intermediate layers used for L_mid without exact layer indices
llm_evaluation.rationale: Training-free inference framework for video MLLMs: Stage I performs MLLM-attention-guided token selection on spatially downscaled 'macro' frames (k=2, G=4 groups), Stage II uses group-wise consensus voting for early exit, escalating to high-resolution 'micro' tokens only on disagreement. In scope (multimodal LLM inference efficiency, not pure CV), but it targets video benchmarks rather than the highest-weight preference areas (reasoning, agents, code, safety); relevance is moderate-to-good via Multimodal AI, Long Context, Inference/Serving, and Efficiency. Novelty is moderate: coarse-to-fine selection, attention-based importance (cf. VisionZip/FlexSelect), and self-consistency voting are combined into a new 'perceptual granularity' framing with a macro-to-micro token mapping (Eq. 7) and adaptive computation. Rigor is solid: three MLLMs, three benchmarks, unified 8,192-token budget, iso-throughput comparison (Table 2), ablations over k, frames, adaptive variants, a three-stage variant, and early-exit statistics; however, the claimed 'negligible' consensus overhead is asserted rather than measured, hardware for throughput is unspecified, and the accuracy-gain figure is inconsistent (7.4% in abstract vs 7.0% in Section 1). Evidence strength is good given detailed per-task tables and Pareto analyses, though gains over vanilla are marginal on the strongest model (Qwen3-VL-8B: +0.4 avg, and −0.2 on VideoMME per Table 1). Generalizability is decent across dynamic-resolution MLLMs but limited to multiple-choice video QA. Reproducibility is moderate: code URL given and hyperparameters disclosed, but layer indices for L_mid and evaluation hardware are not pinned down.

primary_link.title: VideoMM: Adaptive Macro-Micro Inference for Efficient Video MLLMs

radar.summary: Scaling Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to long-form video understanding is bottlenecked by the explosion of visual tokens, which saturates context windows and incurs prohibitive costs. Current solutions predominantly rely on auxiliary models for token reduction but face a fundamental dilemma: lightweight encoder-driven approaches often overlook critical semantic information, whereas heavyweight MLLM-driven reduction negates the efficiency gains. {In this work, we identify a more fundam
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型在長影片理解上受視覺 token 爆炸所苦:十分鐘的 720p 影片在 Qwen3-VL 中可產生逾 30 萬個 token,迅速耗盡上下文視窗。現有精簡方法陷入兩難:輕量級 encoder 驅動方法語意感知不足,易誤刪關鍵資訊;重量級 MLLM 驅動方法雖提升準確率,輔助模型開銷卻抵銷加速效益。本文提出 VideoMM,將典範從模型規模縮減轉向自適應感知粒度,核心洞察是:高解析度細節對精確推理必要,但對「挑選語意相關區域」的前置任務大多冗餘。方法分兩階段:第一階段以降取樣 k=2 的 Macro Proxy 執行 MLLM 引導的分組選取,利用中間層跨模態注意力對影格與 token 進行階層式篩選;第二階段採共識投票機制,各群組答案一致即提前輸出,僅在出現分歧時才將選中巨觀區域映射至高解析度 Micro Token 進行細粒度推理。實驗以 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、GLM-4.1V-9B 與 Qwen3-VL-8B 在 LongVideoBench、VideoMME、LVBench 上驗證:相較完整上下文基線,VideoMM 達 6.13 倍加速與約 7 個百分點準確率提升,並較 FlexSelect 快 2.73 倍,早期退出率約 70%。限制方面:激進降取樣 k=3 會使 LongVideoBench 準確率由 67.54 降至 65.89,三階段 VideoMM-multi 與多數決變體亦以精度換取速度。整體而言,本文證實巨觀-微觀感知粒度能建立更優的 Pareto 前沿,對長影片多模態系統的實際部署深具價值。

links.title: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals

evidence: Abstract: 'eleven generators are exploited on 8–26% of an unbiased 150-environment cut' and 'holding one generator's 45 rubrics, attack responses, and judge scores fixed while changing only the Oracle configuration yields 33.3%, 75.6%, and 66.7% exploitation'

§4.1: formal exploitation definition exploited(g,e) iff J(a*) ≥ J(a0) and ¬Hc(a*), with explicit validity conditions and acknowledgment that the attacker is an LLM so rates are 'empirical exploitability under this threat model rather than a theoretical upper bound'
Table 3 (§5): Full-150 leaderboard from Opus 5 at 8% to GPT-5.4-mini at 26%; Hard-45 rates 36–98%; certificate-faithful reference 0/45 vs naive decisiveness proxy 64%
§6.2: safety-prompt ablation leaves residual exploitation (Opus 5 22%, GPT-5.6-sol 36%, Sonnet 5 49%) with unadjusted McNemar p=0.109/0.508/0.039 and single-draw caveats
§6.1/Table 4: rubric resampling (k=3, k=6 for Opus 4.8) with cluster-bootstrap CIs; resampled means drop 7.7–15.8 points; Sonnet≈Haiku not separable
§F: single-rater human calibration, 38/40 agreement, κ=0.89, with explicit note 'There is one rater, so inter-annotator agreement is unmeasured'

§M: frozen-answer Oracle swap across three configurations with paired McNemar/Holm tests; baseline audit finds omitted certificate requirements and a source-attribution discrepancy, so 'agreement does not establish correctness'
§H: per-type analysis on Full-150 showing discrimination concentrated in evidence_insufficient (52–60%) and objective_conflict (16–24%), with false_premise at 0% across generators
Appendix A: build-time provenance contract (158 real_web_grounded + 11 hybrid; 109 verifiable + 60 partial) enforced in CI
§J: best-of-N without adversary — 5/18 environments yield no honest sample, rubric-argmax violates certificate 0/13 times, best-of-N beats random selection by −16.7% [−30.0, −5.6]
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work directly matching top preferences: LLM-as-a-judge, reward hacking in rubric-as-reward RL, adversarial evaluation, and abstention. The contribution is a genuinely new stress-testing angle (attacking generator-emitted rubrics against oracle certificates on evidence-constrained impossible tasks), with a formal exploitation definition (§4.1) rather than a pure application. Rigor is unusually strong: 11 generators on a 150-env unbiased cut plus a selected Hard-45, judge swaps (60/60 verdict stability, §E), held-out attacker (§G), rubric resampling with cluster bootstraps (§6.1), safety-prompt ablation (§6.2), multiplicity corrections (§D, §5), a negative control against degenerate refusal rubrics (§K), and a best-of-N realistic-selection study (§J). The paper is candid that evidence is conditional: Oracle swaps move the same frozen attacks from 33.3% to 75.6% exploitation (§M), the human calibration uses a single rater with 40 items (§F), headline GPT-5.6 rates are k=1 draws, and baseline/certificate inconsistencies were found in audit (§M). Absolute label validity therefore remains open, and discrimination concentrates in only two of six impossibility types (§H), limiting generalizability. Reproducibility is supported by pre-registration, pinned API configs, CI-enforced provenance contracts (Appendix A), and claimed artifact releases, though links are placeholders in the text. Overall a high-quality, highly relevant benchmark paper whose measured magnitudes must be read with its own verification-protocol caveats.

primary_link.title: ImpossibleRubrics: Stress-Testing Generated Rubrics as Reward Signals

top5.summary: Language model-generated rubrics are increasingly used as reward signals for rubric-based reinforcement learning, LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and automated grading. Such rubrics are reliable only if they reward honest answers over adversarial answers optimized to exploit them. Yet their robustness to such optimization remains poorly understood. We isolate the hardest regime: impossible tasks, where the prompt pressures the model toward an unsupported conclusion, so the only honest response is to
top5.summary_zh: 語言模型自動生成的評分準則（rubric）正被廣泛用作強化學習的獎勵訊號、LLM-as-a-judge 評審與自動評分，但其可靠性取決於是否會獎勵誠實回答勝過刻意利用準則漏洞的對抗性回答。本文聚焦「不可能任務」：題目迫使模型給出證據不支持的結論，誠實的回答必須承認衝突或證據缺口。作者建立 ImpossibleRubrics 基準，包含 169 個橫跨六種不可能類型的任務，每個環境附有封閉證據包與可機器驗證的 oracle 證書，明定允許與禁止的主張，另含 48 個可回答的對照題。評測採對抗流程：生成器以中性提示（不透露任務不可答）產出準則，固定攻擊者（Claude Opus）據準則撰寫追求高分的回答，字面評審（Claude Haiku）將其與誠實基準比較，再由 oracle 判定是否違反證書。結果顯示，十一個生成器在無偏的 Full-150 上有 8–26% 的準則被利用，呈現能力分層梯度；在挑選過的 Hard-45 壓力集上最高達 98%（Haiku 4.5）、最低 36%（Opus 5），而忠於證書的固定準則為 0/45，通用果斷回答代理指標則為 64%。穩健性分析排除了評審、攻擊者與組成混淆，但僅更換 oracle 就使同一批凍結攻擊的利用率在 33.3% 至 75.6% 間變動，且共用證書與基準答案瑕疵使一致同意無法視為獨立真值，顯示測得的數字高度依賴驗證協定。此研究揭露自動生成獎勵準則的可剝削性，為 rubric-as-reward 訓練與評測的安全性提供了重要警示與可重用的測試資源。

Appendix C.1: causal validation repeated under seeds 42/43/44 for six methods on Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology research: layer-importance diagnostics for transformers vs. Mamba-style SSMs, with LoRA/PEFT placement, pruning, and interpretability implications, so it matches several high-weight preferences (LLMs, Transformer Architecture, Interpretability, Training & Optimization). The Necessity-Plasticity Alignment diagnostic and the architecture-conditional sign split are genuinely new relative to single-estimator prior work, supported by a formal appendix whose scope is stated honestly (Remark A.5 explicitly walks back an earlier overclaim). Rigor is strong: layer-0 leave-out, submodule-matched scopes, adapter-free full-FT control on 13 checkpoints, weight-norm normalization, k-sweep, three seeds, EWC and published-method baselines, and statistical tests. Evidence for the diagnostic split is robust (Table 11: transformer mean -0.39 at <=14B vs. Mamba mean +0.24); evidence for downstream consequences is real but modest, and the paper itself flags small causal-validation margins (0.01-0.05, Appendix C.3/E.5). Generalizability is appropriately but genuinely limited: the negative-transformer result fails beyond 14B (Qwen3-32B +0.07, Llama-3.1-70B +0.01), hybrids rest on one checkpoint, and only LoRA/full-FT adaptation procedures are tested. Code, per-layer scores, and analysis scripts are released.

primary_link.title: What Does Layer-Importance Reveal About Transformers and State-Space Models?

top5.summary: Transformers and state-space models (SSMs) are the two dominant families of sequence models, and a central open question is how far the analytical knowledge built for transformers transfers to SSMs. We address this through the lens of layer importance which underpins compression, selective fine-tuning, and interpretability across both families. We decompose layer importance into two distinct notions. \emph{Necessity} captures how much the pretrained model depends on a layer's existing contributi
top5.summary_zh: 「層重要性」廣泛用於模型壓縮、選擇性 fine-tuning 與可解釋性分析，但這些工具多在 Transformer 上發展，能否直接套用到狀態空間模型（SSM）是本文核心問題。作者將層重要性拆解為兩個概念：Necessity 衡量預訓練模型對某層既有計算的依賴，以旁路該層造成的損失上升量化；Plasticity 衡量 fine-tuning 時模型於何處吸收新資訊，以 LoRA 更新幅度量化；兩者排名的 Spearman 相關即為本文提出的 NPA 診斷指標。結果顯示清晰分歧：所有受評估、參數量至 14B 的殘差 Transformer 均呈負 NPA，早期層最必要、後期層最可塑；所有受評估的 Mamba 型 SSM 均呈正 NPA，兩種量集中於重疊區域；Qwen3-32B 與 Llama-3.1-70B 則趨近於零。此分歧在排除 layer 0、改用全參數 fine-tuning 的控制下依然成立，並延伸至 RWKV 與混合架構 Zamba2。雙任務遺忘探針顯示：Transformer 中挑選最可塑層會顯著加劇遺忘，SSM 則無此層級效應；作者並以殘差幾何與 Fisher 曲率提出機制解釋。限制包括：重要性定義僅涵蓋消融與更新幅度兩種錨定量測，架構結論限於受評估的 checkpoints，理論依賴簡化假設，遺忘實驗亦僅為雙任務機制探針而非完整基準。本文指出層重要性並非與架構無關的普適排序，Transformer 校準的工具套用於 SSM 或混合架構時可能默默失效，應視為量測問題，並依架構調整 adapter 放置與正則化策略。
top5.title: What Does Layer-Importance Reveal About Transformers and State-Space Models?

links.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers

evidence: Abstract: 'A fixed quarter step recovers positive gains in reference utility for 72.2-83.2% of selected failures across four settings', with quadratic selection raising recovery from 71.0% to 94.2% on Ouro-1.4B/GSM8K test (Sec. 5, Table 12).

Sec. 4.2 / Table 1: finite-step failures occur in all nine model-task conditions (1.4-49.2% of harmful updates); adding curvature improves sign accuracy to 97.2-99.9% and reduces MAE by 5.9-29.8x across all nine matched conditions.

Sec. 4.3 / Table 2: predicted vs. empirical scales have Spearman >0.995 and the quadratic rule reduces mean grid regret by more than two orders of magnitude vs. first-order and vs. best hindsight fixed scale.

Sec. 4.3 / Table 15: integrated curvature bound C̄/κ has median 0.058-0.114 versus 2.84-4.61 for the global third-derivative bound and covers numerical scale-error intervals of all 2034 primary updates.

Appendix F (Limitations): interventions scale an already computed proposal and evaluate 'before further recurrence'; accumulation over trajectories, generation quality, and computation cost are left unestablished, limiting practical impact claims.

Appendix E.1: on Ouro-1.4B/HellaSwag, mean utility change at 4→5 is -0.008006 [-0.010838, -0.004991] while option accuracy rises 68.4%→69.2%, showing reference utility and discrete accuracy can diverge, so evidence ties to the utility metric rather than task accuracy.

Appendix E.2: reproducibility support includes fixed seeds (20260904), precision settings (TF32 disabled, FP64 checks), replay differences ≤8.89e-16, and 144 derivative-check passes, but no explicit code or artifact release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic/analytical study of looped transformer language models (Ouro, Huginn) for test-time scaling and latent reasoning, directly aligned with high-weight LLM, reasoning, and transformer-architecture preferences. The direction-vs-step-scale decomposition of finite-step failure, pathwise curvature identity, and integrated-curvature error bounds are a genuinely fresh angle relative to overthinking and stability literature, though state-interpolation analysis has partial precedent (acknowledged TRM work). Rigor is exceptionally high: proven propositions, stated assumptions, FP32/FP64 derivative cross-checks, prespecified protocols, bootstrap CIs, and complete benchmark coverage. Evidence is strong within its defined scope (teacher-forced reference utility, immediate post-update effect), but the paper itself shows utility and discrete accuracy can diverge (Appendix E.1) and does not demonstrate end-task generation gains. Generalizability is limited to frozen looped LMs with differentiable readouts; no code release is stated despite unusually detailed numerical protocols and seeds.

primary_link.title: Right Direction, Wrong Step: Geometric Analysis of Finite-Step Failure in Looped Transformers

top5.summary: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient route to test-time scaling by reusing shared layers for iterative latent reasoning. However, additional iterations can reduce support for a reference answer, leaving unclear whether an update's direction is locally unhelpful or its full displacement moves too far. We study this distinction by analysing reference utility, which measures this support, along the model's own update direction, varying the fraction of the proposed displacement supplied t
top5.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 Looped Transformers（重複套用共用層迭代潛在推理的模型）在測試期運算擴增時的現象：多跑一次迴圈反而降低對參考答案的支持。作者區分兩種情況——更新方向本身無益，或方向有益但整步位移走得太遠，並將後者定義為有限步失效。方法上，在凍結模型與固定 readout 下，沿模型自身提出的更新方向以步長 α 內插隱藏狀態，定義參考效用並做路徑曲率分解：初步改善 A 可能被累積曲率校正抵銷。局部二次模型以 A、Q 預測全步增益與效用最大的步長，並以沿路徑積分的曲率變化推導近似誤差與後悔上界。實驗涵蓋 Ouro-1.4B/2.6B 與 Huginn 於 MATH-500、GSM8K、HellaSwag 共九種條件：九種條件皆出現有限步失效，占有害更新的 1.4–49.2%；加入曲率項後全步增益符號準確率達 97.2–99.9%，二次規則步長預測與網格最佳值相關性超過 0.995；固定四分之一步長回復四個設定中 72.2–83.2% 的選定失效，Ouro-1.4B/GSM8K 上的二次步長選擇更將回復率從 71.0% 提升至 94.2%。限制在於分析針對凍結模型、teacher forcing 下的單次更新與立即效用，未延伸至生成軌跡、後續狀態與運算成本。其意義在於指出方向與步長不匹配是遞迴運算喪失進展的機制，啟發除選擇迴圈次數外，也應決定每次更新的套用比例。

links.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 6.83x lossless inference speedup across diverse Looped Transformers; code and project page links provided
Section 5, Theorem 1: restart probability bounded by epsilon_2 independent of d_1 (2*epsilon_2 with gating), proof in Appendix G.1
Section 5, Theorem 2 and Eq. 8: closed-form optimal depths (1.26, 8.85) from power-law envelope (alpha=1.03, beta=0.175), matching empirical best (2,8) for Raven-Llama-3.2
Section 6, Table 1: speedups 2.64x-6.83x and gamma up to 14.86 across GSM8K, MATH-500, BBH, HumanEval+, MBPP+ on 5 base checkpoints
Section 6.3, Table 3: ablation on Raven-Llama-3.2 shows residual second proposal plus gating lifts speedups from 3.24x-4.59x to 3.74x-5.00x over non-residual second proposal
Section 6.3, Figure 4 and Appendix C: LoopSpec beats training-based DFlash (SpecForge, OpenR1-Math-220k, 10k steps) by up to 1.7x under identical SGLang settings
Appendix A, Table 4: exact HuggingFace checkpoint identifiers for all 7 evaluated models; Table 5 lists prompting protocols and generation budgets
Appendix B: branch-wise KV cache reuse and CUDA Graph strategies on a single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell in BF16
Appendix D, Table 6: gate opening frequency 18.75%-40.40%; effective batch size reduced (e.g., 43.75 to 34.06 mean on Raven-Llama-3.2)
Appendix E: first proposals commit 86.57%-96.31% of tokens, second proposals recover most of the rest, at most 2.95% full restarts
Limitation signal: Section 6.1 notes gamma can overstate wall-clock gains due to pre/post-layer costs; evaluations are single-batch, and Section 4.3 requires d_2 and R divisible by d_1
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-inference methodology paper: training-free self-speculative pipelined decoding for looped transformers, evaluated on standard LLM reasoning (GSM8K, MATH-500, BBH, AIME) and code (HumanEval+, MBPP+) benchmarks with LLM checkpoints (Llama-3.2, OLMo-2, TinyLlama derivatives), fitting LLM, inference/serving, and efficiency preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental within the speculative-decoding lineage (Draft & Verify, LayerSkip, SPEED): the residual second proposal, gating, cascade verification, and closed-form optimal depths via power-law TV decay are tailored contributions rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is strong: two theorems with full proofs (Appendix G), theory-experiment match on depth selection ((1.26,8.85) predicted vs (2,8) best), ablations (Table 3), gate-frequency analysis (Appendix D), and fair DFlash comparison with documented training (Appendix C). Evidence is consistent and quantitative (Table 1: 2.64x-6.83x; Table 2 up to 2.95x), with the lossless property guaranteed by rejection sampling. Generalizability is limited to looped/recurrent-depth architectures and divisibility constraints on depths; single-GPU single-batch evaluation. Reproducibility is high: public code, project page, HuggingFace checkpoint IDs (Table 4), benchmark configs (Table 5), hardware/precision, and pseudocode (Appendix H).

primary_link.title: LoopSpec: Pipelined Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers

top5.summary: Looped Transformers achieve strong performance with compact parameter sizes by repeatedly applying a shared stack of Transformer blocks across recurrent depths. However, they incur higher decoding latency than standard Transformer models of comparable parameter size because shared weights are accessed at every recurrent depth. To improve decoding efficiency, self-speculative decoding is particularly well suited to Looped Transformers, as their intermediate recurrent states can directly provide d
top5.summary_zh: Looped Transformers 透過在多個遞迴深度反覆套用共享的 Transformer 區塊，以極少參數達到相當效能，但每個解碼步驟都需反覆存取相同權重，使推論受限於記憶體頻寬而延遲偏高。本文提出 LoopSpec，一個免訓練的自推測解碼框架：利用淺層遞迴狀態產生草稿 token，並立即開始後續 token 的運算，與目標驗證形成管線化重疊執行；再從較深層引入殘差式第二提案與閘控機制，在第一提案被拒時提供備援分支，並以級聯拒絕抽樣保證在貪心與抽樣解碼下皆與目標模型分布完全一致（無損）。理論上，作者證明重啟機率僅取決於第二提案深度的近似誤差，與第一提案無關；並利用中間層與目標分布間總變差距離的冪次衰減規律，推導出最佳提案深度的封閉解，與實測最佳設定（d1=2、d2=8）高度吻合。實作上，團隊擴充 SGLang，採用分支層級的 KV cache 管理與 CUDA Graph 最佳化，在 Ouro（R=4）與 Raven（R=32）兩系列共七個檢查點上，於 GSM8K、MATH-500、BBH、HumanEval+、MBPP+ 及 AIME 等基準取得最高 6.83 倍的無損加速，並比需訓練草稿模型的 DFlash 快達 1.7 倍。限制方面，平均接受長度 γ 未計入 pre/post 層的額外成本，過小的 d1 會增加草稿與分支開銷；評估僅於單一批次情境進行，且要求各深度間具整除關係。整體而言，本方法將遞迴深度轉化為 token 位置間的平行度，為輕量迴圈式模型提供無需額外草稿模型或訓練的高效推論路徑。

links.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems rely on.'
Section 2: unforgeability defined as E(t)∩C=∅ for every attacker-chosen t; nameless tokens implemented by serializing the tokenizer, emptying the added-token table, and dropping the post-processor.
Section 3, Table 1: all 256 tokenizers forgeable by default; with split_special_tokens, 56.6% remain forgeable; 16,415 perturbations yield 0.0% reserved identifiers under nameless tokenization.
Section 4, Table 2: every defense reproduces the standard token stream on 100.0% of attack-free host prompts; delimiter fidelity probe 8.5% (none) vs 59.9% (nameless) vs 2.2% (strip).

Section 4, Table 3: forged turn 99.9% (none) vs 92.8% (nameless); forged tool 33.1% vs 7.4%; Section 5, Table 6: on checkpoints lacking training separation, nameless cuts forged system from 98.0% to 66.6%.

Limitations: evaluation covers five models, three host tasks, two objectives; nameless tokenization raises forged-system success from 46.9% to 68.0% averaged over models under the task-only system message; artifact release of renderer, audit harness, attacks, and per-item generations is promised but not verifiable from the text.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope LLM safety/security paper on tokenizer-level prompt-injection defense for open-weight models, directly relevant to LLMs, AI safety, agents/tool channels, and red-team evaluation. Novelty is solid: a formal threat model (Section 2: E(t)∩C=∅) plus a 256-tokenizer audit (Section 3, Table 1: 100% forgeable by default, 56.6% even with split_special_tokens) and a by-construction defense are new angles relative to training-level defenses (StruQ, SecAlign, ISE, ASIDE). Rigor is good: attacks differ only in the delimiter (Section 4), isolating surface vs identifier contributions with bootstrap ranges (99.9→92.8, 91.4-94.1), and losslessness is verified (Table 2: 100.0% identical token streams). Evidence is strong and unusually honest, reporting that nameless tokenization worsens forged-system success from 46.9% to 68.0% under a task-only system message (Limitations). Deductions: deep evaluation covers only 5 models, 296 host items and 200 probe items, with small absolute numbers; reproducibility relies on promised artifact release (Limitations/Appendix B) rather than verified availability.

primary_link.title: Nameless Tokenization: A Lossless Tokenizer-Level Defense Against Control-Token Forgery in Open-Weight LLMs

top5.summary: Open-weight language models publish the strings their chat templates use to mark turns, roles and tool results, which the tokenizer maps back to the reserved identifiers the model obeys. Anyone who controls text in a prompt can therefore write a turn boundary indistinguishable from one the serving stack wrote. We audit 256 deployed chat tokenizers. All are forgeable, and the flag usually recommended as a fix leaves 56.6% forgeable because it misses the tool and reasoning markers agent systems re
top5.summary_zh: 開放權重語言模型的聊天範本控制字串是公開的,分詞器會把訊息內容中出現的這些字串映射回保留識別碼,攻擊者因此可偽造與伺服器端無法區分的輪次邊界。稽核 256 個已部署聊天分詞器發現全部可偽造;建議的 split_special_tokens 旗標仍留下 56.6% 可偽造,漏洞集中在工具呼叫與推理標記。本文提出無名標記化(nameless tokenization):控制詞表條目只留識別碼而無表面字串,內容編碼器便無法產生控制識別碼;範本層直接寫入識別碼,內容逐字原樣送達,由建構保證通道不可偽造且無損。在五個分詞器家族上,此法對無攻擊資料 100% 重現標準 token 流,主機任務準確率幾乎不變;含分隔符文字的探測由 8.5% 升至 59.9%,遠優於刪除、遮罩或同形字替換等清理式防禦。拆解顯示:純任務系統訊息下,偽造輪次成功主要來自分隔符外觀而非識別碼;但當系統訊息要求將使用者內容視為資料時,關閉識別碼通道正是擋下偽造輪次與工具結果的關鍵,如 Qwen 工具通道由 53.4% 降至 0.7%。限制:評估僅涵蓋五個模型、三項任務與兩種注入目標,絕對攻擊率不宜推及部署風險;無損僅指內容,偽造系統輪次反而更易得逞(46.9%→68.0%);保證僅限文字到識別碼介面,直接提供識別碼的呼叫端不在範圍。此法以近乎零成本關閉提示注入中唯一可獲建構性保證的通道,應成為開放權重部署的預設。
